original: naisargiko'yaṃ lokavyavahāraḥ" ityantaṃ bhāṣyaṃ "asyānarthahetoḥ prahāṇāya ātmaikatvavidyāpratipattaye sarve vedāntā ārabhyante" ityanena bhāṣyeṇa paryavasyat, śāstrasya viṣayaḥ prayojanaṃ ca arthāt prathamasūtreṇa sūtrite iti pratipādayati iti|

original: nanu kathaṃ bhāṣyadvayameva viṣayaprayojane pratipādayati śāstrārambhanimittaviṣayaprayojanasiddhihetoḥ adhyāsasya upasthāpakatvāt iti brūmaḥ; hetuvacanaṃ hi pratijñātārthameva sādhayati||

original: tathā hi -- etat śāstraṃ, ārambhaṇīyam, sambhāvitaviṣayaprayojanavatvāt, kṛṣyādyārambhavat ; śāstraṃ ca, sambhāvitaviṣayaprayojanam, avidyātmakabandhapratyanīkatvāt, jāgradbodhavat iti||

original: tadevaṃ śāstrasyārambhanimittaviṣayaprayojanavattvapratyanīkasya bandhasya avidyātmakatvaṃ nirdiśat bhāṣyadvayaṃ viṣayayojane pratipādayati iti|| nanu bandhasyāvidyātmakatvalakṣaṇo heturasiddhaḥ, kathamasiddhaṃ asiddhena sādhyate iti ata āha -- sarve vedāntā ārabhyante ityanena bhāṣyeṇa paryavasyat iti|
analyzed: tat evam śāstrasya ārambha nimitta viṣaya prayojanavat tva pratyanīkasya bandhasya avidyā ātmaka tvam nirdiśat bhāṣya dvayam viṣaya yojane pratipādayati iti nanu bandhasya avidyā ātmaka tva lakṣaṇaḥ hetuḥ asiddhaḥ katham asiddham asiddhena sādhyate iti atas āha sarve vedāntāḥ ārabhyante iti anena bhāṣyeṇa paryavasyat iti

original: viṣayādisiddhihetoḥ adhyāsasya siddhihetubhūtāni lakṣaṇasambhāvanāsadbhāvapramāṇāni pratipādayatā bhāṣyeṇa saha lakṣaṇādibhiḥ svārthaṃ adhyāsaṃ sādhayitvā viṣayaprayojane sādhayati ityarthaḥ| ata eva vyavadhānāvyavadhānābhyāṃ viṣayādeḥ sādhakatvāt etadantam anena paryavasyat iti bhāṣyasya vibhāgena upādānaṃ kṛtam||
analyzed: viṣaya ādi siddhi hetoḥ adhyāsasya siddhi hetu bhūtāni lakṣaṇa sambhāvanā sadbhāva pramāṇāni pratipādayatā bhāṣyeṇa saha lakṣaṇa ādibhiḥ svārtham adhyāsam sādhayitvā viṣaya prayojane sādhayati iti arthaḥ atas eva vyavadhāna avyavadhānābhyām viṣaya ādeḥ sādhaka tvāt etad antam anena paryavasyat iti bhāṣyasya vibhāgena upādānam kṛtam

original: nanu tarhi "sarvalokapratyakṣaḥ" ityanena paryavasyat iti vaktavyam| satyam;"asyānarthahetoḥ" iti bhāṣyasya viṣayaprayojanayoḥ vedāntavākyasambandhakathanadvāreṇa vicāraśāstrasambandhapratipādanaparatvāt vicāraśāstrīyaviṣayaprayojanasādhane savyavadhānatvasāmyena pūrvabhāṣyeṇa saha upādānaṃ kṛtam||
analyzed: nanu tarhi sarva loka pratyakṣaḥ iti anena paryavasyat iti vaktavyam satyam asya anartha hetoḥ iti bhāṣyasya viṣaya prayojanayoḥ vedānta vākya sambandha kathana dvāreṇa vicāra śāstra sambandha pratipādana paratvāt vicāra śāstrīya viṣaya prayojana sādhane savyavadhāna tva sāmyena pūrva bhāṣyeṇa saha upādānam kṛtam

original: nanu -- evamapi asūtrasambandhinī viṣayaprayojane kimiti pratipādyete iti ata āha -- viṣayaḥ prayojanaṃ ca arthāt prathamasūtreṇa sūtrite itīti| itiśabdo hetau| yasmāt prathamasūtreṇa arthāt sūtrite tasmāt pratipādayati iti||
analyzed: nanu evam api asūtra sambandhinī viṣaya prayojane kim iti pratipādyete iti atas āha viṣayaḥ prayojanam ca arthāt prathama sūtreṇa sūtrite iti iti iti iti śabdaḥ hetau yasmāt prathama sūtreṇa arthāt sūtrite tasmāt pratipādayati iti

original: kaḥ punarasyasūtrasya prasaṅgaḥ ucyate; nityenava adhyayanavidhinā adhītasvādhyāyaḥ vedāntavākyeṣu āpātadarśanena idamavagacchati -- "atmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyam" ityupakramāt sarvato viraktasya ātmaprepsoḥ "ātmani vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñātam" "etāvadare khalvamṛtatvam" ityupasaṃhārāt amṛtatvasādhanaṃ
analyzed: kaḥ punar asya sūtrasya prasaṅgaḥ ucyate adhyayana vidhinā adhīta svādhyāyaḥ vedānta vākyeṣu āpāta darśanena idam avagacchati kāmāya sarvam priyam iti upakramāt sarvatas viraktasya ātma prepsoḥ ātmani vijñāte sarvam idam vijñātam etāvat are khalu amṛta tvam iti upasaṃhārāt amṛta tva sādhanam

original: ātmadarśanaṃ "draṣṭavyaḥ" ityanūdya tādarthyena manananididhyāsanābhyāṃ phalopakāryāṅgābhyāṃ saha śravaṇaṃ nāma aṅgi vidhīyate iti| sa ca -- tatra kiyadviśeṣaṇaparyantaḥ adhikārī ko vā asau vedāntavākyavicāraḥ anyataḥ prāptaḥ aprāpto vā kathaṃ ca ātmajñānaṃ mokṣasādhanam kimpramāṇakaṃ ca tat kiṃ vā tat ātmatattvam kimpramāṇakaṃ ca iti jijñāsate|
analyzed: ātma darśanam draṣṭavyaḥ iti anūdya tādarthyena manana nididhyāsanābhyām phala upakārya aṅgābhyām saha śravaṇam nāma aṅgi vidhīyate iti sa ca tatra kiyat viśeṣaṇa paryantaḥ adhikārī kaḥ vā asau vedānta vākya vicāraḥ anyatas prāptaḥ aprāptaḥ vā katham ca ātma jñānam mokṣa sādhanam kimpramāṇakam ca tat kim vā tat ātma tattvam kimpramāṇakam ca iti jijñāsate

original: taṃ ca jijñāsuṃ puruṣārthakāmaṃ upalabhamāno bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ sādhanacatuṣṭayasampannasya mokṣasādhanabrahmajñānāya vedāntavākyavicāraṃ vidadhato vidheḥ apekṣitādhikāriviṣayaphalānubandhatrayaṃ āgamikamapi nyāyena nirṇetuṃ sūtrayāmāsa -- "athāto brahmajijñāsā" iti; śrutisūtrayoḥ aikarūpyāvagamāt|
analyzed: tam ca jijñāsum puruṣa artha kāmam upalabhamānaḥ bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ sādhana catuṣṭaya sampannasya mokṣa sādhana brahma jñānāya vedānta vākya vicāram vidadhataḥ vidheḥ apekṣita adhikāri viṣaya phala anubandha trayam āgamikam api nyāyena nirṇetum sūtrayāmāsa atha atas brahma jijñāsā iti śruti sūtrayoḥ aikarūpya avagamāt

original: manananididhyāsanayośca śravaṇāṅgatvaṃ uttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ|| nanu "śrotavya" iti vidhiḥ mokṣasādhanabrahmātmajñānāya vedāntavākyavicāraṃ sādhanacatuṣṭayasampannasya vidhātuṃ na śaknoti; śravaṇādīnāṃ viṣayāvagamaṃ prati anvayavyatirekasiddhasādhanatvāt, na ca avaghātādivat ubhayārthatā sambhavati;
analyzed: manana nididhyāsanayoḥ ca śravaṇa aṅga tvam uttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ nanu śrotavyaḥ iti vidhiḥ mokṣa sādhana brahma ātma jñānāya vedānta vākya vicāram sādhana catuṣṭaya sampannasya vidhātum na śaknoti śravaṇa ādīnām viṣaya avagamam prati anvaya vyatireka siddha sādhana tvāt na ca avaghāta ādi vat ubhaya artha tā sambhavati

original: dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprakāradvayasādhyāpūrvavat iha adṛṣṭasādhyasyābhāvāt, ātmāvagamasya dṛṣṭopāyamātrasādhyatvāt -- iti, naitat sāram; ātmatattvāparokṣyasya sarvādṛṣṭasādhyatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt avaghātādivat ubhayarthatayā vidhānopapatteḥ|
analyzed: dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa prakāra dvaya sādhya apūrva vat iha adṛṣṭa sādhyasya abhāvāt ātma avagamasya dṛṣṭa upāya mātra sādhya tvāt iti na etat sāram ātma tattva aparokṣyasya sarva adṛṣṭa sādhya tvasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt avaghāta ādi vat ubhaya artha tayā vidhāna upapatteḥ

original: nanu vidhiparatve vedāntānāṃ tanniṣṭhatayā brahmasvarūpasya asiddhyādidoṣaprasaṅgāt nāsti śravaṇādividhānaṃ iti bhāṣyakāraireva darśitam, satyam jñānavidhiḥ tatra nirākṛtaḥ, na śravaṇādividhiḥ; tatra uktadoṣaprasaṅgābhāvāt|
analyzed: nanu vidhi paratve vedāntānām tad niṣṭhatayā brahma svarūpasya asiddhi ādi doṣa prasaṅgāt na asti śravaṇa ādi vidhānam iti bhāṣyakāraiḥ eva darśitam satyam jñāna vidhiḥ tatra nirākṛtaḥ na śravaṇa ādi vidhiḥ tatra ukta doṣa prasaṅga abhāvāt

original: katham darśanavidhāne hi brahma karmatayā guṇabhūtaṃ prasajyate, brahmadarśanamuddiśya vicāravidhāne tu svapradhānaphalabhūtadarśanaviśeṣaṇatayā brahmāpi svapradhānaṃ bhavati, na tu guṇabhūtaṃ iti, vedāntaiḥ brahmaṇi svapradhāne pratipādyamāne taddarśanāya śravaṇādividhānaṃ naiva virudhyate||
analyzed: katham darśana vidhāne hi brahma karma tayā guṇa bhūtam prasajyate brahma darśanam uddiśya vicāra vidhāne tu sva pradhāna phala bhūta darśana viśeṣaṇa tayā brahma api sva pradhānam bhavati na tu guṇa bhūtam iti vedāntaiḥ brahmaṇi sva pradhāne pratipādyamāne tad darśanāya śravaṇa ādi vidhānam na eva virudhyate

original: nanu evamapi upakramopasaṃhārābhyāṃ ekasmin ātmapratipādanapare vākye kathaṃ avāntaravākyaiḥ śravaṇādividhānaṃ kalpyate iti avāntaravākyabhedena '"vividiṣanti" iti yajñādīnāṃ jñānasaṃyogavidhānavat, "upari hi devebhyaḥ" iti uparidhāraṇavidhānavat, malavadvāsaso vratakalāpavidhānavacceti brūmaḥ|
analyzed: nanu evam api upakrama upasaṃhārābhyām ekasmin ātma pratipādana pare vākye katham avāntaravākyaiḥ śravaṇa ādi vidhānam kalpyate iti avāntaravākya bhedena vividiṣanti iti yajña ādīnām jñāna saṃyoga vidhāna vat upari hi devebhyaḥ iti upari dhāraṇa vidhāna vat malavat vāsasaḥ vrata kalāpa vidhāna vat ca iti brūmaḥ

original: athavā -- "tasmād brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ nirvidya" ityādivākyaṃ śravaṇādividhāyakamastu; tasya tatparatvāt, sūtrakāreṇa ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt| sarvathā tāvat manananididhyāsanābhyāṃ aṅgabhūtābhyāṃ saha śravaṇavidhānaṃ astyeva| ataḥ tadapekṣitānubandhatrayanirṇayāya sūtramārabdham|
analyzed: athavā tasmāt brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityam nirvidya ityādi vākyam śravaṇa ādi vidhāyakam astu tasya tad paratvāt sūtrakāreṇa ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt sarvathā tāvat manana nididhyāsanābhyām aṅga bhūtābhyām saha śravaṇa vidhānam asti eva atas tad apekṣita anubandha traya nirṇayāya sūtram ārabdham

original: kartavye ca adhikāriṇā mokṣasādhanabrahmajñānāya vedāntavākyavicāre prathamasūtreṇa pratipādite, sa ca kartavyo vicāraḥ janmādisūtramārabhya pravartiṣyata iti| tatra vidhyapekṣiteṣu adhikāriviṣayaphalānubandheṣu viṣayaphalayoḥ upapādanāya bandhasya mithyātvaṃ atra varṇyate iti sūtrasaṅgatamevedaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ iti||
analyzed: kartavye ca adhikāriṇā mokṣa sādhana brahma jñānāya vedānta vākya vicāre prathama sūtreṇa pratipādite sa ca kartavyaḥ vicāraḥ janma ādi sūtram ārabhya pravartiṣyate iti tatra vidhi apekṣiteṣu adhikāri viṣaya phala anubandheṣu viṣaya phalayoḥ upapādanāya bandhasya mithyātvam atra varṇyate iti sūtra saṅgatam eva idam bhāṣyam vyākhyeyam iti

original: nanu yadi arthāt viṣayaprayojane sūtrite, tarhi bhāṣyakāreṇa sūtrasya tatra vyāpāraṃ darśayitvā ākṣepasamādhānapūrvakaṃ sākṣādeva pratipādanīye viṣayaprayojane; anyathā sūtrakārabhāṣyakārayoḥ tatra tātparyābhāvaprasaṅgāt iti, tatrāha -- etacca tasmād brahma jijñāsitavyamityādibhāṣye spaṣṭataraṃ iti||
analyzed: nanu yadi arthāt viṣaya prayojane sūtrite tarhi bhāṣyakāreṇa sūtrasya tatra vyāpāram darśayitvā ākṣepa samādhāna pūrvakam sākṣāt eva pratipādanīye viṣaya prayojane anyathā sūtrakāra bhāṣyakārayoḥ tatra tātparya abhāva prasaṅgāt iti tatra āha etat ca tasmāt brahma jijñāsitavyam ityādi bhāṣye spaṣṭataram iti

original: bhāṣyakāreṇoktam iti prajarśayiṣyāmaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ|
analyzed: bhāṣyakāreṇa uktam iti prajarśayiṣyāmaḥ iti adhyāhāraḥ

original: prathamaganthoktamevārthaṃ ākṣepasamādhānapūrvakaṃ atitarāṃ spaṣṭīkartuṃ codayati -- atrāha yadyevam iti|| nanu "asyānarthahetoḥ" iti bhāṣyavat pūrvabhāṣyamapi viṣayādikameva pratipādayati, kutaḥ tatra paryanuyogaḥ iti netyāha -- ahaṃ manuṣya iti dehendriyādiṣu ityādinā iti||
analyzed: prathama gantha uktam eva artham ākṣepa samādhāna pūrvakam atitarām spaṣṭīkartum codayati atra āha yadi evam iti nanu asya anartha hetoḥ iti bhāṣya vat pūrva bhāṣyam api viṣaya ādikam eva pratipādayati kutas tatra paryanuyogaḥ iti na iti āha aham manuṣyaḥ iti deha indriya ādiṣu ityādinā iti

original: atra vicārakartavyātāviṣayaprayojanādhyāsānāṃ uttarottareṇa pūrvapūrvasya sādhyatvasya sūtreṇaiva sūcitatvāt adhyāsasādhanadvāreṇa viṣayaprayojane sādhayitvā vicārakartavyatā sādhanīyā iti kramaniyamaṃ vivakṣan āha -- "ucyata" ityārabhya "vakṣyati caitat" ityataḥ prāktanena granthena||
analyzed: atra uttara uttareṇa pūrva pūrvasya sādhya tvasya sūtreṇa eva sūcita tvāt adhyāsa sādhana dvāreṇa viṣaya prayojane sādhayitvā vicāra kartavya tā sādhanīyā iti krama niyamam vivakṣan āha ucyate iti ārabhya vakṣyati ca etat iti atas prāktanena granthena

original: nanu brahmajñānaprayojanāṃ vicārakartavyatāṃ sūcayatā sūtreṇa kathaṃ bandhanivṛttiḥ vicāravijñānayoḥ prayojanatvena sūtritā iti tatrāha -- brahmajñānaṃ hi sūtritaṃ anarthahetunibarhaṇam iti|| vicārasādhyajñānasya prayojanaṃ ākāṅkṣan vicāravidhiḥ adhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṃ prayojanatvena pramimīte ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu brahma jñāna prayojanām vicāra kartavyatām sūcayatā sūtreṇa katham bandha nivṛttiḥ vicāra vijñānayoḥ prayojana tvena sūtritā iti tatra āha brahma jñānam hi sūtritam anartha hetu nibarhaṇam iti vicāra sādhya jñānasya prayojanam ākāṅkṣan vicāra vidhiḥ adhikāri viśeṣaṇam mokṣam prayojana tvena pramimīte iti arthaḥ

original: nanu anarthaḥ narakapātādilakṣaṇaḥ anye eva, śarīrādipratibhāsasya ca mithyātvaṃ sādhyate, iti kiṃ kena saṅgatamiti netyāha anarthaśca pramātṛtāpramukhaṃ kartṛtvabhoktṛtvam iti|| nivartyatāṃ tarhi jñānena vastubhūtameva pramātṛtvakartṛtvabhoktṛtvamiti netyāha -- tadyadi vastukṛtam iti|| tathā hi -- citrāvayavini
analyzed: nanu anarthaḥ naraka pāta ādi lakṣaṇaḥ anye eva śarīra ādi pratibhāsasya ca mithyātvam sādhyate iti kim kena saṅgatam iti na iti āha anarthaḥ ca pramātṛtā pramukham kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tvam iti nivartyatām tarhi jñānena vastu bhūtam eva pramātṛ tva kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tvam iti na iti āha tat yadi vastu kṛtam iti tathā hi citra avayavini

original: nīlaviśiṣṭadravyajñānaṃ svaviṣayaṃ vā svaviṣayasamavetaṃ vā rasādikaṃ virodhinaṃ vā pītimādiguṇaṃ na nivartayati, svaviṣayānavabodha eva kevalaḥ tena nivartyate| svāśrayagataṃ vastu jñānena nivartata iti cet, na; ghaṭādijñānena ātmagatadharmādharmādiguṇānivṛtteḥ| na ca āśrayaviṣayobhayasambandhi vastu jñānena nivartate;
analyzed: nīla viśiṣṭa dravya jñānam sva viṣayam vā sva viṣaya samavetam vā rasa ādikam virodhinam vā pītima ādi guṇam na nivartayati sva viṣaya anavabodhaḥ eva kevalaḥ tena nivartyate sva āśraya gatam vastu jñānena nivartate iti ced na ghaṭa ādi jñānena ātma gata dharma adharma ādi guṇa a nivṛtteḥ na ca āśraya viṣaya ubhaya sambandhi vastu jñānena nivartate

original: ātmanaḥ śarīraviṣayajñānena dehātmasambandhādyanivṛtteḥ iti| nanu na dṛṣṭasāmarthyāt jñānāt bandhanivṛttiḥ, yena avidyātmatvaṃ varṇyeta, kiṃ tu āgama eva jñānāt bandhanivṛttiṃ śrāvayati| nanu śrutopapattyarthameva bandhasya avidyātmatvaṃ varṇanīyameva;
analyzed: ātmanaḥ śarīra viṣaya jñānena deha ātma sambandha ādi anivṛtteḥ iti nanu na dṛṣṭa sāmarthyāt jñānāt bandha nivṛttiḥ yena avidyā ātma tvam varṇyeta kim tu āgamaḥ eva jñānāt bandha nivṛttim śrāvayati nanu śruta upapatti artham eva bandhasya avidyā ātma tvam varṇanīyam eva

original: yathā āgneyādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ yāgānāṃ adhikārāpūrvaviṣayatayā apūrvakaraṇabhāve śrute'pi kālāntarabhāvipradhānāpūrvasādhanatvopapattyarthaṃ kramabhāviyāgakarvajanyāni madhyavartīni avāntarāpūrvāṇi kalpyante, yathā vā śrutasyaiva svargasādhanatvasyopapattaye'pūrvaṃ kalpyate, tadvat|
analyzed: yathā āgneya ādīnām ṣaṇṇām yāgānām adhikāra apūrva viṣaya tayā apūrva karaṇa bhāve śrute api kāla antara bhāvi pradhāna apūrva sādhanatva upapatti artham krama bhāvi yāga karva janyāni madhya vartīni avāntara apūrvāṇi kalpyante yathā vā śrutasya eva svarga sādhanatvasya upapattaye pūrvam kalpyate tadvat

original: nanu tatra kṣaṇikānāṃ karmaṇāṃ kālāntaravartiphalasādhanatvābhāvavyāptiniyamāt loke, vede'pi svargāpūrvasiddhyai madhye apūrvāṇi kalpyante śrutopapattaye iti| tarhi ihāpi vyāptiniyatiḥ asti ityāha -- yato jñānaṃ ajñānasyaiva nivartakam iti||
analyzed: nanu tatra kṣaṇikānām karmaṇām kāla antara varti phala sādhanatva abhāva vyāpti niyamāt loke vede api svarga apūrva siddhyai madhye apūrvāṇi kalpyante śruta upapattaye iti tarhi iha api vyāpti niyatiḥ asti iti āha yatas jñānam ajñānasya eva nivartakam iti

original: ataḥ sūtrasyaiva bandhasya avidyātmakatve vyāpārāt sūtrārthavicārakartavyatopapatyarthaprayojanasādhanāya adhyāso varṇanīyaḥ ityāha -- tat yadi ityādinā sūtrārthopapatyupayogitā ityantena granthena||
analyzed: atas sūtrasya eva bandhasya avidyā ātmaka tve vyāpārāt sūtra artha vicāra kartavyatā upapati artha prayojana sādhanāya adhyāsaḥ varṇanīyaḥ iti āha tat yadi ityādinā sūtra artha upapati upayogi tā iti antena granthena

original: nanu sūtreṇa prathamapratipannaṃ pratipādyaṃ arthaṃ ullaṅghya kimiti caramapratipannaṃ ārthikārthameva bhāṣyakāraḥ prathamaṃ varṇayati iti tatrāha -- sakalatantropodghātaḥ iti|| pratipādyamarthaṃ buddhau saṃgṛhya prāgeva tadarthamarthāntaravarṇanaṃ upodghātaḥ|
analyzed: nanu sūtreṇa prathama pratipannam pratipādyam artham ullaṅghya kim iti carama pratipannam ārthika artham eva bhāṣyakāraḥ prathamam varṇayati iti tatra āha sakala tantra upodghātaḥ iti pratipādyam artham buddhau saṃgṛhya prāk eva tad artham artha antara varṇanam upodghātaḥ

original: pratipādyaṃ bahireva pratijñāya paścāt tatsiddhihetūpavarṇanaṃ pratipādanaṃ iti vibhāgaḥ| tantraṃ iti tantrārtho brahmātmaikatvamucyate| nanu bhavatu prayojanasiddhiheturadhyāsaḥ, kathaṃ tantrārthasiddhihetuḥ ityāśaṅkya tatkathanāya tantrārthaṃ prathamaṃ kathayati -- tathācāsya śāstrasya iti||aidamparyaṃ pratipāditaṃ ityuttareṇa sambandhaḥ|
analyzed: pratipādyam bahis eva pratijñāya paścāt tad siddhi hetu upavarṇanam pratipādanam iti vibhāgaḥ tantram iti tantra arthaḥ brahma ātma ekatvam ucyate nanu bhavatu prayojana siddhi hetuḥ adhyāsaḥ katham tantra artha siddhi hetuḥ iti āśaṅkya tad kathanāya tantra artham prathamam kathayati tathā ca asya śāstrasya iti aidamparyam pratipāditam iti uttareṇa sambandhaḥ

original: tadeva aidamparyaṃ darśayati -- sukhaikatānetyādinā|| ayamarthaḥ -- brahmātmaikatve vedāntāḥ paryavasyanti iti yadidaṃ vedāntaśāstrasya aidamparyaṃ, tat sūtrabhāṣyābhyāṃ pratipāditaṃ iti| tantrārthaṃ pradarśya tasya adhyāsasiddhyadhīnatayā adhyāsasya prathamavarṇanīyatāṃ darśayati -- taccāhaṃ kartā sukhī duḥkhī iti||
analyzed: tat eva aidamparyam darśayati sukha ekatāna ityādinā ayam arthaḥ brahma ātma ekatve vedāntāḥ paryavasyanti iti yat idam vedānta śāstrasya aidamparyam tat sūtra bhāṣyābhyām pratipāditam iti tantra artham pradarśya tasya adhyāsa siddhi adhīna tayā adhyāsasya prathama varṇanīya tām darśayati tat ca aham kartā sukhī duḥkhī iti

original: nanu śāstrameva pratyakṣābhimatamapi bandhaṃ ābhāsīkṛtya brahmātmaikatvaṃ pratipādayiṣyati, kiṃ pṛthak adhyāsavarṇanena iti tatrāha -- tāvat jaradgavādivākyavat iti|| nanu śāstrārthasiddhiḥ adhyāsaparādhīnā cet, sa eva tarhi adhyāsaḥ sūtrakāreṇa mukhato varṇanīyaḥ;
analyzed: nanu śāstram eva pratyakṣa abhimatam api bandham ābhāsīkṛtya brahma ātma ekatvam pratipādayiṣyati kim pṛthak adhyāsa varṇanena iti tatra āha tāvat jaradgava ādi vākya vat iti nanu śāstra artha siddhiḥ adhyāsa para adhīnā ced saḥ eva tarhi adhyāsaḥ sūtrakāreṇa mukhataḥ varṇanīyaḥ

original: tasya prādhānyāt, anyathā tatra atātparyaprasaṅgāt, iti tatrāha -- vakṣyati ca etat iti|| tarhi upodghātatvāt prathamamevādhyāsaviṣayaṃ sūtraṃ praṇetavyamiti codayati -- yadyevaṃ iti|| arthanirṇayapradhānatvāt vādakathālakṣaṇāyāṃ pratipādanaprakriyāyāṃ pravṛttaḥ sūtrakāraḥ na upodghātaprakriyāyāṃ iti pariharati -- maivaṃ arthaviśeṣopapatteḥ iti||
analyzed: tasya prādhānyāt anyathā tatra atātparya prasaṅgāt iti tatra āha vakṣyati ca etat iti tarhi upodghāta tvāt prathamam eva adhyāsa viṣayam sūtram praṇetavyam iti codayati yadi evam iti artha nirṇaya pradhāna tvāt vāda kathā lakṣaṇāyām pratipādana prakriyāyām pravṛttaḥ sūtrakāraḥ na upodghāta prakriyāyām iti pariharati mā evam artha viśeṣa upapatteḥ iti

original: tarhi bhāṣyakāreṇāpi yathāsūtrakramameva pravartitavyaṃ na tu sūtrakramamatilaṅghya iti tatrāha -- bhāṣyakārastu iti|| sukhapratipattyartham-pravṛttyaṅgabhāvāya ityarthaḥ||
analyzed: tarhi bhāṣyakāreṇa api yathāsūtrakramam eva pravartitavyam na tu sūtrakramam atilaṅghya iti tatra āha bhāṣyakāraḥ tu iti sukha pratipatti artham pravṛtti aṅga bhāvāya iti arthaḥ

original: evamapi na vyākhyeyamidaṃ bhāṣyam; śāstrādau maṅgalācaraṇābhāvāt, vighnopasaṃsṛṣṭatayā śāstrārthe'pratipattyanyathāpratipattivipratipattisaṃbhavāt, śiṣṭācāraparipālanahīnatayā ca anāptapraṇītatvaprasaṅgāt iti codayati -- nanu ca granthakaraṇādikāryārambhe iti||
analyzed: evam api na vyākhyeyam idam bhāṣyam śāstra ādau maṅgala ācaraṇa abhāvāt vighna upasaṃsṛṣṭa tayā śāstra arthe pratipatti anyathā pratipatti vipratipatti saṃbhavāt śiṣṭa ācāra paripālana hīna tayā ca anāpta praṇīta tva prasaṅgāt iti codayati nanu ca grantha karaṇa ādi kārya ārambhe iti

original: nanu śiṣṭānāṃ niṣṭhīvanādipravṛttiḥ kimanyena anusaraṇīyā iti netyāha -- śiṣṭācāraśca naḥ pramāṇaṃ iti|| ācāraḥ-dharmaḥ ityevānuṣṭhīyamānaṃ karma| pramāṇaṃ-kartavyaṃ ityarthaḥ| nanu prayojanābhāvāt kiṃ maṅgalācaraṇena iti netyāha -- prasiddhaṃ ca maṅgalācaraṇasya iti|| nanu atra vighna eva nāsti alpārambhatvāt iti netyāha -- mahati ca iti||
analyzed: nanu śiṣṭānām niṣṭhīvana ādi pravṛttiḥ kim anyena anusaraṇīyā iti na iti āha śiṣṭa ācāraḥ ca naḥ pramāṇam iti ācāraḥ dharmaḥ iti eva anuṣṭhīyamānam karma pramāṇam kartavyam iti arthaḥ nanu prayojana abhāvāt kim maṅgala ācaraṇena iti na iti āha prasiddham ca maṅgala ācaraṇasya iti nanu atra vighnaḥ eva na asti alpa ārambha tvāt iti na iti āha mahati ca iti

analyzed: pramāṇam iti arthaḥ maṅgala ācaraṇam iti vā katham idam viśiṣṭa devatā anusmaraṇam gamayati iti tatra āha asya ca ayam arthaḥ iti nanu na iha viśuddha ātma tatva devatā anusmaryate kiṃtu adhyāsa abhāvaḥ varṇyate iti satyam tādarthyena tattvam api anusmaryate iti āha tat kathaṃcana iti

original: uttarapadaṃ vyākhyātuṃ bhāṣyamādadāti -- viṣayaviṣayiṇoḥ ityādinā|| tatra dvividho virodhaḥ, dvividhā ca itaretarabhāvānupapattiḥ; katham dvayoḥ padārthayorekadeśakālāvasthānasāmarthyābhāvaḥ padārthadharmo virodhaḥ; tannimitto avasthānalakṣaṇakāryābhāva itaretarabhāvānupapattirityekaḥ skandhaḥ|

original: nanu rūpavato dravyasya sparśavattvaniyamāt tadrahitaṃ tamaḥ kathaṃ rūpavat dravyaṃ avagamyeta naiṣa doṣaḥ; -- vāyoranyatra sparśavaddravyasya rūpavattvaniyame'pi rūparahitasyasparśavato vāyorabhyupagamāt, tadvat darśananiyamādeva sparśahīnasya rūpavattamasaḥ siddheḥ|

original: bahulāndhakārasaṃvṛtāpavarakāntaravasthitasyāpi bahiḥ rūpadarśanena saha apavarakāntaḥ tamodarśanāt na rūpadarśanābhāvamātraṃ tamaḥ iti alamatiprasaṅgena||

original: anātmano nāsti ityāha -- svataḥ tāvat viṣayiṇaḥ cidekarasatvānna yuṣmadaṃśasambhavaḥ ityādinā||
analyzed: anātmanaḥ na asti iti āha svatas tāvat viṣayiṇaḥ cit eka rasa tvāt na yuṣmat aṃśa sambhavaḥ ityādinā

original: ayamāśayaḥ -- draṣṭuḥ acidaṃśaḥ svābhāviko vā syāt āgāntuko veti| na svābhāvika ityāha -- svata iti|| cetyaṃ hi jaḍaṃ caitanyasya karmakārakatayā avabhāsate| tat kathamekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ kartuḥ viparītasthānagataṃ karmakārakaṃ ātmā syāt ityabhiprāyaḥ| āgantukaścet, saheturaheturvā| nirhetuścet, tatrāha -- apariṇāmitvāt iti||
analyzed: ayam āśayaḥ draṣṭuḥ acit aṃśaḥ svābhāvikaḥ vā syāt āgāntukaḥ vā iti na svābhāvikaḥ iti āha svatas iti cetyam hi jaḍam caitanyasya karma kārakatayā avabhāsate tat katham ekasyām kriyāyām kartuḥ viparīta sthāna gatam karma kārakam ātmā syāt iti abhiprāyaḥ āgantukaḥ ced sa hetuḥ ahetuḥ vā nirhetuḥ ced tatra āha apariṇāmi tvāt iti

original: na hi niravayavaṃ vastu svataḥ sāvayavākāreṇa pariṇamamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ityabhiprāyaḥ| na sahetuḥ ityāha -- nirañjanatvāt iti|| na hi niravayavamākāśaṃ hetūparāgān pariṇamamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ityarthaḥ| tarhyanātmaiva adhiṣṭhānaṃ ātmāṃśātmakaṃ kvacit dṛṣṭaṃ iti , netyāha -- viṣayasyāpi iti||
analyzed: na hi niravayavam vastu svatas sa avayava ākāreṇa pariṇamamānam dṛṣṭam iti abhiprāyaḥ na sa hetuḥ iti āha nirañjana tvāt iti na hi niravayavam ākāśam hetu uparāgān pariṇamamānam dṛṣṭam iti arthaḥ tarhi anātmā eva adhiṣṭhānam ātma aṃśa ātmakam kvacid dṛṣṭam iti na iti āha viṣayasya api iti

original: samatvāt iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- yathā draṣṭuḥ draṣṭrantaraṃ na pratyakṣagocaraḥ, anumeyameva tat, evaṃ viṣayo'pi syāt iti| parato'pi na anātmanaḥ cidākārapariṇāmaḥ; jaḍopādānasyāpi kāryasya jaḍatvāt, tarhi ātmacaitanyameva
analyzed: samatvāt iti ayam arthaḥ yathā draṣṭuḥ draṣṭṛ antaram na pratyakṣa gocaraḥ anumeyam eva tat evam viṣayaḥ api syāt iti paratas api na anātmanaḥ cit ākāra pariṇāmaḥ jaḍa upādānasya api kāryasya jaḍa tvāt tarhi ātma caitanyam eva

original: anātmā svāṃśatvena svīkaroti iti cet, tatrāha -- citeḥ apratisaṃkramatvāti iti|
analyzed: anātmā sva aṃśa tvena svīkaroti iti ced tatra āha citeḥ iti

original: tasmāt kvacidapi tādātmyādarśanāt anyatra anyatarāṃśadarśanena anyatarāṃśādhyāso nopapadyate iti| taddharmāṇāmapi sutarāṃ ityārabhya ābhāva evādhyāṃsasya yuktaḥ ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt kvacid api tādātmya adarśanāt anyatra anyatara aṃśa darśanena anyatara aṃśa adhyāsaḥ na upapadyate iti tad dharmāṇām api sutarām iti ārabhya ābhāvaḥ eva adhyāṃsasya yuktaḥ iti atas prāktanaḥ granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ

original: nanu ahaṅkārādiṣu śarīrānteṣu ahamityeva pratyayaḥ, na tu idamiti kathameṣāṃ yuṣmatpratyayagocaratvaṃ iti tatrāha -- tadbalanirbhāsitatayā iti|| tasya -- asmatpratyayagocarasya caitanyasya balena nirbhāsyatvāt ahaṅkārādeḥ pratibhāsato yuṣmadarthatvābhāvepi aparokṣatayā avabhāsasyatvena lakṣaṇena yuṣmadarthabhāvo yujyate ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu ahaṅkāra ādiṣu śarīra anteṣu aham iti eva pratyayaḥ na tu idam iti katham eṣām yuṣmad pratyaya gocara tvam iti tatra āha tad bala nirbhāsita tayā iti tasya asmad pratyaya gocarasya caitanyasya balena nirbhāsya tvāt ahaṅkāra ādeḥ pratibhāsataḥ yuṣmadartha tva abhāve pi aparokṣa tayā avabhāsa sya tvena lakṣaṇena yuṣmadartha bhāvaḥ yujyate iti arthaḥ

original: apṛthaktve'pi caitanyāt pṛthagiva avabhāsante iti|| antaḥkaraṇavṛttyupādhau nāneva avabhāsante ityarthaḥ||
analyzed: apṛthaktve pi caitanyāt pṛthak iva avabhāsante iti antaḥkaraṇa vṛtti upādhau nānā iva avabhāsante iti arthaḥ

original: bhūyo'vayavasāmānyasādṛśyābhāvāt ātmani kartṛtvādeḥ ahaṅkārādyupādhinimittabhramatve'pi, śarīrādyadhyāsasya sopādhikabhramatvābhāvāt| draṣṭari ahaṅkārādiśarīrāntapadārthādhyāsasya sambhavaṃ prāptaṃ aṅgīkaroti -- yadyapyevaṃ iti||
analyzed: bhūyas vayava sāmānya sādṛśya abhāvāt ātmani kartṛ tva ādeḥ ahaṅkāra ādi upādhi nimitta bhrama tve api śarīra ādi adhyāsasya sopādhika bhrama tva abhāvāt draṣṭari ahaṅkāra ādi śarīra anta padārtha adhyāsasya sambhavam prāptam aṅgīkaroti yadi api evam iti

original: nirupādhikabhramakāryadarśanameva guṇāvayavasāmānyābhāve'pi ketakīgandhasadṛśaḥ sarpagandhaḥ itivat sādṛśyāntaraṃ vā śaṅkhapītimādāviva kāraṇāntaraṃ vā kalpayati ityāha -- "tathāpi" ityādinā "evamadhyāsasyāpi" ityabhiprāyaḥ ityantena granthena|| naisargikaśabdārthamāha -- pratyakcaityanyasattāmātrānubandhī iti||
analyzed: nirupādhika bhrama kārya darśanam eva guṇa avayava sāmānya abhāve pi ketakī gandha sadṛśaḥ sarpa gandhaḥ iti vat sādṛśya āntaram vā śaṅkhapītim ādau iva kāraṇa antaram vā kalpayati iti āha tathā api ityādinā evam adhyāsasya api iti abhiprāyaḥ iti antena granthena naisargika śabda artham āha pratyak caitya nya sattā mātra anubandhī iti

original: katham ātmani kartṛtvabhoktṛtvadoṣasaṃyoga eva adhyāsaḥ| tatra bhoktṛtvādhyāsaḥ kartṛtvādhyāsamapekṣate; akarturbhogābhāvāt, kartṛtvaṃ ca rāgadveṣasaṃyogādhyāsamapekṣate; tadrahitasya kartṛtvābhāvātsa, doṣasaṃyogaśca bhoktṛtvamapekṣate;
analyzed: katham ātmani kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva doṣa saṃyogaḥ eva adhyāsaḥ tatra bhoktṛ tva adhyāsaḥ kartṛ tva adhyāsam apekṣate akartuḥ bhoga abhāvāt kartṛ tvam ca rāga dveṣa saṃyoga adhyāsam apekṣate tad rahitasya kartṛ tva abhāvāt sa doṣa saṃyogaḥ ca bhoktṛ tvam apekṣate

original: anupabhutte atañjātīye vā rāgādyanupapatteḥ, evaṃ bījāṅkuravat hetuparamparayā anāditvāt adhyāsasya naisargikatvaṃ iti| lokavyavahāraśabdaḥ adhyāsābhidhāyīti darśayati -- lokaḥ iti manuṣyo'haṃ ityādinā|| vyavahāraḥ -- abhijñā abhivadanaṃ upādānaṃ arthakriyā iti caturvidhaḥ| ato manuṣyo'haṃ iti jñānābhidhāne vyayavahāraśabdaṃ arhataḥ iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: anupabhutte a tañjātīye vā rāga ādi anupapatteḥ evam bīja aṅkura vat hetu paramparayā anādi tvāt adhyāsasya naisargika tvam iti loka vyavahāra śabdaḥ adhyāsa abhidhāyī iti darśayati lokaḥ iti manuṣyaḥ aham ityādinā vyavahāraḥ abhijñā abhivadanam upādānam arthakriyā iti caturvidhaḥ atas manuṣyaḥ aham iti jñāna abhidhāne vyaya vahāra śabdam arhataḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: anyasya anyātmatāvabhāsaḥ avidyā ityukte "śuklaḥ paṭaḥ" ityādipratyayānāṃ avidyātvaprasaṅgo mā bhūt iti satyasya vastuno mithyāvastusambhedāvabhāso avidyā iti svasiddhāntamaṅgīkṛtya "satyānṛte mithunīkṛtya" ityuktam, tat vyācaṣṭe -- satyaṃ anidaṃ caitanyaṃ ityādinā||
analyzed: anyasya anya ātmatā avabhāsaḥ avidyā iti ukte śuklaḥ paṭaḥ ityādi pratyayānām avidyā tva prasaṅgaḥ mā bhūt iti satyasya vastunaḥ mithyā vastu sambheda avabhāsaḥ avidyā iti sva siddhāntam aṅgīkṛtya satya anṛte mithunīkṛtya iti uktam tat vyācaṣṭe satyam anidam caitanyam ityādinā

original: nanu ktvāpratyayopādānāt arthataḥ kriyābhedaḥ pūrvāparabhāvaśca aṅgīkartavyaḥ, tat kathaṃ adhyāsamithunīkaraṇalokavyavahārāṇāṃ ekārthatvaṃ iti netyāha -- adhyasya mithunīkṛtya ityādinā|| nanu kimiti svarūpamātraparyavasānam kriyābheda eva ktvāpratyayasāmarthyādupādīyatāṃ iti, netyāha -- upasaṃhāre ca iti||
analyzed: nanu ktvāpratyaya upādānāt arthataḥ kriyābhedaḥ pūrva apara bhāvaḥ ca aṅgīkartavyaḥ tat katham adhyāsa mithunīkaraṇa lokavyavahārāṇām ekārtha tvam iti na iti āha adhyasya mithunīkṛtya ityādinā nanu kim iti svarūpa mātra paryavasānam kriyābhedaḥ eva ktvāpratyaya sāmarthyāt upādīyatām iti na iti āha upasaṃhāre ca iti

original: na hi padamātravaiyarthyabhayāvākyārtho naisargikatvaguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ viśeṣyapadārthaḥ adhyāsaḥ upakramopasaṃhārayoḥ bhettuṃ yuktaḥ ityabhiprāyaḥ| kiṃ tarhi ktvāpratyayāvalambanaṃ iti pratipattitaḥ kriyābhedapūrvāparībhāvo ityāha -- ataḥ caitanyaṃ puruṣasya svarūpaṃ itivadvyapadeśamātraṃ iti|| upacāramātraṃ ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: na hi naisargika tva guṇa viśiṣṭaḥ viśeṣya padārthaḥ adhyāsaḥ upakrama upasaṃhārayoḥ bhettum yuktaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ kim tarhi ktvā pratyaya avalambanam iti pratipattitaḥ iti āha atas caitanyam puruṣasya svarūpam itivat vyapadeśa mātram iti upacāra mātram iti arthaḥ

original: katham eko'pyadhyāsaḥ anyonyātmatā satyānṛte ahamidaṃ mamedaṃ iti ca viśeṣaṇabhedāt viśiṣṭaḥ paropādhau bhidyate; viśiṣṭārtha pratyayāśca krameṇa vaktuḥ bhavanti iti, pratipattitaḥ pūrvāparībhāvaṃ viśeṣaṇabhedācca viśiṣṭakriyābhedaṃ ca aṅgīkṛtya ktvāpratyayaḥ iti|
analyzed: katham ekaḥ api adhyāsaḥ anyonya ātmatā satya anṛte aham idam mama idam iti ca viśeṣaṇa bhedāt viśiṣṭaḥ para upādhau bhidyate viśiṣṭa artha pratyayāḥ ca krameṇa vaktuḥ bhavanti iti pratipattitaḥ pūrvāparībhāvam viśeṣaṇa bhedāt ca viśiṣṭa kriyā bhedam ca aṅgīkṛtya ktvāpratyayaḥ iti

original: tatra ajñānaṃ ityukte bhrāntijñānaṃ iti syāt, tadubhayavyāvṛttyarthaṃ nirucya padārthau darśayati -- mithyā ca tat ajñānaṃ ca ityādinā||
analyzed: tatra ajñānam iti ukte bhrānti jñānam iti syāt tad ubhaya vyāvṛtti artham nirucya padārthau darśayati mithyā ca tat ajñānam ca ityādinā

original: nanu kathaṃ mithyājñānaṃ adhyāsasya upādānam tasmin sati adhyāsasya udayāt asati ca anudayāt iti brūmaḥ|| nanu adhyāsasya pratibandhakaṃ tattvajñānaṃ tadabhāvaśca ajñānaṃ iti pratibandhakābhāvaviṣayatayā ajñānasya adhyāsena anvayavyatirekau anyathāsiddhau, naitat sāram;puṣkalakāraṇe hi sati kāryotpādavirodhi pratibandhakam|
analyzed: nanu katham mithyājñānam adhyāsasya upādānam tasmin sati adhyāsasya udayāt asati ca anudayāt iti brūmaḥ nanu adhyāsasya pratibandhakam tattva jñānam tad abhāvaḥ ca ajñānam iti pratibandhaka abhāva viṣaya tayā ajñānasya adhyāsena anvaya vyatirekau anyathā asiddhau na etat sāram puṣkala kāraṇe hi sati kārya utpāda virodhi pratibandhakam

original: na ca adhyāsapuṣkalakāraṇe sati tattvajñānodayaḥ| tasmānnājñānādayavyatirekau pratibandhakābhāvaviṣayau| tathāpi virodhisaṃsargābhāva iti cet, na;kāryasya kāraṇāpekṣā hi prathamamutpadyate, na virodhisaṃsargābhāvāpekṣā| tasmāt prathamāpekṣitakāraṇaklṛtpimeva anvayavyatirekau nyāyasahitau kurvāte|
analyzed: na ca adhyāsa puṣkala kāraṇe sati tattva jñāna udayaḥ tasmāt na ajñāna ādaya vyatirekau pratibandhaka abhāva viṣayau tathā api virodhi saṃsarga abhāvaḥ iti ced na kāryasya kāraṇa apekṣā hi prathamam utpadyate na virodhi saṃsarga abhāva apekṣā tasmāt prathama apekṣita kāraṇa anvaya vyatirekau nyāya sahitau kurvāte

original: nanu klṛptaṃ viṣayendriyādidoṣaḥ kāraṇaṃ iti| satyam; nimittaṃ tu tat, upādānāpekṣāyāṃ ajñānamanupraviśati; sarvaṃ ca kāryaṃ sopādānam, bhāvakāryatvāt, ghaṭādivat, ityanumānāt, kriyāguṇāderapi sāśrayasyaiva utpatteḥ utpadyamānāśrayasyaiva upādānatvāt| nanu ātmā antaḥkaraṇaṃ vā bhrāntijñānopādānaṃ bhaviṣyati na; ātmanaḥ apariṇāmitvāt;
analyzed: nanu klṛptam viṣaya indriya ādi doṣaḥ kāraṇam iti satyam nimittam tu tat upādāna apekṣāyām ajñānam anupraviśati sarvam ca kāryam sa upādānam bhāva kārya tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti anumānāt kriyā guṇa ādeḥ api sa āśrayasya eva utpatteḥ utpadyamāna āśrayasya eva upādāna tvāt nanu ātmā antaḥkaraṇam vā bhrānti jñāna upādānam bhaviṣyati na ātmanaḥ apariṇāmi tvāt

original: antaḥkaraṇasya ca indriyasaṃyogādisāpekṣatvāt na; mithyārthe ca pratyayamātraviparivartini tadayogāt, adhiṣṭhānajñānena anyathāsiddhatvācca tadanvayavyatirekayoḥ| antaḥkaraṇasya
analyzed: antaḥkaraṇasya ca indriya saṃyoga ādi sāpekṣa tvāt na mithyā arthe ca pratyaya mātra viparivartini tad ayogāt adhiṣṭhāna jñānena anyathā asiddha tvāt ca tad anvaya vyatirekayoḥ antaḥkaraṇasya

analyzed: jaḍa tvāt ajñātṛ tvāt ātmanaḥ abhrānta tva prasaṅgāt ca tasmāt mithyartha tad jñāna ātmakam mithyābhūtam adhyāsam upādāna kāraṇa sāpekṣam anāśraya sthānatayā kācid inimitta kāraṇeṣu bhidyamāneṣu mithyābhūtasya eva sarva kārya svabhāva anukūlasya sarvatra anugamāt ajñānasya ātma āśraya tayā bhrānti jñāna āśraya koṭi nikṣipta tvāt ca mithyājñānam eva adhyāsa upādānam na asti

original: ātmāntaḥkaraṇakācādidoṣāḥ iti sūktam| atmāśrayādhyāsasya śuktikāsaṃsargovibhrama iti vakṣyate| ekasyaiva adhyāsasya naisargikatvaṃ naimittikatvaṃ ca viruddhaṃ iti codayati -- kathaṃ punaḥ iti||
analyzed: ātma antaḥkaraṇa kāca ādi doṣāḥ iti su uktam atma āśraya adhyāsasya śuktikā saṃsargaḥ vibhramaḥ iti vakṣyate ekasya eva adhyāsasya naisargika tvam naimittika tvam ca viruddham iti codayati katham punar iti

original: tatra prathamaṃ tāvat adhyāsapravāhajanmanā upādānakāraṇarūpeṇa naisargikatvaṃ kāryavyaktirūpeṇa naimittikatvaṃ iti avirodhaṃ darśayituṃ ātmani bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ sādhayati -- avaśyameṣā avidyāśaktiḥ iti|| 'avaśyaṃ' iti "eṣā iti" ca pramāṇadvayavattāmāha| pratyakṣaṃ tāvat; "ahamajñaḥ" "māmanyaṃ ca na jānāmi" ityaparokṣāvabhāsadarśanāt|
analyzed: tatra prathamam tāvat adhyāsa pravāha janmanā upādānakāraṇa rūpeṇa naisargika tvam kārya vyakti rūpeṇa naimittika tvam iti avirodham darśayitum ātmani bhāva rūpam ajñānam sādhayati avaśyam eṣā avidyā śaktiḥ iti avaśyam iti eṣā iti ca pramāṇa dvayavat tām āha pratyakṣam tāvat aham ajñaḥ mām anyam ca na jānāmi iti aparokṣa avabhāsa darśanāt

original: nanu jñānābhāvaviṣayaḥ ayamavabhāsaḥ, na;aparokṣāvabhāsatvāt ahaṃ sukhī itivat, abhāvasya ca ṣaṣṭhapramāṇagocaratvāt, pratyakṣābhāvavādino'pi na ātmani vijñānābhāvāvagamaḥ sambhavati;
analyzed: nanu jñāna abhāva viṣayaḥ ayam avabhāsaḥ na aparokṣa avabhāsa tvāt aham sukhī iti vat abhāvasya ca ṣaṣṭha pramāṇa gocara tvāt pratyakṣa abhāva vādinaḥ api na ātmani vijñāna abhāva avagamaḥ sambhavati

original: "mayi jñānaṃ nāsti" iti pratipattau atmani dharmiṇi pratiyogini vā arthe avagate tatra jñānasadbhāvāt jñānābhāvapratipattyayogāt, anavagate'pi dharmyādau sutarāṃ abhāvānavagamāt, ṣaṣṭhapramāṇagocare phalaliṅgābhāvānumeye'pi jñānābhāve, ātmādau avagate anavagate'pi ātmani jñānābhāvapratipattyayogāt|
analyzed: mayi jñānam na asti iti pratipattau dharmiṇi pratiyogini vā arthe avagate tatra jñāna sadbhāvāt jñāna abhāva pratipatti ayogāt anavagate pi dharmya ādau sutarām abhāva anavagamāt ṣaṣṭha pramāṇa gocare phala liṅga abhāva anumeye api jñāna abhāve ātma ādau avagate anavagate pi ātmani jñāna abhāva pratipatti ayogāt

original: iha ca "tvaduktamarthaṃ saṃkhyāṃ vā śāstrārthaṃ vā na jānāmi" iti viṣayavyāvṛttamajñānamanubhūya tacchravaṇādau pravartate|
analyzed: iha ca tvad uktam artham saṃkhyām vā śāstra artham vā na jānāmi iti viṣaya vyāvṛttam ajñānam anubhūya tad śravaṇa ādau pravartate

original: bhāvarūpājñānapratyakṣavāde tu satyapi āśrayapratiyogijñāne jñānābhāvasyeva bhāvāntarasyāpi na anupapattiḥ niyantuṃ śakyate| na ca āśrayapratiyogijñānabhūtamapi sākṣicaitanyaṃ bhāvāntarasya ajñānasya nivartakam; tasya ajñānaviṣayapratibhāsatvāt| na hi svajñānenaiva svayaṃ nivartate|
analyzed: bhāva rūpa ajñāna pratyakṣa vāde tu sati api āśraya pratiyogi jñāne jñāna abhāvasya iva bhāva antarasya api na anupapattiḥ niyantum śakyate na ca āśraya pratiyogi jñāna bhūtam api sākṣi caitanyam bhāva antarasya ajñānasya nivartakam tasya ajñāna viṣaya pratibhāsa tvāt na hi sva jñānena eva svayam nivartate

original: nanu ajñānasya vyāvartako viṣayaḥ kathaṃ sākṣicaitanyena avabhāsyate pramāṇāyattatvāt viṣayasiddheḥ iti, ucyate;sarvaṃ vastu jñātatayā vā ajñātatayā vā sākṣicaitanyasya viṣaya eva|
analyzed: nanu ajñānasya vyāvartakaḥ viṣayaḥ katham sākṣi caitanyena avabhāsyate pramāṇa āyatta tvāt viṣaya siddheḥ iti ucyate sarvam vastu jñāta tayā vā ajñāta tayā vā sākṣi caitanyasya viṣayaḥ eva

original: tatra jñātatayā viṣayaḥ pramāṇavyavadhānamapekṣate, anyastu sāmānyākāreṇa viśeṣākāreṇa vā ajñānavyāvartakatayā sadā bhāsate iti upapattisahitaṃ ajñānapratyakṣaṃ bhāvarūpameva ātmani ajñānaṃ gamayati iti siddham||
analyzed: tatra jñāta tayā viṣayaḥ pramāṇa vyavadhānam apekṣate anyaḥ tu sāmānya ākāreṇa viśeṣa ākāreṇa vā ajñāna vyāvartaka tayā sadā bhāsate iti upapatti sahitam ajñāna pratyakṣam bhāva rūpam eva ātmani ajñānam gamayati iti siddham

original: anumānamapi -- vivādagocarāpannaṃ pramāṇajñānaṃ, svaprāgabhāvavyatiriktaviṣayāvaraṇasvanivartyasvadeśagatavastvantaraṃpūrvakaṃ bhavitumarhati, aprakāśitārthaprakāśakatvāt, andhakāre prathamotpannapradīpaprabhāvat iti| tataśca jñānena samānāśrayaviṣayaṃ bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ siddham|
analyzed: anumānam api vivāda gocara āpannam pramāṇa jñānam sva prāgabhāva vyatirikta viṣaya āvaraṇa sva nivartya sva deśa gata vastu antaraṃpūrvakam bhavitum arhati aprakāśita artha prakāśaka tvāt andhakāre prathama utpanna pradīpa prabhā vat iti tatas ca jñānena samāna āśraya viṣayam bhāva rūpam ajñānam siddham

original: śaktiriti ātmaparatantratayā ātmanaḥ sarvakāryopādānatvasya nirvoḍhṛtvamāha| tatsvarūpam -- ātmatattvam, tatsattāmātrānubandhinī ityarthaḥ| kiṃca arthāpattirapi bhāvarūpājñānasadbhāve pramāṇaṃ ityāha -- anyathā mithyārthāvabhāsānupapatteḥ iti||
analyzed: śaktiḥ iti ātma paratantra tayā ātmanaḥ sarva kārya upādāna tvasya nirvoḍhṛ tvam āha tad svarūpam ātma tattvam tad sattā mātra anubandhinī iti arthaḥ kiṃca arthāpattiḥ api bhāva rūpa ajñāna sadbhāve pramāṇam iti āha anyathā mithyārtha avabhāsa anupapatteḥ iti

original: viśuddhabrahmātmani śuktikāyāṃ ca ahaṅkārarajatādhyāsasya arthajñānātmakasya mithyābhūtasya mithyābhūtameva kiṃcit upādānamanveṣaṇīyam; satyopādānatve kāryasya kāraṇasvabhāvatayā adhyāsasyāpi satyatvaprasaṅgāt, tasyāpi mithyopādānasya sāditve tathāvidhopādānāntarakalpanāprasaṅgāt anādyeva tat mithyopādānaṃ iti kalpanīyam|
analyzed: viśuddha brahma ātmani śuktikāyām ca ahaṅkāra rajata adhyāsasya artha jñāna ātmakasya mithyābhūtasya mithyābhūtam eva kiṃcid upādānam anveṣaṇīyam satya upādāna tve kāryasya kāraṇa svabhāva tayā adhyāsasya api satya tva prasaṅgāt tasya api mithyā upādānasya sādi tve tathāvidha upādāna antara kalpanā prasaṅgāt anādyā eva tat mithyā upādānam iti kalpanīyam

original: yacca anādi svayaṃ mithyā mithyopādānaṃ ātmasanbandhi ca tat ajñānaṃ iti mithyādhyāsa eva tathāvidhājñānopādānaṃ kāraṇaṃ antareṇa anupapadyamānaḥ tat kalpayati ityuktam||
analyzed: yat ca anādi svayam mithyā mithyā upādānam ātma sanbandhi ca tat ajñānam iti mithyā adhyāsaḥ eva tathāvidha ajñāna upādānam kāraṇam antareṇa anupapadyamānaḥ tat kalpayati iti uktam

original: nanu yena yasya atiśayaḥ utpadyate, sa tasya viṣayaḥ, na ca ajñānena anātmani āvaraṇātiśayajanma; pramāṇābhāvāt, arthānupapatteśca| na tāvat agavate nīlārthe tatra āvaraṇakṛtyamavagantuṃ śakyate, anavagate tu na tarām| nanu avagate sati pūrvaṃ āvṛtaṃ ityavagamyatām, na;dhārāvāhikavijñānagamye'rthe pūrvamavagatasyāpi paścādavagamadarśanāt|
analyzed: nanu yena yasya atiśayaḥ utpadyate sa tasya viṣayaḥ na ca ajñānena anātmani āvaraṇa atiśaya janma pramāṇa abhāvāt artha anupapatteḥ ca na tāvat agavate nīla arthe tatra āvaraṇa kṛtyam avagantum śakyate anavagate tu na tarām nanu avagate sati pūrvam āvṛtam iti avagamyatām na dhārāvāhika vijñāna gamya īrthe pūrvam avagatasya api paścāt avagama darśanāt

original: nanu idānīmeva avagatatvaṃ pūrvamanavagatiṃ sādhayati, na;pūrvānavagatimavijñāya idānīmeva avagataṃ ityavadhāraṇāyogāt| nanu pūrvāparapratyabhijñāyāṃ madhye anavagatiravagamyate iti, na pratyabhijñānupapattiḥ madhye anavagatiṃ sādhayati;
analyzed: nanu idānīm eva avagata tvam pūrvam anavagatim sādhayati na pūrva anavagatim a vijñāya idānīm eva avagatam iti avadhāraṇā yogāt nanu pūrva apara pratyabhijñāyām madhye anavagatiḥ avagamyate iti na pratyabhijñā anupapattiḥ madhye anavagatim sādhayati

original: dhārāvāhike'pyātmani sadāvagate taddarśanāt, madhye jñānasmṛtyabhāvāt anavagatiravagamyate iti cet, na;avagate'pi smṛtiniyamābhāvāt| tathāpi viṣayānavagatiḥ pratīyate iti cet, satyam viṣayaiḥ saha sākṣicaitanye ajñānādhyāsāt pratibhāsaḥ, na ca adhyastasya āvaraṇamasti; dvicandrādivat pramāṇagamyatvābhāvāt| tasmāt nāsti anātmani āvaraṇe pramāṇam|
analyzed: dhārāvāhike api ātmani sadā avagate tad darśanāt madhye jñāna smṛti abhāvāt anavagatiḥ avagamyate iti ced na avagate api smṛti niyama abhāvāt tathā api viṣaya anavagatiḥ pratīyate iti ced satyam viṣayaiḥ saha sākṣi caitanye ajñāna adhyāsāt pratibhāsaḥ na ca adhyastasya āvaraṇam asti dvi candra ādi vat pramāṇa gamya tva abhāvāt tasmāt na asti anātmani āvaraṇe pramāṇam

original: na ca svayameva prakāśahīnasya jaḍasya āvaraṇārtho'pi sambhavati| tasmāt atiśayābhāvāt na ajñānaviṣayaḥ anātmā iti, tatrāha -- sā ca na jaḍeṣu vastuṣu tatsvarūpāvabhāsaṃ pratibadhnāti iti|| kiṃ tu anyadeva anātmani atiśayakāryaṃ kṛtvā tadviṣayamajñānaṃ iti vakṣyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| tatra hetuḥ -- pramāṇa vaikalyādeva iti||
analyzed: na ca svayam eva prakāśa hīnasya jaḍasya āvaraṇa arthaḥ api sambhavati tasmāt atiśaya abhāvāt na ajñāna viṣayaḥ anātmā iti tatra āha sā ca na jaḍeṣu vastuṣu tad svarūpa avabhāsam pratibadhnāti iti kim tu anyat eva anātmani atiśaya kāryam kṛtvā tad viṣayam ajñānam iti vakṣyate iti abhiprāyaḥ tatra hetuḥ pramāṇa vaikalyāt eva iti

original: athavā caitanyaprakāśena jaḍānāṃ nityavadanvayāt nityavat prakāśe prāpte, sambhavatyeva anātmasu āvaraṇakṛtyaṃ ityāśaṅkya āha -- pramāṇavaikalyādeva iti|| anātmapramāṇasya caitanyasya vaikalyāt -- āvaraṇādeva viṣayānavagatisiddheḥ na viṣaye pṛthagāvaraṇaṃ kalpanīyaṃ ityarthaḥ| itaśca na anātmani āvaraṇaṃ ityāha -- rajatapratibhāsāt iti||
analyzed: athavā caitanya prakāśena jaḍānām nitya vat anvayāt nitya vat prakāśe prāpte sambhavati eva anātmasu āvaraṇa kṛtyam iti āśaṅkya āha pramāṇa vaikalyāt eva iti anātma pramāṇasya caitanyasya vaikalyāt āvaraṇāt eva viṣaya anavagati siddheḥ na viṣaye pṛthak āvaraṇam kalpanīyam iti arthaḥ itas ca na anātmani āvaraṇam iti āha rajata pratibhāsāt iti

original: yadi ātmāśrayaṃ ajñānaṃ anātmāvaraṇaṃ syāt, tadā, āvaraṇavināśamantareṇa viṣayāvabhāsāyogāt viṣayajñānena ātmājñānaṃ nivarteta| ataḥ satyāmeva ātmani avidyāyāṃ triṣvapi kāleṣu viṣayasvarūpapratibhāsadarśanāt, na anātmāvaraṇaṃ ajñānaṃ iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yadi ātma āśrayam ajñānam anātma āvaraṇam syāt tadā āvaraṇa vināśam antareṇa viṣaya avabhāsa ayogāt viṣaya jñānena ātma ajñānam nivarteta atas satyām eva ātmani avidyāyām triṣu api kāleṣu viṣaya sva rūpa pratibhāsa darśanāt na anātma āvaraṇam ajñānam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu śuktikāviṣayaṃ ajñānaṃ anyadeva, tajjñānāt tat nivartate, anyacca ātmaviṣayaṃ ajñānaṃ ātmani dṛśyamānaṃ iti, tanna; ātmāśrayaṃ ātmaviṣayaṃ ca ajñānaṃ antareṇa anātmasu prativiṣayaṃ bhāvarūpājñānasadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt, viṣayāgrahaṇasya pramāṇavaikalyādapi upapatteḥ|
analyzed: nanu śuktikā viṣayam ajñānam anyat eva tad jñānāt tat nivartate anyat ca ātma viṣayam ajñānam ātmani dṛśyamānam iti tat na ātma āśrayam ātma viṣayam ca ajñānam antareṇa anātmasu prati viṣayam bhāva rūpa ajñāna sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt viṣaya agrahaṇasya pramāṇa vaikalyāt api upapatteḥ

original: Bkiṃ ca tarhi atiśayaṃ ajñānajanyaṃ āśritya bāhyādhyātmikeṣu vastu iti anātmaviṣayamajñānaṃ darśitaṃ iti tadāha -- ataḥ tatra rūpāntarāvabhāsahetureva kevalam iti||
analyzed: kim ca tarhi atiśayam ajñāna janyam āśritya bāhya ādhyātmikeṣu vastu iti anātma viṣayam ajñānam darśitam iti tat āha atas tatra rūpa antara avabhāsa hetuḥ eva kevalam iti

original: nanu atrāpi anupapattiḥ samānā, katham śuktikājñānaṃ hi rūpāntarāvabhāsaṃ nivartayan tadupādānaṃ ajñānamapi nivartayati iti te matam, tatra kathaṃ śuktikājñānāt sahājñānena adhyāse nivartyamāne punaḥ ātmani ajñānaṃ dṛśyate ataḥ prativiṣayamajñānabhedaḥ, adhyāsasya ajñānānupādānatvaṃ vā, upādānanivṛttimantareṇa adhyāsanivṛttirvā samāśrayaṇīyā iti,
analyzed: nanu atra api anupapattiḥ samānā katham śuktikā jñānam hi rūpa antara avabhāsam nivartayan tad upādānam ajñānam api nivartayati iti te matam tatra katham śuktikā jñānāt saha ajñānena adhyāse nivartyamāne punar ātmani ajñānam dṛśyate atas prati viṣayam ajñāna bhedaḥ adhyāsasya ajñāna anupādāna tvam vā upādāna nivṛttim antareṇa adhyāsa nivṛttiḥ vā samāśrayaṇīyā iti

original: ucyate;asmin pakṣe śuktikādijñānena rajatādyadhyāsānāṃ svakāraṇe pravilayamātraṃ kriyate musalaprahāreṇeva ghaṭasya| athavā -- mūlājñānasyaiva avasthābhedā rajatādyupādānāni śuktikādijñānaiḥ sahādhyāsena nivartante iti kalpyatām|
analyzed: ucyate asmin pakṣe śuktikā ādi jñānena rajata ādi adhyāsānām sva kāraṇe pravilaya mātram kriyate musala prahāreṇa iva ghaṭasya athavā mūla ajñānasya eva avasthā bhedāḥ rajata ādi upādānāni śuktikā ādi jñānaiḥ saha adhyāsena nivartante iti kalpyatām

original: kathaṃ punaḥ loke sahājñānenādhyāsasya tattvajñānāt nivṛtteḥ apratipattau brahmajñānāt sahājñānena adhyāsasya nivṛttiḥ dṛṣṭadvāreṇa kalpyate iti naiṣa doṣaḥ; tattvāvabhāsavirodhinaḥ agrahaṇamithyājñānādeḥ tattvajñānena nivṛttidarśanāt ihāpi tattvāvabhāsavirodhitayaiva bhāvarūpājñānādeḥ kalpyamānatvāt tasya brahmajñānāt nivṛtteḥ upapatteḥ|
analyzed: katham punar loke saha ajñānena adhyāsasya tattva jñānāt nivṛtteḥ apratipattau brahma jñānāt saha ajñānena adhyāsasya nivṛttiḥ dṛṣṭa dvāreṇa kalpyate iti na eṣa doṣaḥ tattva avabhāsa virodhinaḥ agrahaṇa mithyājñāna ādeḥ tattva jñānena nivṛtti darśanāt iha api tattva avabhāsa virodhi tayā eva bhāva rūpa ajñāna ādeḥ kalpyamāna tvāt tasya brahma jñānāt nivṛtteḥ upapatteḥ

original: na ca āvaraṇapakṣoktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ ; viṣayavyāvṛttarūpāntarasya bhrāntijñānena avagamāt| nanvevaṃ ātmanyapi ajñānanimittaṃ āvaraṇakṛtyaṃ nāsti, katham na tāvat āvaraṇaṃ prakāśavilopaḥ ; svarūpasya anapāyāt, nāpi sata eva prakāśasya kāryapratibandhaḥ ;
analyzed: na ca āvaraṇa pakṣa ukta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ viṣaya vyāvṛtta rūpa antarasya bhrānti jñānena avagamāt nanu evam ātmani api ajñāna nimittam āvaraṇa kṛtyam na asti katham na tāvat āvaraṇam prakāśa vilopaḥ svarūpasya anapāyāt na api sataḥ eva prakāśasya kārya pratibandhaḥ

original: jñānasya viṣayāvabhāsātmanā uditasya svakārye pratibandhapratīkṣayorabhāvāt, tasmāt naiva ātmanyapi bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ; anupayogāt iti tatrāha -- "pratyagātmani tu citisvabhāvatvāt svayaṃprakāśamāne"ityādinā "tasya anavabhāsaḥ"ityantena granthena||
analyzed: jñānasya viṣaya avabhāsa ātmanā uditasya sva kārye pratibandha pratīkṣayoḥ abhāvāt tasmāt na eva ātmani api bhāva rūpam ajñānam anupayogāt iti tatra āha pratyagātmani tu citi svabhāva tvāt svayam prakāśamānā ityādinā tasya anavabhāsaḥ iti antena granthena

original: ayamarthaḥ -- "asti, prakāśate" ityādyabhijñādivyavahāraṃ prati puṣkalakāraṇe sati -- "nāsti na prakāśate ca" iti yo'yaṃ ātmatattvālambano vyavahāraḥ, saḥ bhāvarūpeṇa kenacit ātmani āvaraṇamantareṇa nopapadyate;
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ asti prakāśate iti ādi abhijñā ādi vyavahāram prati puṣkala kāraṇe sati na asti na prakāśate ca iti yaḥ yam ātma tattva ālambanaḥ vyavahāraḥ saḥ bhāva rūpeṇa kenacid ātmani āvaraṇam antareṇa na upapadyate

original: sati puṣkalakāraṇe asati ca āvaraṇe, sannihite dhaṭe "prakāśate" ityādivyavahāradarśanāt, ato "nāsti brahma, na prakāśate ca" iti vyavahāraḥ anyathānupapattyā bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ gamayati iti arthāpattiḥ anumānaṃ vā samudāyārthaḥ|
analyzed: sati puṣkala kāraṇe asati ca āvaraṇe sannihite dhaṭe prakāśate ityādi vyavahāra darśanāt atas na asti brahma na prakāśate ca iti vyavahāraḥ anyathā anupapattyā bhāva rūpam ajñānam gamayati iti arthāpattiḥ anumānam vā samudāya arthaḥ

original: tatsiddhyarthamātmani "prakāśate" ityādivyavahāraṃ prati puṣkalakāraṇatāṃ darśayati -- citisvabhāvatvāt iti|| kiṃ tarhi āvaraṇamiti tatrāha -- brahmasvarūpānavabhāsasya iti|| "nāsti na prakāśate" iti vyāvahārālambanayogyatvasya vyavahārakāryadarśanādeva kalpyamānasya ityarthaḥ| na ca adhiṣṭhānapratibandhamantareṇa tatra viparyayakāryamupapadyate|
analyzed: tad siddhi artham ātmani prakāśate ityādi vyavahāram prati puṣkala kāraṇatām darśayati citi svabhāva tvāt iti kim tarhi āvaraṇam iti tatra āha brahma svarūpa anavabhāsasya iti na asti na prakāśate iti vyāvahāra ālambana yogya tvasya vyavahāra kārya darśanāt eva kalpyamānasya iti arthaḥ na ca adhiṣṭhāna pratibandham antareṇa tatra viparyaya kāryam upapadyate

original: avidyāsambandhatvādeva āvaraṇasya anirūpatitākāratā ca yuktā iti bhāvaḥ| nanu pramāṇavaikalyādeva atrāpyagrahaṇamiti, netyāha -- ananyamanimittatvāt iti|| ataḥ anavabhāsāt puṣkalakāraṇe sati pariśeṣāt idamāyātaṃ ityāha -- tadgatanisargasiddhāvidyāśaktipratibandhādeva tasyānavabhāsaḥ iti|| mūrtadravyāntarasya asambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: avidyā sambandha tvāt eva āvaraṇasya ca yuktā iti bhāvaḥ nanu pramāṇa vaikalyāt eva atra api agrahaṇam iti na iti āha ananyam animitta tvāt iti atas anavabhāsāt puṣkala kāraṇe sati pariśeṣāt idam āyātam iti āha tad gata nisarga siddha avidyā śakti pratibandhāt eva tasya anavabhāsaḥ iti mūrta dravya antarasya asambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: ataḥ kāryadarśanonneyaṃ āvaraṇakṛtyaṃ viparyayaṃ ca ātmani kurvāṇaṃ ajñānaṃ bhāvarūpameva ubhayakāraṇatvānyathānupapattyā kalpyate ityāha -- ataḥ sā pratyakciti iti||
analyzed: atas kārya darśana unneyam āvaraṇa kṛtyam viparyayam ca ātmani kurvāṇam ajñānam bhāva rūpam eva ubhaya kāraṇatva anyathā anupapattyā kalpyate iti āha atas sā pratyakciti iti

original: nanu agrahaṇamithyājñānatatsaṃskārebhyaḥ anyat ajñānaṃ nāma na paśyāmaḥ, ta eva ca jīvasya svayaṃprakāśamānamapi brahmasvarūpāvabhāsaṃ pratibadhnanti iti, netyāha -- suṣuptādau ca iti|| tatrāpi avidyāśaktiḥ saṃskāraśeṣaṃ tiṣṭhatīti, na saṃskārādaya eva ajñānaṃ ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu agrahaṇa mithyājñāna tad saṃskārebhyaḥ anyat ajñānam nāma na paśyāmaḥ te eva ca jīvasya svayam prakāśamānam api brahma svarūpa avabhāsam pratibadhnanti iti na iti āha suṣupta ādau ca iti tatra api avidyā śaktiḥ saṃskāra śeṣam tiṣṭhati iti na saṃskāra ādayaḥ eva ajñānam iti arthaḥ

original: katham na tāvat suṣuptādau svayamprakāśabrahmasvarūpānavabhāsaḥ puruṣāntarasaṃvedanavat draṣṭurbhinnatvāt iti śakyaṃ vaktum; ekatvaśruteḥ, nāpi mithyājñānapratibandhāt; tatra tasya abhāvāt, nāpi tatsaṃskārapratibandhāt;
analyzed: katham na tāvat suṣupta ādau svayam prakāśa brahma sva rūpa anavabhāsaḥ puruṣa antara saṃvedana vat draṣṭuḥ bhinna tvāt iti śakyam vaktum ekatva śruteḥ nā api mithyājñāna pratibandhāt tatra tasya abhāvāt nā api tad saṃskāra pratibandhāt

original: bhrāntisaṃskārāṇāṃ tattvāvabhāsapratibandhakatvābhāvāt, satsvapi rajatabhramasaṃskāreṣu śuktikāvabodhadarśanāt, nāpi agrahaṇapratibandhāt; svarūpagrahaṇasya nityatvāt svayaṃprakāśamāne saṃvedane tadviṣayakādācitkāgrahaṇasya apratibandhakatvāt, nāpi karmaṇāṃ svarūpāvabhāsavirodhitā;
analyzed: bhrānti saṃskārāṇām tattva avabhāsa pratibandhaka tva abhāvāt satsu api rajata bhrama saṃskāreṣu śuktikā avabodha darśanāt na api agrahaṇa pratibandhāt svarūpa grahaṇasya nitya tvāt svayam prakāśamāne saṃvedane tad viṣaya kādācitka agrahaṇasya apratibandhaka tvāt na api karmaṇām sva rūpa avabhāsa virodhi tā

original: sarvadā aṇumātrasyāpi caitanyasya anavabhāsaprasaṅgāt, ajñāne'pi tulyaṃ iti cet, na; tasya svaviṣayacaitanyāvabhāsaṃ prati apratibandhakatvāt, na ca ajñānasyeva karmaṇāṃ nityavat sākṣicaitanyena avabhāsyatā, yena tadavabhāsakatayā sākṣicaitanyamapratibaddhaṃ prakāśeta| na ca karmāṇi svāśrayāvabhāsavirodhīni iti pramāṇamasti|
analyzed: sarvadā aṇu mātrasya api caitanyasya anavabhāsa prasaṅgāt ajñāne api tulyam iti cet na tasya sva viṣaya caitanya avabhāsam prati apratibandhaka tvāt na ca ajñānasya iva karmaṇām nitya vat sākṣi caitanyena avabhāsya tā yena tad avabhāsaka tayā sākṣi caitanyam apratibaddham prakāśeta na ca karmāṇi sva āśraya avabhāsa virodhīni iti pramāṇam asti

original: saṃskāratvācca karmaṇāṃ bhrāntisaṃskāravat apratibandhakatā| tasmāt suṣuptādau svarūpānavabhāsavyavahāraḥ agrahaṇamithyājñānatatsaṃskārakarmabhyaḥ anyadeva kiṃcit pratibandhakaṃ ajñānaṃ kalpayatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: saṃskāra tvāt ca karmaṇām bhrānti saṃskāra vat apratibandhaka tā tasmāt suṣupta ādau sva rūpa anavabhāsa vyavahāraḥ agrahaṇa mithyājñāna tad saṃskāra karmabhyaḥ anyat eva kiṃcid pratibandhakam ajñānam kalpayati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu dravyāntarameva pratibandhakaṃ kalpyatāṃ, kimajñānakalpanayā iti, naitat;brahmajñānāt pratibandhanivṛttimantareṇa svaviṣayāvabhāsāyogāt, jñānanivartyasya ca ajñānatvāt||
analyzed: nanu dravya antaram eva pratibandhakam kalpyatām kim ajñāna kalpanayā iti na etat brahma jñānāt pratibandha nivṛttim antareṇa sva viṣaya avabhāsa ayogāt jñāna nivartyasya ca ajñāna tvāt

original: atra kaścit bhedābhedābhyāṃ sarvasaṃkaravādī vedāntārthagahanasampradāyahīnaḥ durjaramaṇīyāṃ vācaṃ jalpati -- na kila agrahaṇamithyājñānatatsaṃskārebhyaḥ anyat sakalasaṃsārabījabhūtaṃ avasthātraye'pi anapāyi āsaṃsāravimokṣāt daṇḍāyamānamajñānaṃ nāma asti, kiṃ tu bhrāntijñānaṃ agrahaṇaṃ vā ajñānaṃ iti||
analyzed: atra kaścid bheda abhedābhyām sarva saṃkara vādī vedānta artha gahana sampradāya hīnaḥ durjara maṇīyām vācam jalpati na kila agrahaṇa mithyājñāna tad saṃskārebhyaḥ anyat sakala saṃsāra bīja bhūtam avasthā traye api anapāyi ā saṃsāra vimokṣāt daṇḍāyamānam ajñānam nāma asti kim tu bhrānti jñānam agrahaṇam vā ajñānam iti

original: ayaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ -- keyaṃ bhrāntiḥ iti| ahaṃkārādiśarīraparyante anātmani ātmabuddhiḥ iti cet , aho vismaraṇaśīlatā sarvatra saṅgīrṇacetasaḥ|
analyzed: ayam praṣṭavyaḥ kā iyam bhrāntiḥ iti ahaṃkāra ādi śarīra paryante anātmani ātma buddhiḥ iti ced aho vismaraṇa śīla tā sarvatra saṅgīrṇa cetasaḥ

original: "khaṇḍo gauḥ" ityādibhedābhedapratyayaṃ pramāṇamupapādayan "ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ" iti pratyayaṃ bhedābhedaviṣayaṃ kimiti upekṣase "nāhaṃ manuṣyaḥ brahmāsmi" iti pratyayasāmarthyāt iti cet, tanna;"nāyaṃ khaṇḍo gauḥ, kiṃ tu muṇḍo gauḥ" iti pratyaye'pi khaṇḍamuṇḍābhyāṃ gotvasya abhedavat śarīrabrahmabhyāṃ jīvasya abhedapratyayasyāpi prāmāṇyopapatteḥ|
analyzed: khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ ityādi bheda abheda pratyayam pramāṇam upapādayan aham manuṣyaḥ iti pratyayam bheda abheda viṣayam kim iti upekṣase na aham manuṣyaḥ brahma asmi iti pratyaya sāmarthyāt iti ced khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ kim tu muṇḍaḥ gauḥ iti pratyaye pi khaṇḍa muṇḍābhyām go tvasya abheda vat śarīra brahmabhyām jīvasya abheda pratyayasya api prāmāṇya upapatteḥ

original: idaṃrajatavat bhrāntiḥ iti cet, na;khaṇḍo gauḥ ityatrāpi tathātvaprasaṅgāt, "nāyaṃ khaṇḍo gauḥ, kiṃ tu muṇḍaḥ" iti vyaktyantare khaṇḍasya gotvopādhau niṣedhapratyayasāmarthyāt tatra vyavahārānucchedāt prāmāṇyaṃ iti cet, tat -- "ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ" ityatrāpi tulyam; mokṣāvasthāyāmapi sarvātmatvāt tava sarvaśarīrendriyādyabhimānavyavahārānucchedāt|
analyzed: idam rajata vat bhrāntiḥ iti ced na khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ iti atra api tathātva prasaṅgāt na ayam khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ kim tu muṇḍaḥ iti vyakti antare khaṇḍasya go tva upādhau niṣedha pratyaya sāmarthyāt tatra vyavahāra anucchedāt prāmāṇyam iti ced tat aham manuṣyaḥ iti atra api tulyam mokṣa avasthāyām api sarva ātma tvāt tava sarva śarīra indriya ādi abhimāna vyavahāra anucchedāt

original: jātivyakti guṇaguṇi kāryakāraṇa viśiṣṭasvarūpa aṃśāṃśi sabandhāḥ yatra vidyante, tatra bhedābhedau, na śarīrātmanoḥ; teṣāmabhāvāt iti cet, tarhi śarīraśarīrisambandho'pi guṇaguṇyādivat bhedanimittaṃ kiṃ na syāt anyathā sarvasaṅkaravāditayā kṣapaṇakaśiṣyatā cirakālasamupārjitā bādhyeta|
analyzed: jāti vyakti guṇa guṇi kārya kāraṇa viśiṣṭa svarūpa aṃśa aṃśi sabandhāḥ yatra vidyante tatra bheda abhedau na śarīra ātmanoḥ teṣām abhāvāt iti ced tarhi śarīra śarīri sambandhaḥ api guṇa guṇi ādi vat bheda nimittam kim na syāt anyathā sarva saṅkara vādi tayā kṣapaṇaka śiṣya tā cira kāla samupārjitā bādhyeta

original: asti ca cetanasvarūpaśarīrayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, cetanasvarūpāṃśasya brahmatvāt, ataḥ na te bhrāntirasti||
analyzed: asti ca cetana sva rūpa śarīrayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ cetana sva rūpa aṃśasya brahma tvāt atas na te bhrāntiḥ asti

original: kiṃ ca, bhrāntijñānaṃ antaḥkaraṇapariṇāmaścet, tadā ātmāśrayā avidyā na syāt, antaḥkaraṇapariṇāma eva ātmani adhyasta iti cet, tathāpi anyathākhyātivādinaḥ saṃsargasya śūnyatvāt ātmāvidyāsambandho na syāt| na ca ātmapariṇāmo bhrāntiḥ; apariṇāmitvāt| na ca jñānaguṇasya dravyasya punaḥ jñānaguṇāntarākāreṇa pariṇāmaḥ sambhavati;
analyzed: kim ca bhrānti jñānam antaḥkaraṇa pariṇāmaḥ ced tadā ātma āśrayā avidyā na syāt antaḥkaraṇa pariṇāmaḥ eva ātmani adhyastaḥ iti ced tathā api anyathā khyāti vādinaḥ saṃsargasya śūnya tvāt ātma avidyā sambandhaḥ na syāt na ca ātma pariṇāmaḥ bhrāntiḥ apariṇāmi tvāt na ca jñāna guṇasya dravyasya punar jñāna guṇa antara ākāreṇa pariṇāmaḥ sambhavati

original: avāntarajātīyasya ekasmin dravye guṇadvayasya yugapat samavāyāyogāt, na hi paṭe śauklyaṃ yugapat samavaiti| tasmāt anādisiddhamithyājñānānabhyupagame na kācitsarvasaṅkaravādino'vidyā sambhavati| anādimithyājñānasambandho'pi ātmani ajñānavat kālpanikatvāt ākāśakārṣṇyavat ātmanaḥ kūṭasthatāṃ na vihanti ityalamatiprasaṅgena|
analyzed: avāntara jātīyasya ekasmin dravye guṇa dvayasya yugapad samavāya ayogāt na hi paṭe śauklyam yugapad samavaiti tasmāt anādi siddha mithyājñāna anabhyupagame na kācid sarva saṅkara vādinaḥ vidyā sambhavati anādi mithyājñāna sambandhaḥ api ātmani ajñāna vat kālpanika tvāt ākāśa kārṣṇya vat ātmanaḥ kūṭastha tām na vihanti iti alam atiprasaṅgena

original: atra ca pratyakṣānumānārthāpattayaḥ anādibhāvarūpājñāne pramāṇatvena upanyastāḥ| tatra evaṃbhūtena kāraṇarūpeṇa kāryarūpeṇa ca naimittikatvanaisargikatve na viruddhe ityupasaṃharati -- ato naisargiko'pyahaṅkāra iti||"anyo'nyadharmāṃśca" ityādiḥ adhyāsasvarūpaṃ darśayati ityanto granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ||
analyzed: atra ca pratyakṣa anumāna arthāpattayaḥ anādi bhāva rūpa ajñāne pramāṇa tvena upanyastāḥ tatra evaṃbhūtena kāraṇa rūpeṇa kārya rūpeṇa ca naimittika tva naisargika tve na viruddhe iti upasaṃharati atas naisargikaḥ api ahaṅkāraḥ iti anyonya dharmān ca ityādiḥ adhyāsa svarūpam darśayati iti antaḥ granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ

original: niṣkalaṅkacaitanyaikatāne niraṃśānandaikarase ajñānādisākṣiṇi anādisiddhe'pi ajñānādhyāse, kādācitkamadhyāsamāśritya āha -- ahamiti tāvat prathamo'dhyāsaḥ iti|| nanu "idaṃ rajataṃ" itivat
analyzed: niṣkalaṅka caitanya eka tāne niraṃśa ānanda ekarase ajñāna ādi sākṣiṇi anādi siddhe api ajñāna adhyāse kādācitkam adhyāsam āśritya āha aham iti tāvat prathamaḥ udhyāsaḥ iti nanu idam rajatam itivat

original: adhyāse "dvairūpyaṃ ahaṃ" ityatrāpi vaktavyam| "ahaṃ" iti ca ekarūpeṇāvabhāsate, ato nādhyāsaḥ iti codayati -- nanvahamiti niraṃśacaitanyamātraṃ iti|| yathā dvairūpyeṇādhyāsasambhavaḥ, tathā vakṣyata ityāha -- yathādhyāstāṃśāntarbhāvaḥ iti||
analyzed: adhyāse dvairūpyam aham iti atra api vaktavyam aham iti ca eka rūpeṇa avabhāsate atas na adhyāsaḥ iti codayati nanu aham iti niraṃśa caitanya mātram iti yathā dvairūpyeṇa adhyāsa sambhavaḥ tathā vakṣyate iti āha yathā adhyāsta aṃśa antarbhāvaḥ iti

original: nanu antaḥkaraṇendriyāṇāmātmānaḥ pṛthaksattvopalabdhyabhāvāt adhyastatayaiva siddheḥ ātmatattvāvabodhena na svarūpato vilayaśravaṇāt svarūpeṇa saṃsṛṣṭarūpeṇa ca ātmanyadhyastatayā siddhistu, śarīraṃ punarindriyairidaṃbuddhigṛhītatvāt kevalasākṣivedyatvābhāvāt utkrānte'pyātmani pṛthagupalabdheḥ bhūteṣu layaśravaṇācca na adhyastatayā siddhaṃ iti
analyzed: nanu antaḥkaraṇa indriyāṇām ātmānaḥ pṛthak sattva upalabdhi abhāvāt adhyasta tayā eva siddheḥ ātma tattva avabodhena na svarūpataḥ vilaya śravaṇāt sva rūpeṇa saṃsṛṣṭa rūpeṇa ca ātmani adhyasta tayā siddhiḥ tu śarīram punar indriyaiḥ idam buddhi gṛhīta tvāt kevala sākṣi vedya tva abhāvāt utkrānte api ātmani pṛthak upalabdheḥ bhūteṣu laya śravaṇāt ca na adhyasta tayā siddham iti

original: codayati -- nanvidamityahaṃkartuḥ iti|| śarīravyatiriktaṃ mamabuddhigṛhītaṃ sutarāmanadhyastamityāha -- mamedamiti ca iti||
analyzed: codayati nanu idam iti ahaṃkartuḥ iti śarīra vyatiriktam mama buddhi gṛhītam sutarām anadhyastam iti āha mama idam iti ca iti

original: śarīrādipadārthasvarūpasya mithyākalpitakartṛbhoktṛpramātṛdoṣasaṃyuktātmārthatayaiva kāryatayā bhogyatayā prameyatayā dveṣyatayā ca tādarthyenaiva sṛṣṭatvāt svarūpeṇāpi mithyātvaṃ svapnadṛṣṭāntena anumātuṃ śakyate ityāha -- ucyate yadaivāhaṃkartā ityādinā|| dārṣṭāntikaṃ darśayati -- evamahaṃkartṛtvapramukhaḥ iti||
analyzed: śarīra ādi padārtha svarūpasya mithyā kalpita kartṛ bhoktṛ pramātṛ doṣa saṃyukta ātma artha tayā eva kārya tayā bhogya tayā prameya tayā dveṣya tayā ca tādarthyena eva sṛṣṭa tvāt sva rūpeṇa api mithyātvam svapna dṛṣṭāntena anumātum śakyate iti āha ucyate yadā eva ahaṃkartā ityādinā dārṣṭāntikam darśayati evam ahaṃkartṛ tva pramukhaḥ iti

original: draṣṭari dṛṣyāvabhāsasyāvidyādhyāsattve śāstrīyaviṣayaprayojanasiddhiḥ phaliṣyati ityāha -- atastādṛgbrahmātmānubhavaparyantāt iti|| tādṛgbrahmātmānubhavo bandhanivṛttiśca upapadyate ityarthaḥ| viṣayaprayojanasiddhau kimāyātam iti| śāstrārambhakartavyatā siddhā ityāha -- tadarthaviṣayavedāntamīmāṃsārambhaḥ iti||
analyzed: draṣṭari dṛṣya avabhāsasya avidyā adhyāsa ttve śāstrīya viṣaya prayojana siddhiḥ phaliṣyati iti āha atas tādṛś brahma ātma anubhava paryantāt iti tādṛś brahma ātma anubhavaḥ bandha nivṛttiḥ ca upapadyate iti arthaḥ viṣaya prayojana siddhau kim āyātam iti śāstra ārambha kartavya tā siddhā iti āha tad artha viṣaya vedānta mīmāṃsā ārambhaḥ iti

original: te eva-brahmātmānubhavabandhanivṛttī, arthaḥ-prayojanaṃ viṣayaśca yasya vedāntamīmāṃsārambhasya iti vigrahaḥ| "sarvalokapratyakṣa" ityantasya uttarabhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- āha ko'yaṃ iti|| idanīṃ vibhajya avāntaratātparyaṃ kathayati -- tatrāpi iti||
analyzed: te eva brahma ātma anubhava bandha nivṛttī arthaḥ prayojanam viṣayaḥ ca yasya vedānta mīmāṃsā ārambhasya iti vigrahaḥ sarva loka pratyakṣaḥ iti antasya uttara bhāṣyasya tātparyam āha āha kaḥ yam iti idanīm vibhajya avāntara tātparyam kathayati tatra api iti

original: lakṣaṇasambhāvanāparabhāṣyamākṣipati -- yadyevaṃ iti|| kimiti lakṣaṇasambhāvane nāpekṣyete iti tatrāha -- na hyanirjñātarūpaṃ iti|| pramāṇameva hi prameyaṃ anyasya anyātmanā avabhāsamadhyāsaṃ vyavasthāpayat svadeśakālopādhau sambhāvitarūpaṃ sarvatovyāvṛttāsādhāraṇarūpaṃ ca vyavasthāpayati, kiṃ pṛthak lakṣaṇasambhāvanopanyāsena ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: lakṣaṇa sambhāvanā para bhāṣyam ākṣipati yadi evam iti kim iti lakṣaṇa sambhāvane na apekṣyete iti tatra āha na hi anirjñāta rūpam iti pramāṇam eva hi prameyam anyasya anya ātmanā avabhāsam adhyāsam vyavasthāpayat sva deśa kāla upādhau sambhāvita rūpam sarvatas vyāvṛtta asādhāraṇa rūpam ca vyavasthāpayati kim pṛthak lakṣaṇa sambhāvanā upanyāsena iti arthaḥ

original: nanu anumānādipramāṇanirjñāteṣu vastumātreṣu viśeṣalakṣaṇasambhāvane pṛthagapekṣyete, iti ata āha -- duḥsaṃpādaṃ iti|| viśeṣata iti|| asādhāraṇākāravyāvṛttatayā ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu anumāna ādi pramāṇa nirjñāteṣu vastu mātreṣu viśeṣa lakṣaṇa sambhāvane pṛthak apekṣyete iti atas āha duḥsaṃpādam iti viśeṣataḥ iti asādhāraṇa ākāra vyāvṛtta tayā iti arthaḥ

original: tatra draṣṭuranyasya dṛśyena anyātmanā avabhāso vidyata ityetāvati pramāṇaṃ vakṣyate, na tasya avidyābhrāntyadhyāsamithyātve, ataḥ tatpramāṇena na sidhyati iti pariharati -- ucyate -- na dehendriyādiṣu ityādinā||
analyzed: tatra draṣṭuḥ anyasya dṛśyena anya ātmanā avabhāsaḥ vidyate iti etāvati pramāṇam vakṣyate na tasya avidyā bhrānti adhyāsa mithyātve atas tad pramāṇena na sidhyati iti pariharati ucyate na deha indriya ādiṣu ityādinā

original: nanu anyasya anyātmanāvabhāsapramāṇenaiva tanmithyātvamapi sidhyati, prameyaikyāt iti codayati -- tat kasya hetoḥ iti|| nānubhavādeva iti pariharati -- loke iti|| nanu pramāṇe sati kimiti anubhavābhāvaḥ pramāṇabhedāt ityāha -- bādhe hi sati iti|| bādhānupapattirmithyātve pramāṇaṃ;
analyzed: nanu anyasya anya ātmanā avabhāsa pramāṇena eva tad mithyātvam api sidhyati prameya aikyāt iti codayati tat kasya hetoḥ iti na anubhavāt eva iti pariharati loke iti nanu pramāṇe sati kim iti anubhava abhāvaḥ pramāṇa bhedāt iti āha bādhe hi sati iti bādhā anupapattiḥ mithyātve pramāṇam

original: pratyakṣānumānavyavahārānupapattyāgamā ātmanyanātmāvabhāse pramāṇaṃ iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ihāpi bādhanimittamitaretaravivekamantareṇa anyasyānyātmanā'vabhāso'yaṃ ityavagantuṃ na śakyate; anyathā svasyaiva svenātmanā avabhāsaḥ kiṃ na syāt iti netyāha -- neha sa vidyate iti|| yauktikajñānādinā parokṣavivekamāśritya parasparātmanā'vabhāsaniścayaḥ|
analyzed: pratyakṣa anumāna vyavahāra anupapatti āgamāḥ ātmani anātma avabhāse pramāṇam iti bhāvaḥ nanu iha api bādha nimittam itaretara vivekam antareṇa anyasya anya ātmanā avabhāsaḥ yaḥ iti avagantum na śakyate anyathā svasya eva svena ātmanā avabhāsaḥ kim na syāt iti na iti āha na iha sa vidyate iti yauktika jñāna ādinā parokṣa vivekam āśritya paraspara ātmanā avabhāsa niścayaḥ

original: aparokṣabādhasya bhrāntipratibhāsocchedino'bhāvāt na spaṣṭo mithyātvādhyavasāyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| ataḥ avidyātvaspaṣṭīkaraṇāya lakṣaṇameva vaktavyaṃ ityāha -- tasmādadhyāsasya iti|| tarhi lakṣaṇapramāṇābhyāmeva vastunirṇayasiddheḥ pramāṇenaiva asambhāvanānirākaraṇāt sambhāvanā pṛthak na vaktavyā iti codayati -- nanu evamapi iti||
analyzed: aparokṣa bādhasya bhrānti pratibhāsa ucchedinaḥ bhāvāt na spaṣṭaḥ mithyātva adhyavasāyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ atas avidyā tva spaṣṭīkaraṇāya lakṣaṇam eva vaktavyam iti āha tasmāt adhyāsasya iti tarhi lakṣaṇa pramāṇābhyām eva vastu nirṇaya siddheḥ pramāṇena eva asambhāvanā nirākaraṇāt sambhāvanā pṛthak na vaktavyā iti codayati nanu evam api iti

original: satyapi pramāṇasāmarthye pratyakṣāvabhāsanamapi asambhāvyamānatayā nirākṛtamanubhūyate iti anubhavamevāvalambya pariharati -- satyamevaṃ iti|| autpātikaḥ iti|| adṛṣṭavyatiriktakāraṇaśūnyaḥ ityarthaḥ||
analyzed: sati api pramāṇa sāmarthye pratyakṣa avabhāsanam api asambhāvyamāna tayā nirākṛtam anubhūyate iti anubhavam eva avalambya pariharati satyam evam iti autpātikaḥ iti adṛṣṭa vyatirikta kāraṇa śūnyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu pramāṇenaiva kvacidasambhāvanā tiraskriyate, yathā ākāśagamane pakṣiṇām; kvacidasambhāvanayā pratibhāsaḥ aparokṣo'pi nirasyate, yathā savitṛsuṣyādau; tatra ātmani anātmāvabhāsaḥ kaṃ pakṣamavalambatām iti asambhāvanāpakṣameva iti viśeṣaṃ darśayati -- evamaviṣaye'ṅge iti||
analyzed: nanu pramāṇena eva kvacid asambhāvanā tiraskriyate yathā ākāśa gamane pakṣiṇām kvacid asambhāvanayā pratibhāsaḥ aparokṣaḥ api nirasyate yathā savitṛ suṣya ādau tatra ātmani anātma avabhāsaḥ kam pakṣam avalambatām iti asambhāvanā pakṣam eva iti viśeṣam darśayati evam aviṣaya iṅge iti

original: adhiṣṭhānasyādhyasyamānena saha ekajñānaviṣayatvaṃ vaktavyam, tadabhāvāt na adhyāsasambhavaḥ ityāha -- aviṣaye iti|| draṣṭurvyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya kāryakāraṇasaṃghātasya adhyāsātmakatvena draṣṭaryeva kācādivat doṣānuṣaṅgo vaktavyaḥ, tadabhāvāt na adhyāsasambhavaḥ
analyzed: adhiṣṭhānasya adhyasyamānena saha eka jñāna viṣaya tvam vaktavyam tad abhāvāt na adhyāsa sambhavaḥ iti āha aviṣaye iti draṣṭuḥ vyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya kārya kāraṇa saṃghātasya adhyāsa ātmaka tvena draṣṭari eva kāca ādi vat doṣa anuṣaṅgaḥ vaktavyaḥ tad abhāvāt na adhyāsa sambhavaḥ

analyzed: iti āha asaṅge iti adhiṣṭhānasya adhyasyamānena guṇa avayava sādṛśyam vaktavyam tad abhāvāt na adhyāsa sambhavaḥ iti āha kenacid api guṇa ādinā iti adhiṣṭhāna yāthātmya avabhāsaḥ adhyāsa virodhī tad bhāvāt ca na adhyāsa sambhavaḥ iti āha niṣkalaṅka caitanya tayā iti

original: nanu ātmanyaviṣayādirūpe anavagate nāsambhavānābuddhiḥ, avagate tu nādhyāsa eva tiṣṭhati, kuto'sambhāvanābuddhiḥ iti| naitat sāram;ātmanyaviṣayādirūpe parokṣāvabhāso'sambhāvanābuddhihetuḥ aparokṣāvabhāso'dhyāsasya nivartakaḥ ityuktatvāt| upasaṃharati -- tat māśaṅki iti|| taducyate||tat- tritayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sambhāvanā pramāṇaṃ krameṇocyata ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu ātmani aviṣaya ādi rūpe anavagate avagate tu na adhyāsaḥ eva tiṣṭhati kutas sambhāvanā buddhiḥ iti na etat sāram ātmani aviṣaya ādi rūpe parokṣa avabhāsa usambhāvanā buddhi hetuḥ aparokṣa avabhāsa udhyāsasya nivartakaḥ iti ukta tvāt upasaṃharati tat mā āśaṅki iti tat ucyate etat tritayam lakṣaṇam sambhāvanā pramāṇam krameṇa ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: anantarabhāṣyasya tātāparyamāha -- āha ko'yaṃ iti|| tantreṇa iti| yugapadarthadvayavivakṣayā ityarthaḥ| ubhayasya ceha sambhavāt iti|| lakṣaṇapraśnasya sambhāvanākṣepasyā ca sambhavāt ityarthaḥ| ubhayamatraiva vivakṣitaṃ cet sambhāvanaiva prathamaṃ kiṃ na pradarśyata iti atrāha -- tatrāpi iti|| svarūpamākhyāya iti prāthamye hetuḥ||
analyzed: anantara bhāṣyasya tāta āparyam āha āha iti tantreṇa iti yugapad artha dvaya vivakṣayā iti arthaḥ ubhayasya ca iha sambhavāt iti lakṣaṇa praśnasya ca sambhavāt iti arthaḥ ubhayam atra eva vivakṣitam ced sambhāvanā eva prathamam kim na pradarśyate iti atra āha tatra api iti svarūpam ākhyāya iti prāthamye hetuḥ

original: nanu āha iti paroktikathanaṃ kimartham iti arthanirṇayapradhānatvāt vādakathā śāstram, tatra "pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhaḥ siddhāntaviruddhaḥ pañcāvayavopapannaḥ pakṣapratipakṣaparigraho vādaḥ" iti vādiprativādibhyāṃ guruśiṣyābhyā vā pakṣapratipakṣaparigraheṇa kriyamāṇā arthanirṇayāvasānā vādakathā atra pravṛttā iti darśayituṃ paroktikathanaṃ
analyzed: nanu āha iti para ukti kathanam kimartham iti artha nirṇaya pradhāna tvāt vāda kathā śāstram tatra pramāṇa tarka sādhana upālambhaḥ siddhānta viruddhaḥ pañcāvayava upapannaḥ pakṣa pratipakṣa parigrahaḥ vādaḥ iti vādi prativādibhyām guru śiṣyābhyām vā pakṣa pratipakṣa parigraheṇa kriyamāṇā artha nirṇaya avasānā vāda kathā atra pravṛttā iti darśayitum para ukti kathanam

original: ityāha -- tatraivambhūte viṣaye ityādinā|| tenākṣiptam ākṣepharūpaṃ api abhiprāyaṃ anena pṛṣṭaṃ eva iti matvā pratyuktaṃ punarasau ākṣeparūpeṇa vivṛṇoti iti ākṣepamavatārya iti vyākhyeyam| nanu śāstreṣu jalpavitaṇḍābhiprāyeṇāpi paroktirasti iti , netyāha -- sarvatraivaṃvidhe iti||

original: nanu lakṣaṇavākye lakṣyābhidhāyinaḥ padasyābhāvāt sākāṅkṣaṃ vacanamanarthakaṃ ityāśaṅkya vākyaṃ pūrayati praśnavākyasthitaṃ iti|| nanu parasya parātmanā avabhāso'dhyāsaḥ iti vakṣyati, tatra kathamekenaiva paraśabdena lakṣaṇaṃ pūryate iti atrāha -- tatra paratretyukte iti|| uttaro granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|

original: nanu smaryate cet rūpaśabdaḥ kimartha iti asmaryamāṇe vastuni upamāsamāsārthaḥ ityāha -- smaryamāṇarūpamiva iti|| nanu kimupamāsamāsena smaryate eva "idaṃ rajatam" iti, netyāha -- na punaḥ smaryata eva iti|| nanu cakṣurādipramāṇābhāvāt pariśeṣāt smṛtiriti, netyāha -- spaṣṭaṃ puro'vasthitatvāvabhāsanāt iti||
analyzed: nanu smaryate ced rūpa śabdaḥ kimarthaḥ iti asmaryamāṇe vastuni upamā samāsa arthaḥ iti āha smaryamāṇa rūpam iva iti nanu kim upamā samāsena smaryate eva idam rajatam iti na iti āha na punar smaryate eva iti nanu cakṣuḥ ādi pramāṇa abhāvāt pariśeṣāt smṛtiḥ iti na iti āha spaṣṭam purovasthita tva avabhāsanāt iti

original: yathā anyatra "idaṃ rajatam ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ" ityādāvitaretarasaṃsṛṣṭau sāmānyaviśeṣāvaparokṣāvavabhāsete, tathehāpi pratibhāsaḥ| na hi paramārthedaṃrajatasaṃvedanākārāvabhāsanyūnatāmantareṇa saṃsargasaṃvidaṃśābhāvaḥ śakyate vaktum||
analyzed: yathā anyatra idam rajatam ayam ghaṭaḥ ityādau itaretara saṃsṛṣṭau sāmānya viśeṣau aparokṣau avabhāsete tathā iha api pratibhāsaḥ na hi paramārtha idam rajata saṃvedana ākāra avabhāsa nyūna tām antareṇa saṃsarga saṃvid aṃśa abhāvaḥ śakyate vaktum

original: arthābhāve kathamaparokṣā saṃviditi cet, na; yathāsaṃvidavabhāsādhīnatvādarthasattāniścayasya| na hi arthasattāniścayādhīnaḥ saṃvitsattāniścayaḥ| arthasattāniścayasyāpi niścayāntarādhīnatvaprasaṅgāt| nanu "nedaṃ rajatam" ityuttarasaṃvedanādarthābhāvo'pi niścitaḥ| na -- tatrāpi pūrvasaṃvedanena sadbhāvaviṣayeṇa virodhāt|
analyzed: artha abhāve katham aparokṣā saṃvid iti ced na yathā saṃvid avabhāsa adhīna tvāt artha sattā niścayasya na hi artha sattā niścaya adhīnaḥ saṃvid sattā niścayaḥ artha sattā niścayasya api niścaya antara adhīna tva prasaṅgāt nanu na idam rajatam iti uttara saṃvedanāt artha abhāvaḥ api niścitaḥ na tatra api pūrva saṃvedanena sadbhāva viṣayeṇa virodhāt

original: idaṃrajatābhāvasaṃvedanānāmavivekakalpanayā uttarajñāne'pi saṃsargasaṃvidabhāvaḥ kiṃ na syāt vyavahārasaṃvādajñānāduttarajñāne saṃsargasaṃvitsadbhāvaścet, na -- arthakriyāsaṃvādajñānādarthasaṃvitsadbhāvaniścayaḥ iti vadataḥ saṃvitpratyakṣatvavādahānāt; arthakriyāsaṃvido'pi saṃvidantarādhīnasadbhāvaniścayaprasaṅgāt||
analyzed: idam rajata abhāva saṃvedanānām aviveka kalpanayā uttara jñāne api saṃsarga saṃvid abhāvaḥ kim na syāt vyavahāra saṃvāda jñānāt uttara jñāne saṃsarga saṃvid sadbhāvaḥ ced na arthakriyā saṃvāda jñānāt artha saṃvid sadbhāva niścayaḥ iti vadataḥ saṃvid pratyakṣa tva vāda hānāt arthakriyā saṃvidaḥ api saṃvid antara adhīna sadbhāva niścaya prasaṅgāt

original: nanu sampratipannaḥ arthābhāvaḥ| na; yathāpratibhāsameva mithyārajatasya uttarajñānena nirasanayogyasya upagamāt, laukikaparamārthadṛṣṭarajatapratiyogikābhāvaviṣayatvāt rajate traikālyābhāvajñānasya iti saṃviddvayānurodhena vyavasthāsiddheḥ anyatarasaṃvidapahnavāyogāt|
analyzed: nanu sampratipannaḥ artha abhāvaḥ na yathā pratibhāsam eva mithyārajatasya uttara jñānena nirasana yogyasya upagamāt laukika paramārtha dṛṣṭa rajata pratiyogika abhāva viṣaya tvāt rajate traikālya abhāva jñānasya iti saṃvid dvaya anurodhena vyavasthā siddheḥ anyatara saṃvid apahnava ayogāt

original: tathā ca ubhayasaṃvidviṣayānubhavaḥ "nāstyatra rajataṃ" "mithyaiva rajatamabhāt" iti| nanu aparokṣaśuktikājñānāvivekāt rajatamaparokṣatayā pratibhāsate iti; netyāha -- spaṣṭaṃ iti|| keyaṃ spaṣṭatā nāma vivekajñānasamaye'pi -- "etāvantaṃ kālamidaṃ rajatamiti abhāt" iti saṃsṛṣṭāvabhāsatvena pratyabhijñāyogyatā;
analyzed: tathā ca ubhaya saṃvid viṣaya anubhavaḥ na asti atra rajatam mithyā eva rajatam abhāt iti nanu aparokṣa śuktikā jñāna avivekāt rajatam aparokṣa tayā pratibhāsate iti na iti āha spaṣṭam iti kā iyam spaṣṭa tā nāma viveka jñāna samaye pi etāvantam kālam idam rajatam iti abhāt iti saṃsṛṣṭa avabhāsa tvena pratyabhijñā yogya tā

original: anyathā "tat rajatametāvantaṃ kālamito'viviktaṃ" iti pratiyāt, athavā -- tajjñānāt tatra pravṛttiḥ iti padārthāṃśajñānatatpravṛttyoḥ niyamāt ihāpi saṃsargapravṛttinimittatā saṃsargajñānasya spaṣṭatā iti|
analyzed: anyathā tat rajatam etāvantam kālam itas viviktam iti pratiyāt athavā tad jñānāt tatra pravṛttiḥ iti padārtha aṃśa jñāna tad pravṛttyoḥ niyamāt iha api saṃsarga pravṛtti nimitta tā saṃsarga jñānasya spaṣṭa tā iti

original: "pūrvadṛṣṭāvabhāsaḥ" iti spaṣṭārthaḥ||

yadā jñānaviśiṣṭo'rtha evādhyāsaḥ, tadā smaryamāṇasadṛśaḥ anyātmanāvabhāsamāno'nyo'rtho'dhyāsaḥ ityevaṃlakṣaṇaparatayā vākyaṃ yojitam| yadā punaḥ arthaviśiṣṭaṃ jñānamevādhyāsaḥ, tadā smṛtisamānaḥ anyasyānyātmanāvabhāso'dhyāsaḥ ityevaṃlakṣaṇaparatayāpi tadeva vākyaṃ yojayituṃ śakyate ityāha -- yato'rthāt iti| arthāt-vākyasāmarthyāt ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yadā jñāna viśiṣṭaḥ ūrthaḥ eva adhyāsaḥ tadā smaryamāṇa sadṛśaḥ anya ātmanā avabhāsamānaḥ nyaḥ arthaḥ adhyāsaḥ iti evaṃlakṣaṇa para tayā vākyam yojitam yadā punar artha viśiṣṭam jñānam eva adhyāsaḥ tadā smṛti samānaḥ anyasya anya ātmanā avabhāsaḥ adhyāsaḥ iti evaṃlakṣaṇa para tayā api tat eva vākyam yojayitum śakyate iti āha yatas ūrthāt iti iti arthaḥ

original: kathaṃ ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu na smṛtiścet bhrāntiḥ, pratyakṣajñānavat na pūrvānubhavajanyatvaṃ ityāśaṅkya, saṃprayogamātrajanyajñānādanyeṣāṃ sarveṣāmaviśiṣṭaṃ pūrvapramāṇajanyatvaṃ anvayavyatirekasāmarthyāt ityāha -- na hyasaṃprayuktāvabhāsinaḥ iti||
analyzed: katham ityādiḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ nanu na smṛtiḥ ced bhrāntiḥ pratyakṣa jñāna vat na pūrva anubhava janya tvam iti āśaṅkya saṃprayoga mātra janya jñānāt anyeṣām sarveṣām aviśiṣṭam pūrva pramāṇa janya tvam anvaya vyatireka sāmarthyāt iti āha na hi asaṃprayukta avabhāsinaḥ iti

original: nanu saṃskārajanyatvamupagataṃ cet, anyasamprayukte cakṣuṣi yadanantaramanyaviṣayaṃ jñānamutpadyate, sā smṛtireva, tadvyavadhānena tu yajjñānamutpadyate, tadanumānādi pramāṇaṃ iti, pramāṇasmṛtidvairāśyameva vijñānasya, na tṛtīyaṃ mithyājñānaṃ nāma asti iti akhyātivādī pratyavatiṣṭhate ityāha -- apara āha ityādinā||
analyzed: nanu saṃskāra janya tvam upagatam ced anya samprayukte cakṣuṣi yat anantaram anya viṣayam jñānam utpadyate sā smṛtiḥ eva tad vyavadhānena tu yat jñānam utpadyate tat anumāna ādi pramāṇam iti pramāṇa smṛti dvairāśyam eva vijñānasya na tṛtīyam mithyājñānam nāma asti iti akhyāti vādī pratyavatiṣṭhate iti āha aparaḥ āha ityādinā

original: nanu smṛtiścet gavādismṛtivat svārthaṃ gṛhyamāṇādvivicya smarāmi iti darśayet iti ; ata āha -- pramoṣastu iti|| nanu śuktikāsamprayoge rajataṃ kimiti smaryate sādṛśyāditi cet atisādṛśyāt śuktikāntarameva smaryatāmiti, netyāha -- indriyādīnāṃ iti||
analyzed: nanu smṛtiḥ ced gavā ādi smṛti vat sva artham gṛhyamāṇāt vivicya smarāmi iti darśayet iti atas āha pramoṣaḥ tu iti nanu śuktikā samprayoge rajatam kim iti smaryate sādṛśyāt iti ced ati sādṛśyāt śuktikā antaram eva smaryatām iti na iti āha indriya ādīnām iti

analyzed: nanu mā bhūt smṛteḥ pramoṣāt sva artha vivecaka tā grahaṇam tu sva artham smaryamāṇāt vivecayet iti na iti āha saṃprayuktasya ca iti nanu smṛti grahaṇayoḥ yaugapadya abhāvāt krama varti tve pūrva jñānam vyavadhānāt na pravṛtti hetuḥ na ca sāmānya mātra jñānāt viśeṣa mātra jñānāt vā pravṛttiḥ iti atas āha tena darśana smaraṇayoḥ nirantara utpannayoḥ iti
