original: "janmāntarānubhūtaṃ na smaryate" iti bhāṣyavacanādasmaryamāṇatvācca bālasya tiktasmṛtiḥ kathaṃ iti codayati -- nanvānāsvāditatiktarasasya iti|| janmāntarānubhūtatiktasmṛtiḥ kalpyate ityāha -- ucyate iti|| janmāntarānubhavasyopakāritāmāha -- anyathā ananubhūtatveti||
analyzed: janma antara anubhūtam na smaryate iti bhāṣya vacanāt asmaryamāṇa tvāt ca bālasya tikta smṛtiḥ katham iti codayati nanu ānāsvādita tikta rasasya iti janma antara anubhūta tikta smṛtiḥ kalpyate iti āha ucyate iti janma antara anubhavasya upakāri tām āha anyathā ananubhūta tva iti

original: kimiti tarhi janmāntarānubhūtaṃ kiñcideva smaryate na sarvaṃ iti doṣabalādityāha -- tasmāt pittameva iti|| kimiti tarhi doṣa eva janmāntarānubhūtaṃ sarvaṃ na smārayati iti ata āha -- kāryagamyatvāt iti|| nanu atattve tattvajñānamiti śāstrakāreṇaiva darśitaḥ saṃsargabhramaḥ iti, netyāha -- etenānyasamprayoge iti||
analyzed: kim iti tarhi janma antara anubhūtam kiñcid eva smaryate na sarvam iti doṣa balāt iti āha tasmāt pittam eva iti kim iti tarhi doṣaḥ eva janma antara anubhūtam sarvam na smārayati iti atas āha kārya gamya tvāt iti nanu atattve tattva jñānam iti śāstra kāreṇa eva darśitaḥ saṃsarga bhramaḥ iti na iti āha etena anya samprayoge iti

original: vaktavyaṃ ca pūrvavādinā'pyaviveke saṃsargajñānakalpanāgauravādakhyātireva yukteti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: vaktavyam ca pūrvavādinā api aviveke saṃsarga jñāna kalpanā gauravāt akhyātiḥ eva yuktā iti bhāvaḥ

original: ucyate -- keyamakhyātiḥ iti na tāvat khyātyabhāvamātram; anabhyupagamādatiprasaṅgācca| anyārthino'nyatra pravṛttihetuḥ jñānamiti cet -- yatra tarhi na pravṛttiḥ jhaṭiti, bādhaśca, tatra kathaṃ bhrāntiḥ atha aviviktānekapadārthajñānam, tarhi "idaṃ" iti "rajataṃ" iti cāpunaruktaśabdadvayasmṛtihetutayā viviktāvabhāsanāt na tasya sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ
analyzed: ucyate kā iyam akhyātiḥ iti na tāvat khyāti abhāva mātram anabhyupagamāt atiprasaṅgāt ca anya arthinaḥ anyatra pravṛtti hetuḥ jñānam iti ced yatra tarhi na pravṛttiḥ jhaṭiti bādhaḥ ca tatra katham bhrāntiḥ atha avivikta aneka padārtha jñānam tarhi idam iti rajatam iti ca apunarukta śabda dvaya smṛti hetutayā vivikta avabhāsanāt na tasya sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ

original: avivekabhramaḥ sambhavati| na ca bhedāvamarśena ekatvajñānamanabhyupagacchataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoravivekaḥ sambhavati; viviktākāradvayāvabhāsanāt| itaretarābhāvabhedadvitvādisaṅkhyāviśiṣṭajñānaṃ vivekaḥ iti cet, "gāmānaya daṇḍena" iti godaṇḍayoḥ tatkārakatvayoścāviveko bhramaḥ syāt|
analyzed: aviveka bhramaḥ sambhavati na ca bheda avamarśena ekatva jñānam anabhyupagacchataḥ sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ avivekaḥ sambhavati vivikta ākāra dvaya avabhāsanāt itaretara abhāva bheda dvi tva ādi saṅkhyā viśiṣṭa jñānam vivekaḥ iti ced gām ānaya daṇḍena iti go daṇḍayoḥ tad kāraka tvayoḥ ca avivekaḥ bhramaḥ syāt

original: tatrāpyānuṣaṅgikabhedādijñānamastīti cet, "idami"ti "rajatami"ti ca ihāpyapunaruktaśabdānuṣaktākāradvayāvabhāse dvitvādyavabhāso vidyata eva; anyathā sāmānyākārāt viśeṣākārasya vivekānavabhāsā"didami"tyeva syāt, "rajatami"tyeva vā syāt, "idaṃ rajata"miti| kiñca, pratīyamānakārayoḥ na avivekaḥ; apunaruktapratibhāsāt|
analyzed: tatra api ānuṣaṅgika bheda ādi jñānam asti iti ced idam iti rajatam iti ca iha api apunarukta śabda anuṣakta ākāra dvaya avabhāse dvi tva ādi avabhāsaḥ vidyate eva anyathā sāmānya ākārāt viśeṣa ākārasya viveka anavabhāsāt idam iti eva syāt rajatam iti eva vā syāt idam rajatam iti kiñca pratīyamāna kārayoḥ na avivekaḥ apunarukta pratibhāsāt

original: apratīyamānākārāviveko na bhramaḥ; atiprasaṅgāt| tasmāt na aviveko bhramaḥ||
analyzed: apratīyamāna ākāra avivekaḥ na bhramaḥ atiprasaṅgāt tasmāt na avivekaḥ bhramaḥ

original: kiñca "khaṇḍo gauḥ" ityādipratyayāśca avivikātānekapadārthaviṣayā vibhramāḥ prasajyeran| na ca grahaṇasmaraṇāviveka eva bhramaḥ; "ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ" iti gṛhyamāṇāvivekasya bhramatvāt| sāmānyaviśeṣādau saṃsargajñānamevāstīti cet , tathāpi aviviktānekapadārthajñānāt bhramatvamapi syāt| na ca tatra saṃsargapratyayo'pi; aikyasya tadālambanasyābhāvāt|

original: sarvatra yadākāraṃ saṃvedanaṃ tadevālambanamiti niyame rajatākārasaṃvedanaviruddhaṃ śuktikālambanatvamityarthaḥ| nanu na saṃvidākāratā ālambanatā sarvatra, kintu saṃvitprayuktavyavahāraviṣayatā iti codayati -- nanu śukteḥ svarūpeṇāpi iti||
analyzed: sarvatra yad ākāram saṃvedanam tat eva ālambanam iti niyame rajata ākāra saṃvedana viruddham śuktikā ālambana tvam iti arthaḥ nanu na saṃvid ākāra tā ālambana tā sarvatra kintu saṃvid prayukta vyavahāra viṣaya tā iti codayati nanu śukteḥ sva rūpeṇa api iti

original: idaṃ tāvadayuktam; na hi vyāghrasarpādijñānāt daṇḍādiṣu ādīyamāneṣu vyāghrādijñānasya daṇḍādi ālambanam, na ca dravyaguṇādiṣu ādīyamāneṣu dravyādīnāmanyonyajñānālambanatvaṃ prasiddham; tasmāt tadākāra evālambanamiti nānyākāraṃ jñānamanyālambanamanyathākhyātiriti bahirevopasaṃhartavyam| astu tarhi vastuno vastvantarātmanāvabhāsaḥ iti;
analyzed: idam tāvat ayuktam na hi vyāghra sarpa ādi jñānāt daṇḍa ādiṣu ādīyamāneṣu vyāghra ādi jñānasya daṇḍa ādi ālambanam na ca dravya guṇa ādiṣu ādīyamāneṣu dravya ādīnām anyonya jñāna ālambana tvam prasiddham tasmāt tad ākāraḥ eva ālambanam iti na anya ākāram jñānam anya ālambanam anyathā khyātiḥ iti bahis eva upasaṃhartavyam astu tarhi vastunaḥ vastu antara ātmanā avabhāsaḥ iti

original: tatrāha -- atha tathārūpāvabhāsanaṃ iti|| na tāvadatyantabhedavādināṃ saṃsargaḥ paramārthaḥ, tataśca anirvacanīyānabhyupagamāt śūnya eva saṃsargaḥ prakāśeta| evaṃ "khaṇḍo gauḥ" ityādisaṃsargapratyayāḥ sarve eva vibhramāḥ prasajyeranniti, bahireva ekaḥ pakṣaḥ prativaktavyaḥ||
analyzed: tatra āha atha tathārūpa avabhāsanam iti na tāvat atyanta bheda vādinām saṃsargaḥ paramārthaḥ tatas ca anirvacanīya anabhyupagamāt śūnyaḥ eva saṃsargaḥ prakāśeta evam khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ ityādi saṃsarga pratyayāḥ sarve eva vibhramāḥ prasajyeran iti bahis eva ekaḥ pakṣaḥ prativaktavyaḥ

original: atha bhedābhedavādī saṃsargasatyatāṃ brūyāt, tatrāha -- yadi pāramārthikaṃ iti|| "khaṇḍo gau"rityādivat sarvasya bhedābhedāt na kvacidapi bhrāntibādhau, sarvatra vā tau syātāṃ ityarthaḥ| astu tarhi anyathāpariṇate vastuni khyātiḥ anyathākhyātiḥ, iti tatrāha -- atha śuktereva iti|| śukteḥ pariṇāmanirākaraṇagranthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ||
analyzed: atha bheda abheda vādī saṃsarga satya tām brūyāt tatra āha yadi pāramārthikam iti khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ ityādi vat sarvasya bheda abhedāt na kvacid api bhrānti bādhau sarvatra vā tau syātām iti arthaḥ astu tarhi anyathā pariṇate vastuni khyātiḥ anyathā khyātiḥ iti tatra āha atha śukteḥ eva iti śukteḥ pariṇāma nirākaraṇa granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ

original: "atha punarduṣṭakāraṇajanyāyāḥ pratīteḥ" ityādinā anyathākhyātāveva pariṇāmaprakārabhedo nirākriyate, khyātyantaranirākaraṇaṃ vā; katham atrāha ātmakhyātivādī -- buddhereva rajatākāraḥ na bahiriti, kutaḥ saṃprayogavyatirekeṇāparokṣatvāt buddhivat, kathaṃ vijñānasya rajatākāraḥ prāptaḥ saṃskārasāmarthyāditi vadāmaḥ|
analyzed: atha punar duṣṭa kāraṇa janyāyāḥ pratīteḥ ityādinā anyathā khyātau eva pariṇāma prakāra bhedaḥ nirākriyate khyāti antara nirākaraṇam vā katham atra āha ātma khyāti vādī buddheḥ eva rajata ākāraḥ na bahis iti kutas saṃprayoga vyatirekeṇa aparokṣa tvāt buddhi vat katham vijñānasya rajata ākāraḥ prāptaḥ saṃskāra sāmarthyāt iti vadāmaḥ

original: tathāhi -- yasyāṃ jñānasantatau yadā kadācit pūrvaṃ rajatajñānamutpannaṃ tadeva saṃskāra ucyate| na ca vijñānajanyaḥ anyeṣāmiva sthāyī kṣaṇiko vā anyaḥ kaścit asya saṃskāro vidyate; vijñānamātravādāt|
analyzed: tathā hi yasyām jñāna santatau yadā kadācid pūrvam rajata jñānam utpannam tat eva saṃskāraḥ ucyate na ca vijñāna janyaḥ anyeṣām iva sthāyī kṣaṇikaḥ vā anyaḥ kaścid asya saṃskāraḥ vidyate vijñāna mātra vādāt

original: sa ca anekajñānavyavahito'pi kadācit sajjātīyaṃ rajatajñānāntaramutpādayati, śālibījamiva anekāṅkurādikāryavyavadhānena punaḥ sajātīyabījāntaranimittaṃ iti| athava -- tajjanyajñānasantāna eva saṃskāraḥ, sa ca tathāvidhajñānāntarāt iti anādivāsanāprāpitaṃ rajataṃ buddhyākāro bahirvadavabhāsate iti||
analyzed: sa ca aneka jñāna vyavahitaḥ api kadācid sat jātīyam rajata jñāna antaram utpādayati śāli bījam iva aneka aṅkura ādi kārya vyavadhānena punar sajātīya bīja antara nimittam iti athavā tad janya jñāna santānaḥ eva saṃskāraḥ sa ca tathāvidha jñāna antarāt iti anādi vāsanā prāpitam rajatam buddhi ākāraḥ bahis vat avabhāsate iti

original: sa vaktavyaḥ -- kiṃ tadrajataṃ jāyate na vā iti| na cet, jāyamānasvarūpaṃ na syāt ākāśavat| jāyate cet, nā;rthāt arthāntarābhāvāt, atha jñānādeva duṣṭakāraṇajanyāt rajatotpādaḥ iti, tadāha -- atha punarduṣṭakāraṇajanyāyāḥ pratītereva rajatotpāda iti iti||
analyzed: sa vaktavyaḥ kim tat rajatam jāyate na vā iti na ced jāyamāna svarūpam na syāt ākāśa vat jāyate ced na arthāt artha antara abhāvāt atha jñānāt eva duṣṭa kāraṇa janyāt rajata utpādaḥ iti tat āha atha punar duṣṭa kāraṇa janyāyāḥ pratīteḥ eva rajata utpādaḥ iti iti

original: janakapratīteḥ rajatāt pūrvakālatvāt atadviṣayatvāt pratītyantarasyāduṣṭakāraṇasya tadviṣayatve sarvapratītiviṣayatvaprasaṅgāt, duṣṭakāraṇapratīteśca rajatajanyatayā tadālambanatve rajatasyārthakriyāvattayā sattvaprasaṅgāt atañjanyatve tadviṣayatvābhāvādapratītameva rajataṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: janaka pratīteḥ rajatāt pūrva kāla tvāt atadviṣayatvāt pratīti antarasya aduṣṭa kāraṇasya tad viṣaya tve sarva pratīti viṣaya tva prasaṅgāt duṣṭa kāraṇa pratīteḥ ca rajata janya tayā tad ālambana tve rajatasya arthakriyāvat tayā sattva prasaṅgāt a tad janya tve tad viṣaya tva abhāvāt apratītam eva rajatam syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: anyathākhyātiṃ nirākṛtya akhyātivādī svapakṣamupasaṃharati -- tadevaṃ pāriśeṣyāt iti|| akhyātidūṣaṇamapyuktamanusmārayati -- nanu smṛteḥ iti||
analyzed: anyathā khyātim nirākṛtya akhyāti vādī sva pakṣam upasaṃharati tat evam pāriśeṣyāt iti akhyāti dūṣaṇam api uktam anusmārayati nanu smṛteḥ iti

original: nanu na smṛtiḥ nāpi grahaṇaṃ cet, alaukikamidaṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ iti codayati -- kā tarhi gatiriti| kiṃ sāmagryam tatrāha -- nendriyajajñānāt ityādinā|| nanu indriyasaṃskārau cetsāmagrī, samyagjñānamevedaṃ syāt, smṛtigrahaṇavaditi codayati -- kathametat iti|| doṣasahakṛtatvāt tṛtīyamidaṃ sāmagryamityāha -- ucyate kāraṇadoṣaḥ iti||
analyzed: nanu na smṛtiḥ na api grahaṇam ced alaukikam idam jñānam katham iti codayati kā tarhi gatiḥ iti kim sāmagryam tatra āha na indriya ja jñānāt ityādinā nanu indriya saṃskārau ced sāmagrī samyak jñānam eva idam syāt smṛti grahaṇa vat iti codayati katham etat iti doṣa sahakṛta tvāt tṛtīyam idam sāmagryam iti āha ucyate kāraṇa doṣaḥ iti

original: nanu doṣaḥ prāptakāryasya pratibandhakaḥ nādhikye heturiti, tatrāha -- kāryagamyatvāt iti|| na ca anādeḥ kāryānudayasya heturdoṣaḥ; kṛtyābhāvāt, kintu vyādhyādivat viparyayakāryaheturdoṣaḥ iti| nanu doṣaḥ saṃskārodbodhakṛccet na sāmagryāmantarbhavati iti na tṛtīyamidaṃ sāmagryamiti, tatrāha -- ataḥ saṃskāraduṣṭakāraṇasaṃvalitā iti||
analyzed: nanu doṣaḥ prāpta kāryasya pratibandhakaḥ na ādhikye hetuḥ iti tatra āha kārya gamya tvāt iti na ca anādeḥ kārya anudayasya hetuḥ doṣaḥ kṛtyā bhāvāt kintu vyādhi ādi vat viparyaya kārya hetuḥ doṣaḥ iti nanu doṣaḥ saṃskāra udbodha kṛt ced na sāmagryām antarbhavati iti na tṛtīyam idam sāmagryam iti tatra āha atas saṃskāra duṣṭa kāraṇa saṃvalitāḥ iti

original: atha jñānasyaikyaṃ codyate, tatrāha -- sā caikameva jñānaṃ iti||
analyzed: atha jñānasya aikyam codyate tatra āha sā ca ekam eva jñānam iti

original: nanu idamā saṃprayogādantaḥkaraṇapariṇāmajñānamekamutpadyate, na tat rajataṃ tatsaṃsargaṃ vā viṣayīkartumīṣṭe, mithyāvastuni deśāntarādigate vā saṃprayogānupapatteḥ, cakṣurunmīlanānvayavyatirekayoradhiṣṭhānajñānopakṣayādanyathāsiddheḥ, nāpi saṃskārāt rajatāṃśāvagamaḥ; smṛtyanabhyupagamāt, nāpi doṣaḥ svayameva kasya cij‌jñānasya heturdṛṣṭaḥ;
analyzed: nanu saṃprayogāt antaḥkaraṇa pariṇāma jñānam ekam utpadyate na tat rajatam tad saṃsargam vā viṣayīkartum īṣṭe mithyā vastuni deśa antara ādi gate vā saṃprayoga anupapatteḥ cakṣuḥ unmīlana anvaya vyatirekayoḥ adhiṣṭhāna jñāna upakṣayāt anyathā siddheḥ nā api saṃskārāt rajata aṃśa avagamaḥ smṛti anabhyupagamāt nā api doṣaḥ svayam eva kasya cit jñānasya hetuḥ dṛṣṭaḥ

original: jñānakāraṇānāmeva kāryaviśeṣanimittatvāt| ato na rajatatatsambhinnaśuktiviṣayamekaṃ jñānaṃ samāsti, kiṃ tu avidyaiva bāhyadoṣanimittakāraṇāpekṣayā rajatākāreṇa sākṣicaitanyasya rajatāvacchedajñānābhāsākāreṇa ca pariṇamamānā svakāryeṇa saha sākṣicaitanyasya viṣayabhāvaṃ pratipadyate iti te matam, tatra kathamekajñānatvaṃ iti tatrāha -- ekaphalaṃ
analyzed: jñāna kāraṇānām eva kārya viśeṣa nimitta tvāt atas na rajata tad sambhinna śukti viṣayam ekam jñānam samāsti kim tu avidyā eva bāhya doṣa nimitta kāraṇa apekṣayā rajata ākāreṇa sākṣi caitanyasya rajata avaccheda jñāna ābhāsa ākāreṇa ca pariṇamamānā sva kāryeṇa saha sākṣi caitanyasya viṣaya bhāvam pratipadyate iti te matam tatra katham eka jñāna tvam iti tatra āha eka phalam

original: iti|| viṣayāvacchinnaṃ hi phalamavabhāsate, na jñānāvacchinnam| viṣayaśca satyamithyāvastunoranyonyātmatayā ekatāmāpannaḥ, tena ekaviṣayāvacchinnaphalaikatvopādhau satyamithyājñānadvayamapi ekamityupacaryate iti bhāvaḥ| atha viṣayaḥ kathamiti tadāha -- tasya ca iti|| kuto rajatasya mithyātvaṃ iti ; ata āha -- tena mithyālambanaṃ iti||
analyzed: iti viṣaya avacchinnam hi phalam avabhāsate na jñāna avacchinnam viṣayaḥ ca satya mithyā vastunoḥ anyonya ātmatayā ekatām āpannaḥ tena eka viṣaya avacchinna phala ekatva upādhau satya mithyājñāna dvayam api ekam iti upacaryate iti bhāvaḥ atha viṣayaḥ katham iti tat āha tasya ca iti kutas rajatasya mithyātvam iti atas āha tena mithyā ālambanam iti

original: bhāvābhāvajñānayoḥ mithyātvaprasiddhyabhāvāt idaṃ jñānasamavāyi mithyātvaṃ anirvacanīyārthatāmeva gamayatītyarthaḥ||
analyzed: bhāva abhāva jñānayoḥ mithyātva prasiddhi abhāvāt idam jñāna samavāyi mithyātvam anirvacanīya artha tām eva gamayati iti arthaḥ

original: saṃprayukte'rthe saṃprayogo nirapekṣo jñānakāraṇam, saṃskāraśca pūrvānubhūtasmṛtau nirapekṣaḥ; tataśca nirapekṣakāraṇadvayajanyatvāt jñānadvayameva nirantarotpannaṃ iti akhyātivādī codayatī -- bhinnajātīyajñāneti| jñānabhede hi nirantarotpattāvapi na pravṛttikāryodayaḥ sambhavati;
analyzed: saṃprayukta īrthe saṃprayogaḥ nirapekṣaḥ jñāna kāraṇam saṃskāraḥ ca pūrva anubhūta smṛtau nirapekṣaḥ tatas ca nirapekṣa kāraṇa dvaya janya tvāt jñāna dvayam eva nirantara utpannam iti akhyāti vādī codayatī bhinna jātīya jñāna iti jñāna bhede hi nirantara utpattau api na pravṛtti kārya udayaḥ sambhavati

original: tatra yathā varṇajñāneṣu kramavartiṣu jñānakāryodayānyathānupapattyā pūrvapūrvavarṇasaṃskārasahitamantyavarṇajñānameva hetutvena kalpyate kāraṇayogapadyāya, tathā pravṛttikāryānupapattireva jñānaikyaṃ kalpayati kiṃ kāraṇabhedena iti pariharati -- naiṣa doṣaḥ iti|| nanu kāraṇabhedāt kāryabhedo'pyanumīyate iti, netyudāharaṇamāha -- dṛśyate hi iti||
analyzed: tatra yathā varṇa jñāneṣu krama vartiṣu jñāna kārya udaya anyathā anupapattyā pūrva pūrva varṇa saṃskāra sahitam antya varṇa jñānam eva hetu tvena kalpyate kāraṇa yogapadyāya tathā pravṛtti kārya anupapattiḥ eva jñāna aikyam kalpayati kim kāraṇa bhedena iti pariharati na eṣa doṣaḥ iti nanu kāraṇa bhedāt kārya bhedaḥ upi anumīyate iti na iti udāharaṇam āha dṛśyate hi iti

original: nanu tatrāpi kāraṇabhedāt jñānabhedaḥ iti netyāha -- ubhayatrāpi iti|| nanu liṅgadarśanaṃ vyāptismṛtiśca liṅgajñānakāraṇaṃ, na saṃskāraḥ iti netyāha -- saṃskārānudbodhe iti|| jñānadvayayaugapadyābhāvādityarthaḥ| tasmāt ityupasaṃharati|
analyzed: nanu tatra api kāraṇa bhedāt jñāna bhedaḥ iti na iti āha ubhayatra api iti nanu liṅga darśanam vyāpti smṛtiḥ ca liṅga jñāna kāraṇam na saṃskāraḥ iti na iti āha saṃskāra anudbodhe iti jñāna dvaya yaugapadya abhāvāt iti arthaḥ tasmāt iti upasaṃharati

original: nanu pratyabhijñāyāṃ saṃprayogaḥ pūrvānubhūtasmṛtiśca kāraṇaṃ, jñānadvayayaugapadyaprasaṅgābhāvāt na saṃskāraḥ iti tatrāha -- ayameva nyāyaḥ iti|| jñānājjñānāntarotpattau vyāptyādyabhāvāt saṃskāra eva kāraṇamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu pratyabhijñāyām saṃprayogaḥ pūrva anubhūta smṛtiḥ ca kāraṇam jñāna dvaya yaugapadya prasaṅga abhāvāt na saṃskāraḥ iti tatra āha ayam eva nyāyaḥ iti jñānāt jñāna antara utpattau vyāpti ādi abhāvāt saṃskāraḥ eva kāraṇam iti arthaḥ

original: nanu pramāṇāntareṣvayaṃ nirapekṣakāraṇasamāhāraḥ., nābhijñāpratyakṣe, abhijñāpratyakṣaṃ ca rajatajñānaṃ iti, tatrāha -- tathā bhinnajātīyajñānahetubhya iti|| nanu yatra saṃskāraḥ pramāṇakāraṇena saṃbadhyate, tatra smṛtigarbhapramāṇajñānameva dṛṣṭam, na tathedaṃ rajatajñānamiti, tatrāha -- tatra laiṅgikajñānetyādinā||
analyzed: nanu pramāṇa antareṣu ayam nirapekṣa kāraṇa samāhāraḥ na abhijñā pratyakṣe abhijñā pratyakṣam ca rajata jñānam iti tatra āha tathā bhinna jātīya jñāna hetubhyaḥ iti nanu yatra saṃskāraḥ pramāṇa kāraṇena saṃbadhyate tatra smṛti garbha pramāṇa jñānam eva dṛṣṭam na tathā idam rajata jñānam iti tatra āha tatra laiṅgika jñāna ityādinā

original: kiñca -- jñānadvayapakṣe akhyātau aparokṣāvabhāsinaḥ smaryamāṇatve, sarvatra pratipannopādhau viṣayasattvābhāve anyathākhyātau pratipannasya saṃsargasya śūnyatve purodeśapratipannasya rajatasya deśāntarasattve ca, ātmakhyātau bahiravabhāsasyāntaratve ca anubhavavirodhaḥ syāt, na tathā asmatpakṣe ityāha -- evaṃ ca sati nānubhavavirodhaḥ
analyzed: kiñca jñāna dvaya pakṣe akhyātau aparokṣa avabhāsinaḥ smaryamāṇa tve sarvatra pratipanna upādhau viṣaya sattva abhāve anyathā khyātau pratipannasya saṃsargasya śūnya tve puras deśa pratipannasya rajatasya deśa antara sattve ca ātma khyātau bahis avabhāsasya antara tve ca anubhava virodhaḥ syāt na tathā asmat pakṣe iti āha evam ca sati na anubhava virodhaḥ

original: iti||
analyzed: iti

original: nanu tavāpi "asti" iti pratipannasyānirvacanīyatve anubhavavirodhaḥ samānaḥ, tanna idantāsaṃsargavat rajatasya śuktikāsattāsaṃsargo'yamavabhāsate, na rajatasyāparasattvam||
analyzed: nanu tava api asti iti pratipannasya anirvacanīya tve anubhava virodhaḥ samānaḥ tat na idantā saṃsarga vat rajatasya śuktikā sattā saṃsargaḥ ūyam avabhāsate na rajatasya apara sattvam

analyzed: kāraṇa tritaya janya tvam anyasya anya ātmanā avabhāsam ca sampādayāmi iti āha atra ucyate iti samprayoga abhāvāt aparokṣa avabhāsi tvāt grahaṇa smṛti mātra tve pratyukte tṛtīyam idam vijñānam svayam eva ukta adhyāsa lakṣaṇam gamayitum samartham iti vaditum prakāra antaram paryudāsyati uktam etat iti

original: svapnaprapañcaviparītapramātrādivijñānasādhanasyāntaḥkaraṇasya nidrādidoṣapūrvānubhavasaṃskārasahitasya saṃpratipannakāraṇatritayatvāt yuktaṃ smṛtirūpaṃ bhrāntijñānamityāha -- tadiha nidrādidoṣopaplutaṃ iti||
analyzed: svapna prapañca viparīta pramātṛ ādi vijñāna sādhanasya antaḥkaraṇasya nidrā ādi doṣa pūrva anubhava saṃskāra sahitasya saṃpratipanna kāraṇa tritaya tvāt yuktam smṛti rūpam bhrānti jñānam iti āha tat iha nidrā ādi doṣa upaplutam iti

original: kathaṃ paratra parāvabhāsaḥ iti tadāha -- tasya ca iti|| nidrādidoṣasaṃskāropaplutenāntaḥkaraṇena mithyādhyāsanimittakāraṇenāvacchinnacaitanyasthā avidyāśaktiḥ puṣkalanimittakāraṇasaṃsargādadhyāsaṃ prati puṣkalakāraṇatāmāpadyamānā mithyārthālambanākāreṇa vivartate iti, caitanyameva svāvidyāyā vivartate|
analyzed: katham paratra para avabhāsaḥ iti tat āha tasya ca iti nidrā ādi doṣa saṃskāra upaplutena antaḥkaraṇena mithyā adhyāsa nimitta kāraṇena avacchinna caitanya sthā avidyā śaktiḥ puṣkala nimitta kāraṇa saṃsargāt adhyāsam prati puṣkala kāraṇa tām āpadyamānā mithyā artha ālambana ākāreṇa vivartate iti caitanyam eva sva avidyāyāḥ vivartate

original: ataḥ satyasya vastuno mithyāvastusaṃbhedāvabhāsa lakṣaṇaḥ paratra parāvabhāso vidyate iti bhāvaḥ| tathā jāgaraṇe'pi bāhyādhiṣṭhānāṃśasaṃsṛṣṭāntaḥkaraṇāvacchinnatayā bāhyādhiṣṭhānasaṃsṛṣṭacaitanyasyāvidyāśaktiḥ bāhyādhiṣṭhānasaṃsṛṣṭarajatādyākāreṇa vivartata iti, śuktikādyavacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ rajatādyālambanamiti bāhyālambanaṃ rajatādi kathyate|
analyzed: atas satyasya vastunaḥ mithyā vastu saṃbheda avabhāsa lakṣaṇaḥ paratra para avabhāsaḥ vidyate iti bhāvaḥ tathā jāgaraṇe api bāhya adhiṣṭhāna aṃśa saṃsṛṣṭa antaḥkaraṇa avacchinna tayā bāhya adhiṣṭhāna saṃsṛṣṭa caitanyasya avidyā śaktiḥ bāhya adhiṣṭhāna saṃsṛṣṭa rajata ādi ākāreṇa vivartate iti śuktikā ādi avacchinnam caitanyam rajata ādi ālambanam iti bāhya ālambanam rajata ādi kathyate

original: sarvatra tu caitanyameva sākṣādvā anyāvacchinnatayā vā vibhramālambanamiti, yuktaḥ "paratra parāvabhāsaḥ" ityarthaḥ||
analyzed: sarvatra tu caitanyam eva sākṣāt vā anya avacchinna tayā vā vibhrama ālambanam iti yuktaḥ paratra para avabhāsaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ākāśavat sarvaviṣayoparaktatayā sarvatrāvabhāsamānamātmānamanādṛtya ahamityevāvacchinnamātmānamupādāya codayati -- nanvevaṃ satyantarameva iti|| ātmaivādhiṣṭhānaṃ cet, idaṃ rajataṃ itivat ahaṃ nīlaṃ ityeva svapnaprapañco bhāyādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ākāśa vat sarva viṣaya uparakta tayā sarvatra avabhāsamānam ātmānam an ādṛtya aham iti eva avacchinnam ātmānam upādāya codayati nanu evam satya antaram eva iti ātmā eva adhiṣṭhānam ced idam rajatam iti vat aham nīlam iti eva svapna prapañcaḥ bhāyāt iti arthaḥ

original: niṣkṛṣṭāhaṅkāraṃ caitanyamātramātmānamādāya cetyasya ca citsāmānādhikaraṇyāvabhāsaṃ sarvatrāṅgīkṛtya pariharati -- ko vā brūte iti|| punarapi ahaṅkārāvacchinnamātmānamādāya codayati -- nanu vicchinnadeśaḥ iti|| idamiti pṛthaktvāvabhāso'pyantarevetyāha -- nanu deśo'pi iti|| anavacchinnacaitanyasaṃsṛṣṭatayaiva bhedāvabhāso'pīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: niṣkṛṣṭa ahaṅkāram caitanya mātram ātmānam ādāya cetyasya ca cit sāmānādhikaraṇya avabhāsam sarvatra aṅgīkṛtya pariharati kaḥ vā brūte iti punar api ahaṅkāra avacchinnam ātmānam ādāya codayati nanu vicchinna deśaḥ iti idam iti pṛthaktva avabhāsaḥ api antar eva iti āha nanu deśaḥ api iti anavacchinna caitanya saṃsṛṣṭatayā eva bheda avabhāsaḥ api iti bhāvaḥ

original: ahaṅkārāvacchinnamādāya ahaṃ bhedaḥ ityapi pratīyādityāha -- ayamapi iti|| nigūḍhābhisandhireva pūrvamuttaramuktvā, idānīṃ sarvato viprasṛtaṃ caitanyaṃ sarvātmanā prakāśamānamātmānaṃ spaṣṭīkurvannāha naiṣa doṣaḥ jāgaraṇe'pi iti|| prātibhāsikabhedamantareṇa pramāṇato na bhidyate ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ahaṅkāra avacchinnam ādāya aham bhedaḥ iti api pratīyāt iti āha ayam api iti nigūḍha abhisandhiḥ eva pūrvam uttaram uktvā idānīm sarvatas viprasṛtam caitanyam sarvātmanā prakāśamānam ātmānam spaṣṭīkurvan āha na eṣa doṣaḥ jāgaraṇe api iti prātibhāsika bhedam antareṇa pramāṇataḥ na bhidyate iti arthaḥ

original: nanu ahamavacchinnacaitanyādanyānyeva viṣayagatacaitanyāni kiṃ na syuḥ iti ata āha -- anyathā jaḍasya iti|| svayaṃ caitanyahīnā viṣayā ātmāvagatiprakāśenāpi na saṃsṛjyante cet mayāvagatāḥ iti sambandhāvabhāso na syādityarthaḥ||
analyzed: nanu aham avacchinna caitanyāt anyāni eva viṣaya gata caitanyāni kim na syuḥ iti atas āha anyathā jaḍasya iti svayam caitanya hīnāḥ viṣayāḥ ātma avagati prakāśena api na saṃsṛjyante ced mayā avagatāḥ iti sambandha avabhāsaḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ

original: sarvatra caitanyāvaguṇḍhane'pi -- "ahaṃ idaṃ" iti ca ātmānātmāno vibhaktāviti pratibhāsaḥ katham iti tatrāha -- yaḥ punaḥ iti|| nanu caitanyameva sarvatra antarbahirbhedādirūpeṇāvabhāsate cet, kathaṃ tasyākhaṇḍādvitīyatā iti cetyabhedoparāganimittabhedamantareṇa svarūpabhedānavagamāt ityāha -- tasya ca niraṃśasya iti||
analyzed: sarvatra caitanya avaguṇḍhane api aham idam iti ca ātma an ātmānaḥ vibhaktau iti pratibhāsaḥ katham iti tatra āha yaḥ punar iti nanu caitanyam eva sarvatra antar bahis bheda ādi rūpeṇa avabhāsate ced katham tasya akhaṇḍa advitīya tā iti cetya bheda uparāga nimitta bhedam antareṇa svarūpa bheda anavagamāt iti āha tasya ca niraṃśasya iti

original: niraṃśadravyasyāṇutvamanantatvaṃ vā syāt, madhyamaparimāṇaṃ cedaṃ caitanyaṃ sarvatrāvabhāsate; na ca niraṃśaṃ madhyamaparimāṇaṃ iti| paropādhiparimāṇaṃ caitanyamityarthaḥ| jāgaraṇepyevam| kimu vaktavyaṃ svapnasya caitanyādhiṣṭhānatvamityarthaḥ||
analyzed: niraṃśa dravyasya aṇu tvam ananta tvam vā syāt madhyama parimāṇam ca idam caitanyam sarvatra avabhāsate na ca niraṃśam madhyama parimāṇam iti para upādhi parimāṇam caitanyam iti arthaḥ jāgaraṇe api evam kimu vaktavyam svapnasya caitanya adhiṣṭhāna tvam iti arthaḥ

original: kevalasya manaso bahiḥpratyakṣasādhanatvābhāvāt atha vā iti aṅgīkaraṇavādaḥ| avyāptiḥ parihṛtā, idānīṃ mithyādhyāsabhrāntyavidyāprasiddhyabhāve'pi anyasyānyāvabhāso vidyate iti lakṣaṇasyātivyāptimāha -- kathaṃ tarhi nāmādiṣu iti||
analyzed: kevalasya manasaḥ bahis pratyakṣa sādhanatva abhāvāt atha vā iti aṅgīkaraṇa vādaḥ avyāptiḥ parihṛtā idānīm mithyā adhyāsa bhrānti avidyā prasiddhi abhāve pi anyasya anya avabhāsaḥ vidyate iti lakṣaṇasya ativyāptim āha katham tarhi nāma ādiṣu iti

original: anyasyānyātmatājñānaṃ adhyāsalakṣaṇam, iyaṃ tu anyasyānyatra mānasī kriyā iti ativyāptiṃ pariharati -- satyamata eva codanāvaśāt iti|| nanu jñānameva tatra vidhīyate iti, netyāha -- na hi jñānam iti|| vidhijanyapuruṣecchāprayatnanirapekṣameva sarvatra jñānasya puṣkalakāraṇam; anicchato'pyaniṣṭajñānadarśanāt, ato vidhānāt mānasī kriyeti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: anyasya anya ātma tā jñānam adhyāsa lakṣaṇam iyam tu anyasya anyatra mānasī kriyā iti ativyāptim pariharati satyam atas eva codanā vaśāt iti nanu jñānam eva tatra vidhīyate iti na iti āha na hi jñānam iti vidhi janya puruṣa icchā prayatna nirapekṣam eva sarvatra jñānasya puṣkala kāraṇam an icchatā upi aniṣṭa jñāna darśanāt atas vidhānāt mānasī kriyā iti bhāvaḥ

original: "nanu smṛtijñānaṃ" ityārabhya "taṃ kecit" ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanvadhyāse vādivipratipattidarśanāt na ekarūpeṇa lakṣaṇaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyate ityāśaṅkya adhiṣṭhānādhyasyamānayoḥ svarūpatattvadeśakālaviśeṣeṣveva vādināṃ vipratipattiḥ, anyasyānyātmatāvabhāsamātre lakṣaṇe na vipratipattiḥ|
analyzed: nanu smṛti jñānam iti ārabhya tam kecid iti atas prāktanaḥ granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ nanu adhyāse vādi vipratipatti darśanāt na eka rūpeṇa lakṣaṇam vyavasthāpayitum śakyate iti āśaṅkya adhiṣṭhāna adhyasyamānayoḥ sva rūpa tattva deśa kāla viśeṣeṣu eva vādinām vipratipattiḥ anyasya anya ātmatā avabhāsa mātre lakṣaṇe na vipratipattiḥ

original: tacca lakṣaṇaṃ laukikasāmānyaviśeṣādisaṃsargapratyayānāṃ bhramatvaprāptiparihārāya satyasya mithyāvastusambhedāvabhāsaḥ iti balādāpatati ityaṅgīkṛtya matāntarāṇyupanyasyati -- taṃ kecidityādinā||
analyzed: tat ca lakṣaṇam laukika sāmānya viśeṣa ādi saṃsarga pratyayānām bhrama tva prāpti parihārāya satyasya mithyā vastu sambheda avabhāsaḥ iti balāt āpatati iti aṅgīkṛtya mata antarāṇi upanyasyati tam kecid ityādinā

original: prathamastu ātmakhyātyanyathākhyātiviśeṣayoḥ, dvitīyastu akhyāteḥ, tṛtīyastu śukteḥ svābhāvarajatātmanā khyātiriti śūnyakhyātyanyathākhyātiviśeṣayorupanyāsaḥ| kalpanāṃ ityasya vyākhyā avidyamānasyaivāvabhāsamānatāṃ iti| yallakṣaṇamavādiṣma iti pūrvalakṣaṇaśabdena yacchabdasya sambandhaḥ|
analyzed: prathamaḥ tu ātma khyāti anyathākhyāti viśeṣayoḥ dvitīyaḥ tu akhyāteḥ tṛtīyaḥ tu śukteḥ svābhāva rajata ātmanā khyātiḥ iti śūnya khyāti anyathākhyāti viśeṣayoḥ upanyāsaḥ kalpanām iti asya vyākhyā a vidyamānasya eva avabhāsamāna tām iti yat lakṣaṇam avādiṣmaḥ iti pūrva lakṣaṇa śabdena yad śabdasya sambandhaḥ

original: akhyātivādināpi mānasaṃ saṃsargajñānaṃ saṃsargābhimāno vā vaktavyaḥ ityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu smṛtirūpatayā kāraṇatritayajanyatvamupekṣitamiti , netyāha -- pūrvadṛṣṭatveti||
analyzed: akhyāti vādinā api mānasam saṃsarga jñānam saṃsarga abhimānaḥ vā vaktavyaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ nanu smṛti rūpatayā kāraṇa tritaya janya tvam upekṣitam iti na iti āha pūrva dṛṣṭa tva iti

original: nanu avidyādidoṣapūrvabhramasaṃskārābhyāmeva padārthamātrajñānāni jāyamānāni vibhramāḥ, na satyaṃ vastu tatsaṃprayogādi pramāṇakāraṇaṃ cāpekṣate vibhramaḥ iti, paratretipadamavivakṣitamiti śūnyavādī manyate, tatrāha -- smṛtirūpaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭāvabhāsaḥ iti|| na padārthamātrajñānaṃ vibhramaḥ; śūnyajñānasyāpi tathātvaprasaṅgāt, kintvanyatrānyajñānam;
analyzed: nanu avidyā ādi doṣa pūrva bhrama saṃskārābhyām eva padārtha mātra jñānāni jāyamānāni vibhramāḥ na satyam vastu tad saṃprayoga ādi pramāṇa kāraṇam ca apekṣate vibhramaḥ iti paratra iti padam avivakṣitam iti śūnyavādī manyate tatra āha smṛti rūpaḥ pūrva dṛṣṭa avabhāsaḥ iti na padārtha mātra jñānam vibhramaḥ śūnya jñānasya api tathātva prasaṅgāt kintu anyatra anya jñānam

original: tataśca avibhrame'pi padārthajñāne lakṣaṇavyāpteḥ nirupapattikatvamiti| kathaṃ nirupapattiko'yaṃ ityādigranthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu saṃvidrajatayoritaretarādhiṣṭhānatvena sādhiṣṭhāne bhrame sambhavati na tṛtīyasya satyavastuno'dhiṣṭhānatvakalpanā yukteti codayati -- nanu rajate saṃviditi||
analyzed: tatas ca avibhrame api padārtha jñāne lakṣaṇa vyāpteḥ nirupapattika tvam iti katham nirupapattikaḥ yaḥ ityādi granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ nanu saṃvid rajatayoḥ itaretara adhiṣṭhāna tvena sa adhiṣṭhāne bhrame sambhavati na tṛtīyasya satya vastunā adhiṣṭhāna tva kalpanā yuktā iti codayati nanu rajate saṃvid iti

original: nanu adhyasyamānavyatirekeṇa adhiṣṭhānasya siddhirvaktavyā, tatra itaretarādhiṣṭhānatve satītaretarāpekṣasiddhitvādasamañjasaṃ syāditi, tatrāha -- bījāṅkurādivaditi|| na būjāṅkurādiṣvitaretarāśrayatā, kintu kāraṇaparamparayā anavastheti pariharati -- naitat sāramiti|| nanvihāpi kāraṇaparampareti, netyāha -- iha punaryasyāmiti|| nanvihāpi tarhi
analyzed: nanu adhyasyamāna vyatirekeṇa adhiṣṭhānasya siddhiḥ vaktavyā tatra itaretara adhiṣṭhāna tve sati itaretara apekṣa siddhi tvāt asamañjasam syāt iti tatra āha bīja aṅkura ādi vat iti na būja aṅkura ādiṣu itaretara āśraya tā kintu kāraṇa paramparayā anavasthā iti pariharati na etat sāram iti nanu iha api kāraṇa paramparā iti na iti āha iha punar yasyām iti nanu iha api tarhi

original: rajate saṃvit, rajataṃ pūrvasyāṃ saṃvidi sā ca svaviṣaye, tat ca pūrvasaṃvidi iti paramparāmevaṃ kalpayāmīti -- cet, yadi tāvat pūrvapūrvamuttarottarasyānvitatvenādhiṣṭhānaṃ syāt, tataḥ pūrvasya pūrvasyottarasminnuttarasminnadhyāse yugapadavasthānāt kṣaṇikatvahāniḥ|
analyzed: rajate saṃvid rajatam pūrvasyām saṃvidi sā ca sva viṣaye tat ca pūrva saṃvidi iti paramparām evam kalpayāmi iti ced yadi tāvat pūrva pūrvam uttara uttarasya anvita tvena adhiṣṭhānam syāt tatas pūrvasya pūrvasya uttarasmin uttarasmin adhyāse yugapad avasthānāt kṣaṇika tva hāniḥ

original: nanu bījāṅkurādāvanyonyopādānatve'pi na yugapadavasthānaṃ dṛśyate iti, tatrāha -- bījāṅkurādiṣvapīti|| abhimatavastusiddhiḥ-anvayikāraṇatvasiddhirityarthaḥ; ananviteṣu bījādiṣvanvayikāraṇākāṅkṣāyā anivṛttatvādityarthaḥ| ataḥ anvayidravyameva tatrāpyupādānam; bījāderanyo'nyanimittanaimittikateti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu bīja aṅkura ādau anyonya upādāna tve api na yugapad avasthānam dṛśyate iti tatra āha bīja aṅkura ādiṣu api iti abhimata vastu siddhiḥ anvayi kāraṇatva siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ ananviteṣu bīja ādiṣu anvayi kāraṇa ākāṅkṣāyāḥ anivṛtta tvāt iti arthaḥ atas anvayi dravyam eva tatra api upādānam bīja ādeḥ anyonya nimitta naimittika tā iti bhāvaḥ

original: ihāpi tarhi pūrvasyottaraṃ pratyananvitatvenaivādhyāsanimittatā bījādivaditi, netyāha -- kuta idamevamiti paryanuyoge dṛṣṭatvādevamiti||
analyzed: iha api tarhi pūrvasya uttaram prati ananvita tvena eva adhyāsa nimitta tā bīja ādi vat iti na iti āha kutas idam evam iti paryanuyoge dṛṣṭa tvāt evam iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- bījāṅkurayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasya dṛṣṭatvādadṛṣṭe'pi tayoreva kāryakāraṇaparamparā dṛṣṭaparamparātvāt na anavasthādoṣamāvahati, saṃvidrajatayoradhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭheyatayā nimittanaimittikabhāvasya prathamameva kalpyatvāt tayoreva pūrvapūrvanimittanaimittikabhāvakalpanā tu andhaparamparaiva syāditi|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ bīja aṅkurayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya dṛṣṭa tvāt adṛṣṭe api tayoḥ eva kārya kāraṇa paramparā dṛṣṭa paramparā tvāt na anavasthā doṣam āvahati saṃvid rajatayoḥ adhiṣṭhāna adhiṣṭheya tayā nimitta naimittika bhāvasya prathamam eva kalpya tvāt tayoḥ eva pūrva pūrva nimitta naimittika bhāva kalpanā tu andha paramparā eva syāt iti

original: dṛṣṭaparamparāmeva darśayati -- dṛṣṭatvādevamiti|| tatraivadūraṃ veti|| nānavasthādoṣamativarteta iti|| andhaparamparāmevetyarthaḥ||

original: nanu idaṃ rajatamitivadadhyastatve -- "ahami"ti dvairūpyāvabhāso vaktavyaḥ ityata āha -- sa cedamanidamiti|" "ayo dahatī"ti dagdhṛtvaviśiṣṭasyāgnerayasaśca dvairūpyāvabhāsavat -- "ahamupalabhe" ityupalabdhṛtvaviśiṣṭasyātmano'ntaḥkaraṇasya cāstyeva dvairūpyāvabhāsaḥ, asādhāraṇakriyoparaktamātmādidravyameva vastvantaraviśiṣṭamavabhāsata iti bhāvaḥ|

original: kiñca -- grāhakarūpasyāpi viṣayatayā siddhirasti vā na vā na cet, svayaṃprakāśatvasaṃvidāśrayatvasiddhayoranabhyupagamāt asiddhiprasaṅgaḥ, karmatayā siddhiścet, tatrāha -- prameyasya ceti|| tasmāt saṃvidbalādeva tritayasiddhau saṃvidāśrayapakṣapātitayā ahamaḥ siddheḥ na idamaṃśo'haṅkāraḥ ityupasaṃharati -- tasmānnīlādijñānaphalamiti||

original: ahaṃṅkārasyātmavyatiriktatvaṃ sādhayitumātmanaḥ svayaṃprakāśatvasādhanāya vikalpayati -- tatredaṃ bhavāniti|| uta so'pi anubhavo'pītyarthaḥ| tatra ātmā citsvabhāvaḥ, anubhavo jaḍaprakāśaḥ iti pakṣo nopapadyate ityāha -- tatra na tāvat iti|| nanu aprakāśamānameva pramāṇaphalaṃ cakṣurādivadviṣayamavabhāsayediti kuto viśvasyānavabhāsaḥ na;
analyzed: ahaṃṅkārasya ātma vyatirikta tvam sādhayitum ātmanaḥ svayaṃprakāśa tva sādhanāya vikalpayati tatra idam bhavān iti uta saḥ api anubhavaḥ api iti arthaḥ tatra ātmā cit svabhāvaḥ anubhavaḥ jaḍa prakāśaḥ iti pakṣaḥ na upapadyate iti āha tatra na tāvat iti nanu aprakāśamānam eva pramāṇa phalam cakṣuḥ ādi vat viṣayam avabhāsayet iti kutas viśvasya anavabhāsaḥ na asti iti

original: viṣayaprakāśajananena cakṣuṣaḥ prakāśakatvāt saṃvidvailakṣaṇyāt, saṃvedanaṃ tu svayaṃprakāśa eva, na prakāśāntarahetuḥ; ataḥ cakṣurādivailakṣaṇyāt pradīpavadavabhāsamāna evānubhavo'rtha prakāśayati| na ca pradīpālokasyārthānubhavajananenaiva cakṣurādivadarthasya prakāśakatā, kintu pṛthageva|

original: tathāhi -- jñānaprakāśyatvādajñānavirodhino'nyadevālokaprakāśyatvaṃ tamovirodhitayā prasiddham tat avyavadhānena ālokena kriyate, na tadubhayaṃ karoti cakṣuḥ; ajñānatvādanālokatvācca| tasmādanubhavaḥ sajātīyaprakāśāntaranirapekṣaḥ prakāśamāna eva viṣaye prakāśādivyavahāranimittaṃ bhavitumarhati;

original: avyavadhānena viṣaye prakāśādivyavahāranimittatvāt pradīpalokavat| na ca cakṣuṣā sajātīyaprakāśena pradīpasyālokeneva ghaṭasya prakāśyatā; svayameva prakāśaguṇatvāt| tadviṣayajñānaprakāśaṃ janayati cakṣuriti cet, tathāpi vijātīyajñānenaiva pradīpasya prakāśyateti na sajātīyālokāpekṣā|

original: tasmāt vyavahitapradīpasyeva anubhavasyāpyaprakāśamānatve pradīpaprakāśasyeva viśvasyānavabhāsaprasaṅga iti||

original: nanu pramātṛcaitanyameva jaḍānubhavabalādātmānaṃ viṣayaṃ cāvabhāsayatīti codayati, -- maivam,pramātā cetanaḥ iti|| tatra yadi caitanyasya viṣayoparāgaheturanubhavaḥ parābhyupagatabuddhipariṇāmavadiṣyate, tat yujyate; cidātmaprakāśasya tu jaḍānubhavādhīnatā anupapannetyāha -- tanna svayaṃprakāśacaitanyasvabhāvo'pi sanniti||

original: nanu cidguṇamapi puruṣāntarasaṃvedanaṃ na puraṣāntarasya svayaṃprakāśam, tathā ātmā caitanyaguṇo'pi na svayaṃ prakāśate iti śaṅkate -- atha caitanyasvabhāvatve'pīti|| pariharati -- viśeṣe heturvācyaḥ iti|| anubhavo'pi tarhi na svayaṃprakāśaḥ syāt| puruṣāntarasaṃvedanavat, avyavadhānāt na iti cedātmanyapi tat samānamiti bhāvaḥ| kiñceti spaṣṭārthaḥ|

analyzed: astu tarhi jaḍa ātmanaḥ svayam prakāśa anubhava āśraya tayā siddhiḥ iti na iti āha tṛtīye api iti ayam arthaḥ saṃvedanam nāma guṇaḥ dravyam karma vā bhavati karma tve prakāśa tva phala tvayoḥ anupapattiḥ dravya tve pi aṇu madhyama anantara parimāṇānām aṇu parimāṇa tve viṣaye pi tāvat mātra avabhāsaḥ

original: syāt; na hi khadyotaprakāśamātrasaṃsṛṣṭasya ghaṭasya sarvātmanā avabhāsaḥ, mahāparimāṇatve tadāśrayatayā ātmano'pi sarvatrāvabhāsaprasaṅgaḥ; madhyamaparimāṇatve sāvayavatvena avayavaparatantratā syāt| guṇatve sati ātmaiva prakāśaguṇaḥ iti pradīpavadātmā svayaṃprakāśaḥ syāt| sa ca guṇaḥ svāśrayopādhau na jāyate;
analyzed: syāt na hi khadyota prakāśa mātra saṃsṛṣṭasya ghaṭasya sarvātmanā avabhāsaḥ mahā parimāṇa tve tad āśraya tayā ātmanaḥ api sarvatra avabhāsa prasaṅgaḥ madhyama parimāṇa tve sāvayava tvena avayava paratantra tā syāt guṇa tve sati ātmā eva prakāśa guṇaḥ iti pradīpa vat ātmā svayaṃprakāśaḥ syāt sa ca guṇaḥ sva āśraya upādhau na jāyate

original: prakāśaguṇatvāt, ātmanyavyabhicārāt, ādityādiprakāśaguṇavat, iti ātmaiva svayaṃprakāśa iti, tadetadāha -- anicchato'pyātmaiva citiprakāśaḥ iti||

original: nanu madhyamaparimāṇameva svāvayavāśrayaṃ phalamastu, ātmaparatantratā tu ghaṭasyeva bhūtalatantratā iti, netyāha -- na tadatiriktatathāvidhaphalasadbhāve iti|| "pradīpena prakāśitami"tivat "mayā avagatami"tyanubhavādātmaiva citprakāśaḥ; anyathā kāṣṭhena prakāśitamitivadupacāraprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ|

original: pramāṇāntarāpekṣayā pṛcchati -- kathamiti saṃvedanasya bhedāvabhāsaśūnyatvādanubhavādhīnasiddhikasya ca viṣayavadanātmatvādekaḥ sthāyyātmaivānubhavaḥ ityāha -- pramāṇajanyaścedanubhavaḥ iti|| sāmānyaviśeṣabhedakalpanāgauravādātmā eka evānabhuvaḥ ityāha -- sarvānubhavānugataṃ ceti||

analyzed: svagata bheda pratibhāsa śūnyatām eva prapañcayati na ca nīla anubhavaḥ iti nanu nīla saṃvid sthiti kāle pīta saṃvidaḥ bhāvāt sthiti vināśau dṛṣṭau dharmi bhedam kalpayataḥ iti codyam udbhāvya pariharati nanu vinaṣṭa avinaṣṭa ityādinā nanu sādhana sannidhānāt uttara saṃvedanasya jāta tvāt saṃvid dvaya yaugapadya ayogāt vinaṣṭā pūrva saṃvid iti ced na

original: itaretarāśrayādityāha -- sā ca janyatve iti|| siddhasyaiva saṃvedanasya viṣayoparāganimittaṃ sādhanamiti kalpanaṃ laghīyaḥ viṣayoparaktasaṃvijjanmasādhanatvakalpanāditi bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: itaretara āśrayāt iti āha sā ca janya tve iti siddhasya eva saṃvedanasya viṣaya uparāga nimittam sādhanam iti kalpanam laghīyaḥ viṣaya uparakta saṃvid janma sādhanatva kalpanāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā "kasminnvahamutkrānte utkranto bhaviṣyāmi" iti śrutāvutkrāntyādyupādheḥ prāṇasyāpyantaḥkaraṇāṃśatvamavagatam; yugapadupādhidvayāyogāt| tataśca varṇitamantaḥkaraṇaṃ śrutiliṅgasiddhamiti| nanu arthavādaliṅgānāṃ nyāyāpekṣā vidyate, satyam; niraṃśasarvagatāsaṅgasyākāśasyeva nirupādheḥ gamanaparicchedādyanupapattireva nyāyaḥ ityalamatiprasaṅgena||

original: nanu ātmana eva vijñānakriyāpariṇāmaśaktī kiṃ na syātām iti niravayavasarvagatāsaṅgasya pariṇāmānupapatteḥ, pariṇāmyantaḥkaraṇasannidhānācca pratibhāsasyānyathāsiddheriti sadṛṣṭāntamāha -- tenāntaḥkaraṇoparāganimittamiti|| mithyātvaṃ sphaṭikalauhityasya; klṛptapratītisattayoḥ kāraṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| tadubhayābhāvamuttaragranthena sādhayati||

original: tatrākhyātivādī -- na sphaṭikagataṃ mithyālauhityamavabhāsate, kintu japākusumagatameva gṛhyamāṇaṃ sphaṭikādaviviktamevāvabhāsate iti codayati -- kathaṃ punaḥ sphaṭike iti|| naitadityāha -- yadi sphaṭikapratisphālitāḥ iti||

original: nanu doṣabalādindriyasya kusumasaṃyogābhāvāt na sanniveśagrahaṇamiti, netyāha -- na hi rūpamātraniṣṭhaḥ iti|| saṃyuktasamavāyāt saṃyogādvāguṇagrahaṇe dravyamapi saṃyuktamiti bhāvaḥ| anyathākhyātivādī-rūpamātraṃ pratibimbitaṃ sphaṭikātmanā pratibhātīti vakti, tannetyāha -- nāpi svāśrayamiti||
analyzed: nanu doṣa balāt indriyasya kusuma saṃyoga abhāvāt na sanniveśa grahaṇam iti na iti āha na hi rūpa mātra niṣṭhaḥ iti saṃyukta samavāyāt saṃyogāt vā guṇa grahaṇe dravyam api saṃyuktam iti bhāvaḥ anyathākhyātivādī rūpa mātram pratibimbitam sphaṭika ātmanā pratibhāti iti vakti tat na iti āha na api sva āśrayam iti

original: tarhi sphaṭikadeśe lauhityaṃ sadravyamevāviviktaṃ sphaṭikātmanā vā gṛhyate iti codayati -- nanvabhijātasyeveti|| tathāpyanyathākhyātau saṃsargamithyātvamityāha -- tathāpi svayamalohitaḥ iti||
analyzed: tarhi sphaṭika deśe lauhityam sa dravyam eva aviviktam sphaṭika ātmanā vā gṛhyate iti codayati nanu abhijātasya iva iti tathā api anyathā khyātau saṃsarga mithyātvam iti āha tathā api svayam alohitaḥ iti

original: akhyātivādino matamādadāti -- atha prabhaiva lohiteti|| tarhi sphaṭikagrahaṇe saṃyuktasamavāyakāraṇapauṣkalyādapratibaddhasaṃyogādvā rūpagrahaṇamapi syādityāha -- śauklyamapi tarhīti|| virodhiguṇayā prabhayā virodhiguṇasyāpasāraṇaṃ pratibandhau vā kṛtaḥ iti śaṅkate -- prabhayā'pasāritaṃ taditi|| apasāraṇe doṣamāha -- sa tarhi nīrūpaḥ iti||
analyzed: akhyāti vādinaḥ matam ādadāti atha prabhā eva lohitā iti tarhi sphaṭika grahaṇe saṃyukta samavāya kāraṇa pauṣkalyāt apratibaddha saṃyogāt vā rūpa grahaṇam api syāt iti āha śauklyam api tarhi iti virodhi guṇayā prabhayā virodhi guṇasya apasāraṇam pratibandhau vā kṛtaḥ iti śaṅkate prabhayā apasāritam tat iti apasāraṇe doṣam āha sa tarhi nīrūpaḥ iti

original: pratibandhaśca dravyasyāpi samānaḥ| guṇadvārā virodhisāmyādityarthaḥ| rūpahīnamapi dravyaṃ rūpiprabhāsaṃyogāccākṣuṣaṃ syāt ityāśaṅkyāha -- na ca rūpisaṃyogāditi|| tarhi śauklyamapasārya lauhityasyotpannatvāt rūpavattayā cākṣuṣaḥ sphaṭikaḥ iti , netyāha -- na prabhānimittamiti|| abhyupagamya prabhāṃ ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ||
analyzed: pratibandhaḥ ca dravyasya api samānaḥ guṇa dvārā virodhi sāmyāt iti arthaḥ rūpa hīnam api dravyam rūpi prabhā saṃyogāt cākṣuṣam syāt iti āśaṅkya āha na ca rūpi saṃyogāt iti tarhi śauklyam apasārya lauhityasya utpanna tvāt rūpavat tayā cākṣuṣaḥ sphaṭikaḥ iti na iti āha na prabhā nimittam iti abhyupagamya prabhām ityādiḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ

original: tataścoparaktāhaṅkāranimittamātmani kartṛtvādyoropaṇamityāha -- tadevamiti||
analyzed: tatas ca uparakta ahaṅkāra nimittam ātmani kartṛ tvāt yoropaṇam iti āha tat evam iti

original: nanu ahaṅ‌kāradharmasyātmanyāropamātraṃ kriyate kiṃ vā mithyaiva dharmāntaramutpadyate iti| pūrvasmin nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, anyathākhyātiśca syāt, uttarasmin satyamithyākartṛdvayāvabhāsaḥ syāt, ucyate -- ahaṅkārasya svadharmasahitasyaivātmanyadhyastatayā mithyātvāt na anyathākhyātiprasaṅgaḥ, anyasannidhānādanyasmin mithyādharmāvabhāsaḥ ityetāvati

original: dṛṣṭāntaḥ| atha vā -- kartṛtvadvaye'pi dharmiṇorekatvāpattyā dharmabhedāvabhāsaḥ ityavirodhaḥ|

original: nanu "bhidyate hṛdayagranthiḥ" ityādau hṛdayagranthirātmani anarthaheturiti gamyate, tat kathamahaṅkārasyocyata iti tatrāha -- tataḥ saṃbhinnobhayarūpatvāditi|| nanu ātmā svātmanyuparaktāhaṅkārataddharmādīn nāvabhāsayet, uparaktatvasāmyāt sphaṭikādivaditi, tatrāha -- tatra jaḍarūpatvāditi||

original: nanu sākṣisvarūpavat vijñānakriyāvyavadhānamantareṇa ahaṅkārasya siddhau kathamidamaṃśatā iti tatrāha -- tena lakṣaṇataḥ iti|| arthasvabhāvata ityarthaḥ| arthataḥ citsvarūpatā anidamaṃśatā, caitanyakarmatā cedamaṃśatā, na jñānakriyāvyavadhānatetyarthaḥ| vyavahārataḥ punaḥ kathaṃbhūtasya idamaṃśatā iti tadāha -- vyavahārataḥ punariti||
analyzed: nanu sākṣi sva rūpa vat vijñāna kriyā vyavadhānam antareṇa ahaṅkārasya siddhau katham idam aṃśa tā iti tatra āha tena lakṣaṇataḥ iti artha svabhāvataḥ iti arthaḥ arthataḥ cit svarūpa tā anidamaṃśatā caitanya karmatā ca idam aṃśa tā na jñāna kriyā vyavadhāna tā iti arthaḥ vyavahārataḥ punar kathaṃbhūtasya idam aṃśa tā iti tat āha vyavahārataḥ punar iti

original: yaduparāgāt-yasyāhaṅkārasyoparāgādityarthaḥ| tadātmana iti|| tadātmatāṃ ahaṅkārātmatāṃ āpannasyetyarthaḥ| tadvyāpāreṇa-ahaṅkāravyāpāreṇeti| vṛttivyavadhānasiddhireva śarīrendriyaviṣayāṇāṃ idamiti pratibhāsitā tadavyavadhānasiddhirevānidaṃpratibhāsiteti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yat uparāgāt yasya ahaṅkārasya uparāgāt iti arthaḥ tad ātmanaḥ iti tad ātmatām ahaṅkāra ātmatām āpannasya iti arthaḥ tad vyāpāreṇa ahaṅkāra vyāpāreṇa iti vṛtti vyavadhāna siddhiḥ eva śarīra indriya viṣayāṇām idam iti pratibhāsi tā tad avyavadhāna siddhiḥ eva anidam pratibhāsi tā iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu ajñānavyavahito'haṅkāraḥ, kathamavyavadhānādidaṃtāvabhāsābhāvaḥ syāditi atrāha -- ata eva ahaṃ iti|| anidantāpratibhāsādeva-ajñānamātravyavadhānādevetyarthaḥ| nanu arthato yuṣmadarthatve tathāpratibhāsābhāvo na yuktaḥ iti; atrāha -- dṛṣṭaśca lakṣaṇataḥ iti||

original: nanu tatra vimarśe'pimṛnmayavyavahāro na jāyate, iha tu vimarśe yuṣmadarthatā vyavahriyate, ato nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ ityata āha -- vyutpannamatayastviti|| ata eva nipuṇataramabhivīkṣya ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ||
analyzed: nanu tatra vimarśepi mṛd maya vyavahāraḥ na jāyate iha tu vimarśe yuṣmad artha tā vyavahriyate atas na ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti atas āha vyutpanna matayaḥ tu iti atas eva nipuṇataram abhivīkṣya ityādiḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ

original: yadi sphaṭikodāharaṇenaivātmanyanātmādhyāsaḥ siddho na tarhi darpaṇajalādyudāharaṇena vedāntavihitena kṛtyamiti ; tatrāha -- yat punaḥ darpaṇajalādiṣviti|| nanu pratyaṅmukhatābhedāvabhāsābhyāṃ vastvantare bimbāt pratibimbe pratyakṣe kathamekatvapramāṇamantareṇa tadeva tat iti codayati -- kathaṃ punastadeva taditi|
analyzed: yadi sphaṭika udāharaṇena eva ātmani anātma adhyāsaḥ siddhaḥ na tarhi darpaṇa jala ādi udāharaṇena vedānta vihitena kṛtyam iti tatra āha yat punar darpaṇa jala ādiṣu iti nanu pratyaṅmukha tā bheda avabhāsābhyām vastu antare bimbāt pratibimbe pratyakṣe katham ekatva pramāṇam antareṇa tat eva tat iti codayati katham punar tat eva tat iti

original: vyaktipratyabhijñānāditi pariharati -- ekasvalakṣaṇatvāvagamāditi|| nanu abhijñāyāṃ bhedapratibhāsaḥ kathaṃ pratyabhijñayā bādhyate iti ; tatrāha -- na tadvastvantaratve iti|| nanu vyaktigatayoraikyabhedāvabhāsayoḥ kena kiṃ bādhyamiti viśaye vyaktibhedaḥ tatropapattiśūnyatvādbādhyate ityāha -- api ca arthādvastvantaratve iti||
analyzed: vyakti pratyabhijñānāt iti pariharati eka sva lakṣaṇa tva avagamāt iti nanu abhijñāyām bheda pratibhāsaḥ katham pratyabhijñayā bādhyate iti tatra āha na tat vastu antara tve iti nanu vyakti gatayoḥ aikya bheda avabhāsayoḥ kena kim bādhyam iti viśaye vyakti bhedaḥ tatra upapatti śūnya tvāt bādhyate iti āha api ca arthāt vastu antara tve iti

original: darpaṇāvayavā eva vyaktyantarākāreṇa pariṇatāḥ iti vācyam, anyathā vyaktyut‌pattyupāyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu mukhalāñchitapratimudreyaṃ, na pariṇāma iti, netyāha -- viruddhaparimāṇatvāditi|| astu tarhi pariṇāma iti; netyāha -- tathā satīti|| nanu dṛśyate eva sarvadā, naivam; darpaṇasya tiryaṅnirīkṣaṇe pūrvotpannamukhadarśanābhāvāt||
analyzed: darpaṇa avayavāḥ eva vyakti antara ākāreṇa pariṇatāḥ iti vācyam anyathā vyakti utpatti upāya abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu mukha lāñchita pratimudrā iyam na pariṇāmaḥ iti nā iti āha viruddha parimāṇa tvāt iti astu tarhi pariṇāmaḥ iti nā iti āha tathā sati iti nanu dṛśyate eva sarvadā na evam darpaṇasya tiryak nirīkṣaṇe pūrva utpanna mukha darśana abhāvāt

original: nanu nimittakāraṇāpāye'pi kāryamapaiti, yathā vaiśeṣikāṇāmapekṣābuddhivināśe dvitvādivināśaḥ hastasaṃyogāpāye ca kaṭavivaraṇāpāyaḥ iti; netyāha -- na khalu saṃveṣṭitaḥ iti|| sarvatrāgnisaṃyuktadrutatāmrādāviva puṣkalakāraṇena viruddhakāryodayādeva pūrvakāryavināśaḥ, vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ ca prakriyāmātraṃ; taddvitvādervastusahabhāvitvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu nimitta kāraṇa apāye api kāryam apaiti yathā vaiśeṣikāṇām apekṣā buddhi vināśe dvi tva ādi vināśaḥ hasta saṃyoga apāye ca kaṭa vivaraṇa apāyaḥ iti na iti āha na khalu saṃveṣṭitaḥ iti sarvatra agni saṃyukta druta tāmra ādau iva puṣkala kāraṇena viruddha kārya udayāt eva pūrva kārya vināśaḥ vaiśeṣikāṇām ca prakriyā mātram tat dvi tva ādeḥ vastu sahabhāvi tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu saṃskārajanyakāryāntarodayāt pūrvakāryavināśaḥ, na nimittakāraṇāpāyāditi iti, tatrāha -- tathā ca yāvaditi|| nimittāpāyamātrāccedvivaraṇāpāyaḥ saṃskārābhāve saṃveṣṭeteti bhāvaḥ| ihāpi tarhi pūrvasaṃsthānasya cirakālaṃ saṃssthānasaṃskārabalādviruddhakāryodaye pratibimbāpāyaḥ iti cet, na;
analyzed: nanu saṃskāra janya kārya antara udayāt pūrva kārya vināśaḥ na nimitta kāraṇa apāyāt iti iti tatra āha tathā ca yāvat iti nimitta apāya mātrāt ced vivaraṇa apāyaḥ saṃskāra abhāve saṃveṣṭeta iti bhāvaḥ iha api tarhi pūrva saṃsthānasya cira kālam saṃssthāna saṃskāra balāt viruddha kārya udaye pratibimba apāyaḥ iti ced na

original: utpannadarpaṇamātre cirakālāvasthitamukhapariṇāmasaṃskāre'pi bimbāpāyamātrāt pratibimbāpagamadarśanādityāha -- evaṃ cirakāleti||
analyzed: utpanna darpaṇa mātre cira kāla avasthita mukha pariṇāma saṃskāre api bimba apāya mātrāt pratibimba apagama darśanāt iti āha evam cira kāla iti

original: nanu cirakālāvasthitavikāsapariṇāmasaṃskārapracaye'pi savitṛkiraṇāpāye vikāsāpāyadarśanavaccirakālāvasthitapratibimbāpāyo'pi bimbāpāye syāditi ; netyāha -- yaḥ punaḥ kamalamukulasyeti|| nanu nimittakāraṇāpāya eva tatrāpi nimittaṃ, na pārthivādyavayavajanyā mukulateti ; tatrāha -- taduparame iti||
analyzed: nanu cira kāla avasthita vikāsa pariṇāma saṃskāra pracaye api savitṛ kiraṇa apāye vikāsa apāya darśana vat cira kāla avasthita pratibimba apāyaḥ api bimba apāye syāt iti na iti āha yaḥ punar kamala mukulasya iti nanu nimitta kāraṇa apāyaḥ eva tatra api nimittam na pārthiva ādi avayava janyā mukula tā iti tatra āha tad uparame iti

original: ādarśe'pi tarhi mukhaviparītakāryapariṇāmahetuḥ kalpyatāmiti ; netyāha nādarśe punariti|| kārukarmāpekṣaṃ cādarśatalajanmeti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca, satyapi bimbasannidhāne darpaṇadravya mukhākāraṃ kartuṃ dāhacchedādibahuprayatnadarśanāt, sparśagocaratvābhāvācca| avayavavyavadhāne cākṣuṣatvamapi na syāt ityabhyuccayaḥ|
analyzed: ādarśe api tarhi mukha viparīta kārya pariṇāma hetuḥ kalpyatām iti nā iti āha na ādarśe punar iti kāru karma apekṣam ca ādarśa tala janma iti bhāvaḥ kim ca sati api bimba sannidhāne darpaṇa dravya mukha ākāram kartum dāha cheda ādi bahu prayatna darśanāt sparśa gocara tva abhāvāt ca avayava vyavadhāne cākṣuṣa tvam api na syāt iti abhyuccayaḥ

original: tatrāyaṃ prayogaḥ -- na darpaṇādau mukhavyaktyantaramasti, tajjanmakāraṇaśūnyatvāt; śaśamastake viṣāṇavaditi||
analyzed: tatra ayam prayogaḥ na darpaṇa ādau mukha vyakti antaram asti tad janma kāraṇa śūnyatvāt śaśa mastake viṣāṇa vat iti

original: tarhi śuktikārajatavat mithyātvopapatteḥ na mukhaikatvamiti codayatyatrāheti|| nanu pratyabhijñayā ekatvamavagatamiti; netyāha -- śuktikārajatasyeti|| mithyārajate'pi pratyabhijñā dṛśyate -- "madīyamidaṃ rajatamitī"tyarthaḥ| uttaramāha -- maivaṃ; tatra hīti||
analyzed: tarhi śuktikā rajata vat mithyātva upapatteḥ na mukha ekatvam iti codayati atra āha iti nanu pratyabhijñayā ekatvam avagatam iti na iti āha śuktikā rajatasya iti mithyārajate api pratyabhijñā dṛśyate madīyam idam rajatam iti iti arthaḥ uttaram āha mā evam tatra hi iti

original: tatra "nedaṃ rajatami"ti rajatasvarūpameva bādhyate, "nātra rajataṃ kiṃ tu tadidaṃ rajatami"ti deśamātrabādhayā satyarajatenaikatayā na pratyabhijñāyate; ato rajate'bhijñābādhāt pratyabhijñā vibhrama ityarthaḥ| iha tu "nedaṃ mukhami"ti na svarūpeṇa bādhyate, kiṃ tu "nātra mukhaṃ, madīyameve"ti pratyabhijñāyate;
analyzed: tatra na idam rajatam iti rajata svarūpam eva bādhyate na atra rajatam kim tu tat idam rajatam iti deśa mātra bādhayā satya rajatena ekatayā na pratyabhijñāyate atas rajata ibhijñā bādhāt pratyabhijñā vibhramaḥ iti arthaḥ iha tu na idam mukham iti na sva rūpeṇa bādhyate kim tu na atra mukham madīyam eva iti pratyabhijñāyate

original: na ca sā bādhyate, vyaktyantaratve ca "nātra mukhamastī"ti na bādhaḥ syādityarthaḥ| yaḥ punariti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu svamukhāvayavānāmacākṣuṣatvāt kathaṃ pratyakṣapratyabhijñā na; katipayāvayavadarśanādapi lokavadavayavinaścākṣuṣatvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca sā bādhyate vyakti antara tve ca na atra mukham asti iti na bādhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ yaḥ punar iti spaṣṭa arthaḥ nanu sva mukha avayavānām acākṣuṣa tvāt katham pratyakṣa pratyabhijñā na katipaya avayava darśanāt api loka vat avayavinaḥ cākṣuṣa tva upapatteḥ

original: tattvamasivākyaṃ tvaṃpadārthabādhanimittam, saṃsāriṇo vināśamantareṇa mokṣānupapatteḥ, ato nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti codayati -- nanu tattvamasivākyāditi|| "so'yaṃ devadattaḥ itivat tādātmyaparaṃ, na parārthabādhaparamiti pariharati -- maivamiti|| kiṃ ca śāstrīyo'pīti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| "na vāristham" ityādityasya vāristhatopajīvyate||
analyzed: tattvamasi vākyam tvaṃ padārtha bādha nimittam saṃsāriṇaḥ vināśam antareṇa mokṣa anupapatteḥ atas na ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti codayati nanu tattvamasi vākyāt iti saḥ uyam devadattaḥ iti vat tādātmya param na parārtha bādha param iti pariharati mā evam iti kim ca śāstrīyaḥ upi iti spaṣṭa arthaḥ na vāri stham iti ādityasya vāri stha tā upajīvyate

original: akhyātivādī -- na bimbādanyatvena pratibimbaṃ nāma darpaṇagatamavabhāsate, kiṃ tu bimbameva darpaṇādaviviktaṃ prakāśate iti -- vadati, tadanuvadati -- yastu manyate iti||
analyzed: akhyāti vādī na bimbāt anya tvena pratibimbam nāma darpaṇa gatam avabhāsate kim tu bimbam eva darpaṇāt aviviktam prakāśate iti vadati tat anuvadati yaḥ tu manyate iti

original: spaṣṭapratyaṅmukhāvabhāsaṃ darpaṇāntaranupraviṣṭamiva svamātmānaṃ puruṣāntaravannirīkṣamāṇamivedaṃ yādṛgdṛśyamānaṃ mukhaṃ, tathā nāvabhāsate iti vadan kathamāptaḥ syādityāha -- tamanubhava eveti||
analyzed: spaṣṭa pratyak mukha avabhāsam darpaṇa antar anupraviṣṭam iva svam ātmānam puruṣa antara vat nirīkṣamāṇam iva idam yādṛś dṛśyamānam mukham tathā na avabhāsate iti vadan katham āptaḥ syāt iti āha tam anubhavaḥ eva iti

original: nanu mūrtadravyasya yugapat kātrsnyena deśadvayavartitvaṃ loke na kvacidapi dṛṣṭamiti codayati -- kathaṃ punaḥ paricchinnamiti|| ekamekadeśasthameva mukhaṃ saṃbhramādbhinnaṃ bhinnadeśasthaṃ ca avabhāsate ityāha -- na vayamiti|| kiṃ punaridamekasminnekadeśavastuni bhedabhinnadeśatvalakṣaṇaṃ vastu iti; tadāha -- vicchedastviti||
analyzed: nanu mūrta dravyasya yugapad kātrsnyena deśa dvaya varti tvam loke na kvacid api dṛṣṭam iti codayati katham punar paricchinnam iti ekam eka deśa stham eva mukham saṃbhramāt bhinnam bhinna deśa stham ca avabhāsate iti āha na vayam iti kim punar idam ekasmin eka deśa vastuni bheda bhinna deśa tva lakṣaṇam vastu iti tat āha vicchedaḥ tu iti

original: nanu māyayāpi pramāṇaviruddhaṃ kathamavabhāsate ityata āha -- na hi māyāyāmiti||
analyzed: nanu māyayā api pramāṇa viruddham katham avabhāsate iti atas āha na hi māyāyām iti

original: nanu vicchedāvabhāsaḥ kathamavidyāvijṛmbhitaḥ yāvatā ūrdhvāgro'pi spaṣṭamavabhāsamāno vṛkṣaḥ adho'gro jale pratīyate, na ca tatrājñānamastīti| ucyate -- na ca viṣayāvaraṇamajñānamadhyāsaheturityuktam| tatra aupādhikabhrameṣu upādhireva ātmāvidyāpariṇāme puṣkalakāraṇam|
analyzed: nanu viccheda avabhāsaḥ katham avidyā vijṛmbhitaḥ yāvatā ūrdhva agraḥ api spaṣṭam avabhāsamānaḥ vṛkṣaḥ adhograḥ jale pratīyate na ca tatra ajñānam asti iti ucyate na ca viṣaya āvaraṇam ajñānam adhyāsa hetuḥ iti uktam tatra aupādhika bhrameṣu upādhiḥ eva ātma avidyā pariṇāme puṣkala kāraṇam

original: na cādhiṣṭhānayāthārthyasya jñānaṃ sopādhikabhrameṣvadhyāsavirodhi, kiṃ tu nirupādhikabhrameṣviti draṣṭavyam||
analyzed: na ca adhiṣṭhāna yāthārthyasya jñānam sopādhika bhrameṣu adhyāsa virodhi kim tu nirupādhika bhrameṣu iti draṣṭavyam

original: nanu sopādhikabhramatve bhedakartṛtvādyadhyāsasya, na tattvajñānādadhyāsanivṛttiḥ, kiṃ tu upādhimātranivṛttyeti codayati -- nanu satyeva bimbaikatāvagame iti||
analyzed: nanu sopādhika bhrama tve bheda kartṛ tva ādi adhyāsasya na tattva jñānāt adhyāsa nivṛttiḥ kim tu upādhi mātra nivṛttyā iti codayati nanu sati eva bimba ekatā avagame iti

original: coditadoṣaṃ parihartumāśaṅkāntaraṃ prathamaṃ nivartayati -- katham jīvaḥ pratibimbaścet, na bimbātmatāmavagantumalam, pratibimbatvāt, akṣipātragatadevadattapratibimbavat, ityetannirācaṣṭe -- devadattasyācetanāṃśasyeti|| acetanatvaprayuktā tatrānavagatiḥ, na pratibimbatvaprayuktā; ghaṭādiṣu tathā darśanāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: codita doṣam parihartum āśaṅkā antaram prathamam nivartayati katham jīvaḥ pratibimbaḥ ced na bimba ātmatām avagantum alam pratibimba tvāt akṣi pātra gata devadatta pratibimba vat iti etat nirācaṣṭe devadattasya acetana aṃśasya iti acetana tva prayuktā tatra anavagatiḥ na pratibimba tva prayuktā ghaṭa ādiṣu tathā darśanāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu śarīrameva cetanamiti lokāyataḥ, tatrāha -- sacetanāṃśasyaiveti|| darpaṇajāḍyena pratibandhāt svabhāvajāḍyād‌vetyarthaḥ| devadattapratibimbasyācetanatve hetvantaramāha -- tathā cānubhavaḥ iti|| kadācit tasyāpi cetanatve svātantryāt tacceṣṭayā vināpīdaṃ ceṣṭatāmiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu śarīram eva cetanam iti lokāyataḥ tatra āha sa cetanā aṃśasya eva iti darpaṇa jāḍyena pratibandhāt svabhāva jāḍyāt vā iti arthaḥ devadatta pratibimbasya acetana tve hetu antaram āha tathā ca anubhavaḥ iti kadācid tasya api cetana tve svātantryāt tad ceṣṭayā vinā api idam ceṣṭatām iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu devadattasyaiva bimbasya bhramanivartakatattvajñānāśrayatvaṃ dṛṣṭam, evaṃ bimbatvād brahmaṇa eva bhramanirāsitattvajñānāśrayatvaṃ syāditi ; netyāha -- yasya hi bhrāntiriti|| na bimbatvakṛtaṃ tattvajñānāśrayatvāt, kiṃ tu bhrāntatvakṛtam, tadapyajñatvakṛtam, tadapi jīvatvanimittamiti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: nanu devadattasya eva bimbasya bhrama nivartaka tattva jñāna āśraya tvam dṛṣṭam evam bimba tvāt brahmaṇaḥ eva bhrama nirāsi tattva jñāna āśraya tvam syāt iti na iti āha yasya hi bhrāntiḥ iti na bimba tva kṛtam tattva jñāna āśraya tvāt kim tu bhrānta tva kṛtam tat api ajña tva kṛtam tat api jīva tva nimittam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu jīvalakṣaṇapratibimbātmatāmātmano brahma jānīyādvā na vā| na cet sarvajñatāhāniḥ, jānāti cet brahma svātmanyeva saṃsāraṃ paśyediti; netyāha -- yastu jānīte devadattaḥ iti||
analyzed: nanu jīva lakṣaṇa pratibimba ātmatām ātmanaḥ brahma jānīyāt vā na vā na ced sarvajña tā hāniḥ jānāti ced brahma svātmani eva saṃsāram paśyet iti na iti āha yaḥ tu jānīte devadattaḥ iti

original: devadatto hi svātmānamakṣipātre'lpatvādiguṇamavagacchannapi tattvajñānapratihatatvāt nānuśocati, evaṃ brahmāpi svātmani jīve pratibimbe saṃsāraṃ paśyadapi tattvajñānitvāt nānuśocati| tattvajñānasaṃsaraṇe cāvadātaśyāmatvādivat na itaretaratra vyavatiṣṭhete iti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: devadattaḥ hi sva ātmānam akṣi pātra ilpa tva ādi guṇam avagacchan api tattva jñāna pratihata tvāt na anuśocati evam brahmā api sva ātmani jīve pratibimbe saṃsāram paśyat api tattva jñāni tvāt na anuśocati tattva jñāna saṃsaraṇe ca avadāta śyāma tva ādi vat na itaretaratra vyavatiṣṭhete iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu ekatāvagame'pi na tatra vicchedavibhramo nivartate, satyam na pratibimbabhāvakṛtaṃ tat, kiṃ tu upādherajñānājanyatvājjñānānivartyatvakṛtamityāha -- nāpi jñānamātrāditi|| nanu jīvasyāpi tarhyupādhijāḍyenāskandanasambhavāt na bhrāntisamyagjñānāśrayatvaṃ, apratibimbatā ca tadāśrayatve syāditi, netyāha -- jīvaḥ punariti||
analyzed: nanu ekatā avagame api na tatra viccheda vibhramaḥ nivartate satyam na pratibimba bhāva kṛtam tat kim tu upādheḥ ajñāna ajanya tvāt jñāna anivartya tva kṛtam iti āha nā api jñāna mātrāt iti nanu jīvasya api tarhi upādhi jāḍyena āskandana sambhavāt na bhrānti samyak jñāna āśraya tvam apratibimba tā ca tad āśraya tve syāt iti nā iti āha jīvaḥ punar iti

original: "rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūva" "ekadhā bahudhā caiva dṛśyate jalacandravat" "ata eva copamāsūryakādivat" iti ca śrutismṛtisūtraiḥ jīvasya pratibimbabhāvasya darśitatvāt, amūrtasya cākāśasya sābhranakṣatrasya jale pratibimbavadamūrtasya brahmaṇo'pi pratibimbasambhavāt, jānumātrapramāṇe'pi jale dūraviśālākāśadarśanāt, jalāntarākāśa
analyzed: rūpam rūpam pratirūpaḥ babhūva ekadhā bahudhā ca eva dṛśyate jala candra vat atas eva ca upamā sūryaka ādi vat iti ca śruti smṛti sūtraiḥ jīvasya pratibimba bhāvasya darśita tvāt amūrtasya ca ākāśasya sa abhra nakṣatrasya jale pratibimba vat amūrtasya brahmaṇaḥ api pratibimba sambhavāt jānu mātra pramāṇe api jale dūra viśāla ākāśa darśanāt jala antara ākāśa antara ākāśa antara ākāśa antara ākāśa antara ākāśa antara ākāśa antara ākāśa anta
