analyzed: eva abhra ādi pratibimba yuktaḥ dṛśyate iti vaktum aśakya tvāt tad pratibimba tvam cit rūpa tvam ca śāstra pratipannam pratyakṣa pratipannam ca na nirākartum śakyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu ghaṭākāśavadupādhyavacchinno jīvaḥ kiṃ na syāt na -- sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāmupādhibhiraṇḍāntarvartibrahmaṇaḥ sarvātmanā jīvabhāvenāvacchinnatvādanavacchinnasya brahmaṇo'ṇḍādbahireva sadbhāvaprasaṅgāt, tatra sarvagatatvasarvaniyantṛtvādi brahmaṇo na syāt; avacchinnapradeśeṣvanavacchinnasya dviguṇīkṛtya vṛttyayogāt|
analyzed: nanu ghaṭa ākāśa vat upādhi avacchinnaḥ jīvaḥ kim na syāt na sāmānya viśeṣābhyām upādhibhiḥ aṇḍa antarvarti brahmaṇaḥ sarvātmanā jīva bhāvena avacchinna tvāt anavacchinnasya brahmaṇā uṇḍāt bahis eva sadbhāva prasaṅgāt tatra sarvagata tva sarva niyantṛ tva ādi brahmaṇaḥ na syāt avacchinna pradeśeṣu anavacchinnasya dvi guṇīkṛtya vṛtti ayogāt

original: svarūpāpekṣayā tat sarvaṃ, na bahisthitabrahmāpekṣayeti cet -- na -- "yo vijñāne tiṣṭhan" ityādau jīvavyatiriktasyaiva brahmaṇo jīvasaṃnidhānena vikārāntaravasthānaśravaṇāt,
analyzed: svarūpa apekṣayā tat sarvam na bahi sthita brahma apekṣayā iti ced na yaḥ vijñāne tiṣṭhan ityādau jīva vyatiriktasya eva brahmaṇaḥ jīva saṃnidhānena vikāra antar avasthāna śravaṇāt

original: pratibimbapakṣe tu jalagatasvabhāvikākāśe satyeva pratibimbākāśadarśanādekatraiva dviguṇīkṛtya vṛttyupapatteḥ jīvāvacchedeṣu brahmaṇo'pi niyantṛtvādirūpeṇāvasthānamupapadyate iti pratibimbapakṣa eva śreyāniti mithyātattvajñānāśrayatvaṃ ca tatra pratyakṣamityāha -- sa cāhaṃkartṛtvamiti|| upādhisvarūpamapi bhrāntyaivāvabhāsate ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pratibimba pakṣe tu jala gata svabhāvika ākāśe sati eva pratibimba ākāśa darśanāt ekatra eva dviguṇīkṛtya vṛtti upapatteḥ jīva avacchedeṣu brahmaṇaḥ api niyantṛ tva ādi rūpeṇa avasthānam upapadyate iti pratibimba pakṣaḥ eva śreyān iti mithyātattva jñāna āśraya tvam ca tatra pratyakṣam iti āha sa ca ahaṃkartṛ tvam iti upādhi svarūpam api bhrāntyā eva avabhāsate iti arthaḥ

original: ataḥ tattvajñānenopādhinivṛtteḥ vicchedāpāyaḥ itāyaha -- ato yukta iti||
analyzed: atas tattva jñānena upādhi nivṛtteḥ viccheda apāyaḥ iti āyaha atas yuktaḥ iti

original: nanu ajñānaṃ jīvāvacchedopādhiriti purastāduktam, tat kathamahaṃkāropādhitā jīvasyābhidhīyate iti| naiṣa doṣaḥ;caitanyasyāvacchedakavikalpatāratamyena vyavahāravikalpatāratamyāt| tathā hi -- nirvikalpakacaitanyamātraikarasaṃ avidyāsambandhādīṣadvikalpavyavahārālambanaṃ bhavati suṣupteḥ;
analyzed: nanu ajñānam jīva avaccheda upādhiḥ iti purastāt uktam tat katham ahaṃkāra upādhi tā jīvasya abhidhīyate iti na eṣa doṣaḥ caitanyasya avacchedaka vikalpa tāratamyena vyavahāra vikalpa tāratamyāt tathā hi nirvikalpaka caitanya mātra ekarasam avidyā sambandhāt īṣat vikalpa vyavahāra ālambanam bhavati suṣupteḥ

original: tataḥ tadupādānāntaḥkaraṇāvacchedāt tadeva sthūlataravyavahārālambanaṃ bhavati svapne; punarantaḥkaraṇasaṃsṛṣṭasthūlaśarīroparāgāt sthūlatamaṃ bhavati jāgaraṇe| na copādhibhedāt jīvabhedaprasaṅgaḥ; pūrvapūrvopādhyavacchinnasyaivottarottareṇāvacchedāt| nirapekṣopādhibhede hi jīvabhedaḥ||
analyzed: tatas tad upādāna antaḥkaraṇa avacchedāt tat eva sthūlatara vyavahāra ālambanam bhavati svapne punar antaḥkaraṇa saṃsṛṣṭa sthūla śarīra uparāgāt sthūlatamam bhavati jāgaraṇe na ca upādhi bhedāt jīva bheda prasaṅgaḥ pūrva pūrva upādhi avacchinnasya eva uttarottareṇa avacchedāt nirapekṣa upādhi bhede hi jīva bhedaḥ

original: nanu sthūlaśarīropādānabhūtasūkṣmarūpasahitena liṅgaśarīrasaṃskāreṇoparaktamajñānaṃ suṣupte na jīvamavacchettumarhati; tatra bhrāntyabhāvāt, tallakṣaṇatvācca vibhāgasya|
analyzed: nanu sthūla śarīra upādāna bhūta sūkṣma rūpa sahitena liṅga śarīra saṃskāreṇa uparaktam ajñānam suṣupte na jīvam avacchettum arhati tatra bhrānti abhāvāt tad lakṣaṇa tvāt ca vibhāgasya

original: atha bhrāntijñānamanapekṣyaivārthagata eva vibhāgaḥ kalpyate, tatra vibhāgasya kāryatve suṣuptipralayādāvabhāvāt brahmaṇyeva avidyādisāṅkaryaṃ syāt, akāryatve vibhāgasyānāditvādavidyānimittatvaṃ na syāt, ucyate; -- brahmaṇyavidyādisāṅkaryaparihārāya suṣuptyādāvapi astyeva jīvabrahmavibhāgaḥ iti kalpyate|
analyzed: atha bhrānti jñānam an apekṣya eva artha gataḥ eva vibhāgaḥ kalpyate tatra vibhāgasya kārya tve suṣupti pralaya ādau abhāvāt brahmaṇi eva avidyā ādi sāṅkaryam syāt akārya tve vibhāgasya anādi tvāt avidyā nimitta tvam na syāt ucyate brahmaṇi avidyā ādi sāṅkarya parihārāya suṣupti ādau api asti eva jīva brahma vibhāgaḥ iti kalpyate

original: nanu arthagata eva tarhi vibhāgo na vibhramagataḥ, satyam; suṣuptyādigatavibhāgādanyatra jīvabrahmavibhāgo vibhramamātratayā avidyopādāna ucyate| nanu arthagato vibhāgastarhi nāvidyopādānaḥ; anāditvāt, avibhramatvācca, satyam; tathāpyavidyātantro vibhāgo'nāditvepī'pi brūmaḥ| yathā hi svātmāvidyāsambandho'vidyātantraḥ, nāvidyopādānaḥ;
analyzed: nanu artha gataḥ eva tarhi vibhāgaḥ na vibhrama gataḥ satyam suṣupti ādi gata vibhāgāt anyatra jīva brahma vibhāgaḥ vibhrama mātra tayā avidyā upādānaḥ ucyate nanu artha gataḥ vibhāgaḥ tarhi na avidyā upādānaḥ anādi tvāt avibhrama tvāt ca satyam tathā api avidyā tantraḥ brūmaḥ yathā hi svātma avidyā sambandhaḥ vidyā tantraḥ na avidyā upādānaḥ

original: sambandhajananāt prāk svātantryeṇāvasthānānupapatteḥ, ajñānasyānāditvāccātmāvidyāsambandhasya nāvidyopādānatā||
analyzed: sambandha jananāt prāk svātantryeṇa avasthāna anupapatteḥ ajñānasya anādi tvāt ca ātma avidyā sambandhasya na avidyā upādāna tā

original: nanu jīvabrahmāśrayo vibhāgaḥ kathamavidyātantraḥ syāt ucyate; -- anādyavidyāviśiṣṭaṃ caitanyamanādijīvabhāvena kālpanikānādibhedasya āśrayaḥ, na svarūpeṇa; tasyaikatvāt, ato viśiṣṭāśrayo vibhāgaḥ svarūpe'pi uparajyamāno viśeṣaṇāvidyātantrau viśiṣṭa ityavidyākṛto vibhāga ucyate|
analyzed: nanu jīva brahma āśrayaḥ vibhāgaḥ katham avidyā tantraḥ syāt ucyate anādya vidyā viśiṣṭam caitanyam anādi jīva bhāvena kālpanika anādi bhedasya āśrayaḥ na svarūpeṇa tasya ekatvāt atas viśiṣṭa āśrayaḥ vibhāgaḥ svarūpe api uparajyamānaḥ viśeṣaṇa avidyā tantrau viśiṣṭaḥ iti avidyā kṛtaḥ vibhāgaḥ ucyate

original: avidyātantrāṇāṃ cānirvacanīyatvamanāditvaṃ cāvidyāsambandhavanna virudhyate| loke ca darpaṇaghaṭādiviśiṣṭayoreva mukhākāśayoḥ mithyābhedāvabhāso na svarūpeṇa ityupādhitantratā bhedasyocyate; tasmādanādyavidyāpratibimbakṛtavibhāgasyaiva jīvasya tadutpannāhaṃkārādiviśeṣeṣu sthūlapratibimbāpekṣayā sarveṣāmupādhitvaṃ na virudhyate||
analyzed: avidyā tantrāṇām ca anirvacanīya tvam anādi tvam ca avidyā sambandha vat na virudhyate loke ca darpaṇa ghaṭa ādi viśiṣṭayoḥ eva mukha ākāśayoḥ mithyā bheda avabhāsaḥ na svarūpeṇa iti upādhi tantra tā bhedasya ucyate tasmāt anādya vidyā pratibimba kṛta vibhāgasya eva jīvasya tad utpanna ahaṃkāra ādi viśeṣeṣu sthūla pratibimba apekṣayā sarveṣām upādhi tvam na virudhyate

original: atra sarvasaṅkaravādī -- pratibimbasyāvastutvābhyupagamāt na jīvaḥ pratibimbamiti -- jalpati|| tatra mukhacitsvarūpayoḥ pratibimbeṣu nāvastutvamiṣyate| bhedaviparyāsādīnāmavastutvābhyupagame'pi na mukhacaitanyayoḥ kācit kṣatiḥ| mukhacitsvarūpayośca bimbātmatāṃ pramimīmahe mithyāṃśaparyudāsena| na ca mithyāṃśasya bandhamokṣau, kiṃ tu svarūpasyaiva;
analyzed: atra sarva saṅkara vādī pratibimbasya avastu tva abhyupagamāt na jīvaḥ pratibimbam iti jalpati tatra mukha cit svarūpayoḥ pratibimbeṣu nā avastu tvam iṣyate bheda viparyāsa ādīnām avastu tva abhyupagame pi na mukha caitanyayoḥ kācid kṣatiḥ mukha cit svarūpayoḥ ca bimba ātmatām pramimīmahe mithyā aṃśa paryudāsena na ca mithyā aṃśasya bandha mokṣau kim tu svarūpasya eva

original: svarūpagatasyāpi sāṅkaryaparihārāyopādhibhedo darśitaḥ| tasmāt parasiddhāntāparijñānavilasito'yaṃ sarvasaṅkaravādino vibhramaḥ; "avastutvābhyupagamāt" iti||
analyzed: sva rūpa gatasya api sāṅkarya parihārāya upādhi bhedaḥ darśitaḥ tasmāt para siddhānta aparijñāna vilasitaḥ yam sarva saṅkara vādinaḥ vibhramaḥ avastu tva abhyupagamāt iti

original: ahaṃkāropādhinimitto jīvabrahmavibhāgo'nātmādhyāsaśca dṛṣṭāntadvayena siddhaḥ, tatra kiṃ rajjusarpodāharaṇena vedāntavihiteneti codite, tasya prayojanamāśaṅkāntaranivṛttirityāha -- nanu tatra vibhrāmyataḥ iti|| nirupādhikādhyāsapariniṣpannāhaṃkāropādhikaḥ kartṛtvādyadhyāsa iti kathayitumityarthaḥ||
analyzed: ahaṃkāra upādhi nimittaḥ jīva brahma vibhāga ūna ātma adhyāsaḥ ca dṛṣṭānta dvayena siddhaḥ tatra kim rajju sarpa udāharaṇena vedānta vihitena iti codite tasya prayojanam āśaṅkā antara nivṛttiḥ iti āha nanu tatra vibhrāmyataḥ iti nirupādhika adhyāsa pariniṣpanna ahaṃkāra upādhikaḥ kartṛ tva ādi adhyāsaḥ iti kathayitum iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sarvatrādhiṣṭhānādhyasyamānavyatiriktopādhinimitta evādhyāso na nirupādhika iti codayati -- nanu tatrāpi yadi nāmeti|| pūrvānubhavasaṃskāramātropādhimātramihāpi vidyate, svatantropādhireva nirākriyate iti pariharati -- bāḍhamihāpīti|| na pūrvānubhavasaṃskāra eva bhramahetuḥ, na pūrvabhrāntisaṃskāraḥ iti niyamo'stīti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: nanu sarvatra adhiṣṭhāna adhyasyamāna vyatirikta upādhi nimittaḥ eva adhyāsaḥ na nirupādhikaḥ iti codayati nanu tatra api yadi nāma iti pūrva anubhava saṃskāra mātra upādhi mātram iha api vidyate svatantra upādhiḥ eva nirākriyate iti pariharati bāḍham iha api iti na pūrva anubhava saṃskāraḥ eva bhrama hetuḥ na pūrva bhrānti saṃskāraḥ iti niyamaḥ usti iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu ātmani sopādhikasya nirupādhikasya cādhyāsasyodāharaṇatrayeṇaiva siddhatvāt na ghaṭākāśodāharaṇena vedāntavihitena kṛtyamastīti āśaṅkya, codyāntaranirākaraṇenāsaṅgatvasiddhiḥ prayojanamityāha -- tatra yadyapyanirvacanīyatayaiveti|| aruṇādinā sphaṭikādeḥ guṇuguṇitvena sambhede
analyzed: nanu ātmani sopādhikasya nirupādhikasya ca adhyāsasya udāharaṇa trayeṇa eva siddhatvāt na ghaṭa ākāśa udāharaṇena vedānta vihitena kṛtyam asti iti āśaṅkya codya antara nirākaraṇena asaṅga tva siddhiḥ prayojanam iti āha tatra yadi api anirvacanīya tayā eva iti aruṇa ādinā sphaṭika ādeḥ guṇu guṇi tvena sambhede

original: yogyasyāpyanirvacanīyatayā aruṇāderasambhedāvabhāsaḥ siddha ityanvayaḥ| kathaṃ punarghaṭākāśodāharaṇenāsaṅgatvasiddhiriti tatrāha -- tatra hīti|| nanu udāharaṇairevāvātmano'vikāritvaikatvāsaṅgatvānāṃ siddhatvāt na āgamena kṛtyamiti; netyāha -- etacca sarvamudāharaṇajātamiti||
analyzed: yogyasya api anirvacanīya tayā aruṇa ādeḥ asambheda avabhāsaḥ siddhaḥ iti anvayaḥ katham punar ghaṭa ākāśa udāharaṇena asaṅga tva siddhiḥ iti tatra āha tatra hi iti nanu udāharaṇaiḥ siddha tvāt na āgamena kṛtyam iti na iti āha etat ca sarvam udāharaṇa jātam iti

original: pramāṇamantareṇodāharaṇamātrādarthasiddhyayogāt, pratyudāharaṇasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: pramāṇam antareṇa udāharaṇa mātrāt artha siddhi ayogāt pratyudāharaṇa sambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: "asmatpratyayaviṣayatvādi"ti bhāṣyamātmanyadhyāsopapattyartham| tatrāsmatpratyayaḥ tannimittādhyāsaśca darśitaḥ, viṣayaśabdārthamidānīmāha -- tadevaṃ yadyapīti|| gauṇyā vṛttyā viṣayaśabdaprayoge kiṃ guṇasāmyam iti; tadāha -- prameyasya ceti|| nanu savikalpakādhyāsasya savikalpakamevādhiṣṭhānaṃ vaktavyam; tathā darśanāt, na nirvikalpakacinmātram;
analyzed: asmad pratyaya viṣaya tvāt iti bhāṣyam ātmani adhyāsa upapatti artham tatra asmad pratyayaḥ tad nimitta adhyāsaḥ ca darśitaḥ viṣaya śabda artham idānīm āha tat evam yadi api iti gauṇyā vṛttyā viṣaya śabda prayoge kim guṇa sāmyam iti tat āha prameyasya ca iti nanu savikalpaka adhyāsasya savikalpakam eva adhiṣṭhānam vaktavyam tathā darśanāt na nirvikalpaka cit mātram

original: tatra kathamahaṃkārādyadhyāsena savikalpake'haṃkārādhyāsaḥ iti codayati -- nanu vyavahārayogyatyatva iti|| nirvikalpe'pi savikalpādhyāsadarśanāt ajñānādhyāsena savikalpe pūrvāhaṃkārādhyāsena vā savikalpake cidavabhāse sambhavatyevottarāhaṃkārādhyāsaḥ ityāha -- nānāditveneti||
analyzed: tatra katham ahaṃkāra ādi adhyāsena sa vikalpaka ihaṃkāra adhyāsaḥ iti codayati nanu iti nirvikalpe api sa vikalpa adhyāsa darśanāt ajñāna adhyāsena sa vikalpe pūrva ahaṃkāra adhyāsena vā savikalpake cit avabhāse sambhavati eva uttara ahaṃkāra adhyāsaḥ iti āha nānā ādi tvena iti

original: nanu avikāricaitanyaikatānasya niṣkalaṅkasvabhāvānandasyāsaṅgasya ātmano na pramātṛtvamupapadyate; pramāṇakriyāpariṇāmābhāvāt, na ca pramātṛtvahīnasya kartṛtvabhoktṛtve sambhavataḥ, iti pramātṛpramāṇaprameyakartṛkarmakāryabhoktṛbhogabhoktavyasaṃsargalakṣaṇasya vyavahārasyātmanyasambhavāt, ahaṃkārasya cācetanatayā
analyzed: nanu avikāri caitanya eka tānasya niṣkalaṅka svabhāva ānandasya asaṅgasya ātmanaḥ na pramātṛ tvam upapadyate pramāṇa kriyā pariṇāma abhāvāt na ca pramātṛ tva hīnasya kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tve sambhavataḥ iti pramātṛ pramāṇa prameya kartṛ karma kārya bhoktṛ bhoga bhoktavya saṃsarga lakṣaṇasya vyavahārasya ātmani asambhavāt ahaṃkārasya ca acetana tayā

original: tadāśrayatvāyogāducchinnavyavahāramidaṃ jagadāpadyeteti prāptam; atha svabhāvasiddhaicaitanyaprakāśenaiva viṣayaṃ prakāśayet, tarhyaviśeṣāt sarvagatatvācca sarvaṃ prakāśayedityavyavasthaiva| tasmāt vikārasamartha evātmeti, atra apara āha -- na tāvat sarvagatātmavādināmidaṃ codyaṃ sambhavati;
analyzed: tad āśraya tva ayogāt ucchinna vyavahāram idam jagat āpadyeta iti prāptam atha svabhāva siddha aicaitanya prakāśena eva viṣayam prakāśayet tarhi aviśeṣāt sarvagata tvāt ca sarvam prakāśayet iti avyavasthā eva tasmāt vikāra samarthaḥ eva ātmā iti atra aparaḥ āha na tāvat sarvagata ātma vādinām idam codyam sambhavati

original: katham yadi tāvadātmaviṣayendriyamanaścatuṣṭayasaṃnikarṣādinotpadyamānaṃ vijñānaṃ kriyā vā guṇo vā yāvadātmasamavāyyevotpadyeta; niravayave pradeśāśrayatvānupapatteḥ, tadā yugapat sarvamūrtadravyasaṃyogalakṣaṇatvāt sarvagatatvasya, svāśrayātmasaṃyuktavastunaḥ sarvasyāvabhāsi vijñānaṃ syāt;
analyzed: katham yadi tāvat ātma viṣaya indriya manaḥ catuṣṭaya saṃnikarṣa ādinā utpadyamānam vijñānam kriyā vā guṇaḥ vā yāvat ātma samavāyī eva utpadyeta niravayave pradeśa āśraya tva anupapatteḥ tadā yugapad sarva mūrta dravya saṃyoga lakṣaṇa tvāt sarvagata tvasya sva āśraya ātma saṃyukta vastunaḥ sarvasya avabhāsi vijñānam syāt

original: pradīpādiṣu kriyāprakāśaguṇayoḥ svāśrayasaṃyukte vastunyanurūpaprakāśādyatiśayahetutvāt, adṛṣṭena kvacideva viṣaye jñānaṃ niyamyate iti cet, na; pradīpādiṣu yāvatsaṃyuktavastvavabhāsiṣvadṛṣṭena vastusāmarthyamatikramya niyamādarśanāt, sukhaduḥkhādyanimittatṛṇādyupekṣaṇīyasarvaviṣayāvabhāsena cādṛṣṭaniyamānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: pradīpa ādiṣu kriyā prakāśa guṇayoḥ sva āśraya saṃyukte vastuni anurūpa prakāśa ādi atiśaya hetu tvāt adṛṣṭena kvacid eva viṣaye jñānam niyamyate iti ced na pradīpa ādiṣu yāvat saṃyukta vastu avabhāsiṣu adṛṣṭena vastu sāmarthyam atikramya niyama adarśanāt sukha duḥkha ādi animitta tṛṇa ādi upekṣaṇīya sarva viṣaya avabhāsena ca adṛṣṭa niyama anupapatteḥ

original: janakameva jñānaṃ prakāśayati, na sarvamiti cet, na; cakṣurādiṣu prakāśaprasaṅgāt, viṣayasya nirūpyamāṇatvāt viṣayatayā janakamiti viśeṣaṇāyogāt, pradīpādiṣu ca prakāśaguṇasya svāśrayasaṃyuktājanakaviṣayasyāpi prakāśakatvadarśanāt| kriyārūpe'pi vijñāne samānametat| iṣvādivyāpārāṇāmanuddiṣṭe'pi viṣaye svāśrayasaṃyoge satyatiśayahetutvadarśanāt|
analyzed: janakam eva jñānam prakāśayati na sarvam iti ced na cakṣuḥ ādiṣu prakāśa prasaṅgāt viṣayasya nirūpyamāṇa tvāt viṣayatayā janakam iti viśeṣaṇa ayogāt pradīpa ādiṣu ca prakāśa guṇasya sva āśraya saṃyukta ajanaka viṣayasya api prakāśaka tva darśanāt kriyā rūpe api vijñāne samānam etat iṣu ādi vyāpārāṇām anuddiṣṭe api viṣaye sva āśraya saṃyoge sati atiśaya hetu tva darśanāt

original: niravayavatvādātmano na sarvasayaṃgaḥ iti cet, na kiṃcidapi; prakāśeta; kriyāguṇayoḥ svāśrayamatilaṅghya anyatra saṃsargāyogādasaṃsargāt, asaṃsṛṣṭe cātiśayāyogāt||
analyzed: niravayava tvāt ātmanaḥ na sarva sayaṃgaḥ iti ced na kiṃcid api prakāśeta kriyā guṇayoḥ sva āśrayam atilaṅghya anyatra saṃsarga ayogāt asaṃsargāt asaṃsṛṣṭe ca atiśaya ayogāt

original: atha śarīrāvacchinnātmapradeśasamavāyyeva jñānaṃ, na yāvadātmasamavāyīti matam, tarhi sāvayavatvamātmanaḥ, na vyavahitaviṣayāvabhāsaśca syāt; ātmāśrayaprakāśasya viṣayeṇāsaṃsargāt, na cāśrayātilaṅghanaṃ kriyāderityuktam| na ca anāśrayātmapradeśasaṃbandhādavabhāsaḥ; sarvasya avabhāsaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: atha śarīra avacchinna ātma pradeśa samavāyi eva jñānam na yāvat ātma samavāyi iti matam tarhi sāvayava tvam ātmanaḥ na vyavahita viṣaya avabhāsaḥ ca syāt ātma āśraya prakāśasya viṣayeṇa a saṃsargāt na ca āśraya atilaṅghanam kriyā ādeḥ iti uktam na ca anāśraya ātma pradeśa saṃbandhāt avabhāsaḥ sarvasya avabhāsa prasaṅgāt

original: nanu abhicārakarma svāśrayātmapradeśāsaṃyukte puruṣāntare anarthaṃ janayati, tadvadihāpi syāt, naitat sāram; dṛṣṭakriyāsāmardhyādevādṛṣṭe'pyubhayātmapradeśasaṃyuktasya devatātmano vā īśvarasya vā hetvantarasya vā anumīyamānatvāt| na ca ātmasaṃyuktamanassaṃsṛṣṭendiyasaṃyuktaviṣaye atiśayaḥ puruṣāśrayajñānādupapadyate;
analyzed: nanu abhicāra karma sva āśraya ātma pradeśa asaṃyukte puruṣa antare anartham janayati tadvat iha api syāt na etat sāram dṛṣṭa kriyā sāmardhyāt eva adṛṣṭe pi ubhaya ātma pradeśa saṃyuktasya devatā ātmanaḥ vā īśvarasya vā hetu antarasya vā anumīyamāna tvāt na ca ātma saṃyukta manaḥ saṃsṛṣṭa indiya saṃyukta viṣaye atiśayaḥ puruṣa āśraya jñānāt upapadyate

original: viṣayasaṃyukte'pi vastvantare "prakāśate" iti vyavahārātiśayaprasaṅgāt, pūrvabhāvitvācca saṃyogapravāhasya jñānavatā viṣayasya vartamānasaṃyogapravāhābhāvāt| evamaṇudehaparimāṇātmavāde'pi tulyo doṣaḥ| tasmāt na sarvavādināṃ pramāṇādivyavahārasambhavaḥ iti||
analyzed: viṣaya saṃyukte api vastu antare prakāśate iti vyavahāra atiśaya prasaṅgāt pūrva bhāvi tvāt ca saṃyoga pravāhasya jñānavatā viṣayasya vartamāna saṃyoga pravāha abhāvāt evam aṇu deha parimāṇa ātma vāde api tulyaḥ doṣaḥ tasmāt na sarva vādinām pramāṇa ādi vyavahāra sambhavaḥ iti

original: satyam; asmatpakṣe tu kathaṃcit saṃbhavaṃ pradarśayiṣyāmītyāha -- tatraivaṃbhūtasyāhaṃkarturiti|| idamaṃśasya-antaḥkaraṇasyetyarthaḥ| vyāpāra iti pariṇāmo'bhidhīyate| prakāśasvabhāvaṃ sāvayavamantaḥkaraṇamadṛṣṭendriyādisahakṛtaṃ dhruvādiviṣayaparyantaṃ dīrghaprabhākāreṇa pariṇamate;
analyzed: satyam asmad pakṣe tu kathaṃcid saṃbhavam pradarśayiṣyāmi iti āha tatra evaṃbhūtasya ahaṃkartuḥ iti idam aṃśasya antaḥkaraṇasya iti arthaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti pariṇāmaḥ abhidhīyate prakāśa svabhāvam sa avayavam antaḥkaraṇam adṛṣṭa indriya ādi sahakṛtam dhruva ādi viṣaya paryantam dīrgha prabhā ākāreṇa pariṇamate

original: tejasaḥ śīghrātidūragamanadarśanāt, pariṇāmadvāreṇa cakartṛkarmasambandho'vasthāviśeṣaḥ ityāha -- sa ca prāp‌notikriyāhiteti||
analyzed: tejasaḥ śīghra ati dūra gamana darśanāt pariṇāma dvāreṇa ca kartṛ karma sambandhaḥ vasthā viśeṣaḥ iti āha sa ca prāpnoti kriyā hita iti

original: syādantaḥkaraṇasya svapariṇāmadvāreṇa viṣayasaṃbandhaḥ, ātmanastu viṣayaviśeṣāvabhāsaḥ katham iti tadāha -- tena viṣayaviśeṣasaṃbaddhamiti|| sarvatrāvidyāvṛtatayā anabhivyaktasvabhāvamapi caitanyaṃ, antaḥkaraṇaṃ yena yenāvasthāviśeṣeṇa vivartate, tena tenākāreṇa vyajyate;
analyzed: syāt antaḥkaraṇasya sva pariṇāma dvāreṇa viṣaya saṃbandhaḥ ātmanaḥ tu viṣaya viśeṣa avabhāsaḥ katham iti tat āha tena viṣaya viśeṣa saṃbaddham iti sarvatra avidyā āvṛta tayā anabhivyakta svabhāvam api caitanyam antaḥkaraṇam yena yena avasthā viśeṣeṇa vivartate tena tena ākāreṇa vyajyate

original: ayaḥpiṇḍeneva catuṣkoṇatvādyavasthāviśeṣamāpadyamānena kṛśānuḥ, iti viṣayasaṃsṛṣṭāntaḥkaraṇāvacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ tadākāramavabhāsate iti bhāvaḥ| nanu pramātṛrūpāvacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ tadrūpeṇa bhāsatām, kathaṃ caitanyasya viṣayāvacchedaḥ iti; tadāha -- karmakārakamapīti|| svavyāpārāviṣṭaṃ iti||
analyzed: ayaḥ piṇḍena iva catuṣkoṇa tva ādi avasthā viśeṣam āpadyamānena kṛśānuḥ iti viṣaya saṃsṛṣṭa antaḥkaraṇa avacchinnam caitanyam tad ākāram avabhāsate iti bhāvaḥ nanu pramātṛ rūpa avacchinnam caitanyam tad rūpeṇa bhāsatām katham caitanyasya viṣaya avacchedaḥ iti tat āha karma kārakam api iti sva vyāpāra āviṣṭam iti

original: pariṇāmasaṃsargādāpannajāḍyābhibhavalakṣaṇayogyatvamucyate| antaḥkaraṇaṃ hi svasminneva svasaṃsargiṇyāpi caitanyābhivyaktiyogyatāmāpādayatīti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: pariṇāma saṃsargāt āpanna jāḍya abhibhava lakṣaṇa yogyatvam ucyate antaḥkaraṇam hi svasmin eva sva saṃsargiṇyā api caitanya abhivyakti yogyatām āpādayati iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu avacchedakabhede citprakāśabhedāt kathaṃ viṣayāvacchinnānubhavasya pramātṛrūpāvabhāsasaṃsargaḥ asaṃsarge vā kathaṃ "mayedamavagatami"ti pramātṛ prameyasaṃsargāvabhāsi saṃvedanaṃ syāt anubhavabhedāt, ekasmin saṃbandhāvagame padārthayoravabhāsāyogāditi, tatrāha -- pradhānakriyāhitapramātravasthāviśeṣāvacchinnāparokṣataikarūpāṃ iti||
analyzed: nanu avacchedaka bhede cit prakāśa bhedāt katham viṣaya avacchinna anubhavasya pramātṛ rūpa avabhāsa saṃsargaḥ a saṃsarge vā katham mayā idam avagatam iti pramātṛ prameya saṃsarga avabhāsi saṃvedanam syāt anubhava bhedāt ekasmin saṃbandha avagame padārthayoḥ avabhāsa ayogāt iti tatra āha pradhāna kriyā hita pramātṛ avasthā viśeṣa avacchinna a parokṣa tā eka rūpā iti

original: ekāmityarthaḥ| pariṇāmasyobhayasaṃsargāt vyañjakābhedena vyaṅgyāvicchedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ubhayatra caitanyābhivyaktyaviśeṣe ghaṭāvacchinnānubhavaḥ pramātā kiṃ vā antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnaḥ iti na viśeṣaḥ syāt iti, netyāha -- tataścātmano'ntaḥkaraṇāvasthāviśeṣopādhijanito viśeṣa iti|| pramāteti vākyaśeṣaḥ| karturhi pramātṛtā, na karmaṇaḥ|
analyzed: ekām iti arthaḥ pariṇāmasya ubhaya saṃsargāt vyañjaka abhedena vyaṅgya avicchedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu ubhayatra caitanya abhivyakti aviśeṣe ghaṭa avacchinna anubhavaḥ pramātā kim vā antaḥkaraṇa avacchinnaḥ iti na viśeṣaḥ syāt iti na iti āha tatas ca ātmanaḥ ntaḥkaraṇa avasthā viśeṣa upādhi janitaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti pramātā iti vākyaśeṣaḥ kartuḥ hi pramātṛ tā na karmaṇaḥ

original: tatrāntaḥkaraṇasya kartṛtvāt tadavacchinnaḥ pramātetyarthaḥ| nanu caitanyasyaikatve pramātaiva phalamiti viruddhamāpannamiti, tatrāha -- viṣayānubhavasaṃśabdito viṣayasthāparokṣaikarasaḥ phalaṃ iti|| antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnatayā pramātā, viṣayāvacchinnatayā phalamiti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: tatra antaḥkaraṇasya kartṛ tvāt tad avacchinnaḥ pramātā iti arthaḥ nanu caitanyasya ekatve pramātā eva phalam iti viruddham āpannam iti tatra āha viṣaya anubhava saṃśabditaḥ viṣaya stha aparokṣa eka rasaḥ phalam iti antaḥkaraṇa avacchinna tayā pramātā viṣaya avacchinna tayā phalam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu kriyāphalayorantaḥkaraṇātmasamavāyinoḥ bhinnāśrayatvam, ghaṭāntaḥkaraṇaviṣayatayā ca bhinnaviṣayatvamiti kriyāphalayorekāśrayatvaikaviṣayatvaniyamavirodhaḥ iti, netyāha -- iti kriyaikaviṣayatā phalasyeti|| "viṣaye"tyāśrayasyāpyupalakṣaṇam| antaḥkaraṇātmanoraikyādhyāsenaikāśrayatvaṃ, caitanyasyāpi ghaṭāvacchedādekaviṣayatvamiti|
analyzed: nanu kriyā phalayoḥ antaḥkaraṇa ātma samavāyinoḥ bhinna āśraya tvam ghaṭa antaḥkaraṇa viṣayatayā ca bhinna viṣayatvam iti kriyā phalayoḥ eka āśraya tva eka viṣayatva niyama virodhaḥ iti na iti āha iti kriyā eka viṣayatā phalasya iti viṣaya iti āśrayasya api upalakṣaṇam antaḥkaraṇa ātmanoḥ aikya adhyāsena eka āśraya tvam caitanyasya api ghaṭa avacchedāt eka viṣayatvam iti

original: nanu "buddhisthamarthaṃ puruṣaścetayate" iti sāṅkhyāḥ, tadviruddhaṃ ātmā svacaitanyoparaktaṃ cetayate iti tatrāha -- evaṃ cāhaṃkarteti| prathamaṃ buddhisthamarthaṃ tadātmatāmāpannaḥ paścāccetayate ityarthaḥ| uktaṃ tāvat sarvagatasyāpyātmano'vidyāvṛtaprakāśasya paricchinnāntaḥkaraṇapariṇāmopādhyabhivyaktyapekṣayā viṣayaviśeṣaṃ prati pramātṛtvam||
analyzed: nanu buddhi stham artham puruṣaḥ cetayate iti sāṅkhyāḥ tad viruddham ātmā sva caitanya uparaktam cetayate iti tatra āha evam ca ahaṃkartā iti prathamam buddhi stham artham tad ātmatām āpannaḥ paścāt cetayate iti arthaḥ uktam tāvat sarvagatasya api ātmanaḥ vidyā vṛta prakāśasya paricchinna antaḥkaraṇa pariṇāma upādhi abhivyakti apekṣayā viṣaya viśeṣam prati pramātṛ tvam

original: nanu keyamabhivyaktiḥ āvaraṇābhibhava eva, na svarūpātiśayaḥ| nanu uktopādhiḥ kiṃpramāṇakaḥ| uktaṃ -- "hvīrghīrbhīrityetatsarvaṃ mana eva" iti| dhīśabdavācyajñānapariṇāmavat mano vijñānaṃ buddhiriti|
analyzed: nanu kā iyam abhivyaktiḥ āvaraṇa abhibhavaḥ eva na svarūpa atiśayaḥ nanu ukta upādhiḥ kiṃpramāṇakaḥ uktam hvīḥ ghīḥ bhīḥ iti etat sarvam manaḥ eva iti dhī śabda vācya jñāna pariṇāmavat manaḥ vijñānam buddhiḥ iti

analyzed: nanu caitanyam abhivyaktam ced sarva pramātṛ sādhāraṇa tayā sarveṣām avabhāsatām iti na iti āha karma kārakam api iti etat pramātṛ caitanya abhinnatayā eva abhivyaktam tad viṣaya caitanyam na pramātṛ antara caitanya abhedena abhivyaktam atas na sarveṣām avabhāsya tvam iti arthaḥ

original: tadapi na yuktam; kāryabhūtenāntaḥkaraṇena svopādanājñānābhibhavāyogāt| tasmāt na yuktaṃ kiñcijjñatve ahaṃkāropādhivarṇanamiti, atrocyate; -- yukta evāyamupādhiḥ sarvagatasyāpi jīvasyāsaṅgitayā sarveṇāsaṃyogāt| prakāśasya ca saṃyuktavastvavabhāsitvāt, brahma tu sarvopādānatayā svātmābhinnaṃ jagadātmānamivāvabhāsayati, na tu jīvaḥ; anupādānatvāt|

analyzed: ucyate yathā go tva ādayaḥ jāti viśeṣāḥ kesara ādimat vyaktai antara pradeśa saṃnihitāḥ api svabhāva viśeṣāt aśva ādi vyakti antara pradeśa saṃnihitāḥ api svabhāva viśeṣāt aśva ādi vyakti antara pradeśa saṃnihitāḥ api svabhāva viśeṣāt aśva ādi vyakti asaṅgi tayā taiḥ anabhivyaktāḥ api sāsnādimat piṇḍa saṅgi tayā abhivyajyante

original: yathā vā pradīpaprabhā vāyvākāśarasagandhādipradeśavyāpinyapi svabhāvaviśeṣāt tāni na prakāśayantī rūpasaṃsargitayā tadeva prakāśayati, evaṃ caitanyamapi svabhāvaviśeṣādantaḥkaraṇe saṃsṛjyate, nānyatreti yuktam| yathā ca kevalena vahninā na dāhyamapi tṛṇādi, ayaḥpiṇḍasamārūḍhena dahyate;

original: athavā -- sopādhikatvāt jīvaḥ paricchinno na sarvamavabhāsayati; jīvāvacchedanimittāntaḥkaraṇapariṇāmasaṃsargakṛtābhivyaktitvāt viṣayāvacchinnacaitanyasya, jīvacaitanyatā ca na virudhyate| brahmākārapariṇatāntaḥkaraṇasaṃsargābhāvācca na nityavat brahmaṇaḥ prakāśaprasaṅgaḥ| na ca antaḥkaraṇasvarūpamātrasaṃsargiṇo'bhivyaktiraṅgīkṛtā;
analyzed: athavā sopādhika tvāt jīvaḥ paricchinnaḥ na sarvam avabhāsayati jīva avaccheda nimitta antaḥkaraṇa pariṇāma saṃsarga kṛta abhivyakti tvāt viṣaya avacchinna caitanyasya jīva caitanya tā ca na virudhyate brahma ākāra pariṇata antaḥkaraṇa saṃsarga abhāvāt ca na nitya vat brahmaṇaḥ prakāśa prasaṅgaḥ na ca antaḥkaraṇa sva rūpa mātra saṃsargiṇaḥ abhivyaktiḥ aṅgīkṛtā

original: tadgatadharmādīnāmapi prasaṅgāt jīvākārāhaṃvṛttipariṇatāntaḥkaraṇena ca jīvo'bhivyajyate; anyathā jīvasya suṣupteḥ| ataḥ paricchinnatvāt na sarvaviṣayāvabhāsitā| atha vā -- ajñānāvṛtaḥ svayamaprakāśamānatayā vividhaviṣayānavabhāsayan antaḥkaraṇoparāgādāvaraṇatirodhāne tatraivābhivyaktaḥ tatsaṃsṛṣṭyaiva viṣayamavabhāsayati|

original: dṛṣṭaṃ ca vṛścikavṛkṣādikāryasya gomayamṛdādivikārasvabhāvatirodhāyakatvaṃ, iti siddhaivātmani pramātṛtvādivyavastheti||
analyzed: dṛṣṭam ca vṛścika vṛkṣa ādi kāryasya gomaya mṛd ādi vikāra svabhāva tirodhāyaka tvam iti siddhā eva ātmani pramātṛ tva ādi vyavasthā iti

original: viṣayasya caitanyavivartatvāt tadabhinnamapi caitanyamahamavabhāsaikarūpamuktam, tatra apasiddhāntaprasaṅgaṃ codayati -- nanu nīlādiviṣayo'pi cediti|| yatkiñcitsāmyādapasiddhāntasaṃkaraḥ syāt, asti cātra mahān siddhāntabhedaḥ|
analyzed: viṣayasya caitanya vivarta tvāt tad abhinnam api caitanyam aham avabhāsa eka rūpam uktam tatra apasiddhānta prasaṅgam codayati nanu nīla ādi viṣayaḥ api ced iti yat kiñcid sāmyāt apasiddhānta saṃkaraḥ syāt asti ca atra mahān siddhānta bhedaḥ

original: kṣaṇikādvijñānāt bhedenārthakriyāsāmarthyasattvaśūnyaṃ viṣayamāhurvijñānavādinaḥ, tattvadarśinastu, advitīyāt saṃvedanādabhede'pi viṣayasya bhedenāpyarthakriyāsāmarthyasattvaṃ sthāyitvaṃ cābādhitamastīti vadanti| tatra kathaṃ siddhāntasaṅkaraḥ iti vadituṃ saṃvedanaikyaṃ darśayati -- maivam; parasparavyāvṛttāviti||
analyzed: kṣaṇikāt vijñānāt bhedena arthakriyā sāmarthya sattva śūnyam viṣayam āhuḥ vijñāna vādinaḥ tattva darśinaḥ tu advitīyāt saṃvedanāt abhede pi viṣayasya bhedena api arthakriyā sāmarthya sattvam sthāyi tvam ca abādhitam asti iti vadanti tatra katham siddhānta saṅkaraḥ iti vaditum saṃvedana aikyam darśayati mā evam paraspara vyāvṛttau iti

original: astvekarūpatā pratyabhijñānāt, bhedo'pi "ghaṭasaṃvit" "paṭasaṃvidi"tyavabhāsate iti, tatrāha -- vicchedavabhāse'pīti|| svarūpapratyabhijñā paropādhivicchedena na bādhyate iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ekatve'pi saṃvidāṃ viṣayābhedaḥ kiṃ na syāt iti tatrāha -- yadi syāditi|| anuvṛttasya vyāvṛttāt nābhedaḥ; anuvṛttatvāt, ākāśaghaṭādivat ityanumānamuktam|
analyzed: astu eka rūpa tā pratyabhijñānāt bhedaḥ upi ghaṭa saṃvid paṭa saṃvid iti avabhāsate iti tatra āha viccheda avabhāse pi iti svarūpa pratyabhijñā para upādhi vicchedena na bādhyate iti bhāvaḥ nanu ekatve api saṃvidām viṣaya abhedaḥ kim na syāt iti tatra āha yadi syāt iti anuvṛttasya vyāvṛttāt na abhedaḥ anuvṛtta tvāt ākāśa ghaṭa ādi vat iti anumānam uktam

original: idānīṃ pratyakṣo'pi viṣayasaṃvidbhedaḥ ityāha -- kiṃ ca tairapīti|| nīlātmakasaṃviditi nīlamevocyate; yugapadviṣayaviṣayisaṃviddvayānabhyupagamāt| pratyagavabhāsa iti ahaṃsaṃvedanamātram| "ahaṃ nīlaṃ paśyāmī"ti kartṛkarmatayā bhedaḥ pratyakṣaḥ ityarthaḥ||
analyzed: idānīm pratyakṣaḥ api viṣaya saṃvid bhedaḥ iti āha kim ca taiḥ api iti nīla ātmaka saṃvid iti nīlam eva ucyate yugapad viṣaya viṣayi saṃvid dvaya anabhyupagamāt pratyak avabhāsaḥ iti aham saṃvedana mātram aham nīlam paśyāmi iti kartṛ karmatayā bhedaḥ pratyakṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: atra vijñānavādī codayati -- naitat dvayorapīti|| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- saṃvido'nyaccennīlaṃ, na tat saṃvedane'vabhāseta| bhāsate cet, sarvaṃ kimiti nāvabhāsate viśeṣasaṃbandhābhāvāt nīlasya| saṃvido janakatā viśeṣasaṃbandhaḥ iti cet, na -- indriyasyāpi viṣayatāprasaṅgāt| tasmāt svābhāvikāsādhāraṇābhedasaṃbandhādeva vijñāne nīlamavabhāsate iti||
analyzed: atra vijñāna vādī codayati na etat dvayoḥ api iti ayam bhāvaḥ saṃvidaḥ ūnyat ced nīlam na tat saṃvedanā iva bhāseta bhāsate ced sarvam kim iti na avabhāsate viśeṣa saṃbandha abhāvāt nīlasya saṃvidaḥ janakatā viśeṣa saṃbandhaḥ iti ced na indriyasya api viṣaya tā prasaṅgāt tasmāt svābhāvika asādhāraṇa abheda saṃbandhāt eva vijñāne nīlam avabhāsate iti

original: siddhāntī tu bhedāvabhāso'pi pratyakṣo yuktyā kathamabahnūyate ityāha -- kathaṃ punaridamahaṃ jānāmīti|| vijñānavādī tu naitat trayamekasaṃvitpratibhāsi, kiṃ tu saṃvittrayametat kramavartīti pariharati -- nāyaṃ tadavabhāsaḥ iti||
analyzed: siddhāntī tu bheda avabhāsaḥ api pratyakṣaḥ yuktyā katham abahnūyate iti āha katham punar idam aham jānāmi iti vijñāna vādī tu na etat trayam eka saṃvid pratibhāsi kim tu saṃvid trayam etat krama varti iti pariharati na ayam tad avabhāsaḥ iti

original: kramavartitve anyasaṃvitkāle anyate nāvabhāseta, idaṃ tu tritayaṃ yugapat pratyakṣamevāvabhāsate, tataḥ pratyakṣaviruddhaḥ kramaḥ ityāha siddhāntī -- kathaṃ punasteṣviti|| āha vijñānavādī -- tadvāsanāsametasamanantarapratyayasamutthamiti|| ahamityahaṃkalpanopārūḍhaṃ kadācidvijñānaṃ bhavati, anantaraṃ "cedami"ti viṣayavikalpitaṃ vijñānaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: krama varti tve anya saṃvid kāle na avabhāseta idam tu tritayam yugapad pratyakṣam eva avabhāsate tatas pratyakṣa viruddhaḥ kramaḥ iti āha siddhāntī katham punar teṣu iti āha vijñāna vādī tad vāsanā sameta samanantara pratyaya samuttham iti aham iti ahaṃkalpanā upārūḍham kadācid vijñānam bhavati anantaram ca idam iti viṣaya vikalpitam vijñānam bhavati

original: te eva vijñāne vāsanā; sajātīyajñānasya pūrvavṛttasajātīyajñānameva vāsanā, nānyaḥ saṃskāraḥ ityuktam|| tatra vāsanādvayasametāt "jānāmī"ti kriyāvikalpapratyayāt kāraṇatritayānurūpeṇa -- "ahamidaṃ jānāmī"ti viṣayakriyāhaṃkalpanāvikalpitaṃ tryākāramekaṃ vijñānamutpadyate iti āha siddhāntī -- kiṃ punarevamiti||
analyzed: te eva vijñāne vāsanā sajātīya jñānasya pūrva vṛtta sajātīya jñānam eva vāsanā na anyaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti uktam tatra vāsanā dvaya sametāt jānāmi iti kriyā vikalpa pratyayāt kāraṇa tritaya anurūpeṇa aham idam jānāmi iti viṣaya kriyā ahaṃkalpanā vikalpitam tri ākāram ekam vijñānam utpadyate iti āha siddhāntī kim punar evam iti

analyzed: satyam na anubhavam āśritya saṃvedanāt abhinnam nīlam brūmaḥ kim tu vijñānena nīlasya pratibhāsa anyathā anupapattyā katham sthāyi tve hi vijñāna viṣayayoḥ kriyā nimitta sādhāraṇa paraspara saṃbandhāt asādhāraṇaḥ viṣaya avabhāsaḥ syāt kṣaṇikasya tu āgantuka sambandha abhāve yadi svābhāvika abheda saṃbandhaḥ api na syāt tatra caitanyena asaṃsṛṣṭasya pratibhāsaḥ eva na asti tatra caitanyena asaṃsṛṣṭasya pratibhāsaḥ eva na asti tatra

analyzed: nanu sati api bheda avabhāse ati sādṛśyāt na spaṣṭam avabhāsate iti śaṅkate atha atyanta sādṛśyāt iti kaḥ yam abhiprāyaḥ yadi tāvat saṃvidaḥ anyaḥ bhedaḥ jñāna antara gamyaḥ ca sādṛśya doṣāt spaṣṭam na avabhāsate iti abhiprāyaḥ tadā dharmi pratiyogi saṃvidoḥ saṃvid antara aviṣaya tvāt na tayoḥ bheda grahaṇam syāt viṣaya tve vā dharmi pratiyogi bheda ākhya tritayam api

original: bhedasaṃvedane kalpitaṃ tadabhinnaṃ vā syāt, atha saṃvitsvarūpameva, bhedaḥ saṃvedanameva tajjñānamiti, tatrāha -- saṃvido'pi cediti|| api ca aikyapratibhāse sādṛśyakalpanaṃ pramāṇaviruddham, bhinnayoraikyabhramaśca sādṛśyakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇam, tadabhāvācca na sādṛśyasiddhirityāha -- api ca tadrūpapratibhāse iti||

original: nanu aikyāvabhāsasya vyāmohatvāt na sādṛśyakalpanā pramāṇaviruddhā, aikyabhramaśca bhinneṣu sādṛśyamantareṇa anupapanna ityarthāpattimūlā ca sādṛśyakalpanā; ataḥ siddhaṃ sādṛśyamityāha pūrvavādī -- tadrūpapratītervyāmohatvāditi|| maivam; aikyabhramasādṛśyasiddhayoritaretarāśrayatvāditi pariharati -- na itaretarāśrayatvāditi||
analyzed: nanu aikya avabhāsasya vyāmoha tvāt na sādṛśya kalpanā pramāṇa viruddhā aikya bhramaḥ ca bhinneṣu sādṛśyam antareṇa anupapannaḥ iti arthāpatti mūlā ca sādṛśya kalpanā atas siddham sādṛśyam iti āha pūrvavādī tad rūpa pratīteḥ vyāmoha tvāt iti mā evam aikya bhrama sādṛśya siddhayoḥ itaretara āśraya tvāt iti pariharati na itaretara āśraya tvāt iti

original: nanu aikyāvabhāsasya prāmāṇyaṃ na svataḥ siddhyati, kiṃ tu sādṛśyasya nirmūlatvapramāṇaviruddhatvāpekṣayā; sādṛśyasya ca nirmūlatvapramāṇaviruddhatvamaikyapratibhāsasya iti tulyaṃ tavāpi itaretarāśrayatvamiti codayati -- syādetat; avyāmohe'pīti|| aikyāvabhāso na sādṛśyābhāvāpekṣaḥ, kiṃ tu svata eva pramāṇamiti pariharati -- naitat svārasikamiti||
analyzed: nanu aikya avabhāsasya prāmāṇyam na svatas siddhi ati kim tu sādṛśyasya nirmūla tva pramāṇa viruddha tva apekṣayā sādṛśyasya ca nirmūla tva pramāṇa viruddha tvam aikya pratibhāsasya iti tulyam tava api itaretara āśraya tvam iti codayati syāt etat a vyāmohe api iti aikya avabhāsaḥ na sādṛśya abhāva apekṣaḥ kim tu svatas eva pramāṇam iti pariharati na etat svārasikam iti

original: nanu sādṛśyamapi svata eva siddhamityāśaṅkyāha -- na tu sādṛśyakalpanā svata iti|| kutastarhi sādṛśyasiddhiḥ ityata āha -- aprāmāṇyapūrviketi|| aikyabhramo hi bhinneṣu sādṛśyaṃ kalpayatīti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: nanu sādṛśyam api svatas eva siddham iti āśaṅkya āha na tu sādṛśya kalpanā svatas iti kutas tarhi sādṛśya siddhiḥ iti atas āha aprāmāṇya pūrvikā iti aikya bhramaḥ hi bhinneṣu sādṛśyam kalpayati iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu keyaṃ pratyabhijñā nāma yatsāmarthyabalāt saṃvidaikyaṃ pratīyate, pūrvānubhavasaṃskārasahitādidānīṃtanavastupramitikāraṇāt jātamekasya kāladvayasambandhaviṣayakaṃ pratyakṣajñānaṃ pratyabhijñeti cet, na tarhyātmani sā saṃbhavati|
analyzed: nanu kā iyam pratyabhijñā nāma yat sāmarthya balāt saṃvid aikyam pratīyate pūrva anubhava saṃskāra sahitāt idānīṃtana vastu pramiti kāraṇāt jātam ekasya kāla dvaya sambandha viṣayakam pratyakṣa jñānam pratyabhijñā iti ced na tarhi ātmani sā saṃbhavati

original: katham vijñānasvabhāvasya hyātmanaḥ sthāyitve, svayaṃprakāśasya jñānāntarāgamyatvāt tadvināśasaṃskārābhāvāt, svarūpasya cāvināśādavināśinaḥ saṃskārābhāvāt svayaṃprakāśasya cedānīntanasvarūpavyatiriktapramāṇakāraṇābhāvācca na pratyabhijñākāraṇaṃ tāvadātmani sambhavati| na ca svarūpajñānameva pratyabhijñā;
analyzed: katham vijñāna svabhāvasya hi ātmanaḥ sthāyi tve svayam prakāśasya jñāna antara agamya tvāt tad vināśa saṃskāra abhāvāt svarūpasya ca avināśāt avināśinaḥ saṃskāra abhāvāt svayam prakāśasya ca idānīntana svarūpa vyatirikta pramāṇa kāraṇa abhāvāt ca na pratyabhijñā kāraṇam tāvat ātmani sambhavati na ca svarūpa jñānam eva pratyabhijñā

original: tasya pradīpaprabhāvat vartamānaprakāśinaḥ pūrvāparaparāmarśātmakatāyogāt; "so'hami"ti ca viṣayākārābhyupagame "saḥ" iti "ahami"ti ca ākārabhedena viṣayabhedāt jñānabhedasiddheḥ| tasmāt na ātmani pratyabhijñeti yuktyā vyāmohatva siddhiriti||
analyzed: tasya pradīpa prabhā vat vartamāna prakāśinaḥ pūrva apara parāmarśa ātmaka tā yogāt saḥ ham iti ca viṣaya ākāra abhyupagame saḥ iti aham iti ca ākāra bhedena viṣaya bhedāt jñāna bheda siddheḥ tasmāt na ātmani pratyabhijñā iti yuktyā vyāmoha tva siddhiḥ iti

original: atrocyate -- antaḥkaraṇaviviśiṣṭe tāvadātmani pratyabhijñānaṃ brūmaḥ, na niṣkalaṅkātmasvarūpamātre; tasya
analyzed: atrā ucyate antaḥkaraṇa vi viśiṣṭe tāvat ātmani pratyabhijñānam brūmaḥ na niṣkalaṅka ātma svarūpa mātre tasya

original: tatra cāntaḥkaraṇajanyāhaṃpratyayādhīnatvāt viśiṣṭātmābhivyakteḥ pūrvakālaviśiṣṭātmānubhavanimittāhaṃvṛttisaṃskārasahitamantaḥkaraṇameva idanīntanātmāvyaktinimittaṃ sat pūrvāparakālaviśiṣṭātmaviṣayaṃ pratyabhijñānamutpādayati||

original: nanu pūrvāparābhijñayoraviṣayatayā abhivyaktasyātmanaḥ kathaṃ pratyabhijñāviṣayatvaṃ iti| naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathā saṃvedanasya svasaṃviditarūpasyāpi kālāntare svasaṃskārajanitasmṛtiviṣayatvaṃ, tadvadihāpyabhijñāyāmaviṣayasyāpi pratyabhijñāviṣayatvaṃ na virudhyate||
analyzed: nanu pūrva apara abhijñayoḥ aviṣaya tayā abhivyaktasya ātmanaḥ katham pratyabhijñā viṣaya tvam iti na eṣa doṣaḥ yathā saṃvedanasya sva saṃvidita rūpasya api kāla antare sva saṃskāra janita smṛti viṣaya tvam tadvat iha api abhijñāyām aviṣayasya api pratyabhijñā viṣaya tvam na virudhyate

original: nanu svayaṃprakāśasya viṣayataivānupapannā, naivam; deśakālāntaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭatayā viṣayopapatteḥ| yathā dharmasyāgamaikasamadhigamyasyāpi idānīṃ phaladānāyonmukhībhāvādilakṣaṇadharmaviśiṣṭatayā vartamāna phalodayaliṅgādigamyatvaṃ, tadvat|

original: nanu ekasyaivātmanaḥ pratyabhijñāyāṃ kathaṃ kartṛkarmatayā yugapat viruddharūpadvayānvayaḥ nanu sarvavādināṃ dehavyatiriktādyanumānaviṣayatayā kartṛkarmabhāvaḥ saṃpratipannaḥ., tanna;

original: anumānādau viṣayasya kārakatābhāvāt ākāramātratayā viṣayatvāt tatra kartṛtaivātmanaḥ, na karmatā, pratyakṣe tu punaḥ viṣayasyāpi svaviṣayajñānajanakatayā karmakārakatvāt prāptaivātmano yugapadekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ viruddharūpadvayāpattiriti||
analyzed: anumāna ādau viṣayasya kāraka tā abhāvāt ākāra mātra tayā viṣaya tvāt tatra kartṛ tā eva ātmanaḥ na karma tā pratyakṣe tu punar viṣayasya api sva viṣaya jñāna janaka tayā karma kāraka tvāt prāptā eva ātmanaḥ yugapad ekasyām kriyāyām viruddha rūpa dvaya āpattiḥ iti

original: ucyate -- antaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭatayā ātmano jñātṛtvaṃ, pūrvāparakālaviśiṣṭatayā ca jñeyatvamityupādhibhedādavirodhaḥ iti| "so'hami"ti ca pratyabhijñāyāḥ svānubhavasiddhatvāt yathākathaṃcinnimittaṃ kalpayitavyam; vyavahārāvisaṃvādāt bhrāntitvāyogāt| na ca "so'hami"tyākārabhedādarthabhedena jñānabhedo yuktaḥ;
analyzed: ucyate antaḥkaraṇa viśiṣṭa tayā ātmanaḥ jñātṛ tvam pūrva apara kāla viśiṣṭa tayā ca jñeya tvam iti upādhi bhedāt avirodhaḥ iti saḥ ham iti ca pratyabhijñāyāḥ sva anubhava siddha tvāt yathā kathaṃcid nimittam kalpayitavyam vyavahāra avisaṃvādāt bhrānti tva ayogāt na ca saḥ ham iti ākāra bhedāt artha bhedena jñāna bhedaḥ yuktaḥ

original: vijñānaṃ kṣaṇikamityākārabhedenārthabhedāt vijñānasya kṣaṇikatābhāvaprasaṅgāt, satyam; vijñāne kṣaṇikatvādidharnoparāgo vikalpavyavahāramātram, na satyato'stīti cet, tathā sthāyitvādivyavahārāśca kālādidharmopādhitvādvijñāne vikalpavyavahārā ityaviśeṣaḥ|
analyzed: vijñānam kṣaṇikam iti ākāra bhedena artha bhedāt vijñānasya kṣaṇikatā bhāva prasaṅgāt satyam vijñāne kṣaṇikatva ādi dharna uparāgaḥ vikalpa vyavahāra mātram na ced tathā sthāyi tva ādi vyavahārāḥ ca kāla ādi dharma upādhi tvāt vijñāne vikalpa vyavahārāḥ iti aviśeṣaḥ

original: iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ -- sati kāle sthāyitvādivikalpapratyayāḥ "so'ham" ityādyanubhavasiddhā vyavahārāvisaṃvādino'rthakriyāsamarthāśca dṛśyante, na tathā kṣaṇikatvādivyavahārāḥ iti||
analyzed: iyān tu viśeṣaḥ sati kāle sthāyi tva ādi vikalpa pratyayāḥ saḥ ham ityādi anubhava siddhāḥ vyavahāra avisaṃvādinā ṛthakriyā samarthāḥ ca dṛśyante na tathā kṣaṇika tva ādi vyavahārāḥ iti

original: atra prābhākarā manyante -- naivaṃ pratyabhijñāyāṃ viṣayatvenāyamātmā sidhyati, kiṃ tu āśrayatveneti, tadayuktam; pūrvāparakālaviśiṣṭasya ātmanaḥ kṣaṇamātravṛttipratyabhijñānāśrayatvāyogāt tadāśrayatayā sthāyitvasiddhyabhāvāt|

original: nanu pūrvakālasaṃvedanamidānīmanusmaryamāṇaṃ svāśrayaṃ tadānīntanamātmānaṃ sādhayati, smṛtiśca svāśrayatayā idānīntanaṃ ātmānaṃ sādhayati, iti kāladvayaviśiṣṭātmasiddhiriti, naitat sāram;
analyzed: nanu pūrva kāla saṃvedanam idānīm anusmaryamāṇam sva āśrayam tadānīntanam ātmānam sādhayati smṛtiḥ ca sva āśraya tayā idānīntanam ātmānam sādhayati iti kāla dvaya viśiṣṭa ātma siddhiḥ iti na etat sāram

original: ekaikasya kāladvayavadātmāśrayatvābhāvāt, na ca saṃbhūya pūrvāparasaṃviddvayaṃ tadvantamātmānaṃ sādhayati ; anyonyasya anyonyasaṃvidviśiṣṭātmaśrayatvābhāvāt| atha saṃviddvayameva pūrvāparasaṃviddvayāśrayātmaikatvaviṣayasaṃvidantaramutpādayati, siddhaṃ tarhi pratyabhijñānamātmaviṣayam|
analyzed: ekaikasya kāla dvaya vat ātma āśraya tva abhāvāt na ca saṃbhūya pūrva apara saṃvid dvayam tadvantam ātmānam sādhayati anyonyasya anyonya saṃvid viśiṣṭa ātma śraya tva abhāvāt atha saṃvid dvayam eva pūrva apara saṃvid dvaya āśraya ātma eka tva viṣaya saṃvid antaram utpādayati siddham tarhi pratyabhijñānam ātma viṣayam

original: kiṃ ca "anubhūtaṃ maye"tyāśrayaviśiṣṭapūrvasaṃvidanusmṛteḥ svānubhavasiddhatvāt smaryamāṇatayaiva idānīṃ pūrvānubhūtātmasiddhiḥ, na pūrvasaṃvedanāśrayatayā; tasyāvidyamānasyedānīmasādhakatvāt| svayaṃprakāśamāne hi saṃvedanamātmāśrayaṃ sādhayati, na smṛtiviṣayatayā paraprakāśyam;
analyzed: kim ca anubhūtam mayā iti āśraya viśiṣṭa pūrva saṃvid anusmṛteḥ sva anubhava siddhatvāt smaryamāṇa tayā eva idānīm pūrva anubhūta ātma siddhiḥ na pūrva saṃvedana āśraya tayā tasya avidyamānasya idānīm asādhaka tvāt svayam prakāśamāne hi saṃvedanam ātma āśrayam sādhayati na smṛti viṣaya tayā para prakāśyam

original: anyathā dharmādīnāmapi paratassiddhānāṃ svāśrayātmasādhakatvaprasaṅgāt| tasmāt siddhamātmani pratyabhijñānamiti||
analyzed: anyathā dharma ādīnām api paratas siddhānām sva āśraya ātma sādhaka tva prasaṅgāt tasmāt siddham ātmani pratyabhijñānam iti

original: syāt tarhi anumānāt kṣaṇikatvamiti ghaṭādau sādhayati -- athānte kṣayadarśanāditi|| ghaṭasya vināśānantarapūrvakṣaṇaviśiṣṭasattvamanta ityucyate| tasya svasattākṣaṇāduttarakṣaṇe vināśo dṛṣṭaḥ| tatrāntyakṣaṇāvacchinnaghaṭasattvāt pūrvapūrvakṣaṇāvatthinnaghaṭasattvānyādirityucyante| tānyapi, svasattākṣaṇāduttarakṣaṇe vināśavyāptāni, ghaṭasattvāt;
analyzed: syāt tarhi anumānāt kṣaṇikatvam iti ghaṭa ādau sādhayati atha ante kṣaya darśanāt iti ghaṭasya vināśa anantara pūrva kṣaṇa viśiṣṭa sattvam antaḥ iti ucyate tasya sva sattā kṣaṇāt uttara kṣaṇe vināśaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tatra antya kṣaṇa avacchinna ghaṭa sattvāt pūrva pūrva kṣaṇa avatthinna ghaṭa sattvāni ādiḥ iti ucyante tāni api sva sattā kṣaṇāt uttara kṣaṇe vināśa vyāptāni ghaṭa sattvāt

original: antyakṣaṇāvacchinnaghaṭasattvavadityanumānam| tataśca sato'nantaraṃ vināśāt kṣaṇikatvasiddhiriti kṣaṇikeṣvaikyaṃ sādṛśyanibandhanamiti||
analyzed: antya kṣaṇa avacchinna ghaṭa sattva vat iti anumānam tatas ca sataḥ unantaram vināśāt kṣaṇika tva siddhiḥ iti kṣaṇikeṣu aikyam sādṛśya nibandhanam iti

original: tatra pratyanumānamāha -- ādau sattādarśanāditi|| ādiriti ghaṭasattāvacchedakāḥ kṣaṇāḥ ucyante| anta
analyzed: tatra pratyanumānam āha ādau sattā darśanāt iti ādiḥ iti ghaṭa sattā avacchedakāḥ kṣaṇāḥ ucyante anta

original: iti vināśāvacchekatvena abhimatāḥ kṣaṇāḥ| tatra antyakṣaṇāḥ sarve ghaṭasattayā vyāptā iti sādhyate| kālatvāt sattāvacchedakakālavaditi pratyanumānam| abhāvānubhavaviruddhamante sattānumānamiti codayati -- kṣayānubhaveti| tarhi antyakṣaṇāt pūrvakṣaṇāvacchinnaghaṭasattvānāmanantarakṣayānumānamapi pratyabhijñāviruddhamiti pariharati -- ihāpi iti|
analyzed: iti vināśa avaccheka tvena abhimatāḥ kṣaṇāḥ tatra antya kṣaṇāḥ sarve ghaṭa sattayā vyāptāḥ iti sādhyate kāla tvāt sattā avacchedaka kāla vat iti pratyanumānam abhāva anubhava viruddham ante sattā anumānam iti codayati kṣaya anubhava iti tarhi antya kṣaṇāt pūrva kṣaṇa avacchinna ghaṭa sattvānām anantara kṣaya anumānam api pratyabhijñā viruddham iti pariharati iha api iti

original: kṣayānubhavo'bhijñā anumānaṃ bādhate, na pratyabhijñā anumānāt durbaleti; netyāha -- na hyubhayoriti||
analyzed: kṣaya anubhava ubhijñā anumānam bādhate na pratyabhijñā anumānāt durbalā iti nā iti āha na hi ubhayoḥ iti

original: sarve bhāvāḥ, kṣaṇikāḥ, arthakriyākāritvāt, yadakṣaṇikaṃ na tadarthakriyākāri; yathā śaśaviṣāṇamityanumānāntaraṃ darśayituṃ sthāyino'rthakriyānupapattimāha -- atha manyeta yo'sau sthiratvenābhimata ityādinā||
analyzed: sarve bhāvāḥ kṣaṇikāḥ arthakriyā kāri tvāt yat akṣaṇikam na tat arthakriyā kāri yathā śaśa viṣāṇam iti anumāna antaram darśayitum sthāyinā ṛthakriyā anupapattim āha atha manyeta yaḥ asau sthira tvena abhimataḥ ityādinā

original: nanu sthirasyaiva nimittasaṃyogādanyathābhūtasya kriyāpūrvakaṃ kāryamutpādayituṃ sāmarthyaṃ, na kṣaṇikasyeti siddhāntī codayati -- kathamayoga iti|| itthamayoga ityādiḥ parihāraḥ| krameṇeti| anekāni sātatyena kuryādityarthaḥ| ekaṃ vā anekaṃ vā kāryaṃ sakṛt kṛtvoparamate ityāha -- yogapadyeneti| kramapakṣaṃ dūṣayati -- na tāvaditi|
analyzed: nanu sthirasya eva nimitta saṃyogāt anyathābhūtasya kriyā pūrvakam kāryam utpādayitum sāmarthyam na kṣaṇikasya iti siddhāntī codayati katham ayogaḥ iti ittham ayogaḥ ityādiḥ parihāraḥ krameṇa iti anekāni sātatyena kuryāt iti arthaḥ ekam vā anekam vā kāryam sakṛt kṛtvā uparamate iti āha yogapadyena iti krama pakṣam dūṣayati na tāvat iti

original: anekāni kāryāṇi kartuṃ samarthaścet, puṣkalakāraṇasya bhāvādekasya anekakāryadarśanācca sakṛdeva kuryāditi bhāvaḥ| dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayati -- nāpi yaugapadyeneti|| arthakriyākāritvalakṣaṇatvāt sattvasyeti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: anekāni kāryāṇi kartum samarthaḥ ced puṣkala kāraṇasya bhāvāt ekasya aneka kārya darśanāt ca sakṛt eva kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ dvitīyam pakṣam dūṣayati nā api yaugapadyena iti arthakriyā kāri tva lakṣaṇa tvāt sattvasya iti bhāvaḥ

original: ataḥ sakṛtkartuḥ kālāntare punaḥ kartṛtve nimittābhāvāt akartṛtve vā asattvāt sakṛdeva sattvamityupasaṃharati -- ato'rthakriyākāritvādeveti||
analyzed: atas sakṛt kartuḥ kāla antare punar kartṛ tve nimitta abhāvāt akartṛ tve vā asattvāt sakṛt eva sattvam iti upasaṃharati atas ṛthakriyā kāri tvāt eva iti

original: siddhāntī tu -- sthāyinaḥ sakṛdeva kāryaṃ kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃbhūtasyāpi na asattvaprāptiḥ; sattvasya arthakriyākāritvalakṣaṇatvābhāvādityupapādayati -- atha keyamityādinā|| tatrāha -- svaviṣayajñānajananamiti|| yuktaṃ bāhyārthānāmetādṛśaṃ sattvam, vijñānānāṃ tu svaviṣayavijñānājanakatvāt na sattvalakṣaṇamiti dūṣayati -- prāptaṃ tarhi sarvāsāmiti||
analyzed: siddhāntī tu sthāyinaḥ sakṛt eva kāryam kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃbhūtasya api na asattva prāptiḥ sattvasya arthakriyā kāri tva lakṣaṇa tva abhāvāt iti upapādayati atha kā iyam ityādinā tatra āha sva viṣaya jñāna jananam iti yuktam bāhya arthānām etādṛśam sattvam vijñānānām tu sva viṣaya vijñāna ajanaka tvāt na sattva lakṣaṇam iti dūṣayati prāptam tarhi sarvāsām iti

original: nanu ekasantānajñānānāmanyonyaviṣayaviṣayitā'bhāve'pi puruṣāntarajñānasya viṣayatayā puruṣāntarajñānaṃ janakamityarthakriyālābhaḥ saṃvidāmiti, netyāha -- na santānāntare'pīti| puruṣāntarajñānaṃ pratipuruṣāntarajñānasya apratyakṣatvādanumeyatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu eka santāna jñānānām anyonya viṣaya viṣayi tā bhāve pi puruṣa antara jñānasya viṣaya tayā puruṣa antara jñānam janakam iti artha kriyā lābhaḥ saṃvidām iti na iti āha na santāna antare api iti puruṣa antara jñānam prati puruṣa antara jñānasya apratyakṣa tvāt anumeya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: anumānajñānaviṣayatvāt tarhi santānāntarajñānasya santānāntarajñānaṃ janakamiti, netyāha -- anumāne'pīti|| pratyakṣamevārthajanyaṃ, nānumānādīti te matamityarthaḥ| nanu sarvaṃ saṃvedanajātaṃ sarvajñānasya viṣayatayā janakaṃ bhavati, tasya sarvaviṣayapratyakṣatvāt ityata āha -- na sārvajñe'pīti|| sākṣāditi||
analyzed: anumāna jñāna viṣaya tvāt tarhi santāna antara jñānasya santāna antara jñānam janakam iti na iti āha anumāne api iti pratyakṣam eva artha janyam na anumāna ādi iti te matam iti arthaḥ nanu sarvam saṃvedana jātam sarva jñānasya viṣaya tayā janakam bhavati tasya sarva viṣaya pratyakṣa tvāt iti atas āha na sārvajñepi iti sākṣāt iti

original: saha vijñānopaplavaiḥ avyavadhānena sarvajñajñānoparaktatayā; tadabhedenetyarthaḥ| tatra hetuḥ -- saṃsārasaṃvidekarūpatvaprasaṅgāditi|| saṃvidviṣayayorabhedopagamāt saṃsārikajñānaiḥ sopaplavaiḥ sarvajñajñānaṃ dūṣitaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu sarvopaplavoparaktamapi tatvajñānena bādhitattvāt na doṣamāvahati, na tāvat tadeva jñānaṃ svopaplavaṃ bādhate;
analyzed: saha vijñāna upaplavaiḥ avyavadhānena sarvajña jñāna uparakta tayā tad abhedena iti arthaḥ tatra hetuḥ saṃsāra saṃvid eka rūpa tva prasaṅgāt iti saṃvid viṣayayoḥ abheda upagamāt saṃsārika jñānaiḥ sa upaplavaiḥ sarvajña jñānam dūṣitam syāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu sarva upaplava uparaktam api tatva jñānena bādhita ttvāt na doṣam āvahati na tāvat tat eva jñānam sva upaplavam bādhate

original: prāptibādhayorekasmin kṣaṇe anupapatteḥ, jñānāntarasya tu na pūrvajñānopaplavo viṣayaḥ, yena tadanuvādena bādhaḥ syāt, viṣayatve ca bādhakajñāne'pyupaplavānāmabhedaḥ syāt| tarhi vinaivopaplavaiḥ sārvajñe jñāne vijñānānyuparajyante iti, netyāha -- atadrūpatve iti|| sarvajñasya laukikopaplavānavabhāsanādupadeśāyogaḥ iti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: prāpti bādhayoḥ ekasmin kṣaṇe anupapatteḥ jñāna antarasya tu na pūrva jñāna upaplavaḥ viṣayaḥ yena tad anuvādena bādhaḥ syāt viṣaya tve ca bādhaka jñāne api upaplavānām abhedaḥ syāt tarhi vinā eva upaplavaiḥ sārvajñe jñāne vijñānāni uparajyante iti na iti āha atadrūpa tve iti sarvajñasya laukika upaplava anavabhāsanāt upadeśa ayogaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: atha na svaviṣayajñānajananamarthakriyā, kiṃ tu sajātīyakṣaṇāntarotpādaḥ iti codayati -- atheti|| uttaramāha -- caramakṣaṇasyāsallakṣaṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- ahamiti saṃtānapatitāni vijñānāni sthāyitvānusandhānakalpanābhyāṃ rāgādidoṣaiḥ viṣayaiśca upaplutāni pūrvapūrvasajātīyaviṣayavijñānalakṣaṇasaṃskārebhyaḥ uttarottarāṇyutpadyante|
analyzed: atha na sva viṣaya jñāna jananam arthakriyā kim tu sajātīya kṣaṇa antara utpādaḥ iti codayati atha iti uttaram āha carama kṣaṇasya asat lakṣaṇa tva prasaṅgaḥ iti ayam arthaḥ aham iti saṃtāna patitāni vijñānāni sthāyi tva anusandhāna kalpanābhyām rāga ādi doṣaiḥ viṣayaiḥ ca upaplutāni pūrva pūrva sajātīya viṣaya vijñāna lakṣaṇa saṃskārebhyaḥ uttarottarāṇi utpadyante

original: tatra sarvamidaṃ kṣaṇikamiti bhāvanayā sthāyitvakalpanā nivartate; svalakṣaṇabhāvanayā dravyaguṇaśabdakarmaviśeṣaṇa viśeṣakalpana vinaśyati; duḥkhamiti bhāvanayā rāgādidoṣapravṛttisukhaduḥkhopaplavāḥ kṣīyante; śūnyamiti bhāvanayā viṣayopaplavavigamaḥ;
analyzed: tatra sarvam idam kṣaṇikam iti bhāvanayā sthāyi tva kalpanā nivartate sva lakṣaṇa bhāvanayā dravya guṇa śabda karma viśeṣaṇa viśeṣa kalpana vinaśyati duḥkham iti bhāvanayā rāga ādi doṣa pravṛtti sukha duḥkha upaplavāḥ kṣīyante śūnyam iti bhāvanayā viṣaya upaplava vigamaḥ

original: tataśca bhāvanābhedaiḥ caturbhiḥ caturvidhopaplave krameṇa mandīkṛte, bhāvanāprakarṣaparyantāt samanantarapratyayāt sarvopaplavavirahi vijñānamutpadyate, tat saṃsārasantānasya antyatvāt caramamiti tasya kāryāntarābhāvāt asattvaprasaṅgāt krameṇa sarvamasadeva pūrvaṃ syāditi|
analyzed: tatas ca bhāvanā bhedaiḥ caturbhiḥ caturvidha upaplave krameṇa mandīkṛte bhāvanā prakarṣa paryantāt samanantara pratyayāt sarva upaplava virahi vijñānam utpadyate tat saṃsāra santānasya antya tvāt caramam iti tasya kārya antara abhāvāt asattva prasaṅgāt krameṇa sarvam asat eva pūrvam syāt iti

original: nanu caramakṣaṇo'pi svasantānajñānāntarābhāve'pi sarvajñajñānaṃ viṣayatayā janayatīti, netyāha -- na ca sarvajñajñānajananeneti|| tulyasvabhāvayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāva eva ekasantānatā nāma, caramakṣaṇasārvajñajñānayoḥ viśuddhatayā tulyasvabhāvayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvādavicchinnaḥ santānaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| mā bhūt saṃtānavicchedaḥ iti,
analyzed: nanu carama kṣaṇaḥ api sva santāna jñāna antara abhāve pi sarvajña jñānam viṣaya tayā janayati iti na iti āha na ca sarvajña jñāna jananena iti tulya svabhāvayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva eka santāna tā nāma carama kṣaṇa sārvajña jñānayoḥ viśuddha tayā tulya svabhāvayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt avicchinnaḥ santānaḥ iti bhāvaḥ mā bhūt saṃtāna vicchedaḥ iti

original: netyāha -- muktyabhāvaprasaṅgāditi|| santānavicchedo hi muktirabhipreteti bhāvaḥ| atha sarvajñasantānasya tulyasantānasya tulyasvabhāvatayā janakatvāt tatsantānaikyameva muktiriti, tarhi viṣayatayā janakatvameva nāstītyāha -- na ca saṃvit saṃvido viṣayaḥ iti|| pratyakṣatvaṃ viṣayaśabdenocyate; puruṣāntarasaṃvedanasyānumeyatvāt|
analyzed: na iti āha mukti abhāva prasaṅgāt iti santāna vicchedaḥ hi muktiḥ abhipretā iti bhāvaḥ atha sarvajña santānasya tulya santānasya tulya svabhāva tayā janaka tvāt tad santāna aikyam eva muktiḥ iti tarhi viṣaya tayā janaka tvam eva na asti iti āha na ca saṃvid saṃvidaḥ viṣayaḥ iti pratyakṣa tvam viṣaya śabdena ucyate puruṣa antara saṃvedanasya anumeya tvāt

original: athavā pratyakṣasyaiva saṃvedanasya dehāntarasambandha evānumīyate iti sarvapramāṇāviṣayaḥ saṃviditi, athavā -- saṃvidātmanā bhedābhāvāditi ayamarthaḥ -- saṃvit saṃvidantarāt na saṃvidākāreṇa bhidyate; pratiyogino'saṃvittvaprasaṅgādekā saṃvit syāt| asaṃvidākāreṇa bhede'pi saṃvidekaiva syāditi na saṃvidāṃ viṣayaviṣayibhāvaḥ iti||
analyzed: athavā pratyakṣasya eva saṃvedanasya deha antara sambandhaḥ eva anumīyate iti sarva pramāṇa aviṣayaḥ saṃvid iti athavā saṃvid ātmanā bheda abhāvāt iti ayam arthaḥ saṃvid saṃvid antarāt na saṃvid ākāreṇa bhidyate pratiyoginoḥ saṃvid tva prasaṅgāt ekā saṃvid syāt a saṃvid ākāreṇa bhede pi saṃvid ekā eva syāt iti na saṃvidām viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ iti

original: kiṃ ceti|| arthakriyā nāma kāraṇasattve hetuḥ pratītinimittaṃ vā iti vikalpya, hetutve dūṣaṇamāha -- svakāraṇaniṣpannasyeti|| kāryāt prāgeva kāraṇasya niṣpannatvādityarthaḥ| na ca niṣpannamapyarthakriyātaḥ pūrvamasaditi śakyaṃ vaktum; śaśaviṣāṇatulyatvenākāraṇatvaprasaṅgāt| pratītipakṣe anavasthādūṣaṇamāha -- tatra tasyā anyataḥ iti||
analyzed: kim ca iti arthakriyā nāma kāraṇa sattve hetuḥ pratīti nimittam vā iti vikalpya hetu tve dūṣaṇam āha sva kāraṇa niṣpannasya iti kāryāt prāk eva kāraṇasya niṣpanna tvāt iti arthaḥ na ca niṣpannam api arthakriyātaḥ pūrvam asat iti śakyam vaktum śaśaviṣāṇa tulya tvena akāraṇa tva prasaṅgāt pratīti pakṣe anavasthā dūṣaṇam āha tatra tasyāḥ anyatas iti

original: nanu kāryamarthakriyā nāma, jñānāni ca pūrveṣāmuttarottarāṇi kāryāṇi svayaṃsiddhānīti na pratītyanavastheti codayati -- nanu svajñānārthakriyāyāḥ iti|| tarhi kāryakāraṇabhūtānāṃ jñānānāṃ svayaṃsiddhatvāt na arthakriyā sattāvagatinimittamityāha -- na tarhyarthakriyātaḥ iti||
analyzed: nanu kāryam arthakriyā nāma jñānāni ca pūrveṣām uttarottarāṇi kāryāṇi svayam siddhāni iti na prati iti anavasthā iti codayati nanu sva jñāna arthakriyāyāḥ iti tarhi kārya kāraṇa bhūtānām jñānānām svayam siddha tvāt na arthakriyā sattā avagati nimittam iti āha na tarhi arthakriyātaḥ iti

original: mā bhūt kāraṇabhūtaṃ jñānaṃ kāryabhūtajñānādhīnaprakāśaṃ svayaṃprabhatvāt, tathāpi svayaṃ svenaivāvabhāsate iti svayameva svasyārthakriyeti netyāha -- na hi svarūpameveti|| tasmāt na arthakriyākāritvalakṣaṇaṃ satvam, kiṃ tu svābhāvikamiti sakṛt kāryaṃ kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃ bhūtasyāpi sthāyinaḥ sattvaṃ na virudhyate iti||
analyzed: mā bhūt kāraṇa bhūtam jñānam kārya bhūta jñāna adhīna prakāśam svayaṃprabha tvāt tathā api svayam svena eva avabhāsate iti svayam eva svasya arthakriyā iti na iti āha na hi svarūpam eva iti tasmāt na arthakriyā kāri tva lakṣaṇam satvam kim tu svābhāvikam iti sakṛt kāryam kṛtvā tūṣṇīm bhūtasya api sthāyinaḥ sattvam na virudhyate iti

original: idānīṃ krameṇāpi kāryaṃ kṛtvā sattvaṃ na virudhyate ityāha -- yat punaḥ krameṇeti|| śaktasyāpi sahakārisannidhānaviśeṣakramāpekṣayā kāryakramo yujyate ityāha -- sthāyino'pīti|| śaktasya sahakārikāraṇāpekṣāmapalapati -- atha kāraṇasyeti|| gūḍhābhisandhiruttaramāha -- akāraṇasyāpi na tarāmiti||
analyzed: idānīm krameṇa api kāryam kṛtvā sattvam na virudhyate iti āha yat punar krameṇa iti śaktasya api sahakāri sannidhāna viśeṣa krama apekṣayā kārya kramaḥ yujyate iti āha sthāyinaḥ api iti śaktasya sahakāri kāraṇa apekṣām apalapati atha kāraṇasya iti gūḍha abhisandhiḥ uttaram āha akāraṇasya api na tarām iti

original: mā bhūt tarhi śaktasyāśaktasya ca sahakāryapekṣeti, tatrāha -- asahakāri viśvaṃ syāditi|| śaktasyaiva sahakāryapekṣayā kāryakaratvānubhavavirodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| aśaktā eva padārthāḥ sāmagrīlakṣaṇakāraṇotpattau parasparamapekṣante, iti nānubhavavirodha ityāśaṅkate -- athākāraṇaṃ kāraṇotpattya iti||
analyzed: mā bhūt tarhi śaktasya aśaktasya ca sahakāri apekṣā iti tatra āha asahakāri viśvam syāt iti śaktasya eva sahakāri apekṣayā kārya kara tva anubhava virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ aśaktāḥ eva padārthāḥ sāmagrī lakṣaṇa kāraṇa utpattau parasparam apekṣante iti na anubhava virodhaḥ iti āśaṅkate atha akāraṇam kāraṇa utpattyai iti

original: kāryaṃ pratyaśaktā api padārthāḥ sāmagrīkāraṇaṃ prati śaktā vā na veti vikalpayati -- ata tat kāraṇasyeti|| ubhayatra dūṣaṇaṃ -- kāraṇaṃ cediti|| atha nāpekṣā ityuktārtham||
analyzed: kāryam prati aśaktāḥ api padārthāḥ sāmagrī kāraṇam prati śaktāḥ vā na vā iti vikalpayati tat kāraṇasya iti ubhayatra dūṣaṇam kāraṇam ced iti atha na apekṣā iti ukta artham

original: nanu śaktāśaktayoḥ apekṣā'bhāve kathaṃ sahakāryanubhavaḥ kathyate nanuna kāryasyāpyasattvāviśeṣāt sarvasmājjanma kiṃ na syāt kāraṇasya vā viśeṣasambandhahīnasya sarvasya janakatā kiṃ na syāt ityavyavasthāyāṃ kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvamātraṃ tvayā vyavasthāpyate atha anvayavyatirekasāmarthyāt kāryakāraṇaniyamaḥ iti, sahakāriṇo'pi tathetyāha --
analyzed: nanu śakta aśaktayoḥ apekṣā abhāve katham sahakāri anubhavaḥ kathyate nanu na kāryasya api asattva aviśeṣāt sarvasmāt janma kim na syāt kāraṇasya vā viśeṣa sambandha hīnasya sarvasya janaka tā kim na syāt iti avyavasthāyām katham kārya kāraṇa bhāva mātram tvayā vyavasthāpyate atha anvaya vyatireka sāmarthyāt kārya kāraṇa niyamaḥ iti sahakāriṇaḥ api tathā iti āha

original: tasmādyathaiva hetoriti|| kva tarhi sahakāryupayogaḥ iti tatra matāntaramupanyasya pūrvavādinaṃ dūṣayati -- yastu manyate sahakārijanitaviśeṣa iti|| yaḥ sahakāriṇamapekṣate, sa svātmani viśeṣotpattau śakto vā na veti vikalpyāhetutve dūṣaṇamāha -- viśeṣotpattāviti|| na hyaśaktaṃ sahakārisahasrasannidhāne'pi kiṃcit kurvat dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt yathā eva hetoḥ iti kva tarhi sahakāri upayogaḥ iti tatra mata antaram upanyasya pūrvavādinam dūṣayati yaḥ tu manyate sahakāri janita viśeṣaḥ iti yaḥ sahakāriṇam apekṣate sa sva ātmani viśeṣa utpattau śaktaḥ vā na vā iti vikalpya ahetutve dūṣaṇam āha viśeṣa utpattau iti na hi aśaktam sahakāri sahasra sannidhāne api kiṃcid kurvat dṛṣṭam iti arthaḥ

original: hetutve dūṣaṇamāha -- atha heturiti|| tatra prathamaviśeṣasya viśeṣāntarāpekṣayā anavasthāprasaṅgadoṣaparihārāya kiṃcideva sahakāribhiḥ kāraṇe viśeṣo janyate kāryajananāya, kvacittu kāraṇe viśeṣajanmānapekṣameva sahakāribhiḥ kāryaṃ janyata ityavyavasthā svayameva darśayati -- atha mataṃ na sarvaṃ kāryamiti||
analyzed: hetu tve dūṣaṇam āha atha hetuḥ iti tatra prathama viśeṣasya viśeṣa antara apekṣayā anavasthā prasaṅga doṣa parihārāya kiṃcid eva sahakāribhiḥ kāraṇe viśeṣaḥ janyate kārya jananāya kvacid tu kāraṇe viśeṣa janma anapekṣam eva sahakāribhiḥ kāryam janyate iti avyavasthā svayam eva darśayati atha matam na sarvam kāryam iti

original: tāvatyevābhavat-ucchūnatāviśeṣe satyevetyarthaḥ| tarhi śaktimatā kāraṇena svātmanyanupakurvannapi sahakāryapekṣyate iti tvayaiva svapakṣo nirastaḥ iti pariharati -- anupakurvannapi tarhīti|| āha sākṣād kṣaṇikavādī -- nānukurvanniti|| sarvasya sahakāritvapa3saṅgādityarthaḥ| kva tarhyupakaroti tadāha -- svarūpe tu nopakarotīti||
analyzed: tāvati sati eva iti arthaḥ tarhi śaktimatā kāraṇena sva ātmani anupakurvan api sahakārī apekṣyate iti tvayā eva sva pakṣaḥ nirastaḥ iti pariharati anupakurvan api tarhi iti āha sākṣāt kṣaṇika vādī na anukurvan iti sarvasya sahakāri tva pasaṅgāt iti arthaḥ kva tarhi upakaroti tat āha svarūpe tu na upakaroti iti

original: kāryaṃ hi sahakāriṇā jāyamānamupakriyata ityarthaḥ| tarhi kṣaṇikasyeva kāryasyopakārāya na virudhyata iti pariharati -- nityo'pi tarhyanādheyātiśaya iti|| tadeva prapañcayati -- yathaiva kṣaṇiko bhāva iti|| sāmagrīsādhyatvāditi|| bahukārakavyāpārasādhyatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: kāryam hi sahakāriṇā jāyamānam upakriyate iti arthaḥ tarhi kṣaṇikasya iva kāryasya upakārāya na virudhyate iti pariharati nityaḥ api tarhi anādheya atiśayaḥ iti tat eva prapañcayati yathā eva kṣaṇikaḥ bhāvaḥ iti sāmagrī sādhya tvāt iti bahu kāraka vyāpāra sādhya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: punaścopakāryamevopakārakaṃ sahakāriṇamapekṣate, nānupakāryaṃ bhavati tadapekṣata iti sambandhaḥ| nitye'pi tarhi kāraṇe kāryamevopakārakaṃ sahakāriṇamapekṣite nānupakāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ityāśaṅkate -- atha
analyzed: punar ca upakāryam eva upakārakam sahakāriṇam apekṣate na anupakāryam bhavati tat apekṣate iti sambandhaḥ nitye api tarhi kāraṇe kāryam eva upakārakam sahakāriṇam apekṣite na anupakāryam kāraṇam iti āśaṅkate atha

original: mataṃ kṣaṇiko'pi naivāpekṣata iti|| yadanyasaṃnidhau bhavati, tadapekṣata iti sambandhaḥ| nitye'pi tarhi kāraṇe kāryameva sahakāriṇamapekṣya krameṇa bhaviṣyatīti; netyāha -- nityasya tu janakasyeti|| sahakāriṇāṃ kāraṇasya ca sarvadā bhāvāt sarvadā kāryajananādityarthaḥ| nanu sahakāriṇāmapi saṃnidhānamapekṣata iti; netyāha -- ko heturiti||
analyzed: matam kṣaṇikaḥ api na eva apekṣate iti yat anya saṃnidhau bhavati tat apekṣate iti sambandhaḥ nitye api tarhi kāraṇe kāryam eva sahakāriṇam apekṣya krameṇa bhaviṣyati iti na iti āha nityasya tu janakasya iti sahakāriṇām kāraṇasya ca sarvadā bhāvāt sarvadā kārya jananāt iti arthaḥ nanu sahakāriṇām api saṃnidhānam apekṣate iti na iti āha kaḥ hetuḥ iti

original: kāraṇasahakāriṇorapi sambandhaḥ kāryaṃ cet, so'pi kāraṇasahakāribhyāṃ sadā bhavatīti kāryajanma sadā bhavedityarthaḥ| nanu kṣaṇikādapi sahakārisavyapekṣāt kimiti sadā kāryaṃ na jāyate viśeṣavati sattākṣaṇe kāryajanmābhāvāt, pūrvottarakālayoḥ viśeṣābhāvāditi , tatrāha -- kṣaṇikastu yo janaka iti||
analyzed: kāraṇa sahakāriṇoḥ api sambandhaḥ kāryam ced saḥ upi kāraṇa sahakāribhyām sadā bhavati iti kārya janma sadā bhavet iti arthaḥ nanu kṣaṇikāt api sahakāri savyapekṣāt kim iti sadā kāryam na jāyate viśeṣavati sattā kṣaṇe kārya janma abhāvāt pūrva uttara kālayoḥ viśeṣa abhāvāt iti tatra āha kṣaṇikaḥ tu yaḥ janakaḥ iti

original: idamayuktaṃ vartata iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- na tāvadagnisvalakṣaṇasyaiva dhūmasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati kāraṇatvamavagantuṃ śakyam; kṣaṇamātrāpavargiṇoranvayavyatirekabuddhidvayakālāvasthānāyogāt, kiṃ tu agnidhūmasantānayoranvayavyatirekābhyāmagnisvalakṣaṇāni dhūmasvalakṣaṇānāṃ kāraṇānīti sāmānyopādhau pramātavyam|
analyzed: idam ayuktam vartate iti ayam arthaḥ na tāvat agni sva lakṣaṇasya eva dhūma sva lakṣaṇam prati kāraṇatvam avagantum śakyam kṣaṇa mātra apavargiṇoḥ anvaya vyatireka buddhi dvaya kāla avasthāna ayogāt kim tu agni dhūma santānayoḥ anvaya vyatirekābhyām agni sva lakṣaṇāni dhūma sva lakṣaṇānām kāraṇāni iti sāmānya upādhau pramātavyam

original: tatra agnisvalakṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣābhāvādaṅgāragatādapyagnisvalakṣaṇāt dhūmajanma kiṃ na syāt kāṣṭhasvalakṣaṇābhāvāditi cet, na; tasyāpi svasaṃtāne vidyamānatvāt| agnikāṣṭhasvalakṣaṇasaṃsargāpekṣā vidyata iti cet, na; santānadvayanityatve tannimittasaṃnidhānasyāpi sadā prasaṅgāt, tatrāpyanyāpekṣeti cet, ihāpi|
analyzed: tatra agni sva lakṣaṇānām viśeṣa abhāvāt aṅgāra gatāt api agni sva lakṣaṇāt dhūma janma kim na syāt kāṣṭha sva lakṣaṇa abhāvāt iti ced na tasya api sva saṃtāne vidyamāna tvāt agni kāṣṭha sva lakṣaṇa saṃsarga apekṣā vidyate iti ced na santāna dvaya nitya tve tad nimitta saṃnidhānasya api sadā prasaṅgāt tatra api anya apekṣā iti ced iha api

original: nitye'pisahakārisaṃnidhānasya kadācidbhāvānnityavatkāryajananaprasaṅgo na yukto vartata iti| nanu sahakārisannidhānādeva kāryodayaniyame'pi dhūmakāṣṭhasantānayoḥ na upakāryopakārakasambandhaḥ ityāha -- kimatrāyuktamiti| pariharati -- sati niyama iti|| sahakāriṇāṃ kāryeṇānvayavyatirekaniyame'pi nopakāryopakārakasambandha ityuktirviruddhetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: nitye pi sahakāri saṃnidhānasya kadācid bhāvāt nitya vat kārya janana prasaṅgaḥ na yuktaḥ vartate iti nanu sahakāri sannidhānāt eva kārya udaya niyame api dhūma kāṣṭha santānayoḥ na upakārya upakāraka sambandhaḥ iti āha kim atra ayuktam iti pariharati sati niyame iti sahakāriṇām kāryeṇa anvaya vyatireka niyame api na upakārya upakāraka sambandhaḥ iti uktiḥ viruddhā iti arthaḥ

original: nanu anvayavyatirekaniyamasya upakāryopakārakasambandhavyāptiḥ kva dṛṣṭā iti ; dṛṣṭā kāryakāraṇayoḥ ityāha -- tathā hi yaḥ kaściditi|| upakāryopakārakasambandhābhāve jaladhūmayoriva anvayavyatirekaniyamānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: nanu anvaya vyatireka niyamasya upakārya   sambandha vyāptiḥ kva dṛṣṭā iti dṛṣṭā kārya kāraṇayoḥ iti āha tathā hi yaḥ kaścid iti upakārya   sambandha abhāve jala dhūmayoḥ iva anvaya vyatireka niyama anupapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu yayoreva agnidhūmasvalakṣaṇayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ, tatraiva anvayavyatirekaniyamaḥ, na agnidhūmasantānayoḥ; yena aviśeṣāt sarvavahnisvalakṣaṇeṣu dhūmavasvalakṣaṇakāraṇeṣu kāṣṭhasaṃyogāsaṃyogābhyāṃ dhūmabhāvābhāvadarśanena sahakārikāraṇeṣu anvayavyatirekaniyamo'pekṣālakṣaṇopakāryopakārakalasambandhaśca syāt|
analyzed: nanu yayoḥ eva agni dhūma sva lakṣaṇayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tatra eva anvaya vyatireka niyamaḥ na agni dhūma santānayoḥ yena aviśeṣāt sarva vahni sva lakṣaṇeṣu dhūma vasu alakṣaṇa kāraṇeṣu kāṣṭha saṃyoga asaṃyogābhyām dhūma bhāva abhāva darśanena sahakāri kāraṇeṣu anvaya vyatireka niyama upekṣā lakṣaṇa upakārya upakāra kala sambandhaḥ ca syāt

original: tasmāt na kāryakāraṇasvalakṣaṇādanyatra sāmānyopādhau kāryakāraṇayogyatāprāptiriti, tatrāha -- evaṃ hi kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddhirityādinā|| sāmānyopādhau hi vyavahāro dṛśyata iti bhāvaḥ| astu sāmānyopādhau janyajanakayogyatāniyamaḥ, tataḥ kim iti; tatrāha -- tatra yadi na kṣaṇikaṃ kāraṇamiti||
analyzed: tasmāt na kārya kāraṇa sva lakṣaṇāt anyatra sāmānya upādhau kārya kāraṇa yogyatā prāptiḥ iti tatra āha evam hi kārya kāraṇa bhāva siddhiḥ ityādinā sāmānya upādhau hi vyavahāraḥ dṛśyate iti bhāvaḥ astu sāmānya upādhau janya janaka yogyatā niyamaḥ tatas kim iti tatra āha tatra yadi na kṣaṇikam kāraṇam iti

original: tadeva sādhayati -- tathā hi hetuparamparāpratibandhāditi|| kāraṇasya svayaṃ śaktatvādityarthaḥ| nāpi kāryaṃ sahakāriṇamapekṣate iti|| kāraṇādeva jananādityarthaḥ| nanu vahnisvalakṣaṇāt dhūmajanmani kāṣṭhasaṃsargasyāpi saṃnidhānāt tadapi sahakāri kalpyata iti, tanna;
analyzed: tat eva sādhayati tathā hi hetu paramparā pratibandhāt iti kāraṇasya svayam śakta tvāt iti arthaḥ na api kāryam sahakāriṇam apekṣate iti kāraṇāt eva jananāt iti arthaḥ nanu vahni sva lakṣaṇāt dhūma janmani kāṣṭha saṃsargasya api saṃnidhānāt tat api sahakāri kalpyate iti tat na

original: prāgapi hi kṛśānusvalakṣaṇasya dhūmajananayogyasya kāṣṭhasaṃsargābhāvāt tadahetutvalakṣaṇasya vyatirekasya darśanamantareṇānvayamātrāt na sahakāritvasiddhirityāha -- kākatālīyamucyata iti|| tarhi mā bhūt sahakāryapekṣeti ; kāraṇamapi mā bhūdityāha -- tathā ca kāryakāraṇavyavahārā iti||
analyzed: prāk api hi kṛśānu sva lakṣaṇasya dhūma janana yogyasya kāṣṭha saṃsarga abhāvāt tad ahetu tva lakṣaṇasya vyatirekasya darśanam antareṇa anvaya mātrāt na sahakāri tva siddhiḥ iti āha kākatālīyam ucyate iti tarhi mā bhūt sahakāri apekṣā iti kāraṇam api mā bhūt iti āha tathā ca kārya kāraṇa vyavahārāḥ iti

original: tasmāt kṣaṇikanityayoḥ sahakārisannidhānakramasyāviśeṣāt kāraṇatvamaviśiṣṭamityupasaṃharati -- tasmāt kṣaṇikasyāpīti|| ayamarthaḥ -- yathaikasmādagnisvalakṣaṇāt samānadeśe vahniḥ, upariṣṭāt dhūmaḥ, adhastādbhasma puruṣe vijñānamiti sahakāribheda ekasmādanekāni kāryāṇyutpadyante tathaikasmāt kāraṇāt kālabhedena sahakāribhedāt kāryabhedā iti||
analyzed: tasmāt kṣaṇika nityayoḥ sahakāri sannidhāna kramasya aviśeṣāt kāraṇa tvam aviśiṣṭam iti upasaṃharati tasmāt kṣaṇikasya api iti ayam arthaḥ yathā ekasmāt agni sva lakṣaṇāt samāna deśe vahniḥ upariṣṭāt dhūmaḥ adhastāt bhasma puruṣe vijñānam iti sahakāri bhedaḥ ekasmāt anekāni kāryāṇi utpadyante tathā ekasmāt kāraṇāt kāla bhedena sahakāri bhedāt kārya bhedāḥ iti

analyzed: na kevalam avidyā anvaya vyatireka sāmarthyāt avidyā upādānatayā avidyā tvam kiṃtu vidyā viparīta tvāt ca iti āha tad vivekena iti nanu avidyām upavarṇya tasyāḥ jñāna nivartya tva pradarśanena adhyāsa nivṛtti siddheḥ kim adhyāsa upavarṇanena iti codayati yadi evam adhyāsaḥ iti prakramya iti

original: puruṣākāṅkṣāyā anarthanivṛttiviṣayatvādanarthasyaivāvidyātvena jñānanivartyatvaṃ vaktavyamiti pariharati -- naitat sāramiti|| anarthasyaivāvidyātmakatve tadāśraye viṣaye vā vastutaḥ tannimittaguṇadoṣābhāvāt jñānena sarvānarthanivṛttiḥ phaliṣyati ; tatphalavacanamuttarabhāṣyamityāha -- tadetadāha yatra yadadhyāsa iti||
analyzed: puruṣa ākāṅkṣāyāḥ anartha nivṛtti viṣaya tvāt anarthasya eva avidyā tvena jñāna nivartya tvam vaktavyam iti pariharati na etat sāram iti anarthasya eva avidyā ātmaka tve tad āśraye viṣaye vā vastutas tad nimitta guṇa doṣa abhāvāt jñānena sarva anartha nivṛttiḥ phaliṣyati tad phala vacanam uttara bhāṣyam iti āha tat etat āha yatra yad adhyāsaḥ iti

original: avidyādhyāsaviṣayatvaprayuktastāvat guṇadoṣābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ|| atrādhyāsapariṇāmitayā āśrayatvaprayuktadoṣaguṇābhāvaḥ kathyate| katham anādyavidyādhyāsasya nityacaitanyāvabhāsatvāt na tatrādhyāsapariṇāmaḥ| kādācitkādhyāsapariṇāmasyāvidyopādānatvādavidyāsaṃbhedādātmāśrayatvādisiddhiriti|
analyzed: avidyā adhyāsa viṣaya tva prayuktaḥ tāvat guṇa doṣa abhāvaḥ siddhaḥ atra adhyāsa pariṇāmi tayā āśraya tva prayukta doṣa guṇa abhāvaḥ kathyate katham anādya vidyā adhyāsasya nitya caitanya avabhāsa tvāt na tatra adhyāsa pariṇāmaḥ kādācitka adhyāsa pariṇāmasya avidyā upādāna tvāt avidyā saṃbhedāt ātma āśraya tva ādi siddhiḥ iti

original: pratijñeti sūtrakārasya -- jñānena bandhanivṛtterarthāt sūtraṇamucyate||
analyzed: pratijñā iti sūtrakārasya jñānena bandha nivṛtteḥ arthāt sūtraṇam ucyate

original: vṛttasaṃkīrtanapūrvakamuttarabhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- evaṃ tāvadyuṣmadasmadityādineti|| atra ca pramātṛpramāṇaprameyakartṛkarmakāryabhoktṛbhogabhogyatvalakṣaṇasya vyavahāratrayasya śarīrendriyādiṣvahaṃmamādhyāsapurassaratvaṃ pratyakṣamiti pratyakṣopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ| nanu "vidhipratiṣedhaparāṇi śāstrāṇī"tyeva vaktavyaṃ, tanniṣṭhatvāt sakalaśāstrasya;
analyzed: vṛtta saṃkīrtana pūrvakam uttara bhāṣyasya tātparyam āha evam tāvat yuṣmat asmat ityādinā iti atra ca pramātṛ pramāṇa prameya kartṛ karma kārya bhoktṛ bhoga bhogya tva lakṣaṇasya vyavahāra trayasya śarīra indriya ādiṣu aham mama adhyāsa purassara tvam pratyakṣam iti pratyakṣa upanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ nanu vidhi pratiṣedha parāṇi śāstrāṇi iti eva vaktavyam tad niṣṭha tvāt sakala śāstrasya

original: kimidaṃ mokṣaparāṇīti tatrāha -- mokṣaparatvaṃ ceti|| "kathaṃ punari"tyādibhāṣyasyādhyāsopādānaṃ vyavahāratritayamityatra pramāṇāntarapraśnaviṣayatvaṃ darśayati -- bāḍhamuktalakṣaṇā avidyetyādinā|| "kathaṃ punari"tyākṣepārthaṃ darśayati -- pramātāramāśrayantīti||
analyzed: kim idam mokṣa parāṇi iti tatra āha mokṣa para tvam ca iti katham punar ityādi bhāṣyasya adhyāsa upādānam vyavahāra tritayam iti atra pramāṇa antara praśna viṣayatvam darśayati bāḍham ukta lakṣaṇā avidyā ityādinā katham punar iti ākṣepa artham darśayati pramātāram āśrayanti iti

original: avidyādhyāsapariniṣpannāhaṃkārātmasaṃpiṇḍitopādānatve pramāṇānāṃ prāmāṇyameva na siddhyatītyasminnarthe bhāṣyaṃ yojayati -- athavā kathamavidyāvadviṣayāṇīti|| avidyāvadupādānatve kā prāmāṇyānupapattiriti tadāha -- avidyāvadviṣayatve iti|| "ucyate -- dehendriyādi"ṣvityādiparihārabhāṣyaṃ avatārayati -- vastusaṃgrahavākyam, asyaiva prapañca iti||
analyzed: avidyā adhyāsa pariniṣpanna ahaṃkāra ātma saṃpiṇḍita upādāna tve pramāṇānām prāmāṇyam eva na siddhi ati iti asmin arthe bhāṣyam yojayati athavā katham avidyāvat viṣayāṇi iti avidyāvat upādāna tve kā prāmāṇya anupapattiḥ iti tat āha avidyāvat viṣaya tve iti ucyate deha indriya ādiṣu ityādi parihāra bhāṣyam avatārayati vastu saṃgraha vākyam asya eva prapañcaḥ iti

original: vyavahāratritayamadhyāsopādānamityatrārthāpattivyatirekyanumānapradarśanāya| yatra yatrādhyāsābhāvaḥ saṃpatipannastatra vyavahārābhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ iti vyatirekavyāptibhāṣyārthaṃ darśayati -- na hi dehendriyādiṣviti|| dehādiśabdārthaṃ vibhāgenādhyāsaṃ ca kathayati -- yato dehe'hamabhimāna ityādinā||
analyzed: vyavahāra tritayam adhyāsa upādānam iti atra arthāpatti vyatireki anumāna pradarśanāya yatra yatra adhyāsa abhāvaḥ saṃpatipannaḥ tatra vyavahāra abhāvaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti vyatireka vyāpti bhāṣya artham darśayati na hi deha indriya ādiṣu iti deha ādi śabda artham vibhāgena adhyāsam ca kathayati yatas deha iham abhimānaḥ ityādinā

original: pramaṇāntarapradarśanāya vyavahāratrayamūlādhyāse pratyakṣamuktamanuvadati -- sarvo hi manuṣyo'hamiti|| atrāyaṃ prayogaḥ -- devadattasya jāgratsvapnakālau, tasyaiva kartuḥ karaṇabhūtadehendriyādiṣvahaṃmamādhyāsapurassarapramātṛtvādivvayahāravantau, tasyaiva suṣuptikālādanyakālatvāt, yaḥ kālastathāvidhavyavahāravān na bhavati, na sa tasyaiva
analyzed: pramaṇa antara pradarśanāya vyavahāra traya mūla adhyāse pratyakṣam uktam anuvadati sarvaḥ hi manuṣyaḥ ham iti atra ayam prayogaḥ devadattasya jāgrat svapna kālau tasya eva kartuḥ karaṇa bhūta deha indriya ādiṣu aham mama adhyāsa purassara pramātṛ tva ādi vvayahāravantau tasya eva suṣupti kālāt anya kāla tvāt yaḥ kālaḥ tathāvidha vyavahāravān na bhavati na sa tasya eva

original: suṣuptikālādanyakālaḥ, yathā tasyaiva suṣuptikālaḥ iti|
analyzed: suṣupti kālāt anya kālaḥ yathā tasya eva suṣupti kālaḥ iti

original: vyavahāratritayaṃ vā darśitādhyāsopādānamantareṇānupapannaṃ; adhyāsābhāve vyavahārādarśanāt suṣupte, ityarthāpattiḥ||
analyzed: vyavahāra tritayam vā darśita adhyāsa upādānam antareṇa anupapannam adhyāsa abhāve vyavahāra adarśanāt suṣupte iti arthāpattiḥ

original: nanu kartṛkaraṇayoḥ saṃbandhamātraṃ vyavahāre apekṣyate, na tādātmyasaṃbandhaḥ, iti tatra pariśeṣānumānārthāpattidvaye saṃbandhāntarāṇi vyāvartayan na tāvatsvasvāmisaṃbandhaḥ ityāha -- na svatvena saṃbandhineti|| suṣupte'pi tasya bhāvāt ityabhyuccayaḥ| icchānuvidhāyitvameva vyavahāranimittaṃ;
analyzed: nanu kartṛ karaṇayoḥ saṃbandha mātram vyavahāre apekṣyate na tādātmya saṃbandhaḥ iti tatra pariśeṣa anumāna arthāpatti dvaye saṃbandha antarāṇi vyāvartayan na tāvat sva svāmi saṃbandhaḥ iti āha na svatvena saṃbandhinā iti suṣupte api tasya bhāvāt iti abhyuccayaḥ icchā anuvidhāyi tvam eva vyavahāra nimittam

original: tadabhāvāt suṣupte vyavahāraviparyayaḥ, iti codayati -- apara āha ātmecchānuvidhāyitvamiti|| astvicchāmātreṇa viniyojyaviniyojakasaṃbandhaḥ, tataḥ kimiti tatrāha -- tata ātmana iti|| nanvetatsaṃbandhamūlo vyavahāra iti kimatra pramāṇamiti ata āha -- tathācottiṣṭhāmīti|| nanu bhṛtyādayo'pi tadicchānuvidhāyinaḥ, taccharīreṇāpi vyavahāraḥ syāditi ;
analyzed: tad abhāvāt suṣupte vyavahāra viparyayaḥ iti codayati aparaḥ āha ātma icchā anuvidhāyi tvam iti astu icchā mātreṇa viniyojya viniyojaka saṃbandhaḥ tatas kim iti tatra āha tatas ātmanaḥ iti nanu etad saṃbandha mūlaḥ vyavahāraḥ iti kim atra pramāṇam iti atas āha tathā ca uttiṣṭhāmi iti nanu bhṛtya ādayaḥ api tad icchā anuvidhāyinaḥ tad śarīreṇa api vyavahāraḥ syāt iti

original: netyāha -- na ca bhṛtyādiṣu tadastīti|| ucyate -- yadīcchānuvidhānayogyatāmātraṃ saṃbandhaḥ, suṣupte'pi tadastīti tatrāpi vyavahāraḥ syāt| athecchayā anuvidhīyamānatvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ, atyāture tadabhāvāt pramātṛtvādivyavahāro na syāt| atha dṛśyate ayaṃ saṃbandho vyavahāramūlamiti, netyāha -- naitat saṃvidi bahumānavato yuktamiti||
analyzed: na iti āha na ca bhṛtya ādiṣu tat asti iti ucyate yadi icchā anuvidhāna yogyatā mātram saṃbandhaḥ suṣupte api tat asti iti tatra api vyavahāraḥ syāt atha icchayā anuvidhīyamāna tvam saṃbandhaḥ atyāture tad abhāvāt pramātṛ tva ādi vyavahāraḥ na syāt atha dṛśyate ayam saṃbandhaḥ vyavahāra mūlam iti na iti āha na etat saṃvidi bahu mānavataḥ yuktam iti

original: na ca gauṇatvam, mukhyānubhavavirodhādityāha -- gauṇītyādinā|| icchāpyadhyāsamūlaivetyāha -- api cecchā'pi pariṇāmaviśeṣa iti|| antaḥkaraṇādhyāsamūlaivecchetyāha -- api cecchā'pi pariṇāmaviśeṣa iti|| antaḥkaraṇādhyāsamūlaivetyatra pratyakṣamāha -- tathā cānubhava iti|| nacātmānātmanoḥ saṃyogasamavāyau vyavahāranimittam; suṣupte'pi bhāvāt;
analyzed: na ca gauṇa tvam mukhya anubhava virodhāt iti āha gauṇī ityādinā icchā api adhyāsa mūlā eva iti āha api ca icchā api pariṇāma viśeṣaḥ iti antaḥkaraṇa adhyāsa mūlā eva icchā iti āha api ca icchā api pariṇāma viśeṣaḥ iti antaḥkaraṇa adhyāsa mūlā eva icchā iti āha api ca icchā api pariṇāma viśeṣaḥ iti antaḥkaraṇa adhyāsa mūlā eva iti atra pratyakṣam āha tathā ca anubhavaḥ iti na ca ātma anātmanoḥ saṃyoga samavāyau vyavahāra nimitta

original: bhoktṛbhogyānvayasvakarmārabhyatvasvendriyādhiṣṭheyatvādīnāṃ bhogādyadhyāsāpekṣatvāt, bhṛtyādiśarīre ca bhāvāt| avyavadhānena bhogyatvaṃ mūlasaṃbandha iti cet yadi bhogayogyatā saṃbandhaḥ, suṣupte'pyasti; yadyavyavadhānena bhujyamānatvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ, tanna; ātmanaḥ sarvaśarīradeśakālāvyavadhāne satyatraiva bhogānvayasya mūlasaṃbandhānveṣaṇāt|
analyzed: bhoktṛ bhogya anvaya sva karma ārabhya tva sva indriya adhiṣṭheya tva ādīnām bhoga ādi adhyāsa apekṣa tvāt bhṛtya ādi śarīre ca bhāvāt avyavadhānena bhogyatvam mūla saṃbandhaḥ iti ced yadi bhoga yogyatā saṃbandhaḥ suṣupte api asti yadi avyavadhānena bhujyamāna tvam saṃbandhaḥ tat na ātmanaḥ sarva śarīra deśa kāla avyavadhāne sati atra eva bhoga anvayasya mūla saṃbandha anveṣaṇāt

original: tasmāt yatkiṃcidetat saṃbandhāntaram| ataḥ pariśeṣādarthāpattyanumānābhyāmadhyāsa eva vyavahāramūlaṃ siddha ityupasaṃharati -- ataḥ svayamasaṅgasyāpīti||
analyzed: tasmāt yat kiṃcid etat saṃbandha antaram atas pariśeṣāt arthāpatti anumānābhyām adhyāsaḥ eva vyavahāra mūlam siddhaḥ iti upasaṃharati atas svayam asaṅgasya api iti

original: nanu sarvaśarīrasaṃnidhānāviśeṣe sati ātmanaḥ kathamasminneva śarīre adhyāsaniyama iti anādistāvadavidyādhyāsaḥ| tatpariṇāmatvālliṅgaśarīre, tatkāryabhūtasūkṣmaśarīrārabdhatvāt tatsaṃśleṣādvā sthūlaśarīre adhyāsaniyamo na virudhyate| nanu pramātaiva vyavahārāśrayo nādhyāsaḥ iti, na; pramātṛtvamevādhyāsapariniṣpannamityāha -- tena yadyapīti||
analyzed: nanu sarva śarīra saṃnidhāna aviśeṣe sati ātmanaḥ katham asmin eva śarīre adhyāsa niyamaḥ iti anādiḥ tāvat avidyā adhyāsaḥ tad pariṇāma tvāt liṅga śarīre tad kārya bhūta sūkṣmaśarīra ārabdha tvāt tad saṃśleṣāt vā sthūlaśarīre adhyāsa niyamaḥ na virudhyate nanu pramātā eva vyavahāra āśrayaḥ na adhyāsaḥ iti na pramātṛ tvam eva adhyāsa pariniṣpannam iti āha tena yadi api iti

original: yattu adhyāsapariniṣpannāhaṃkārātmasaṃpiṇḍitopādānatve kāraṇadoṣādaprāmāṇyaṃ pramāṇānāmiti, tatra yadi pratipannopādhau kenāpi pramāṇenābādhyatvalakṣaṇatattvāvedanaprāmāṇyahānirucyate, tadaṅgīkṛtameva|
analyzed: yat tu adhyāsa pariniṣpanna ahaṃkāra ātma saṃpiṇḍita upādāna tve kāraṇa doṣāt aprāmāṇyam pramāṇānām iti tatra yadi pratipanna upādhau kena api pramāṇena abādhya tva lakṣaṇa tattva āvedana prāmāṇya hāniḥ ucyate tat aṅgīkṛtam eva

original: athāgamena paramārthasatyatvāṃśe bādhyamāne vyavahārasamarthavastvaṅgatāprāmāṇyahānirucyate, na -- tatra bādhābhāvādityāha -- tathā nirapekṣāṇāmiti|| vidhimukhopadarśitamiti| vyavahārāṅgatāyāṃ pratyakṣeṇa adhyāsamūlatāyāṃ pratyakṣānumānārthāpattibhiḥ pradarśitamubhayamityarthaḥ| arthakriyāsamarthatvācca|
analyzed: atha āgamena paramārtha satya tva aṃśe bādhyamāne vyavahāra samartha vastu aṅgatā prāmāṇya hāniḥ ucyate na tatra bādhā abhāvāt iti āha tathā nirapekṣāṇām iti vidhi mukha upadarśitam iti vyavahāra aṅgatāyām pratyakṣeṇa adhyāsa mūla tāyām pratyakṣa anumāna arthāpattibhiḥ pradarśitam ubhayam iti arthaḥ arthakriyā samartha tvāt ca
