original: śabdādipratyakṣāmavidyānivṛttibrahmāvagatilakṣaṇārthakriyāhetutvaṃ mithyātve'pi śabdādīnāṃ na virudhyate||
analyzed: śabda ādi pratyakṣām avidyā nivṛtti brahma avagati lakṣaṇa arthakriyā hetutvam mithyātve api śabda ādīnām na virudhyate

original: nanvarthakriyāsaṃvādāt prāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ, na -- jñānādevārthatathātvavadarthāvagamādevārthakriyāsāmarthyaniścayāt, anyathā tavāpi tathātvajñānāt prāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu brahmajñānasyāpyadhyāsopādānatvāt mithyātvamāpannam yadi tāvat svarūpamithyātvamucyate, aṅgīkṛtameva tat; atha viṣayamithyātvaṃ, na brahmaṇi; bādhābhāvāt|
analyzed: nanu artha kriyā saṃvādāt prāmāṇya prasaṅgaḥ na jñānāt eva artha tathātva vat artha avagamāt eva artha kriyā sāmarthya niścayāt anyathā tava api tathātva jñānāt prāmāṇya prasaṅgaḥ nanu brahma jñānasya api adhyāsa upādāna tvāt mithyātvam āpannam yadi tāvat svarūpa mithyātvam ucyate aṅgīkṛtam eva tat atha viṣaya mithyātvam na brahmaṇi bādhā abhāvāt

original: prapañcasyāpi bādhādeva mithyātvaṃ; nādhyāsopādānajñānagamyatvāt| nanu duṣṭakāraṇajanyasya viṣayato'pi mithyātvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti, netyāha -- doṣastvāgantuka iti| pramāṇakāraṇeṣu satsu paścādbhavan doṣo doṣa ityucyate, sa āgantuka ityuktaḥ| pramāṇakāraṇatvenaiva yo doṣo vyavatiṣṭhate, sa na doṣaḥ; kāraṇatvāt;
analyzed: prapañcasya api bādhāt eva mithyātvam na adhyāsa upādāna jñāna gamya tvāt nanu duṣṭa kāraṇa janyasya mithyātvam dṛṣṭam iti na iti āha doṣaḥ tu āgantukaḥ iti pramāṇa kāraṇeṣu satsu paścāt bhavan doṣaḥ doṣaḥ iti ucyate saḥ āgantukaḥ iti uktaḥ pramāṇa kāraṇa tvena eva yaḥ doṣaḥ vyavatiṣṭhate sa na doṣaḥ kāraṇa tvāt

original: avidyādhyāsastu caitanyasyādvitīyāvabhāsaṃ pratyeva doṣaḥ, na dvaitāvabhāsaṃ prati, tasya kāraṇatvāt, yathā kācādiḥ cakṣurādidoṣaḥ tathāvidhapāpadṛṣṭodayamanumāpayan tatra pramāṇatvāt na doṣaḥ, tadvadityarthaḥ| caitanyadoṣatvādeva tatprakāśyāvyavahāryabrahmaviparītaṃ vyavahārayogyaṃ vastu pradarśayati|
analyzed: avidyā adhyāsaḥ tu caitanyasya advitīya avabhāsam prati eva doṣaḥ na dvaita avabhāsam prati tasya kāraṇa tvāt yathā kāca ādiḥ cakṣuḥ ādi doṣaḥ tathāvidha pāpa dṛṣṭa udayam anumāpayan tatra pramāṇa tvāt na doṣaḥ tadvat iti arthaḥ caitanya doṣa tvāt eva tat prakāśya avyavahārya brahma viparītam vyavahāra yogyam vastu pradarśayati

original: doṣatvaṃ cāvidyāyāḥ caitanyasya tathā'vabhāsavirodhitayā anyathāpratibhāsanimittatvāt| kathamāgantuke doṣabuddhiḥ na naisargike ityetāvanmātre dṛṣṭāntamāha -- na ca sarvasādhāraṇe iti|| nanu bhāṣyakāreṇa doṣamātrameva viṣayato'pi jñānamithyātve
analyzed: doṣa tvam ca avidyāyāḥ caitanyasya tathā avabhāsa virodhi tayā anyathā pratibhāsa nimitta tvāt katham āgantuke doṣa buddhiḥ na naisargike iti etāvat mātre dṛṣṭāntam āha na ca sarva sādhāraṇe iti nanu bhāṣyakāreṇa doṣa mātram eva viṣayatā api jñāna mithyātve

original: heturukta iti; netyāha -- anaisargikaṃ ca doṣamiti||

original: tatra hetudarśanāt hetumantamadhyāsamanumimīte -- atastadekarūpakāryadarśanāditi|| paśvādidṛṣṭānte'pyadhyāsasadbhāve pramāṇaṃ codayati -- nanu paśvādīnāmiti|| padārthadvayadarśane sati pratyakṣānumānāgamaiḥ bhedāpratipattau adhyāsaḥ pariśiṣyate ityāha -- prauḍhamatibhya iti|| svābhāvikapratyakṣeṇa vivekadarśane doṣamāha -- evameveti||
analyzed: tatra hetu darśanāt hetumantam adhyāsam anumimīte atas tad eka rūpa kārya darśanāt iti paśu ādi dṛṣṭānte api adhyāsa sadbhāve pramāṇam codayati nanu paśu ādīnām iti padārtha dvaya darśane sati pratyakṣa anumāna āgamaiḥ bheda apratipattau adhyāsaḥ pariśiṣyate iti āha prauḍha matibhyaḥ iti svābhāvika pratyakṣeṇa viveka darśane doṣam āha evam eva iti

original: nanvanumānāgamavicārahīnānāmapyadṛṣṭārthaṃ vyavahāradarśanāt pratyakṣeṇaiva viveko gṛhyate iti codayati -- nanu gopālāṅganādaya iti|| na pratyakṣeṇa vivekagrahaḥ, kintvāptavacanādityāha -- na tadabhijñavyavahāreti|| pratyakṣaścedviveko viśeṣataḥ pratyagātmānaṃ pratipadyerannityāha -- tathā ca te pṛṣṭā iti||

original: ato nigamanavākyamupapannamityāha -- tasmādyuktamuktamiti|| tasya vyavahārasya kāla eva kālo yasyādhyāsasya so'dhyāsastatkālaḥ, sa ca paśvādibhirvivekināmapi samāna iti||
analyzed: atas nigamana vākyam upapannam iti āha tasmāt yuktam uktam iti tasya vyavahārasya kālaḥ eva kālaḥ yasya adhyāsasya saḥ adhyāsaḥ tad kālaḥ sa ca paśu ādibhiḥ vivekinām api samānaḥ iti

original: evaṃ tāvat pratyakṣādīni tyuktānuvādaḥ| "na tenānadhyastātmabhāvene"ti bhāṣyaṃ pūrvaṃ na vyākhyātaṃ, tadanuvādagranthe vyācaṣṭe|| tatreyamāśaṅkā -- bhavatvadhyāsasya vyavahāranimittatā, tathāpi rajatā divannimittakāraṇamevādhyāso vyavahārasya, ātmaiva kevalastu upādānamiti, tatrāha -- na tenānadhyastātmabhāvenāsaṅgasyeti||
analyzed: evam tāvat pratyakṣa ādīni ti ukta anuvādaḥ na tena anadhyasta ātma bhāvena iti bhāṣyam pūrvam na vyākhyātam tad anuvāda granthe vyācaṣṭe tatra iyam āśaṅkā bhavatu adhyāsasya vyavahāra nimitta tā tathā api rajatā ādi vat nimitta kāraṇam eva adhyāsaḥ vyavahārasya ātmā eva kevalaḥ tu upādānam iti tatra āha na tena anadhyasta ātma bhāvena asaṅgasya iti

original: ayamarthaḥ -- rajatādyadhyāsānāṃ vyavahārāśrayakoṭinikṣiptatvābhāvāt tadantareṇa cātmani pramātṛtvādivyavahāradarśanāt nimittakāraṇataiva yuktā, iha tu punarāśrayakoṭinikṣiptatvāt kevalātmani suṣupte vyavahārādarśanāt upādānakāraṇasyābhyarhitatvāt anvayavyatirekavato'dhyāsasyopādānakāraṇatvameva vyavahāraṃ prati kalpayituṃ yuktamiti|
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ rajata ādi adhyāsānām vyavahāra āśraya koṭi nikṣipta tva abhāvāt tad antareṇa ca ātmani pramātṛ tva ādi vyavahāra darśanāt nimitta kāraṇatā eva yuktā iha tu punar āśraya koṭi nikṣipta tvāt kevala ātmani suṣupte vyavahāra adarśanāt upādānakāraṇasya abhyarhita tvāt anvaya vyatirekavataḥ dhyāsasya upādānakāraṇa tvam eva vyavahāram prati kalpayitum yuktam iti

original: "śāstraṃ punaḥ" ityuttarabhāṣyasyāśaṅkā| tasyāpīti tātparyābhidhānam| śāstrīye tviti adṛṣṭārthapravṛttau vyatirekajñānamabhyanujānāti| abhyanujñāmākṣipati -- nanu phalanaiyamiketi||
analyzed: śāstram punar iti uttara bhāṣyasya āśaṅkā tasya api iti tātparya abhidhānam śāstrīye tu iti adṛṣṭa artha pravṛttau vyatireka jñānam abhyanujānāti abhyanujñām ākṣipati nanu phala naiyamikā iti

original: phalacodanāya tāvat paśvādīnāmasminneva janmani labdhuṃ śakyatvāt, tajjanyasukhasya ca svargasya paśvādicodanāphalatvābhāvāt jyotiṣṭomādi phalatvopapatteḥ niratiśayaprīterapyatraiva sambhavāt na dehāntarasambandhinamātmānamāpādayati, naiyamikanaimittikacodanā tu sutarām; phalaśūnyatvāt| phalavattve vā dṛṣṭenaivopabhoktuṃ śakyatvāt|
analyzed: phala codanāya tāvat paśu ādīnām asmin eva janmani labdhum śakya tvāt tad janya sukhasya ca svargasya paśu ādi codanā phala tva abhāvāt jyotiṣṭoma ādi phala tva upapatteḥ niratiśaya prīteḥ api atra eva sambhavāt na deha antara sambandhinam ātmānam āpādayati naiyamika naimittika codanā tu sutarām phala śūnyatvāt phalavat tve vā dṛṣṭena evā upabhoktum śakya tvāt

original: prāyaścittasya tu doṣanibarhaṇaphalatvāt, doṣaphalasyāsmiñjanmani bhoktuṃ śakyatvāt, janmāntarasya caitādṛśatvāt, phalādarśane ca kārīryādivadaṅgavaikalyapratibaddha sahakāryābhāvakalpanopapatteḥ, mantrauṣadhādisiddhenānenāpi śarīreṇa svargādibhogasambhavāt na dehavyatirekajñānopayoga iti|
analyzed: prāyaścittasya tu doṣa nibarhaṇa phala tvāt doṣa phalasya asmin janmani bhoktum śakya tvāt janmāntarasya ca etādṛśa tvāt phala adarśane ca kārīrya ādi vat aṅga vaikalya pratibaddha sahakārya abhāva kalpanā upapatteḥ mantra auṣadha ādi siddhena anena api śarīreṇa svarga ādi bhoga sambhavāt na deha vyatireka jñāna upayogaḥ iti

original: tatra devatādhikaraṇanayena mantrādiprāmāṇyādviśiṣṭadeśakālaśarīrādibhogyaṃ svargādiphalamaṅgīkṛtyedamuktamiti pariharati -- satyamevaṃ tathāpīti||

original: nanu mantrādisamanvayaprāmāṇyamanapekṣyaiva codanābhireva vyatiriktātmā apekṣyate, karmamātranirṇayapravṛttena bhāṣyakāreṇātmano nirūpitatvāditi, tatrāha -- tathā ca vidhivṛtteti|| vidhibhirevāpekṣitaścet, sūtreṇāpi bhavitavyamityarthaḥ| nanu anapekṣitasyāsūtritasya ca bhāṣyakāreṇa pratipādanamayuktamityākṣipati -- tat kasya hetoriti||
analyzed: nanu mantra ādi samanvaya prāmāṇyam an apekṣya eva codanābhiḥ eva vyatirikta ātmā apekṣyate karma mātra nirṇaya pravṛttena bhāṣyakāreṇa ātmanaḥ nirūpita tvāt iti tatra āha tathā ca vidhi vṛtta iti vidhibhiḥ eva apekṣitaḥ ced sūtreṇa api bhavitavyam iti arthaḥ nanu anapekṣitasya a sūtritasya ca bhāṣyakāreṇa pratipādanam ayuktam iti ākṣipati tat kasya hetoḥ iti

analyzed: tat pramāṇam bādarāyaṇasya anapekṣa tvāt iti sūtra avayavena mantra ādi prāmāṇya dvāreṇa paramparayā sūtritaḥ pariharati dharma jijñāsā iti kārya artha vicāram pratijñāya iti

original: evaṃ sūtrārthaṃ paramparayā bhūte'pyarthe prāmāṇyamāśritya bhāṣyakāreṇātmavicāraḥ kṛtaḥ, na codanāsāmarthyamāśrityeti kathamavagamyate iti tatrāha -- tathā codanā hi bhūtamiti|| tarhi codanāpekṣitatvāt samanvayo'pyatraiva varṇanīya iti, netyāha -- sa ca svarūpāvagama iti||
analyzed: evam sūtra artham paramparayā bhūte api arthe prāmāṇyam āśritya bhāṣyakāreṇa ātma vicāraḥ kṛtaḥ na codanā sāmarthyam āśritya iti katham avagamyate iti tatra āha tathā codanā hi bhūtam iti tarhi codanā apekṣita tvāt samanvayaḥ api atra eva varṇanīyaḥ iti na iti āha sa ca svarūpa avagamaḥ iti

original: nanu dharme prayatamāne nāpyapekṣitatvāt kartavya evātmavicāra iti, netyāha -- upayogābhāvāditi|| na hi dharmamātraṃ vyatiriktātmānamapekṣate, kintu phalamapekṣate, phale ca na prayatate jaiminirityarthaḥ| nanu phalamapyapekṣate cet, tatrāpi prayatno yukta iti, na; -- anyathāsiddhatvādityāha -- bhagavāṃstu punariti||
analyzed: nanu dharme prayatamāne na api apekṣita tvāt kartavyaḥ eva ātma vicāraḥ iti na iti āha upayoga abhāvāt iti na hi dharma mātram vyatirikta ātmānam apekṣate kintu phalam apekṣate phale ca na prayatate jaiminiḥ iti arthaḥ nanu phalam api apekṣate ced tatra api prayatnaḥ yuktaḥ iti na anyathā asiddha tvāt iti āha bhagavān tu punar iti

original: nanu brahmaiva tatra vicāritam, na codanāphalamiti, tatrāha -- tatra ca dehāntaropabhogya iti|| tacca sarvamiti
analyzed: nanu brahma eva tatra vicāritam na codanā phalam iti tatra āha tatra ca deha antara upabhogyaḥ iti tat ca sarvam iti

original: "satyam vināpi tena sidhyedi"tyādinoktamarthaṃ saṃkṣepato darśayati -- asti tu taditi|| bhūte'rthe prāmāṇyam; svargādāvityarthaḥ| na tena vineti| vyatiriktātmanā vinetyarthaḥ|

original: nanu sūtrakārabhāṣyakārābhyāṃ devatādhikaraṇe mukhata eva devatādiṣu mantrādiprāmāṇyaṃ nāstītyuktam, tat kathaṃ sūtrāvayavasāmarthyāt prāmāṇyamanumatamiti manyante, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
analyzed: nanu sūtrakāra bhāṣyakārābhyām devatā adhikaraṇe mukhatas eva devatā ādiṣu mantra ādi prāmāṇyam na asti iti uktam tat katham sūtra avayava sāmarthyāt prāmāṇyam anumatam iti manyante na eṣa doṣaḥ

original: tatra devatāyā vigrahavattve sannipatyopakārakatvaprasaṅgāt yogyānupalabdhivirodhāt, karmaṇi virodhaprasaṅgābhiprāyeṇoktatvāt, nāprāmāṇyābhiprāyeṇa, arthavādaliṅgānāmapi tatra tatra dvādaśalakṣaṇyāṃ pramāṇatvenodāhriyamāṇatvāditi|

original: tathāpi na vedāntavedyam ityādibhāṣyavyākhyānaṃ spaṣṭārtham|tatra "aśanāyādyatītaṃ" ityādinā kartranvayādhikārānvayabhoktranvayāḥ krameṇa nirasyante| prāk cetyādibhāṣyavyākhyānaṃ -- "tattvamasī"tivākyārthāvagamāt ityādi||

analyzed: katham punar vyatireka jñānena adhyāsasya saha vṛttiḥ parokṣa aparokṣa vibhāgāt candra dvi tva jñāna vat avirodhaḥ iti kecid sūkṣma śarīrasya ātma avidyā kārya tvāt kārya kāraṇayoḥ bheda abheda bhāvāt sthūla śarīrasya agni ayaḥ piṇḍa vat sūkṣma śarīreṇa saṃśleṣāt bheda jñāne api adhyāsaḥ iti apare sarvathā api yāvat aparokṣa jñānam adhyāsaḥ na nivartate iti bhāvaḥ

original: tasmāt ityadhyāsapramāṇopasaṃhāraḥ| na ca kevalaṃ pratyakṣānumānārthāpattibhireva adhyāsasiddhiḥ, kiṃ tu āgamo'pi vidheḥ boddhāramadhikāriṇaṃ brāhmaṇādiśabdairanuvadan cetanācetanayoraikyāvabhāsaṃ darśayatītyāha -- tadeva darśayati tathā hīti|| yo jyogāmayāvī-ujjvalāmayavānityarthaḥ||

original: vṛttasaṅkīrtanapūrvakamadhyāso nāmeti lakṣaṇabhāṣyamavatārayati -- evamadhyāsasadbhāvaṃ prasādhyetyādinā|| kimiti punaratroktalakṣaṇānuvādaḥ iti tadāha -- kasya yuṣmadarthasyeti|| bhāṣyaṃ yojayati -- kasminnayuṣmadartha ityādinā||

original: "ātmānātmanoritaretarādhyāsaṃ puraskṛtye" ityādinā pratyakṣato darśitasyādhyāsasya vibhajya pradarśanāyottaraṃ bhāṣyamityāha -- tadāha tadyathā putrabhāryādiṣvityādi|| tathā antaḥkaraṇadharmā nityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|

original: atrottarottarādhyāsaviśiṣṭe pūrvapūrvādhyāsaḥ iti kathayitumātmanyadhyasyatītyātmaśabdārthamāha -- asmadarthaśca ahampratyayisambhinna iti|| nanu śarīramapyadhyasyate, na dharmā evetyata āha -- dharmiṇo'pīti|| grahaṇamityadhyāhāraḥ| dharmaśūbdastarhi kimiti gṛhītaḥ ityata āha -- dharmaśabdastviti||

original: śāstrīyavyavahāramūlatvena prādhānyācca dharmādhyāsasya prādhānyena grahaṇamityāha -- tannimittaśceti||

original: nanu yatra viparyāsagṛhītasya vastuno virodhibhāvāntarātmaviṣayaṃ vākyaṃ viparyāsaṃ nivartayati, tatra viparyāsanirāsapratipādane vākyasya sāmarthyābhāvāt nāntarīyakaṃ nirāsajñānamastu; yatra punaḥ pratyakṣabādhakaṃ tatra viparyāsanirāsaviśiṣṭabhāvāntarajñānameva bādhakam; na tatra viparyāsanirāsasya nāntarīyakajñānam|
analyzed: nanu yatra viparyāsa gṛhītasya vastunaḥ virodhi bhāva antara ātma viṣayam vākyam viparyāsam nivartayati tatra viparyāsa nirāsa pratipādane vākyasya sāmarthya abhāvāt nāntarīyakam nirāsa jñānam astu yatra punar pratyakṣa bādhakam tatra viparyāsa nirāsa viśiṣṭa bhāva antara jñānam eva bādhakam na tatra viparyāsa nirāsasya nāntarīyaka jñānam

original: ihāpyaparokṣajñānāt bandhanivṛtteḥ ubhayaviṣayameva jñānam, nānyatarasya nāntarīyakatā, ityāśaṅkyāha -- pratyakṣabādhasyāpīti|| na tāvadanupalabdhigamyo rajatābhāvaḥ; purodeśe dṛśyamānatvāt; atha saṃprayogajanya iti; netyāha -- asaṃprayuktaviṣayatvāditi|| rajatatadabhāvau na saṃprayogayogyāvityarthaḥ| tadevaśābdaṃ ityupasaṃhāraḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ||
analyzed: iha api aparokṣa jñānāt bandha nivṛtteḥ ubhaya viṣayam eva jñānam na anyatarasya nāntarīyaka tā iti āśaṅkya āha pratyakṣa bādhasya api iti na tāvat anupalabdhi gamyaḥ rajata abhāvaḥ puras deśe dṛśyamāna tvāt atha saṃprayoga janyaḥ iti na iti āha asaṃprayukta viṣaya tvāt iti rajata tad abhāvau na saṃprayoga yogyau iti arthaḥ tat eva śābdam iti upasaṃhāraḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ

original: nanu brahmavidyāphalamanarthahetunirāsaḥ, na vedāntārambhaphalam; tatra kathaṃ prahāṇāya vedāntāḥ ityāśaṅkyāha -- caturthīprayogo'pīti|| upādānaṃ -- vedāntārambha ityarthaḥ| tarhi brahmavidyāphalatvāt śāstrasya na anarthanirāsaḥ prayojanam, na; paramparayāpi puruṣākāṅkṣitaprayojanatvopapatterityāha -- prayojanatvaṃ ceti||
analyzed: nanu brahma vidyā phalam anartha hetu nirāsaḥ na vedānta ārambha phalam tatra katham prahāṇāya vedāntāḥ iti āśaṅkya āha caturthī prayogaḥ upi iti upādānam vedānta ārambhaḥ iti arthaḥ tarhi brahma vidyā phala tvāt śāstrasya na anartha nirāsaḥ prayojanam na paramparayā api puruṣa ākāṅkṣita prayojana tva upapatteḥ iti āha prayojana tvam ca iti

original: vidyāpratipattaye iti pratipattiśabdamākṣipati -- na hi vidyā gavādivaditi|| jñānaṃ hi vastutaḥpratītitaśca jñāturutpattyaiva āptamevetyarthaḥ| tatra pratyakṣāntareṣu svaviṣayeṇa saha aparokṣāvabhāsā vidyā bhavati, āptiśabdena ca viṣayeṇa sahāparokṣyaniścayo vivakṣyate, tadiha na saṃbhavatītyāha -- satyamevamanyatreti||
analyzed: vidyā pratipattaye iti pratipatti śabdam ākṣipati na hi vidyā gavādi vat iti jñānam hi vastutas pratītitaḥ ca jñātuḥ utpattyā eva āptam eva iti arthaḥ tatra pratyakṣa antareṣu sva viṣayeṇa saha aparokṣa avabhāsā vidyā bhavati āpti śabdena ca viṣayeṇa saha āparokṣya niścayaḥ vivakṣyate tat iha na saṃbhavati iti āha satyam evam anyatra iti

original: atra "vidye"ti śaktitātparyavicārasahakṛtācchabdāt yat pramāṇajñānamutpadyate, tadabhidhīyate| tasya pratiṣṭhā svaviṣayeṇa saha āparokṣyamiti| tatra asambhāvaneti|| cittasya brahmātmaparibhāvanāpracayanimittadekāgravṛttyayogyatocyate| viparītabhāvaneti śarīrādyadhyāsasaṃskārapracayaḥ||

analyzed: asambhāvita viśeṣa aṃśa aparokṣa niścayaḥ na utpadyate iti arthaḥ nanu pramāṇāt aniścīyamānaḥ katham tarka pratyayāt niścīyate iti tatra āha atas eva pramāṇānām iti prasiddhā eva sahakāri saṃpattau phala siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ nanu tarkasya api pramāṇa tve katham pramāṇa dvayāt artha niścayaḥ bhavati apramāṇa tve na iti manvānaḥ āha atha kaḥ yam iti

analyzed: tatra idam nirūpitam prathame tantre jñānānām prāmāṇyam aprāmāṇyam ca svatas iti kecid ubhayam api paratas iti anye prāmāṇyam paratas aprāmāṇyam svatas iti apare aprāmāṇyam paratas svatas prāmāṇyam iti veda vādinaḥ tatra na tāvat jñānānām prāmāṇyam aprāmāṇyam ca svatas iti yujyate virodhāt nanu vyakti bhedena vyavasthā satyam arthataḥ tathā eva

original: sādhanajñānānāmeva arthakriyāsaṃvādāt prāmāṇyaṃ, na phalajñānānām, arthakriyāntarābhāvāt, ato nānavastheti cet, tadvadeva sādhanajñānānāmapi tat svata eva syāt; anyathā pravṛttasya arthakriyātaḥprāmāṇyam, prāmāṇyācca pravṛttiḥ iti itaretarāśrayatvaṃ syāt| na ca prāmāṇyaniścayāya pravṛttiḥ; asandigdhārthatvāt jñānānām|

original: rūpakaparīkṣādau pratyayacatuṣṭayāt dṛśyate arthaniścaya iti cet, na; prathamajñānasyaiva saṃśayādipratibandhanirāsitvāduttarajñānānām| tasmāt jñānotpattimātraprayuktārthavyavahāradarśanāt pratītito'rthataśca svata eva arthaniścayaḥ prāmāṇyam| aprāmāṇyajanma doṣasahitāt kāraṇāt tatpratītiḥ bādhāditi parata eva aprāmāṇyaṃ yuktam|

original: tasmāt prāmāṇyatatpratītyoḥ guṇatatjjñānāntarādyanapekṣameva jñānaṃ svataḥ sattayaiva niścayavyavahāranimittamiti sthāpitam| tadetadvirudhyate tarkapratyayāpekṣayā jñānasya svaviṣayaṃ prati niścāyakatve iti codayati -- nanvevaṃ tarkasāpekṣaṃ svamarthamiti|| paraharati -- na syāt svamahimnaivetyādinā||
analyzed: tasmāt prāmāṇya tad pratītyoḥ guṇa tad jñāna antara ādi anapekṣam eva jñānam svatas sattayā eva niścaya vyavahāra nimittam iti sthāpitam tat etat virudhyate tarka pratyaya apekṣayā jñānasya sva viṣayam prati niścāyaka tve iti codayati nanu evam tarka sāpekṣam svam artham iti paraharati na syāt sva mahimnā eva ityādinā

original: pramāṇādeva arthāparokṣyaniścaye tatpratibandhavigame tarkasya upayogāt nārthanirṇayahetutetyuktam||
analyzed: pramāṇāt eva artha āparokṣya niścaye tad pratibandha vigame tarkasya upayogāt na artha nirṇaya hetu tā iti uktam

original: nanu evaṃ bahirarthe pramāṇapratibandhasambhavāt tadvigamāya bhavatu tarkopakāraḥ, na tathā ātmani; svayaṃprakāśe, pratibandhābhāvāditi, tatrāha -- tathā ca tattvamasivākye tvampadārthaḥ iti|| "asambhāvaya"nniti, āparokṣyābhāva ucyate, "viparītami"ti ca pārokṣyamucyate|
analyzed: nanu evam bahis arthe pramāṇa pratibandha sambhavāt tad vigamāya bhavatu tarka upakāraḥ na tathā ātmani svayam prakāśe pratibandha abhāvāt iti tatra āha tathā ca tattvam asi vākye tvam padārthaḥ iti asambhāvayan iti āparokṣya abhāvaḥ ucyate viparītam iti ca pārokṣyam ucyate

original: atrāyamāśayaḥ -- loke tāvadviṣayasyāparokṣatā saṃvidabhedādvā viṣayasyāvyavadhānatayā svasaṃvijjanakatvādvā pramāṇakāraṇendriyasamprayuktatvādvā bhavati; uktakāraṇatrayahīne anumeyādau parokṣatādarśanāt|
analyzed: atra ayam āśayaḥ loke tāvat viṣayasya aparokṣa tā saṃvid abhedāt vā viṣayasya avyavadhāna tayā sva saṃvid janaka tvāt vā pramāṇa kāraṇa indriya samprayukta tvāt vā bhavati ukta kāraṇa traya hīne anumeya ādau parokṣa tā darśanāt

original: tatra brahmaṇa eva sarvasaṃvidupādānatvāt brahmākāraśabdapramāṇajanyasaṃvedane'pi tadabhinnatayā vā tajjanakatayā vā brahmāpi prathamamevāparokṣatayā avabhāsate| tacca cittasyātisūkṣme anekāgratādoṣādviparyayasaṃskāradoṣācca pratibaddhaṃ bhrāntyā parokṣavadavabhāsate|
analyzed: tatra brahmaṇaḥ eva sarva saṃvid upādāna tvāt brahma ākāra śabda pramāṇa janya saṃvedane pi tad abhinna tayā vā tad janaka tayā vā brahma api prathamam eva aparokṣa tayā avabhāsate tat ca cittasya ati sūkṣme anekāgra tā doṣāt viparyaya saṃskāra doṣāt ca pratibaddham bhrāntyā parokṣa vat avabhāsate

original: tatrāparokṣajñānamuddiśya yajñādīnāṃ nididhyāsanādīnāṃ ca vidhānasāmarthyāt yajñādinibarhitakalmaṣapratibandhaṃ śamādiniruddhaviparītapravṛttidoṣaṃ, mananasaṃdarśitaprameyādisaṃbhāvanāguṇapradīpojjvalitaṃ atisūkṣmatarabrahmātmaviṣayanididhyāsanapracayaparinirmitatadekāgravṛttiguṇaṃ cendriyaṃ pārokṣyavibhramanimittapratibandhanirāsena
analyzed: tatra aparokṣa jñānam uddiśya yajña ādīnām nididhyāsana ādīnām ca vidhāna sāmarthyāt yajña ādi nibarhita kalmaṣa pratibandham śama ādi niruddha viparīta pravṛtti doṣam manana saṃdarśita prameya ādi saṃbhāvanā guṇa pradīpa ujjvalitam ati sūkṣmatara brahma ātma viṣaya nididhyāsana pracaya parinirmita tad ekāgra vṛtti guṇam ca indriyam pārokṣya vibhrama nimitta pratibandha nirāsena

original: śabdādevāparokṣaniścayanimittaṃ bhavatīti gamyate; loke ca atisūkṣmavastunirdhāraṇe cittaikāgryaviśeṣāpekṣāyā darśanāt| tarkaśabdena cātra etādṛśaṃ sarvapratibandhanirāsi cittadarpaṇamucyate; yoktikāsambhāvanāviparītabhāvanānirāsitarkāṇāṃ prathamajñāne antarbhūtatvāt|
analyzed: śabdāt eva aparokṣa niścaya nimittam bhavati iti gamyate loke ca ati sūkṣma vastu nirdhāraṇe citta aikāgrya viśeṣa apekṣāyāḥ darśanāt tarka śabdena ca atra etādṛśam sarva pratibandha nirāsi citta darpaṇam ucyate yoktika sambhāvanā viparīta bhāvanā nirāsi tarkāṇām prathama jñāne antarbhūta tvāt

original: evaṃ ca "taṃ tvaupaniṣadam" iti taddhitapratyayena brahmāvagatihetutvaṃ śabdasya darśitamupapannaṃ bhavati; aparokṣāvagatereva samyagavatitvāditi||
analyzed: evam ca tam tu aupaniṣadam iti taddhita pratyayena brahma avagati hetutvam śabdasya darśitam upapannam bhavati aparokṣa avagateḥ eva samyak avati tvāt iti

original: anyanmatam -- na prathamotpannaṃ śābdajñānameva pratibandhavigamāpekṣayā aparokṣāvabhāsaṃ bhavati; kiṃ tu śabda eva prathamaṃ brahmaṇi parokṣajñānamutpādya punaḥ varṇitacittadarpaṇasahakāraṇāpekṣayā dvitīyamaparokṣajñānamutpādayati;
analyzed: anyat matam na prathama utpannam śābda jñānam eva pratibandha vigama apekṣayā aparokṣa avabhāsam bhavati kim tu śabdaḥ eva prathamam brahmaṇi parokṣa jñānam utpādya punar varṇita citta darpaṇa saha kāraṇa apekṣayā dvitīyam aparokṣa jñānam utpādayati

original: śabdādīnāṃ taddhitapratyayādinā aparokṣajñāne viniyogasāmarthyāt, yathā saṃprayogo'bhijñāmutpādya punaḥ pūrvānubhavasaṃskārāpekṣayā pratyabhijñāmutpādayati tadvat| na ca svayamprakāśe brahmaṇi parokṣajñānaṃ vibhramaḥ; svayamprakāśe'pi puruṣāntarasaṃvedane
analyzed: śabda ādīnām taddhita pratyaya ādinā aparokṣa jñāne viniyoga sāmarthyāt yathā saṃprayoga ūbhijñām utpādya punar pūrva anubhava saṃskāra apekṣayā pratyabhijñām utpādayati tadvat na ca svayamprakāśe brahmaṇi parokṣa jñānam vibhramaḥ svayamprakāśe api puruṣa antara saṃvedane

original: parokṣānumānadarśanāditi| sarvathāpi āparokṣyasya prayatnāntaralabhyatvāt yuktaṃ pṛthak pratipattiśabdagrahaṇamityāha -- tataḥ prāgvidyoditāpīti|| kaiḥ punaḥ sahakāribhiḥ śabdapramāṇādāparokṣyaṃ labhyate iti ; tatrāha -- avāptiprakāraśca vedānteṣveva nirdiṣṭa iti||
analyzed: parokṣa anumāna darśanāt iti sarvathā api āparokṣyasya prayatna antara labhya tvāt yuktam pṛthak pratipatti śabda grahaṇam iti āha tatas prāk vidyoditā api iti kaiḥ punar sahakāribhiḥ śabda pramāṇāt āparokṣyam labhyate iti tatra āha avāpti prakāraḥ ca vedānteṣu eva nirdiṣṭaḥ iti

original: nanu -- manananididhyāsanayoḥ kathaṃ śravaṇaṃ pratyaṅgatāvagam yāvatā brahmaṇyeva śaktitātparyaviśiṣṭavedāntaśabdāvadhāraṇācchravaṇaśabdābhidheyādātmanyavabuddhe paścānmananamarthasaṃbhāvanopapattiparyālocanādvārā janitā brahmaṇi pratyayāvṛttirutpadyate|
analyzed: nanu manana nididhyāsanayoḥ katham śravaṇam pratyaṅgatā avagam yāvatā brahmaṇi eva śakti tātparya viśiṣṭa vedānta śabda avadhāraṇāt śravaṇa śabda abhidheyāt ātmani avabuddhe paścāt mananam artha saṃbhāvanā upapatti paryālocanā dvārā janitā brahmaṇi pratyaya āvṛttiḥ utpadyate

original: tataśca pramāṇayuktisambhāvanābhyāṃ pariniścite'pi viṣaye tadekākāraṃ cittasamādhānaṃ nididhyāsanamutpadyate; tadevaṃ nididhyāsanasvarūpopakāritayā śravaṇamananayostadaṅgabhāve'vagate na yujyate śravaṇāṅgatā manananididhyāsanayoriti|
analyzed: tatas ca pramāṇa yukti sambhāvanābhyām pariniścite api viṣaye tad eka ākāram citta samādhānam nididhyāsanam utpadyate tat evam nididhyāsana sva rūpa upakāri tayā śravaṇa mananayoḥ tad aṅga bhāva ivagate na yujyate śravaṇa aṅga tā manana nididhyāsanayoḥ iti

original: atrocyate -- yasmin pakṣe śaktitātparyaviśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ brahmaṇi parokṣajñānamutpādya manananididhyāsanasaṃskāraviśiṣṭāntaḥkaraṇāpekṣayā aparokṣajñānamutpādayati, tatra brahmaṇi parokṣajñānasya nididhyāsanopakāritayā tadaṅgatve'pi tātparyaviśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇādaparokṣajñānotpattau manananididhyāsane śravaṇasya
analyzed: atrā ucyate yasmin pakṣe śakti tātparya viśiṣṭa śabda avadhāraṇam prathamam brahmaṇi parokṣa jñānam utpādya manana nididhyāsana saṃskāra viśiṣṭa antaḥkaraṇa apekṣayā aparokṣa jñānam utpādayati tatra brahmaṇi parokṣa jñānasya nididhyāsana upakāri tayā tad aṅga tve pi tātparya viśiṣṭa śabda avadhāraṇāt aparokṣa jñāna utpattau manana nididhyāsane śravaṇasya

original: phalopakāryaṅgatāmaśnuvāte| nanu aparokṣaphalodaye'pi nididhyāsanāṅgataiva śravaṇamananayoḥ kiṃ na syāt trayāṇāmapi sannipatyopakārāviśeṣāt, darśapaurṇamāsavat samapradhānatā vā kiṃ na syāt iti ; ucyate -- viśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇaṃ prameyāvagamaṃ pratyavyavadhānena kāraṇaṃ bhavati; pramāṇasya prameyāvagamaṃ pratyavyavadhānāt|
analyzed: phala upakāri aṅgatām aśnuvāte nanu aparokṣa phala udaye pi nididhyāsana aṅgatā eva śravaṇa mananayoḥ kim na syāt trayāṇām api sannipatya upakāra aviśeṣāt darśa paurṇamāsa vat sama pradhāna tā vā kim na syāt iti ucyate viśiṣṭa śabda avadhāraṇam prameya avagamam prati avyavadhānena kāraṇam bhavati pramāṇasya prameya avagamam prati avyavadhānāt

original: manananididhyāsane tu cittasya pratyagātmapravaṇatāsaṃskārapariniṣpannatadekāgravṛttikāryadvāreṇa brahmānubhavahetutāṃ pratipadyete, iti phalaṃ pratyavyavahitasya karaṇasya viśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇasya vvayahite manananididhyāsane tadaṅge aṅgīkriyete|
analyzed: manana nididhyāsane tu cittasya pratyagātma pravaṇa tā saṃskāra pariniṣpanna tad ekāgra vṛtti kārya dvāreṇa brahma anubhava hetutām pratipadyete iti phalam prati avyavahitasya karaṇasya viśiṣṭa śabda avadhāraṇasya manana nididhyāsane tad aṅge aṅgīkriyete

original: yadā tu punaḥ śabdādeva prathamamaparokṣānubhavaphalaṃ vijñānamutpannaṃ, bhrāntivikṣepasaṃskārasvacitāntaḥkaraṇadoṣāt arthe'pi parokṣānubhavaphalatayā vibhrāntyā avatiṣṭhate, tadā manananididhyāsane cittagatavikṣepādidoṣapratibandhanirāsena aparokṣaphalapratiṣṭhāhetutayā pramāṇasya phalopakāryaṅgamiti na virudhyate|
analyzed: yadā tu punar śabdāt eva prathamam aparokṣa anubhava phalam vijñānam utpannam bhrānti vikṣepa saṃskāra svacita antaḥkaraṇa doṣāt arthe pi parokṣa anubhava phala tayā vibhrāntyā avatiṣṭhate tadā manana nididhyāsane citta gata vikṣepa ādi doṣa pratibandha nirāsena aparokṣa phala pratiṣṭhā hetutayā pramāṇasya phala upakāri aṅgam iti na virudhyate

original: na ca śabdakaraṇamantareṇa nididhyāsanādeva aparokṣānubhavaphalajanma saṃbhavati; tasya prāmāṇyāsiddheḥ| śabdāvagatabrahmātmaviṣayatvādaparokṣasya taddvāreṇa prāmāṇyaniścaya iti cet, naivam; utpannasya hi vijñānasya pramāṇāntarādhīnaviṣayasadbhāvaniścayādhīnaprāmāṇyakalpanāt varaṃ svasyaiva klṛptapramāṇajanyatvakalpanam;
analyzed: na ca śabda karaṇam antareṇa nididhyāsanāt eva aparokṣa anubhava phala janma saṃbhavati tasya prāmāṇya asiddheḥ śabda avagata brahma ātma viṣaya tvāt aparokṣasya tad dvāreṇa prāmāṇya niścayaḥ iti ced nā evam utpannasya hi vijñānasya pramāṇa antara adhīna viṣaya sadbhāva niścaya adhīna prāmāṇya kalpanāt varam svasya eva klṛpta pramāṇa janya tva kalpanam

original: anyathā parataḥprāmāṇyāt itaratra svataḥprāmāṇyāt| tasmāt yuktaṃ śravaṇasya phalopakāryaṅgatā manananididhyāsanayoriti||
analyzed: anyathā paratas prāmāṇyāt itaratra svatas prāmāṇyāt tasmāt yuktam śravaṇasya phala upakāri aṅga tā manana nididhyāsanayoḥ iti

original: nanu brahmāparokṣajñānamapi nānarthanivṛttinimittam ; satyapi tasmin saṃsārānuvṛttidarśanāt, anyathā sadya eva śarīrapātaḥ syāt iti codayati -- nanvātmaikatvavidyāpratipattiriti|| nanu vyatirekajñānāt tattvajñānasya viśeṣo darśitaḥ, satyam; phalato na viśeṣa ityāha -- tathā hi jīvasyeti|| naitadyuktam;
analyzed: nanu brahma aparokṣa jñānam api na anartha nivṛtti nimittam sati api tasmin saṃsāra anuvṛtti darśanāt anyathā sadyas eva śarīrapātaḥ syāt iti codayati nanu ātma eka tva vidyā pratipattiḥ iti nanu vyatireka jñānāt tattva jñānasya viśeṣaḥ darśitaḥ satyam phalataḥ na viśeṣaḥ iti āha tathā hi jīvasya iti na etat yuktam

original: tattvāparokṣāt samūlādhyāsanivṛtteḥ anvayavyatirekaśāstrasiddhatvādityāha -- bhavatu tatrāvidyāyā iti| nanu adhyāsavirodhivyatirekāvagamavat tattvāvabodho'dhyāsaviruddho'pi tannāpanayatītyanumīyatāmiti ; netyāha -- na hi jīvasyeti| anavabodhaviruddhaṃ tattvajñānaṃ na vyatirekajñānamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tattva aparokṣāt sa mūla adhyāsa nivṛtteḥ anvaya vyatireka śāstra siddha tvāt iti āha bhavatu tatra avidyāyāḥ iti nanu adhyāsa virodhi vyatireka avagama vat tattva avabodhaḥ udhyāsa viruddhaḥ api tat na apanayati iti anumīyatām iti na iti āha na hi jīvasya iti anavabodha viruddham tattva jñānam na vyatireka jñānam iti arthaḥ

original: saśarīrendriyasyaivāparokṣāvagamāt tarhi sadya eva śarīrapātaḥ syāditi codayati -- nanu brahmajñānāditi|| tattvajñānādavidyānirodhe'pi punarvṛttiḥ yujyate ityāha -- na saṃskārāditi|| tadeva prapañcayati -- tathā hīti||
analyzed: sa śarīra indriyasya eva aparokṣa avagamāt tarhi sadyas eva śarīrapātaḥ syāt iti codayati nanu brahma jñānāt iti tattva jñānāt avidyā nirodhe pi punar vṛttiḥ yujyate iti āha na saṃskārāt iti tat eva prapañcayati tathā hi iti

original: nanu kriyājñānayoreva saṃskāraḥ sambhavati, na ajñānatatkāryayoḥ, na; gandhādisaṃskāradarśanāt, pralayāvasthāyāṃ sarvakāryasaṃskāropagamāt| sarvatra ca vināśamātraprayuktasaṃskārajanmānumānāt, avidyātatkāryasya bhrāntijñānātmakatvāt, ajñānādau ca sākṣicaitanyāvacchedakajñānābhāsopagamāt saṃskārasiddheḥ|
analyzed: nanu kriyā jñānayoḥ eva saṃskāraḥ sambhavati na ajñāna tad kāryayoḥ na gandha ādi saṃskāra darśanāt pralaya avasthāyām sarva kārya saṃskāra upagamāt sarvatra ca vināśa mātra prayukta saṃskāra janma anumānāt avidyā tad kāryasya bhrānti jñāna ātmaka tvāt ajñāna ādau ca sākṣi caitanya avacchedaka jñāna ābhāsa upagamāt saṃskāra siddheḥ

original: nanu saṃskārāt smṛtimātrahetoḥ kathamaparokṣadvaitāvabhāsaḥ syāt avidyāvat saṃskārasyāpi caitanyadoṣatvāditi vadāmaḥ| aparokṣāvabhāsakāraṇagato doṣo'parokṣabhramaheturiti siddhatvāt ātmamātrasyaiva avidyāśrayatvāt saṃskārāśrayatvopapatteśca, avidyāsaṃskāravyatiriktakāryāṇāmeva avidyopādānatvāt|
analyzed: nanu saṃskārāt smṛti mātra hetoḥ katham aparokṣa dvaita avabhāsaḥ syāt avidyā vat saṃskārasya api caitanya doṣa tvāt iti vadāmaḥ aparokṣa avabhāsa kāraṇa gataḥ doṣa uparokṣa bhrama hetuḥ iti siddha tvāt ātma mātrasya eva avidyā āśraya tvāt saṃskāra āśraya tva upapatteḥ ca avidyā saṃskāra vyatirikta kāryāṇām eva avidyā upādāna tvāt

original: ātmano mithyābhūtasaṃskāropādānatvābhāve'pi āśrayopādhitvasya avidyopādhitvavadavirodhāt| tattvajñānānusandhānādeva ca krameṇa saṃskāranivṛtteḥ kaṃcit kālamavasthāyaiva videhamuktiḥ na virudhyate, avidyāleśo vā tamoleśavat saṃskāraśabdenābhidhīyate iti niravadyam||
analyzed: ātmanaḥ mithyā bhūta saṃskāra upādāna tva abhāve pi āśraya upādhi tvasya avidyā upādhi tva vat avirodhāt tattva jñāna anusandhānāt eva ca krameṇa saṃskāra nivṛtteḥ kaṃcid kālam avasthāya eva videha muktiḥ na virudhyate avidyā leśaḥ vā tamaḥ leśa vat saṃskāra śabdena abhidhīyate iti niravadyam

original: nanu na sarve vedāntā iti spaṣṭārthaḥ| tatra nirviśeṣabrahmapratipattyartheṣu vedanteṣu saguṇabrahmopāsanānāṃ tāvat prāsaṅgikatvaṃ darśayati -- satyam upāsanākarma tviti|| nanu nirviśeṣaṃ cet brahma pratipādyam, tasya kathaṃ saguṇopāsanālambanaṃ saprapañcaṃ brahma aṅgabhūtaṃ syāt yenāśritya vidhānamucyate iti;

analyzed: tatra uktaḥ tāvat vicāra vidheḥ phala anubandhaḥ vyavahita viṣaya brahma ātmatā anubandhaḥ ca idānīm avyavahita vicāra viṣaya anubandham anyatas eva aprāpta anuṣṭhānam darśayitum prathamam ākṣipati siddhā eva nanu brahma jijñāsā iti vedāntānām artha nirṇaya apekṣitaḥ nyāya kalāpaḥ atha atas dharma jijñāsā ityādi sūtraiḥ sūtritaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu vidhivākyārthanirṇayastatra pravṛttaḥ ityāśaṅkyāha -- sakalavedārthasya vicāritatvāditi| vedasya kāryamātraparatvādityarthaḥ| nanu -- vedāntatātparyāt brahmāvagamyate, na kāryam, anavagamyaṃ ca na vākyaprameyamiti, tatrāha -- brahmajñānasya ceti||
analyzed: nanu vidhi vākya artha nirṇayaḥ tatra pravṛttaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha sakala veda arthasya vicārita tvāt iti vedasya kārya mātra paratvāt iti arthaḥ nanu vedānta tātparyāt brahma avagamyate na kāryam anavagamyam ca na vākya prameyam iti tatra āha brahma jñānasya ca iti

original: nanu kriyāvidhikalāpo nirūpitaḥ, jñānavidhinirūpaṇāyedamārabhyata iti, netyāha -- ataḥ siddhaiveti|| utpattiviniyogaprayogādhikārāṇāṃ vidhyapekṣitarūpāṇāṃ kriyāpratipattyoḥ aviśeṣeṇa nirūpitatvādityarthaḥ||
analyzed: nanu kriyā vidhi kalāpaḥ nirūpitaḥ jñāna vidhi nirūpaṇāya idam ārabhyate iti na iti āha atas siddhā eva iti utpatti viniyoga prayoga adhikārāṇām vidhi apekṣita rūpāṇām kriyā pratipattyoḥ aviśeṣeṇa nirūpita tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu -- yathā prathame'dhyāye vedasya prāmāṇyaṃ nirūpitam; dvitīye karmotpattividhibhedaḥ; tṛtīye vihitānāmaṅgāṅgibhāvo nirūpitaḥ; caturthe kratupuruṣārthaprayuktānuṣṭheyaparimāṇam; pañcame anuṣṭhānakramaḥ; ṣaṣṭhe
analyzed: nanu yathā prathama adhyāye vedasya prāmāṇyam nirūpitam dvitīye karma utpatti vidhi bhedaḥ tṛtīye vihitānām aṅga aṅgi bhāvaḥ nirūpitaḥ caturthe kratu puruṣa artha prayukta anuṣṭheya parimāṇam pañcame anuṣṭhāna kramaḥ ṣaṣṭhe

original: vidhyapekṣito'dhikāranirṇayaḥ; iti pūrvaṣaṭkena prakṛtividhyapekṣito vicāraḥ kṛtaḥ| samagrāṅgasaṃyukto vidhiḥ prakṛtiḥ vikalāṅgasaṃyukto vikṛtirityucyate| tatra saptamena prakṛtyupadiṣṭānāmaṅgānāṃ vikṛtāvatideśo nirṇītaḥ|
analyzed: vidhi apekṣita adhikāra nirṇayaḥ iti pūrva ṣaṭkena prakṛti vidhi apekṣitaḥ vicāraḥ kṛtaḥ samagra aṅga saṃyuktaḥ vidhiḥ prakṛtiḥ vikala aṅga saṃyuktaḥ vikṛtiḥ iti ucyate tatra saptamena prakṛti upadiṣṭānām aṅgānām vikṛtau atideśaḥ nirṇītaḥ

original: aṣṭame tu "āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ" ityādiprakṛtyupadiṣṭānāmaṅgānāṃ "sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet" ityādivikṛtau dravyadevatādisāmānyadvāreṇa viśeṣātideśo nirūpitaḥ; navame tu prakṛtyupadiṣṭamantrasāmasaṃskārakarmaṇāṃ vikṛtāvatidiṣṭānāṃ prakṛtivikṛtyordravyadevatābhede sati prakṛtigatadravyādiśabdaṃ vihāya vikṛtigatadravyādiśabdādhyāhāralakṣaṇa ūho darśitaḥ;
analyzed: aṣṭame tu āgneya uṣṭākapālaḥ ityādi prakṛti upadiṣṭānām aṅgānām sauryam carum nirvapet iti ādi vikṛtau dravya devatā ādi sāmānya dvāreṇa viśeṣa atideśaḥ nirūpitaḥ navame tu prakṛti upadiṣṭa mantra sāma saṃskāra karmaṇām vikṛtau atidiṣṭānām prakṛti vikṛtyoḥ dravya devatā bhede sati prakṛti gata dravya ādi śabdam vihāya vikṛti gata dravya ādi śabda adhyāhāra lakṣaṇaḥ ūhaḥ darśitaḥ

original: yathā -- "agnaye juṣṭam" iti mantrasya vikṛtau "sūryāya juṣṭa"miti padaprakṣepaḥ; daśame tu vikṛtāvatidiṣṭānāmaṅgānāṃ prakṛtau sāvakāśānāṃ vikṛtigataviśeṣāṅgopadeśādinā bādho darśitaḥ, yathā prakṛteḥ vikṛtāvatideśaprāptānāṃ barhiṣāṃ "śaramayaṃ barhi"riti vikṛtau viśeṣopadeśena bādhaḥ;
analyzed: yathā agnaye juṣṭam iti mantrasya vikṛtau sūryāya juṣṭam iti pada prakṣepaḥ daśame tu vikṛtau atidiṣṭānām aṅgānām prakṛtau sa avakāśānām vikṛti gata viśeṣa aṅga upadeśa ādinā bādhaḥ darśitaḥ yathā prakṛteḥ vikṛtau atideśa prāptānām barhiṣām śara mayam barhiḥ iti vikṛtau viśeṣa upadeśena bādhaḥ

original: ekādaśe tu anekaśeṣividhiprayuktasya śeṣasya sakṛdanuṣṭhānādeva sarvaśeṣiṇāmupakārasāmyaṃ tantraṃ nāmoktam -- yathā "yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ" "upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati" "agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālam" iti ca paurṇamāsakarmatrayaprayuktasya prayājādeḥ sakṛdanuṣṭhānādeva śeṣitrayopakāraḥ iti;
analyzed: ekādaśe tu aneka śeṣi vidhi prayuktasya śeṣasya sakṛt anuṣṭhānāt eva sarva śeṣiṇām upakāra sāmyam tantram nāma uktam yathā yat āgneya uṣṭākapālaḥ upāṃśuyājam antarā yajati agnīṣomīyam ekādaśa kapālam iti ca paurṇamāsa karma traya prayuktasya prayāja ādeḥ sakṛt anuṣṭhānāt eva śeṣi traya upakāraḥ iti

original: dvādaśe tu ekaśeṣiprayuktasya śeṣānuṣṭhānasya aprayojakasāmarthyayuktaśeṣyantare'pi upakāraḥ prasaṅgo nāma darśitaḥ -- yathā paśuvidhiprayuktānāmaṅgānāṃ paśupuroḍāśe'pyupakāraḥ|
analyzed: dvādaśe tu eka śeṣi prayuktasya śeṣa anuṣṭhānasya aprayojaka sāmarthya yukta śeṣi antare api upakāraḥ prasaṅgaḥ nāma darśitaḥ yathā paśu vidhi prayuktānām aṅgānām paśupuroḍāśe api upakāraḥ

original: tadevaṃ pratyadhyāyamāśaṅkāntaranirākaraṇena vidhyaṃśabhedo nirūpitaḥ, tathā pratipattavyasya brahmaṇaḥ pratyakṣādibhirasiddhatvāt pratipattividhyayogāśaṅkāyāṃ tannirākaraṇābhedamārabhyata iti, tatrāha -- adhikāśaṅkā'bhāvāditi|| yūpāhavanīyādivat brahmaṇaḥ siddhiḥ, asiddhau vā āropitarūpeṇaivopāsanasiddhirityarthaḥ||
analyzed: tat evam pratyadhyāyam āśaṅkā antara nirākaraṇena vidhi aṃśa bhedaḥ nirūpitaḥ tathā pratipattavyasya brahmaṇaḥ pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ asiddha tvāt pratipatti vidhi ayoga āśaṅkāyām tad nirākaraṇa abhedam ārabhyate iti tatra āha adhika āśaṅkā bhāvāt iti yūpa āhavanīya ādi vat brahmaṇaḥ siddhiḥ asiddhau vā āropita rūpeṇa eva upāsana siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: atra pūrvavādī siddhāntyekadeśīyān dūṣayituṃ vedāntānāṃ vidhiniṣṭhatvamaṅgīkṛtyaiva yā abhyadhikāśaṅkā tannirākaraṇāyaiva teṣāmārambhaprakāraṃ darśayati -- atra keciditi||
analyzed: atra pūrvavādī siddhānti eka deśīyān dūṣayitum vedāntānām vidhi niṣṭhatvam aṅgīkṛtya eva yā abhyadhikā āśaṅkā tad nirākaraṇāya eva teṣām ārambha prakāram darśayati atra kecid iti

original: nanu kvacideva vidhiśravaṇe'pi tadākāṅkṣitānubandhasamarpaṇena vyavahitamapi vedāntavākyajātaṃ tadekavākyatayā saṃbadhyate, kiṃ sarvatra vidhiśravaṇena ityāśaṅkyāha -- yatrāpi vidhiḥ śrūyata iti|| tatrāpi vidheranupapattiritibhāvaḥ||
analyzed: nanu kvacid eva vidhi śravaṇe api tad ākāṅkṣita anubandha samarpaṇena vyavahitam api vedānta vākya jātam tad ekavākyatayā saṃbadhyate kim sarvatra vidhi śravaṇena iti āśaṅkya āha yatra api vidhiḥ śrūyate iti tatra api vidheḥ anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu bhāvakarmaṇorvihitānāmapi kṛtyapratyayānāṃ "kṛtyāśca iti vidhau smaraṇāt tavyapratyayena jñānaṃ vidhīyate iti, tatrāha -- tatra yadyapi kṛtyā iti|| tathāpīha vidhirna sambhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu gantavyamiti gamanavidhānavat jñānaṃ vidhīyatām, satyam -- yuktaṃ bhāvaviṣaye tavyapratyaye vidhānamityāha -- yo bhāvābhidhāyīti||
analyzed: nanu bhāva karmaṇoḥ vihitānām api kṛtya pratyayānām kṛtyāḥ ca iti vidhau smaraṇāt tavya pratyayena jñānam vidhīyate iti tatra āha tatra yadi api kṛtyāḥ iti tathā api iha vidhiḥ na sambhavati iti arthaḥ nanu gantavyam iti gamana vidhāna vat jñānam vidhīyatām satyam yuktam bhāva viṣaye tavya pratyaye vidhānam iti āha yaḥ bhāva abhidhāyī iti

original: bhāva iti dhātvarthamātramucyate| tat prādhānyena svatantraphalāya vidhātuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ| nanu karmābhidhāyitavyapratyayādapi dhātvarthaviṣayo vidhiravagamyate -- "svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ" iti, tatrāha -- yatra punaḥ karma prādhānyenocyata iti||
analyzed: bhāvaḥ iti dhātvartha mātram ucyate tat prādhānyena svatantra phalāya vidhātum śakyate iti arthaḥ nanu karma abhidhāyitavya pratyayāt api dhātvartha viṣayaḥ vidhiḥ avagamyate svādhyāya udhyetavyaḥ iti tatra āha yatra punar karma prādhānyena ucyate iti

original: tatrāpi svatantraphalāya vā karma vidhīyate kiṃ vā karmakārakagataphalāya iti tatra na tāvat svatantraphalāyetyāha -- tatra dravye guṇabhūtāmiti|| atha karmakārakasamavāyiphalāya vidhiḥ tatrāha -- dravyaparatve iti|| nana ātmani vihitakriyāsāmarthyāt ajñānādharmādimalāpakarṣaḥ saṃskāraḥ syāditi, netyāha -- saṃskṛtasya ceti||
analyzed: tatra api svatantra phalāya vā karma vidhīyate kim vā karmakāraka gata phalāya iti tatra na tāvat svatantra phalāya iti āha tatra dravye guṇa bhūtām iti atha karma kāraka samavāyi phalāya vidhiḥ tatra āha dravya paratve iti ātmani vihita kriyā sāmarthyāt ajñāna adharma ādi mala apakarṣaḥ saṃskāraḥ syāt iti na iti āha saṃskṛtasya ca iti

original: tatra "saktūn juhoti" iti kratuprakaraṇe śravaṇāt kratvaṅgatā saktuhomasya avagatā||
analyzed: tatra saktūn juhoti iti kratu prakaraṇe śravaṇāt kratu aṅga tā saktu homasya avagatā

original: tatra aṅgāni ca dvividhāni -- arthakarmāṇi saṃskārakarmāṇi ca|| kratūpakārakāṇyanāśritya svātantryeṇa vihitāni prayājādīnyarthakarmāṇi, vrīhyādikārakaguṇabhūtāni saṃskārakarmāṇi| tatra na tāvat saktuhomasya arthakarmatā; saktudravyasya guṇabhūtatvāt prokṣaṇādivat|
analyzed: tatra aṅgāni ca dvividhāni artha karmāṇi saṃskāra karmāṇi ca kratu upakārakāṇi an āśritya svātantryeṇa vihitāni prayāja ādīni artha karmāṇi vrīhi ādi kāraka guṇa bhūtāni saṃskāra karmāṇi tatra na tāvat saktu homasya artha karma tā saktu dravyasya guṇa bhūta tvāt prokṣaṇa ādi vat

original: saṃskārakarma ca dvividham -- viniyuktasaṃskāraḥ -- yathā "vrīhibhiryajeta" iti viniyuktavrīhīnuddiśya prokṣaṇādisaṃskāraḥ, kaścidviniyokṣyamāṇasaṃskāraḥ -- yathā "āhavanīye juhoti" iti viniyokṣyamāṇasya ādhānena saṃskāraḥ; saṃskṛtasya viniyoga ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: saṃskāra karma ca dvividham viniyukta saṃskāraḥ yathā vrīhibhiḥ yajeta iti viniyukta vrīhīn uddiśya prokṣaṇa ādi saṃskāraḥ kaścid viniyokṣyamāṇa saṃskāraḥ yathā āhavanīye juhoti iti viniyokṣyamāṇasya ādhānena saṃskāraḥ saṃskṛtasya viniyogaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tatra homena bhasmīkṛtānāṃ saktūnāmubhayathāpi kratau viniyogābhāvāt vaiyarthyāyogācca saṃskārakarmatvaṃ parityajya "saktūni"ti prādhānyaṃ ca vihāya saktubhiriti guṇabhāvena karmaprādhānyamupādāya arthakarmatā nirūpitā yathā;
analyzed: tatra homena bhasmīkṛtānām saktūnām ubhayathā api kratau viniyoga abhāvāt vaiyarthya ayogāt ca saṃskāra karma tvam parityajya saktūn iti prādhānyam ca vihāya saktubhiḥ iti guṇa bhāvena karma prādhānyam upādāya artha karmatā nirūpitā yathā

original: tathā "ātmānamiti" sādhyatayā prādhānyaṃ vihāya "ātmanopāsīta" iti guṇatvopagamena svatantraphalāyopāsanaṃ prādhānyena vidhīyatāmiti śaṅkate -- atha punarviparīta iti||
analyzed: tathā ātmānam iti sādhyatayā prādhānyam vihāya ātmanā upāsīta iti guṇatva upagamena svatantra phalāya upāsanam prādhānyena vidhīyatām iti śaṅkate atha punar viparītaḥ iti

original: tatra yathā homaprādhānye'pi sakarmakatvāddhātoḥ saktava eva karmakārakatayā bhasmīkriyante, evamavagamasyāpi sakarmatvādarthataḥ karmābhāve na vidhānamiti pariharati -- tatrāpi na jñāyata iti|| śabdataḥ karaṇatve'pyarthataḥ
analyzed: tatra yathā homa prādhānye api sakarmaka tvāt dhātoḥ saktavaḥ eva karma kārakatayā bhasmīkriyante evam avagamasya api sa karma tvāt arthataḥ karma abhāve na vidhānam iti pariharati tatra api na jñāyate iti śabdataḥ karaṇa tve pi arthataḥ

original: karmatā ātmana evetyāśaṅkate -- atha jñāyata iti|| tarhi karmakārakatve sati ātmani kaścidatiśayo vaktavyaḥ, tadabhāvānniṣkarmakaṃ jñānaṃ na vidhātuṃ śakyata ityāha -- evaṃ tarhi tadevāyātamiti|| nanu avabhāsyatayā avāptirātmani vidheyakriyāphalamiti, netyāha -- tacca kṛtakaraṇamanarthakamiti||
analyzed: karmatā ātmanaḥ eva iti āśaṅkate atha jñāyate iti tarhi karma kāraka tve sati ātmani kaścid atiśayaḥ vaktavyaḥ tad abhāvāt niṣkarmakam jñānam na vidhātum śakyate iti āha evam tarhi tat eva āyātam iti nanu avabhāsya tayā avāptiḥ ātmani vidheya kriyā phalam iti na iti āha tat ca kṛta karaṇam anarthakam iti

original: nityacaitanyena pratītito'vāptatvāt na jñānakarmatā ityarthaḥ||
analyzed: nitya caitanyena na jñāna karma tā iti arthaḥ

original: apare punaḥ ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| avidyādharmādinivṛttiḥ saṃskāraḥ, na ca saṃskṛtasya anyatra viniyogākāṅkṣā; svayaṃpuruṣārthatvāt puruṣārthasaṃskārasya ca viniyogāpekṣatvāt tadarthamārabhyate iti pṛthagārambhavādino matam||
analyzed: apare punar iti atas prāktanaḥ granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ avidyā dharma ādi nivṛttiḥ saṃskāraḥ na ca saṃskṛtasya anyatra viniyoga ākāṅkṣā svayam puruṣa artha tvāt puruṣa artha saṃskārasya ca viniyoga apekṣa tvāt tad artham ārabhyate iti pṛthak ārambha vādinaḥ matam

original: apare punarevamārabhante ityāderayamarthaḥ -- pratipattividhyapekṣito'pi caturvidho nyāyaḥ prathamatantre nirūpitaḥ| tatra tadviṣayasya brahmaṇo nirūpaṇāya śāstramārabdhavyamsa, tacca na saṃbhavati ; brahmaṇi pramāṇābhāvāt iti||
analyzed: apare punar evam ārabhante ityādeḥ ayam arthaḥ pratipatti vidhi apekṣitaḥ api caturvidhaḥ nyāyaḥ prathama tantre nirūpitaḥ tatra tad viṣayasya brahmaṇaḥ nirūpaṇāya śāstram ārabdhavyam sa tat ca na saṃbhavati brahmaṇi pramāṇa abhāvāt iti

original: atrocyate ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| adhikāriniyogaviṣayatayeti|| ayamarthaḥ -- jñānasya phalasambandho'vagamyate, tatphalakāminā tadanuṣṭheyam, niyogācca anuṣṭhānamiti phalakāminiyogaviṣayatā avagamāditi bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: atrā ucyate iti atas prāktanaḥ granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ adhikāri niyoga viṣaya tayā iti ayam arthaḥ jñānasya phala sambandhaḥ uvagamyate tad phala kāminā tat anuṣṭheyam niyogāt ca anuṣṭhānam iti phala kāmi niyoga viṣaya tā avagamāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: atrocyate ityādinā ārambhadvayaṃ pūrvavādī nirācaṣṭe| yadi loke kṛtyapratyayo na niyogaṃ gamayatīti śaṅkate tannāstītyāha -- tat svayameveti|| atha vede, tatrāha -- prasiddhaṃ caitaditi| ataḥ prathamasūtreṇa adhyayanavidhimaṅgīkurvatāṃ gata evāyaṃ vicāra ityarthaḥ| nanu caturvidhasya ityādiruktārthaḥ|
analyzed: atra ucyate ityādinā ārambha dvayam pūrvavādī nirācaṣṭe yadi loke kṛtya pratyayaḥ na niyogam gamayati iti śaṅkate tat na asti iti āha tat svayam eva iti atha vede tatra āha prasiddham ca etat iti atas prathama sūtreṇa adhyayana vidhim aṅgīkurvatām gataḥ eva ayam vicāraḥ iti arthaḥ nanu caturvidhasya ityādiḥ uktārthaḥ

original: nanu aikāgryadvāreṇa āparokṣyanimittatvād dṛṣṭadvāreṇāpi pravartatāmiti codayati -- nanu kimatra śravaṇeneti|| parihāragranthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| ato jñānadvayābhāvāt ekasya jñānasya ubhayārthatā'yogāt na brahmajñānaṃ vidheyamiti bhāvaḥ||
analyzed: nanu aikāgrya dvāreṇa āparokṣya nimitta tvāt dṛṣṭa dvāreṇa api pravartatām iti codayati nanu kim atra śravaṇena iti parihāra granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ atas jñāna dvaya abhāvāt ekasya jñānasya ubhaya artha tā yogāt na brahma jñānam vidheyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yatpunariti spaṣṭārthaḥ| na sthāyivastudṛṣṭāntena tātparyasāpekṣaśabdavyāpāranirṇaya ityāha -- yuktaṃ tatreti|| nanu "samidho yajati" "tanūnapātaṃ yajati" "iḍo yajati" "barhiryajati" "svāhākāraṃ yajati" iti pañca vākyāni pañca padārthān vidhāya teṣāṃ kramamapi vidadhāti| ataḥ śabdasyaiva dvaiyarthyamityuktamanuvadati -- yadapīdamuktamiti||
analyzed: yat punar iti spaṣṭa arthaḥ na sthāyi vastu dṛṣṭāntena tātparya sāpekṣa śabda vyāpāra nirṇayaḥ iti āha yuktam tatra iti nanu samidhaḥ yajati tanūnapātam yajati iḍaḥ yajati barhiḥ yajati svāhākāram yajati iti pañca vākyāni pañca padārthān vidhāya teṣām kramam api vidadhāti atas śabdasya eva dvaiyarthyam iti uktam anuvadati yat api idam uktam iti

original: padārthā eva śabdagamyāḥ, kramastvarthāpattigamyo na śabdagamya iti pariharati -- yattāvat pratyekamiti|| ye tāvadityarthaḥ| teṣāmeva| na kramasya vidhānamityadhyāhāraḥ|
analyzed: padārthāḥ eva śabda gamyāḥ kramaḥ tu arthāpatti gamyaḥ na śabda gamyaḥ iti pariharati yat tāvat pratyekam iti ye tāvat iti arthaḥ teṣām eva na kramasya vidhānam iti adhyāhāraḥ

original: kiṃ padārthebhyo'rthāntarabhūtasya kramasya vākyaiḥ pratipādanamucyate kiṃ vā kiṃ vā padārthamātrasyaiva kramasya pratipādanamiti na tāvat uttaraḥ kalpa ityāha -- nāpi te kramaśabdābhidheyā iti|| nanu vihitamaṅgaṃ bhavati, aṅgaṃ ca prayuṅkte prayogavidhiḥ;
analyzed: kim padārthebhyaḥ ṛtha antara bhūtasya kramasya vākyaiḥ pratipādanam ucyate kim vā kim vā padārtha mātrasya eva kramasya pratipādanam iti na tāvat uttaraḥ kalpaḥ iti āha na api te krama śabda abhidheyāḥ iti nanu vihitam aṅgam bhavati aṅgam ca prayuṅkte prayoga vidhiḥ

original: ataḥ prayogavacanaprayojyatvena kramasyāpi vidheyatve vākyebhya eva apadārthasyāpi kramasya vidhireṣṭavya iti, netyāha -- prayogavacano'pīti|| vihitasyaiva prayojyatvāt padārthānāmeva vihitatvādityarthaḥ| anyathā vihite prayogavidhiḥ, prayogavidhau na vidhikalpanā itītaretarāśrayāt|
analyzed: atas prayoga vacana prayojya tvena kramasya api vidheya tve vākyebhyaḥ eva apadārthasya api kramasya vidhiḥ eṣṭavyaḥ iti na iti āha prayoga vacana upi iti vihitasya eva prayojya tvāt padārthānām eva vihita tvāt iti arthaḥ anyathā vihite prayoga vidhiḥ prayoga vidhau na vidhi kalpanā iti itaretarāśrayāt

original: nanu padārthā eva kramaḥ, tasmāt padārthān prayuñjānaḥ kramamapi prayuṅkte iti, netyāha -- na te krama ityuktamiti||
analyzed: nanu padārthāḥ eva kramaḥ tasmāt padārthān prayuñjānaḥ kramam api prayuṅkte iti na iti āha na te kramaḥ iti uktam iti

original: apara āha -- na kramo nāma kaścidasti, ekaikasmin padārthe'darśanāt, anekapadārthāśrayatve padārthayaugapadyāt kramāyogāt, ayaugapadye ca ubhayāśrayadharmāyogāditi ; tatrāha -- na ca kramo nāmeti|| nanu saṃyogavat ubhayāśrayatve padārthayaugapadyamityuktam, tatrāha -- tatra kramo nāma vastubhūta iti|| kramatvādeva na yaugapadyāpekṣeti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: aparaḥ āha na kramaḥ nāma kaścid asti ekaikasmin padārthe darśanāt aneka padārtha āśraya tve padārtha yaugapadyāt krama ayogāt ayaugapadye ca ubhaya āśraya dharma ayogāt iti tatra āha na ca kramaḥ nāma iti nanu saṃyoga vat ubhaya āśraya tve padārtha yaugapadyam iti uktam tatra āha tatra kramaḥ nāma vastu bhūtaḥ iti krama tvāt eva na yaugapadya apekṣā iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu deśakālavastūpādhiparāmarśamantareṇa kramo na dṛśyate iti, tadāha -- ta eveti|| nanu anuṣṭheyapadārthānāmaniṣpannasvabhāvatvāt na deśakālavastukrama iti, tatrāha -- smṛtivijñānameveti|| pāṭhakrama eva smaryamāṇo'nuṣṭheyapadārtheṣūparajyate ityarthaḥ| sarvathe ityupasaṃhāraḥ|
analyzed: nanu deśa kāla vastu upādhi parāmarśam antareṇa kramaḥ na dṛśyate iti tat āha te eva iti nanu anuṣṭheya padārthānām aniṣpanna svabhāva tvāt na deśa kāla vastu kramaḥ iti tatra āha smṛti vijñānam eva iti pāṭha kramaḥ eva smaryamāṇaḥ unuṣṭheya padārtheṣu uparajyate iti arthaḥ sarvathe iti upasaṃhāraḥ

original: nanu kramasya vidhāyakaṃ vaktavyam, na;kramasya avidheyatvāt, kiṃtu anuṣṭheyaviśeṣaṇatayā pramīyate kramaḥ, na vidhīyate ; ananuṣṭheyatvāt| kena tarhi pramīyate ekasyānekapadārthaprayogānupapattyetyāha -- taccaikattvāt karturiti|| sannihitaṃ ceti|| arthakramābhāve pāṭhakrama ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu kramasya vidhāyakam vaktavyam na kramasya avidheya tvāt kiṃtu anuṣṭheya viśeṣaṇatayā pramīyate kramaḥ na vidhīyate ananuṣṭheya tvāt kena tarhi pramīyate ekasya aneka padārtha prayoga anupapattyā iti āha tat ca ekattvāt kartuḥ iti sannihitam ca iti artha krama abhāve pāṭha kramaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tasmāt sarvatra pramāṇadvayenaiva prameyadvayasiddhiriti prakaraṇārthaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt sarvatra pramāṇa dvayena eva prameya dvaya siddhiḥ iti prakaraṇa arthaḥ

original: na tatheha jñānadvayaṃ ityārabhya vedo'vagamayati itiparyantaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| prativastusaṃprayogaṃ nirapekṣameva pramāṇaṃ cakṣuḥ, na tathā pratipadārthaṃ pramāṇaṃ śabdaḥ, kintu yatra tātparyaṃ, tatra sambhūyaiva pramāṇamityāha -- yuktaṃ tatra yadyadavabodhayatīti||
analyzed: na tathā iha jñāna dvayam iti ārabhya vedaḥ uvagamayati iti paryantaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ prati vastu saṃprayogam nirapekṣam eva pramāṇam cakṣuḥ na tathā prati padārtham pramāṇam śabdaḥ kintu yatra tātparyam tatra sambhūya eva pramāṇam iti āha yuktam tatra yat yat avabodhayati iti

original: nanvābhidhānikamātmatattvajñānaṃ prameyaparameva mā bhūt, kintu vidhiviṣayatayā vidhāyakapadajanyavidhipramitiviṣayatvena vidhiśeṣa ityāha -- mā bhūditi|| kathaṃ tarhi brahmātmasiddhiriti tatrāha -- tasmin vihite'rthāditi|| nanu kasyānupapattyā tattvasiddhiriti tadāha -- saviṣayatvāditi|| avagamasidhyanyathānupapatyaivetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu ābhidhānikam ātma tattva jñānam prameya param eva mā bhūt kintu vidhi viṣayatayā vidhāyaka pada janya vidhi pramiti viṣayatvena vidhi śeṣaḥ iti āha mā bhūt iti katham tarhi brahma ātma siddhiḥ iti tatra āha tasmin vihita īrthāt iti nanu kasya anupapattyā tattva siddhiḥ iti tat āha saviṣayatvāt iti avagama sidhi anyathā anupapatyā eva iti arthaḥ

original: pariharati -- evamapyavivakṣito'rtha iti|| ekasminviṣaye prathamapratipattirapramāṇaṃ, tasminneva dvitīyajñānaṃ pramāṇamiti-śrutiśca na pramāṇaṃ śrutyarthāpattiśca pramāṇamityādi viruddhamityarthaḥ| kiñcāvagamavidhānānupapattirnāvagamyasya vastutvaṃ gamayatītyāha -- naca niyogata iti nanu jñānasya svataḥpramāṇyāt tathābhūtārthataiva yuktā;
analyzed: pariharati evam api avivakṣitaḥ ṛthaḥ iti ekasmin viṣaye prathama pratipattiḥ apramāṇam tasmin eva dvitīya jñānam pramāṇam iti śrutiḥ ca na pramāṇam śruti arthāpattiḥ ca pramāṇam ityādi viruddham iti arthaḥ kiñca avagama vidhāna anupapattiḥ na avagamyasya vastu tvam gamayati iti āha na ca niyogataḥ iti nanu jñānasya svatas pramāṇyāt tathābhūta arthatā eva yuktā

original: anyathā āropitajñānasya vidhau prayojanābhāvāditi, tatrāha -- bhavanti hi parikalpitaviṣayā iti|| ābhidhānikapratyayasya vidhisaṃsargāt prāgapi svataḥprāmāṇyaṃ kiṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu vidheyajñānasyāpi svaviṣayapramitireva dṛṣṭaṃ phalam, tat parityajya āropitaviṣayatve adṛṣṭakalpanā syāditi, tatrāha -- etadevātra yuktimiti||
analyzed: anyathā āropita jñānasya vidhau prayojana abhāvāt iti tatra āha bhavanti hi parikalpita viṣayāḥ iti ābhidhānika pratyayasya vidhi saṃsargāt prāk api svatas prāmāṇyam kim na syāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu vidheya jñānasya api sva viṣaya pramitiḥ eva dṛṣṭam phalam tat parityajya āropita viṣaya tve adṛṣṭa kalpanā syāt iti tatra āha etat eva atra yuktim iti

original: sakalapramāṇavirodhena dṛṣṭakalpanādadṛṣṭakalpanameva yuktamityarthaḥ| "tasmāt kāryaniṣṭhe vede" iti anārambhavādī siddhāntyekadeśīyadūṣaṇamupasaṃharati||
analyzed: sakala pramāṇa virodhena dṛṣṭa kalpanāt adṛṣṭa kalpanam eva yuktam iti arthaḥ tasmāt kārya niṣṭhe vede iti anārambha vādī siddhānti eka deśīya dūṣaṇam upasaṃharati

original: nanu vedāntānāṃ dharmabrahmaviṣayatvābhāve adhyayanavidhyupāttānāmānarthakyaṃ syāditi, netyāha -- evaṃ ca satyayamātmā brahmetyādinā||
analyzed: nanu vedāntānām dharma brahma viṣaya tva abhāve adhyayana vidhi upāttānām ānarthakyam syāt iti na iti āha evam ca sati ayam ātmā brahma ityādinā

original: tatra ātmano vedāntasaṅkīrtitasamastaguṇaviśiṣṭasyopāsanotpattividhau śamādītikartavyopasaṃhāreṇa viniyogavidhau mokṣakāmaniyojyasambandhitayā cādhikāravidhau sāṅge karmaṇyadhikāriṇo'nuṣṭhāpakatayā ca prayogavidhau vedāntāḥ paryavasyanti; tacca sarvaṃ nirūpitamiti|
analyzed: tatra ātmanaḥ vedānta saṅkīrtita samasta guṇa viśiṣṭasya upāsana utpatti vidhau śama ādi itikartavya upasaṃhāreṇa viniyoga vidhau mokṣa kāma niyojya sambandhi tayā ca adhikāra vidhau sa aṅge karmaṇi adhikāriṇaḥ anuṣṭhāpaka tayā ca prayoga vidhau vedāntāḥ paryavasyanti tat ca sarvam nirūpitam iti

original: atra kiṃ śabdānāṃ kāryānvitasvārthāvabodhasāmarthyāt sarvo vedaḥ kāryaparatayā nirūpita ityucyate kiṃ vā sūtrakārādyabhiyuktavacanasāmarthyāditi na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ; samanvayasūtre tasya nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt| abhiyuktavacanasāmarthyācceti, tatrāha -- syādetadevaṃ yadi sarva eva vedārtha iti||
analyzed: atra kim śabdānām kārya anvita sva artha avabodha sāmarthyāt sarvaḥ vedaḥ kārya para tayā nirūpitaḥ iti ucyate kim vā sūtrakāra ādi abhiyukta vacana sāmarthyāt iti na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ samanvaya sūtre tasya nirākariṣyamāṇa tvāt abhiyukta vacana sāmarthyāt ca iti tatra āha syāt etat evam yadi sarvaḥ eva veda arthaḥ iti

original: nanu dharmasyaivopakrāntatve'pi prāsaṅgikatvenedaṃ brahma nirūpitamiti, netyāha -- vicāritaśceti|| kathamavagamyate ca vedārthopādho vicāraḥ pravṛtta iti sūtrabhāṣyavārtikakāravacanasāmarthyādityāha -- yāvatā kāryaniṣṭha eveti||
analyzed: nanu dharmasya eva upakrāntatve pi prāsaṅgika tvena idam brahma nirūpitam iti na iti āha vicāritaḥ ca iti katham avagamyate ca veda artha upādhaḥ vicāraḥ pravṛttaḥ iti sūtra bhāṣya vārtikakāra vacana sāmarthyāt iti āha yāvatā kārya niṣṭhaḥ eva iti

original: atrāyamāśayaḥ -- athāto dharmajijñāsā| dharmamīmāṃsāśāstra viṣayaḥ| tat kimārambhaṇīyaṃ na veti vicāraḥ| nārambhaṇīyamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ; vicāryamāṇārthanirṇaye pratyakṣādīnāmasādhanatvāt āmnāyasya cādhyayanavidhānā adṛṣṭārthatayā viniyogāt| tadarthamadhyayanavidhiḥ adṛṣṭārtho dṛṣṭārtho veti vicāryate|
analyzed: atra ayam āśayaḥ atha atas dharma jijñāsā dharma mīmāṃsā śāstra viṣayaḥ tat kim ārambhaṇīyam na vā iti vicāraḥ na ārambhaṇīyam iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ vicāryamāṇa artha nirṇaye pratyakṣa ādīnām asādhana tvāt āmnāyasya ca adhyayana vidhānā adṛṣṭa artha tayā viniyogāt tad artham adhyayana vidhiḥ adṛṣṭa arthaḥ dṛṣṭa arthaḥ vā iti vicāryate

original: dṛṣṭasādhane vidherayogādadṛṣṭaniyamādvidheradṛṣṭārtha iti prāptam| nanu svādhyāyaḥ adhyayanakriyākarmatayā avagamyamānaḥ saṃskāryo vā, āpyo veti, dṛṣṭasambhave kathamadṛṣṭārthatā sambhavet na; saṃskṛtasya kratvantare viniyojakapramāṇābhāvāt| avāptasya ca niṣphalatvāt|
analyzed: dṛṣṭa sādhane vidheḥ ayogāt adṛṣṭa niyamāt vidheḥ adṛṣṭa arthaḥ iti prāptam nanu svādhyāyaḥ adhyayana kriyā karmatayā avagamyamānaḥ saṃskāryaḥ vā āpyaḥ vā iti dṛṣṭa sambhave katham adṛṣṭa artha tā sambhavet na saṃskṛtasya kratu antare viniyojaka pramāṇa abhāvāt avāptasya ca niṣphala tvāt

original: nanu avāptādāmnāyāt phalavadarthāvabodhe dṛṣṭaphale nādṛṣṭaṃ kalpayituṃ śakyate, na;dṛṣṭaphalasādhane anyata eva pravṛtteḥ vidhivaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| nanu karmakārakapradhānasyādhyayanasya kathaṃ svatantrādṛṣṭaphalatvaṃ kalpyate na;karmakārakasya vaiphalyāt saktunyāyena "svādhyāyenādhīyīte"ti vaiparītyakalpanāt|

original: japādhyayanaphalasya ghṛtakulyāderadhyayanatvasāmānyena prathamādhyayane'pyatidiśya rātrisatranyāyena "ghṛtakulyādikāmaḥ svādhyāyenādhīyīte"ti phalavipariṇāmāt| saṃskārakarmatvābhāvācca na phalaśruterarthavādatā|

original: nanvadṛṣṭārthatve'pi svābhāvikasyārthāvabodhasāmarthyasya kā hāniḥ na;viṣanirharaṇādikāryāntare viniyuktānāṃ mantrāṇāmarthavivakṣāpratibandhadarśanāt| tasmādāmnāyasyārthavivakṣā'bhāvāt pratyakṣādyaviṣayatvāt, pramāṇānugrāhakatvācca vicārasya nirālambano dharmavicāro nārabdhavya iti prāptam|| ārambhaṇīya evāyaṃ vicāra iti siddhāntaḥ;
analyzed: nanu adṛṣṭa artha tve pi svābhāvikasya artha avabodha sāmarthyasya kā hāniḥ na viṣa nirharaṇa ādi kārya antare viniyuktānām mantrāṇām artha vivakṣā pratibandha darśanāt tasmāt āmnāyasya artha vivakṣā bhāvāt pratyakṣa ādi aviṣaya tvāt pramāṇa anugrāhaka tvāt ca vicārasya nirālambanaḥ dharma vicāraḥ na ārabdhavyaḥ iti prāptam ārambhaṇīyaḥ eva ayam vicāraḥ iti siddhāntaḥ

original: tasya svādhyāyādhyayanavidhipramitakartavyatvāt||

original: nanu nirālambanatvamuktam, na; āmnāyasya ālambanatvāt| nanu adṛṣṭārtho'sau darśitaḥ, na; adhyayanasya karmakārakapradhānatvāt svatantrādṛṣṭārthatvāyogāt| nanu karmakārake na kiñcit prayojanamasti ityuktam, na; ubhayasyāpyupapatteḥ -- adhyayanena dṛṣṭadvāreṇa āpyate, sāṅgādhyayanavidhisāmarthyāt saṃskriyate ca svādhyāya iti|
analyzed: nanu nirālambana tvam uktam na āmnāyasya ālambana tvāt nanu adṛṣṭa arthaḥ usau darśitaḥ na adhyayanasya karma kāraka pradhāna tvāt svatantra adṛṣṭa artha tva ayogāt nanu karma kārake na kiñcid prayojanam asti iti uktam na ubhayasya api upapatteḥ adhyayanena dṛṣṭa dvāreṇa āpyate sa aṅga adhyayana vidhi sāmarthyāt saṃskriyate ca svādhyāyaḥ iti

original: nanu saṃskṛtasya viniyogābhāva uktaḥ, na; kratuvidhyupādānapramāṇādeva viniyogasiddheḥ| kratuvidhirhi svaviṣayāvabodhamākāṅkṣamāṇaḥ tasya janakatayā saṃskṛtaṃ svādhyāyamupādatte| nanu upādānapramāṇaṃ jñānasya janakatayā svādhyāyamātramādatte, na saṃskāramiti, satyam;
analyzed: nanu saṃskṛtasya viniyoga abhāvaḥ uktaḥ na kratu vidhi upādāna pramāṇāt eva viniyoga siddheḥ kratu vidhiḥ hi sva viṣaya avabodham ākāṅkṣamāṇaḥ tasya janaka tayā saṃskṛtam svādhyāyam upādatte nanu upādāna pramāṇam jñānasya janaka tayā svādhyāya mātram ādatte na saṃskāram iti satyam

original: adhyayanavidhisāmarthyādeva saṃskṛtasvādhyāyajanyaviśiṣṭajñānavataiva anuṣṭhito yāgo'pūrvaṃ janayatīti kalpyate| ataḥ vidhisāmarthyamīkṣamāṇaḥ kratuvidhiḥ svaviṣayajñānajanakatayā saṃskṛtaṃ svādhyāyamupādatte| nanu svatantrādṛṣṭaṃ kalpyatāmityuktam, na;
analyzed: adhyayana vidhi sāmarthyāt eva saṃskṛta svādhyāya janya viśiṣṭa jñānavatā eva anuṣṭhitaḥ yāga upūrvam janayati iti kalpyate atas vidhi sāmarthyam īkṣamāṇaḥ kratu vidhiḥ sva viṣaya jñāna janaka tayā saṃskṛtam svādhyāyam upādatte nanu svatantra adṛṣṭam kalpyatām iti uktam na ca asya adṛṣṭam kalpyatām iti uktam na ca asya adṛṣṭam kalpyatām iti uktam na ca asya adṛṣṭam kalpyatām iti uktam na ca asya adṛṣṭam kalpyatām iti uktam na

original: dṛṣṭārthākṣarasvīkaraṇatajjanyajñānādisamavāyyadṛṣṭasampattau śrutavirodhena kārakavaiparītyamādāya svatantrādṛṣṭakalpanānupapatteḥ| ādhānavadanaṅgasyāpyadhyayanasya kratūpakāritvaṃ na virudhyate| nanu tavyapratyayena prakṛtyarthoparaktamapūrvameva svatantramabhidhīyate, tanna;
analyzed: dṛṣṭārtha akṣara svīkaraṇa tad janya jñāna ādi samavāyi adṛṣṭa sampattau śruta virodhena kāraka vaiparītyam ādāya svatantra adṛṣṭa kalpanā anupapatteḥ ādhāna vat anaṅgasya api adhyayanasya kratu upakāri tvam na virudhyate nanu tavya pratyayena prakṛti artha uparaktam apūrvam eva svatantram abhidhīyate tat na asti

original: apūrvābhidhāne'pi bhinnapadopāttaprakṛtyarthoparaktāpūrvābhidhānāt varamekapadopāttakarmakārakagatāpūrvābhidhānam| bhāvārthajanyamapūrvaṃ na dravyādijanyamityetāvat, samavāyastu yatra kvāpi sambhavati| adṛṣṭārthatayā ca svādhyāyasya arthavivakṣā'bhāve adhyayanavidhivākyasyāpyarthavivakṣā'bhāvāt adṛṣṭārthatayā adhyayanavidhānameva na syāt|
analyzed: apūrva abhidhāne api bhinna pada upātta prakṛti artha uparakta apūrva abhidhānāt varam eka pada upātta karma kāraka gata apūrva abhidhānam bhāva artha janyam apūrvam na dravya ādi janyam iti etāvat samavāyaḥ tu yatra kvāpi sambhavati adṛṣṭa artha tayā ca svādhyāyasya artha vivakṣā bhāve adhyayana vidhi vākyasya api artha vivakṣā bhāvāt adṛṣṭa artha tayā adhyayana vidhānam eva na syāt

original: tasmāt sāṅgādhyayanavidhiprayuktādṛṣṭasya svasamavāyitayā akṣaragrahaṇārthāvabodhakratupravṛttyādidṛṣṭaphalasāpekṣatvāt svādhyāyasya svabhāvanimittārthāvabodhapratibandhakatā'bhāvāt vivakṣitārthamāmnāyamavalambya dharmavicāraḥ kartavya iti|
analyzed: tasmāt sa aṅga adhyayana vidhi prayukta adṛṣṭasya sva samavāyi tayā akṣara grahaṇa artha avabodha kratu pravṛtti ādi dṛṣṭa phala sāpekṣa tvāt svādhyāyasya svabhāva nimitta artha avabodha pratibandhaka tā bhāvāt vivakṣita artham āmnāyam avalambya dharma vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti

original: tadevamarthavivakṣādharmavicārāvasarapradarśanapare śāstrārambhe na sarvavedārthavicārasiddhiriti, prārabhyamāṇavicāro dharmaviṣayo na vedārthamātraviṣaya ityupapādayati -- tathā hi śāstrārambha iti|| nanu "vedavākyāni vicārayet" ityādibhāṣyaliṅgāt vedārthamātravicārārambho'vagamyate iti śaṅkate -- kathamiti||
analyzed: tat evam artha vivakṣā dharma vicāra avasara pradarśana pare śāstra ārambhe na sarva veda artha vicāra siddhiḥ iti prārabhyamāṇa vicāraḥ dharma viṣayaḥ na veda artha mātra viṣayaḥ iti upapādayati tathā hi śāstra ārambhe iti nanu veda vākyāni vicārayet ityādi bhāṣya liṅgāt veda artha mātra vicāra ārambhaḥ uvagamyate iti śaṅkate katham iti

original: sāmānyaprasiddhiviśeṣavipratipattyoḥ bhāṣyakāreṇa dharme pradarśitatvāt sa eva vicāryate ityāha -- dharmo nāma kaścit sādhayituriti|| evaṃ viṣayavipratipattī darśayitvā dharmaviṣaya eva pūrvapakṣaprāptiṃ darśayatītyāha -- tatrāgnihotrādilakṣaṇa eveti|| nakārastu pūrvaparayoḥ sambadhyate| "evamāśaṅkite" ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ||
analyzed: sāmānya prasiddhi viśeṣa vipratipattyoḥ bhāṣyakāreṇa dharme pradarśita tvāt saḥ eva vicāryate iti āha dharmaḥ nāma kaścid sādhayituḥ iti evam viṣaya vipratipattī darśayitvā dharma viṣaye eva pūrvapakṣa prāptim darśayati iti āha tatra agnihotra ādi lakṣaṇe eva iti nakāraḥ tu pūrva parayoḥ sambadhyate evam āśaṅkite iti atas prāktanaḥ granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ

original: evamāśaṅkite śāstrārambhe siddhāntasūtraṃ tatpratipādyārthakathanena avatārayati -- dharmāya vedavākyānīti|| yasya āmnāyasya arthavivakṣā, tasyaiva vicārāvasaraśceti tadarthavivakṣāvicārāvasarau| vivakṣāvicārāvasaradharmavicārān sūtrārthān sūtrayojanayā darśayati -- vedamadhītyānantaramiti|| tataḥ kimāyātam ityata āha -- evaṃ sthita iti||
analyzed: evam āśaṅkite śāstra ārambhe siddhānta sūtram tad pratipādya artha kathanena avatārayati dharmāya veda vākyāni iti yasya āmnāyasya artha vivakṣā tasya eva vicāra avasaraḥ ca iti tad artha vivakṣā vicāra avasarau vivakṣā vicāra avasara dharma vicārān sūtra arthān sūtra yojanayā darśayati vedam adhītya anantaram iti tatas kim āyātam iti atas āha evam sthitaḥ iti

original: kiṃ tatra vivakṣitaṃ gamyate iti tatrāha -- kiṃ tu dharmātirikta iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- vedasya arthavivakṣāpradarśanena vedārthavicāraḥ kartavya iti vaktavye dharmagrahaṇaṃ kurvan mā bhūt sarvavedārthavicārapratijñā, kiṃtvekadeśavicāro'yamiti manyate sūtrakāra iti gamyate||
analyzed: kim tatra vivakṣitam gamyate iti tatra āha kim tu dharma atiriktaḥ iti ayam arthaḥ vedasya artha vivakṣā pradarśanena veda artha vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti vaktavye dharma grahaṇam kurvan mā bhūt sarva veda artha vicāra pratijñā kiṃtu eka deśa vicāraḥ iyam iti manyate sūtrakāraḥ iti gamyate

original: nanu "athātaḥ"śabdānāṃ svādhyāyasya pūrvanirvṛttatayā vicārahetutvamucyate| svādhyāyo hi svārthavicāraheturbhavati, na dharmavicārahetuḥ; ataḥ athātaḥśabdavirodhāt na dharmavicāraḥ pratijñātuṃ śakyata iti codayati -- tat katham yattāvadidamiti||
analyzed: nanu atha atas śabdānām svādhyāyasya pūrva nirvṛtta tayā vicāra hetu tvam ucyate svādhyāyaḥ hi sva artha vicāra hetuḥ bhavati na dharma vicāra hetuḥ atas atha atas śabda virodhāt na dharma vicāraḥ pratijñātum śakyate iti codayati tat katham yat tāvat idam iti

original: sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ vicāryamāṇapradhānābhidhāyidharmapadagrahaṇasāmarthyāt, tasyaiva vipratipattyā puruṣārthasādhanatayā ca jijñāsitatvāt, prāmāṇyapratipādanāt prāk vedārthe sāmānyapratipattiviśeṣavipratipattipuruṣārthasādhanatvādīnāṃ anavagamāt, jijñāsitatvāyogāt dharma eva vicāryata
analyzed: sāmānya viśeṣābhyām vicāryamāṇa pradhāna abhidhāyi dharma pada grahaṇa sāmarthyāt tasya eva vipratipattyā puruṣa artha sādhanatayā ca jijñāsita tvāt prāmāṇya pratipādanāt prāk veda arthe sāmānya pratipatti viśeṣa vipratipatti puruṣa artha sādhana tva ādīnām anavagamāt jijñāsita tva ayogāt dharmaḥ eva vicāryata

original: ityāha -- ucyate dharmo nāmetyādinā|| tatra dharme jijñāsāyogyatvapradarśanena vedārthe tadabhāvaṃ vivakṣati -- lokapravādāditi|| nanu dharmavicāre svādhyāyasya pūrvanirvṛttatayā hetutvam, arthavivakṣāyāḥ pradarśanaṃ ca anupayogi ityuktam| satyam;
analyzed: iti āha ucyate dharmaḥ nāma ityādinā tatra dharme jijñāsā yogyatva pradarśanena veda arthe tad abhāvam vivakṣati loka pravādāt iti nanu dharma vicāre svādhyāyasya pūrva nirvṛtta tayā hetutvam artha vivakṣāyāḥ pradarśanam ca anupayogi iti uktam satyam

original: agnihotrāderapi dharmaskandhatvāt devagatyā ca dharmatvādupayoga ityāha -- agnihotrādirapi vedārtha iti|| yata iti|| vipratipattiskandhatvādityarthaḥ| tena vivakṣito'sau svādhyāya iti pradarśanīyamityarthaḥ| nanu puruṣārthatvācceddharmavicāraḥ, adhyayanenaiva tatsiddheḥ kiṃ dharmavicāreṇa iti netyāha -- na ca adhyayanamātrāditi||
analyzed: agnihotra ādeḥ api dharma skandha tvāt deva gatyā ca dharma tvāt upayogaḥ iti āha agnihotra ādiḥ api veda arthaḥ iti yatas iti vipratipatti skandha tvāt iti arthaḥ tena vivakṣitaḥ asau svādhyāyaḥ iti pradarśanīyam iti arthaḥ nanu puruṣa artha tvāt ced dharma vicāraḥ adhyayanena eva tad siddheḥ kim dharma vicāreṇa iti na iti āha na ca adhyayana mātrāt iti

original: ato na -- "athātaḥ"śabdavirodha ityāha -- ato'dhyayanānantaramiti|| kiṃ ca dharmaśabdasya pradhānatvāt athātaśśabdavirodhe'pi dharmavicāra eva yukta ityāha -- iti vadituṃ dharmagrahaṇaṃ yuktamiti|| puruṣā hi dharmameva jijñāsante na vedārtham; tasyāpi dharmatvaprayuktatvāt upādānasya ityāha -- yato na vedārtheti||
analyzed: atas na atha atas śabda virodhaḥ iti āha atas adhyayana anantaram iti kim ca dharma śabdasya pradhāna tvāt atha atas śabda virodhe pi dharma vicāraḥ eva yuktaḥ iti āha iti vaditum dharma grahaṇam yuktam iti puruṣāḥ hi dharmam eva jijñāsante na veda artham tasya api dharma tva prayukta tvāt upādānasya iti āha yatas na veda artha iti

original: sāmānyagrahaṇaviśeṣavipratipattipuruṣārthasādhanatvadharmaśabdagrahaṇaiḥ dharmavicāraparaṃ prathamasūtramityuktam, dvitīyamapi sūtraṃ tathaivetyāha -- yat punaḥ dharmasyeti|| dharmalakṣaṇaparaṃ sūtraṃ, arthāt pramāṇapratijñeti prābhākarāḥ| mukhataḥ pramāṇapratijñā, arthāt dharmalakṣaṇatvamiti vārtikakārīyāḥ| sarvathāpyubhayaṃ vivakṣitamiti|
analyzed: sāmānya grahaṇa viśeṣa vipratipatti puruṣa artha sādhana tva dharma śabda grahaṇaiḥ dharma vicāra param prathama sūtram iti uktam dvitīyam api sūtram tathā eva iti āha yat punar dharmasya iti dharma lakṣaṇa param sūtram arthāt pramāṇa pratijñā iti prābhākarāḥ mukhatas pramāṇa pratijñā arthāt dharma lakṣaṇa tvam iti vārtikakārīyāḥ sarvathā api ubhayam vivakṣitam iti

original: tatra vedagrahaṇe prāpte sarvo vedo dharmaviṣayo mā bhūditi codanāmagrahīt iti gamyata ityāha -- tannūnamiti||

original: nanu codanāgrahaṇaṃ sarvavedasya dharme prāmāṇyaparihārāya na bhavati, kiṃ tvanyadeva prayojanamityāha -- nanu codanāgrahaṇasyeti||
analyzed: nanu codanā grahaṇam sarva vedasya dharme prāmāṇya parihārāya na bhavati kim tu anyat eva prayojanam iti āha nanu codanā grahaṇasya iti

original: ayamarthaḥ -- liṅādiśabdavyāpāraḥ puruṣapravṛttilakṣaṇārthabhāvanālakṣaṇabhāvyaniṣṭhaḥ svajñānakaraṇakaḥ stutinindārthavādādijñānetikartavyatāko liṅādiśabdena ākhyātatvasāmānyādarśabhāvanābhidhāyinā'pi liṅviśeṣeṇa abhidhīyamānaḥ śabdabhāvaneti kathyate| śabda eva vā pradarśitāṃśatrayaviśiṣṭaḥ śabdabhāvanā, śabdaguṇo vā|
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ liṅ ādi śabda vyāpāraḥ puruṣa pravṛtti lakṣaṇa artha bhāvanā lakṣaṇa bhāvya niṣṭhaḥ sva jñāna karaṇakaḥ stuti nindā arthavāda ādi jñāna iti kartavya tākaḥ liṅ ādi śabdena ākhyāta tva sāmānya ādarśa bhāvanā abhidhāyinā api liṅ viśeṣeṇa abhidhīyamānaḥ śabda bhāvanā iti kathyate śabdaḥ eva vā pradarśita aṃśa traya viśiṣṭaḥ śabda bhāvanā śabda guṇaḥ vā

original: sarvatra hi karaṇamitikartavyatānugṛhītaṃ bhāvyanirvṛttidvāreṇaiva bhāvanāṃ prati karaṇaṃ bhavati| tatra śabdabhāvanāviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ liṅādiśabdajanyaṃ pravartakajñānatvāt stutyādijñānānugṛhītaṃ puruṣapravṛttinivṛttiheturiti, bhāvyanirvṛttidvāreṇa śabdabhāvanāṃ prati karaṇamucyate|
analyzed: sarvatra hi karaṇam itikartavyatā anugṛhītam bhāvya nirvṛtti dvāreṇa eva bhāvanām prati karaṇam bhavati tatra śabda bhāvanā viṣayam jñānam liṅ ādi śabda janyam pravartaka jñāna tvāt stutya ādi jñāna anugṛhītam puruṣa pravṛtti nivṛtti hetuḥ iti bhāvya nirvṛtti dvāreṇa śabda bhāvanām prati karaṇam ucyate

original: sā ca śabdabhāvanā puruṣapravṛttimutpādayantī tasyāḥ puruṣārthaviṣayatvamantareṇa notpādayituṃ kṣamate ; apuruṣārthe puruṣasya apravṛtteḥ|
analyzed: sā ca śabda bhāvanā puruṣa pravṛttim utpādayantī tasyāḥ puruṣa artha viṣaya tvam antareṇa na utpādayitum kṣamate a puruṣa arthe puruṣasya apravṛtteḥ

original: tataḥ codanāprayuktapuruṣapravṛtteḥ samānapadopāttamapuruṣārthaṃ dhātvarthaṃ bhāvyaṃ vihāya puruṣaviśeṣaṇamapi svargādikaṃ bhāvyatvenopādāya dhātvarthakaraṇikā prayājādītikartavyatākā svargādibhāvyaniṣṭhā puruṣapravṛttirarthabhāvanā sampadyate| tat evaṃvidhārthabhāvanāniṣpattaye śabdabhāvanāyāḥ pravartakatvadyotanāya codanāgrahaṇamiti||
analyzed: tatas codanā prayukta puruṣa pravṛtteḥ samāna pada upāttam apuruṣa artham dhātvartham bhāvyam vihāya puruṣa viśeṣaṇam api svarga ādikam bhāvya tvena upādāya dhātvartha karaṇikā prayāja ādi itikartavya tākā svarga ādi bhāvya niṣṭhā puruṣa pravṛttiḥ artha bhāvanā sampadyate tat evaṃvidha artha bhāvanā niṣpattaye śabda bhāvanāyāḥ pravartaka tva dyotanāya codanā grahaṇam iti

original: netat sāram; adhyayanavidhiḥ ityādiḥ parihāraḥ| tasyāyamarthaḥ -- "svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ" iti tavyapratyayavyāpāraḥ śabdabhāvanā adhyayane puruṣapravṛttilakṣaṇārthabhāvanābhāvyaniṣṭhā svaviṣayapravartakajñānakaraṇikā adhyayanaphalārthavādādivijñānetikartavyatākā bhavati|
analyzed: na etat sāram adhyayana vidhiḥ ityādiḥ parihāraḥ tasya ayam arthaḥ svādhyāya udhyetavyaḥ iti tavya pratyaya vyāpāraḥ śabda bhāvanā adhyayane puruṣa pravṛtti lakṣaṇa artha bhāvanā bhāvya niṣṭhā sva viṣaya pravartaka jñāna karaṇikā adhyayana phala arthavāda ādi vijñāna iti kartavya tākā bhavati

original: sā ca puruṣapravṛttilakṣaṇāmarthabhāvanāmadhyayanakaraṇikāṃ svādhyāyabhāvyaniṣṭhāṃ prāṅmukhatvādītikartavyatākāmutpādayati|
analyzed: sā ca puruṣa pravṛtti lakṣaṇām artha bhāvanām adhyayana karaṇikām svādhyāya bhāvya niṣṭhām prāc mukha tva ādi itikartavya tākām utpādayati

original: sā ca bhāvyasya svādhyāyasya phalavadvijñānajanananimittatvamantareṇa arthabhāvanāmutpādayitumasamarthā svādhyāyagataliṅādiśabdābhidheyakratubhāvanānāṃ svargādiviṣayatvaṃ paramparayā kalpayati ityadhyayanavidhisāmarthyādeva vedasya viśiṣṭaphalaviṣayabhāvanānāṃ pratipādakatvaṃ siddham|
analyzed: sā ca bhāvyasya svādhyāyasya phalavat vijñāna janana nimitta tvam antareṇa artha bhāvanām utpādayitum asamarthā svādhyāya gata liṅ ādi śabda abhidheya kratu bhāvanānām svarga ādi viṣaya tvam paramparayā kalpayati iti adhyayana vidhi sāmarthyāt eva vedasya viśiṣṭa phala viṣaya bhāvanānām pratipādaka tvam siddham

original: ato vedagrahaṇenaiva bhāvanānāṃ dhātvarthaṃ vihāya svargādyālambanakatvaṃ sidhyatīti||

original: "udbhidā yajeta paśukāmaḥ" ityatra paśukāma ityatra paśukāmamuddiśya yāgo vidhīyate yāgavidhānaṃ voddiśya paśukāmādhikāraḥ kiṃ vā ubhayam iti tathā satre yajamānā evartvijaḥ, iti yajamānānuddiśya ṛtvigbhāvo vidhīyate kiṃ vā ṛtvija uddiśya yajamānabhāvo vidhīyate ityādivacanavyaktisaṃśayādvicāra iti|| "athāto dharmajijñāsā|" vedārthavicāro viṣayaḥ|

original: prativākyādhyayanavicāraṃ vidhivyāpārabhedāt prayojanabhedavaśāt ekadeśavicāre'pi na vidhiprayojyatvavirodhaḥ; yathā cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ paśyediti vidhiprayuktyā rūpaikadeśanīladarśane'pi tatprayuktiḥ na virudhyate tadvadityarthaḥ| anyathā vidhyanusāreṇa kṛtsnavedārthavicāravivakṣāyāṃ dharmagrahaṇaṃ na syādityāha -- yato dharma iti kṛtveti||

original: dharmagrahaṇasya ca vedārthaikadeśavicāraparyudāsaḥ prayojanaṃ, kiṃ tu vedārthasya puruṣārthatāsiddhiḥ prayojanamiti śaṅkate -- satyam; tathāpi śāstrakārāṇāmiti|| pariharati -- evaṃ tarhīti|| dharmaśabdasya hi vedārthe prayoganimittaṃ vaktavyam, na tāvadrūḍhiḥ; caityavandanādāvapi prayogavipratipatteḥ|

original: atha anvayavyatirekasiddhaḥśreyassādhanābhidhāyīdharmaśabdaḥ, tathābhūtatvāt vedārthasyāpi dharmaśabdaḥ tatra pravartata iti, evaṃ tarhi svādhyāyapāṭhādeva brahmaṇaḥ pratīyamānasya dharmaśabdābhidheyatvābhāvāt śreyorūpatvāt tasya arthāt paryudastatvāt dharma ityevaṃ kṛtvā vicāro yuktaḥ;
analyzed: atha anvaya vyatireka siddhaḥ śreyaḥ sādhana abhidhāyī dharma śabdaḥ tathābhūta tvāt veda arthasya api dharma śabdaḥ tatra pravartate iti evam tarhi svādhyāya pāṭhāt eva brahmaṇaḥ pratīyamānasya dharma śabda abhidheya tva abhāvāt śreyaḥ rūpatvāt tasya arthāt paryudasta tvāt dharmaḥ iti evam kṛtvā vicāraḥ yuktaḥ

original: nanu paṅkajaśabdādiṣu yogarūḍhiriti vṛttyantaraṃ kalpyata iti, na; tatrāpi yogavṛttyaivārthapratipatteḥ. nanu utpalādivastvantaraṃ vihāya paṅkajaśabdājhaṭiti tāmarase pratipattidarśanācchaktidvayameva kalpanīyam, na; prayogabāhulyādapi sāmarthyāviśeṣe prathamapratipattidarśanāt|

original: yathā navasvartheṣu śaktyaviśeṣe'pi gośabdāt sāsnādimadākṛtau prayogabāhulyādeva prathamapratipattiḥ| tasmāt klṛptasāmarthyādeva prayogapratipattisambhave na śaktyantarakalpanetyāha -- nāyaṃ jijñāsāśabda iti|| kathamityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ||

original: nanu avayavārthasaṃsarga eva yogavṛttyā'pi śabdena pratipādyate, vicārastu na jijñāsāśabdāvayavārthaḥ, kathaṃ tadavagamasya klṛptasāmarthyenaivānyathā siddhiriti codayati -- kathamanyathāsiddhatvamiti||

analyzed: svayam avayava artha tva abhāve pi avayava artha saṃsarga avinābhāvāt api tad lakṣaṇayā prayoga pratyaya upapattau na śakti anta kalpanā ananyathāsiddha kārya abhāvāt iti pariharati antarṇīta vicāra artha tvāt iti nanu jñāna mātram iṣyamāṇam katham vicāreṇa avinābhūtam iti tat āha evam prayoga pratyayoḥ iti

original: jñānaṃ khalviṣyamāṇaṃ viṣayeṇa sahāvagatamiṣyate, anavagataviṣayecchāyogāt| tataśca pratipanne vastuni jñānamiṣyamāṇaṃ saṃdigdhe niścayaphalaṃ vā parokṣe'parokṣaphalaṃ veṣyate|

original: arthalakṣaṇena prādhānyenāntarṇītaṃ vicāramāśrityeti sambandhaḥ| atastrayāṇāmanyatamasyādhikriyamāṇatvamaṅgīkṛtyeti yojanā|

original: tatrāthaśabdenānantaryābhidhānamukhena śāstrīyasādhanacatuṣṭayasaṃpannādhikāriviśeṣasya nyāyataḥ samarpaṇābhāve vicārārambhārthatve ca kartavyatayā vidhīyamāno vicāro niradhikāro'nanuṣṭheyaḥ syāditi pariharati -- ucyate śāstrasyānārambhaprasaṅgāditi||

original: nanu vicāravidhireva viśvajinnyāyenādhikāriviśeṣaṃ kalpayitvā pravṛttiparyanto bhaviṣyati, kimathaśabdeneti nanu kartavyatayā'vagato vicāro'pi prārambhamarthād gamayati, kiṃ vicāraprārambhārthenāthaśabdena nanu vidhisāmarthyādubhayaprāptau kastatra nirṇayaḥ vidhyapekṣitopādhitvādānantaryābhidhānamukhenādhikārisamarpaṇameva yuktamityāha --
analyzed: nanu vicāra vidhiḥ eva viśvajit nyāyena adhikāri viśeṣam kalpayitvā pravṛtti paryantaḥ bhaviṣyati kim athaśabdena iti nanu kartavyatayā avagataḥ vicāraḥ api prārambham arthāt gamayati kim vicāra prārambha arthena atha śabdena nanu vidhi sāmarthyāt ubhaya prāptau kaḥ tatra nirṇayaḥ vidhi apekṣita upādhi tvāt ānantarya abhidhāna mukhena adhikāri samarpaṇam eva yuktam iti āha

original: adhikārārthatve hyaprayojanamiti|| pravṛttidvāreṇa prayojanaparyantatāśūnyamityarthaḥ| nanu mokṣakāmaḥ kalpyate, na; prasajjyapratiṣedhaprasaṅgāt| tathāhi -- kartavya ityukte'viśeṣāt sarvādhikārapratipattau tadanupapattyā viśiṣṭādhikāraḥ kalpanīyaḥ| tato varaṃ śabdenaiva viśiṣṭādhikārisamarpaṇamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: adhikāra artha tve hi aprayojanam iti pravṛtti dvāreṇa prayojana paryanta tā śūnyam iti arthaḥ nanu mokṣa kāmaḥ kalpyate na prasajjya pratiṣedha prasaṅgāt tathā hi kartavyaḥ iti ukte viśeṣāt sarva adhikāra pratipattau tad anupapattyā viśiṣṭa adhikāraḥ kalpanīyaḥ tatas varam śabdena eva viśiṣṭa adhikāri samarpaṇam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu rātrisatranyāyenārthavādagatameva mokṣaṃ brahmajñānaṃ vā prayojanaṃ sādhyatvena pariṇamathya mokṣakāmo brahmajñānakāmo vā vicārayediti vidhipratipattisamaye'dhikāriviśiṣṭavidhipratiṣedha iti codayati -- nanu brahmajñānaṃ prayojanamiti||
analyzed: nanu rātri satra nyāyena arthavāda gatam eva mokṣam brahma jñānam vā prayojanam sādhya tvena pariṇamathya mokṣa kāmaḥ brahma jñāna kāmaḥ vā vicārayet iti vidhi pratipatti samaye adhikāri viśiṣṭa vidhi pratiṣedhaḥ iti codayati nanu brahma jñānam prayojanam iti

original: tatredaṃ vaktavyam -- kiṃ sarveṣāṃ phalakāmitayā sarvādhikāraṃ śāstramucyate kiṃ vā viśiṣṭādhikāramiti viśiṣṭādhikāratve vidhipratipattyadhīnatvādasāmarthyalabhyādhikārikalpanāyāḥ prasajjyapratiṣedhavyāpāragauravaṃ tadavasthameva|
analyzed: tatra idam vaktavyam kim sarveṣām phala kāmitayā sarva adhikāram śāstram ucyate kim vā viśiṣṭa adhikāram iti viśiṣṭa adhikāra tve vidhi pratipatti adhīna tvāt asāmarthya labhya adhikāri kalpanāyāḥ prasajjya pratiṣedha vyāpāra gauravam tad avastham eva

original: ato'thaśabdena śrotavyādividhiprakaraṇapaṭhitasādhanacatuṣṭayasampannādhikāripratipattipūrvake vicāravidhyavagame nāsau doṣaḥ, ityathaśabdena śrautaviśeṣādhikārisamarpaṇameva yuktamiti|
analyzed: atas tha śabdena śrotavya ādi vidhi prakaraṇa paṭhita sādhana catuṣṭaya sampanna adhikāri pratipatti pūrvake vicāra vidhi avagame na asau doṣaḥ iti atha śabdena śrauta viśeṣa adhikāri samarpaṇam eva yuktam iti

original: atha sarvādhikāraṃ śāstramiti, na prasajjyapratiṣedhaḥ, nāpi viśeṣādhikāra samarpaṇe śabdāpekṣeti, tatra vaktavyam -- kiṃ phalataḥ sarvādhikāraṃ śāstram kiṃ vā vidhitaḥ na tāvatphalataḥ; sarveṣāṃ phalārthitā'bhāvādityāha -- na brahmajñāne'rthatvānupapatteriti|| mā bhūd brahmajñānārthatetyataḥ prāktano granthaḥ
analyzed: atha sarva adhikāram śāstram iti na prasajjya pratiṣedhaḥ na api viśeṣa adhikāra samarpaṇe śabda apekṣā iti tatra vaktavyam kim phalataḥ sarva adhikāram śāstram kim vā vidhitaḥ na tāvat phalataḥ sarveṣām phala arthitā bhāvāt iti āha na brahma jñāna īrthatva anupapatteḥ iti mā bhūt brahma jñāna arthatā iti atas prāktanaḥ granthaḥ

original: nanu adhyayanavidhaistraivarṇikādhikāratvāt tatprayuktatvācca vicārasya vidhita eva sarvādhikāraṃ śāstramiti codayati -- mā bhūd brahmajñānārthateti|| nanu vidhirnāma svaviṣayasya tadupakārakasya vā'nuṣṭhānanimittaṃ bhavati, naca vicāro'dhyayanavidheyāvadarthāvabodhaphalaṃ vyāpārādvicāramapi phalaniṣpattaye'dhyayanavidhiranuṣṭhāpayatīti|
