original: nanu viṣayatadupakārivyatiriktasya vyāpārasya phalaniṣpattyapekṣayā vidhiprayuktānuṣṭhetvaṃ kva dṛśyate avaghātādiṣviti cet, na; vidheyāvaghātasyaiva phalaparyantamāvartyamānatvāt, vicārastu svatantrameva bhāvārthāntaraṃ kathaṃ vidhīyate, iti vaktavyam, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
analyzed: nanu viṣaya tad upakāri vyatiriktasya vyāpārasya phala niṣpatti apekṣayā vidhi prayukta anuṣṭhetvam kva dṛśyate avaghāta ādiṣu iti ced na vidheya avaghātasya eva phala paryantam āvartyamāna tvāt vicāraḥ tu svatantram eva bhāva artha antaram katham vidhīyate iti vaktavyam na eṣa doṣaḥ

original: āvṛttiguṇasyāvihitasya vihitānupakārakasya ca vidheḥ phalaparyantatānupapattyā vidheyatvakalpanavad vicārasyāpi tadupapattiriti|
analyzed: āvṛtti guṇasya avihitasya vihita an upakārakasya ca vidheḥ phala paryanta tā anupapattyā vidheya tva kalpana vat vicārasya api tad upapattiḥ iti

original: tatra kiṃ vicārasādhyajñānamarthaniścayaphalamadhyayanasyānvayavyatirekasiddhaṃ dṛṣṭaphalam kiṃ vā taduddeśena vidhānādadhikāriviśeṣaṇatayā śāstrīyaṃ phalam kiṃ vā vidheḥ prayojanaparyantatāsāmarthyalabhyaṃ phalamiti na tāvad dṛṣṭaṃ phalam; adhyayanamātrādāvṛttiguṇakādapyarthaniścayānudayāt, āpātadarśanasya ca vicārānapekṣatvāt|
analyzed: tatra kim vicāra sādhya jñānam artha niścaya phalam adhyayanasya anvaya vyatireka siddham dṛṣṭa phalam kim vā tad uddeśena vidhānāt adhikāri viśeṣaṇa tayā śāstrīyam phalam kim vā vidheḥ prayojana paryanta tā sāmarthya labhyam phalam iti na tāvat dṛṣṭam phalam adhyayana mātrāt āvṛtti guṇakāt api artha niścaya anudayāt āpāta darśanasya ca vicāra anapekṣa tvāt

original: ato nārthaniścayadṛṣṭaphalādhyayanakriyā syāditi| nanu tavyapratyayena svavyāpāraḥ śabdabhāvanā vidhirūpatayā'bhidhīyate, sā ca śabdabhāvanā'dhyayanakaraṇikāmarthabhāvanāṃ niṣpādayantī phalavadarthāvabodhaṃ puruṣārthamarthabhāvanābhāvyatvena kalpayati;
analyzed: atas na artha niścaya dṛṣṭa phala adhyayana kriyā syāt iti nanu tavya pratyayena sva vyāpāraḥ śabda bhāvanā vidhi rūpatayā abhidhīyate sā ca śabda bhāvanā adhyayana karaṇikām artha bhāvanām niṣpādayantī phalavat artha avabodham puruṣa artham artha bhāvanā bhāvya tvena kalpayati

original: apuruṣārthe puruṣapravṛttyayogāt, tataśca bhāvyāntaralābhāt samānapadoṣāttamadhyayanaṃ bhāvanāyāḥ karaṇatāmāpannaṃ bhāvyasyārthāvabodhasya nirvartakatayā karaṇaṃ bhavati;

original: kuṭhārādīnāmapi kriyābhāvyadvaidhībhāvanirvartanadvāreṇa chidibhāvanākaraṇatvadarśanāt, ato'dhyayanavidheḥ pravartakatvānyathānupapattyaivārthabhāvanākaraṇasyādhyayanasyārthāvabodhaḥ phalamiti siddham;

original: anyathā samānapadopāttatyādhyayanasyaiva bhāvyatayā svādhyāyāvāpterapi vidhiphalatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt, ityata āha -- sā hyadhīyamānāvāptiphalatvādakṣaragrahaṇānteti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- tavyapratyayena bhāvanākarmakārake'bhidhīyamāne svādhyāye svāvāptiphale ca na bhāvyāntaraṃ kalpanīyam; bhāvanākarmābhidhāyiśabdavirodhāditi|
analyzed: anyathā samāna pada upātta tyā adhyayanasya eva bhāvya tayā svādhyāya avāpteḥ api vidhi phalatva abhāva prasaṅgāt iti atas āha sā hi adhīyamāna avāpti phala tvāt akṣara grahaṇa antā iti ayam āśayaḥ tavya pratyayena bhāvanā karma kāraka abhidhīyamāne svādhyāye sva avāpti phale ca na bhāvya antaram kalpanīyam bhāvanā karma abhidhāyi śabda virodhāt iti

original: nanu na bhāvyamātreṇa puruṣapravṛttirvidhinā janyate, kintu puruṣārthabhāvyāpekṣayaiva; tataśca śabdavirodhe'pi bhāvanāniṣpattaye'rthāvabodhe bhāvya iti śaṅkate -- athākṣaragrahaṇaṃ niṣprayojanamiti|| pariharati -- bhavatu tarhi saktūnāṃ gatiriti||

original: ayamāśayaḥ -- arthanirṇayasyādhyayanamātrādaniṣpatteḥ, śrūyamāṇasya svādhyāyasya cāphalatvād adhyayanamātrasya cāprayojanatayā bhāvyatvāyogāt svādhyāyādhyayanena svargaṃ bhāvayediti kalpyata iti|

original: kiñca -- sākṣācchrutaḥ jñānasādhanatvānupapattau tatphalasādhanatvakalpanād varaṃ paramparayā'pi tatsādhanatvakalpanam, karaṇavibhakteḥ "kāṣṭheḥ pacatī"ti paramparayā sādhane'pi darśanāt, phalasādhanatve'pi tadayogāt| nacāsmin vākye yajñādisādhyo mokṣaḥ śrūyate, ātmā tu jñākarmatayā tatsādhyo'vagamyate, na yajñādisādhyaḥ|

original: tathā "vidvānnāmarūpādvimuktaḥ" "evamevāsya paridraṣṭurimāḥ ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ puruṣāyaṇāḥ puruṣaṃ prāpyāstaṃ gacchantī"ti ca brahmadarśananivartyatvāvagamāt, ajñānamātropādānatvasya darśitatvācca karmopādhīnām| kiñca samuccayavādino na vijñānasādhyamapi phalamasti ;
analyzed: tathā vidvān nāma rūpāt vimuktaḥ evam eva asya paridraṣṭuḥ imāḥ ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ puruṣāyaṇāḥ puruṣam prāpyāḥ tam gacchanti iti ca brahma darśana nivartya tva avagamāt ajñāna mātra upādāna tvasya darśita tvāt ca karma upādhīnām kiñca samuccaya vādinaḥ na vijñāna sādhyam api phalam asti

original: karmopādhīnāṃ satyavastutayā vijñānānivartyatvāt, mithyādhyāsasya ca kṣaṇikatayā svayameva nivṛtteḥ, pravāhasya ca pravāhinivṛttimantareṇa pṛthagucchedābhāvāt, astutvācca, mithyājñānasaṃskārasya śuktikāditatvajñānenāvirodhadarśanādanivartyatvāt, brahmātmabhāvasya ca svayaṃprakāśatayā vijñānāprakāśyatvāt, tattvajñānābhyāsasaṃskārācca,
analyzed: karma upādhīnām satya vastu tayā vijñāna anivartya tvāt mithyā adhyāsasya ca kṣaṇika tayā svayam eva nivṛtteḥ pravāhasya ca pravāhi nivṛttim antareṇa pṛthak uccheda abhāvāt astu tvāt ca mithyājñāna saṃskārasya śuktikā ādi tatva jñānena avirodha darśanāt anivartya tvāt brahma ātma bhāvasya ca svayam prakāśa tayā vijñāna aprakāśya tvāt tattva jñāna abhyāsa saṃskārāt ca

original: mithyājñānasaṃskāranivṛttau tattvajñānānmuktiśrutivirodhāt| tasmāt sarvānarthopādānānādimithyājñānanivṛttyaiva vijñānaṃ phalavat, iti na samuccayāvakāśaḥ|| tatra sarvasaṅkaravādī brahmavicārāpekṣitādhikāramapyajñānan samuccayasāmarthyādeva dharmāvabodhānantaraṃ brahmāvabodhaṃ jalpati|| tatra sati vā samuccaye viparītaṃ kiṃ na syāditi nirūpaṇīyam|
analyzed: mithyājñāna saṃskāra nivṛttau tattva jñānāt mukti śruti virodhāt tasmāt sarva anartha upādāna anādi mithyājñāna nivṛttyā eva vijñānam phalavat iti na samuccaya avakāśaḥ tatra sarva saṅkara vādī samuccaya sāmarthyāt eva dharma avabodha anantaram brahma avabodham jalpati tatra sati vā samuccaye viparītam kim na syāt iti nirūpaṇīyam

original: tathāhi -- jñānavataivānuṣṭhitāni karmāṇi mokṣaṃ sādhayanti, iti prathamaṃ brahmāvabodhamutpādya tadvataiva brahmacāriṇā dharmavicārādi sarvaṃ svāśramadharmānuṣṭhānaṃ kartuṃ yuktam, iti viparīta eva kramaḥ syāt; anyathā tvādāveva mumukṣorādharmavicāraparisamāpteranuṣṭhīyamānakarmaṇāmānarthakyaprasaṅgāt| dṛśyante ca prathamāśrama eva mumukṣavaḥ|
analyzed: tathā hi jñānavatā eva anuṣṭhitāni karmāṇi mokṣam sādhayanti iti prathamam brahma avabodham utpādya tadvatā eva brahmacāriṇā dharma vicāra ādi sarvam sva āśrama dharma anuṣṭhānam kartum yuktam iti viparītaḥ eva kramaḥ syāt anyathā tu ādau eva mumukṣoḥ ādharma vicāra parisamāpteḥ anuṣṭhīyamāna karmaṇām ānarthakya prasaṅgāt dṛśyante ca prathama āśrame eva mumukṣavaḥ

original: sarvasādhāraṇatvāddharmavicāra eva prathamaḥ kartavya iti cet, devānāṃpriya ! na sarvasādhāraṇaṃ kartumayaṃ pravṛttaḥ, kintu kāmyamānasādhanamavaśyānuṣṭheyaṃ vā nirvatayituṃ pravṛttaḥ| tatra yadi vicāradvayaṃ kāmyamānamokṣasādhanamithyeta, tarhi vyutkrama eva śreyānityuktam|
analyzed: sarva sādhāraṇa tvāt dharma vicāraḥ eva prathamaḥ kartavyaḥ iti ced devānāṃpriya na sarva sādhāraṇam kartum ayam pravṛttaḥ kintu kāmyamāna sādhanam avaśya anuṣṭheyam vā pravṛttaḥ tatra yadi vicāra dvayam kāmyamāna mokṣa sādhanam ithyeta tarhi vyutkramaḥ eva śreyān iti uktam

original: atha nityādhyayanavidhiḥ karmavicāraṃ prayojayati, ato'vaśyānuṣṭheyavicārāntaraṃ
analyzed: atha nitya adhyayana vidhiḥ karma vicāram prayojayati atas vaśya anuṣṭheya vicāra antaram

original: kāmyamānabrahmavicāraḥ prayujyata iti cet, naitat sāram; kāmyamānabrahmavicārānantaramapi nityadharmavicāropapatteḥ| nanu adhyayanānantaraṃ karmavicārānanuṣṭhāne pratyavāyaḥ syāt, satyam; nityavadalpānuṣṭhāne'pi pratyavāyaparihārāt| kiṃca tāvanmātramupeyātām;
analyzed: kāmyamāna brahma vicāraḥ prayujyate iti ced na etat sāram kāmyamāna brahma vicāra anantaram api nitya dharma vicāra upapatteḥ nanu adhyayana anantaram karma vicāra ananuṣṭhāne pratyavāyaḥ syāt satyam nitya vat alpa anuṣṭhāne api pratyavāya parihārāt kiṃca tāvanmātram upeyātām

original: viduṣā'nuṣṭhīyamānabrahmacāridharmāṇāmapi mokṣasādhanatvalābhāt, vedānuvacanādiṣu pratyekaṃ nirapekṣakaraṇavibhaktiśravaṇādvā, āśramakarmaṇāṃ vikalpena mokṣasādhanatvopapatteḥ, brahmacaryādeva saṃnyāsavidhānācca|
analyzed: viduṣā anuṣṭhīyamāna brahmacāri dharmāṇām api mokṣa sādhana tva lābhāt veda anuvacana ādiṣu pratyekam nirapekṣa karaṇa vibhakti śravaṇāt vā āśrama karmaṇām vikalpena mokṣa sādhana tva upapatteḥ brahmacaryāt eva saṃnyāsa vidhānāt ca

original: dharmāvabodho nityatayā'nuṣṭhito'pi na brahmavicārahotuḥ, ananuṣṭheyaśca dharmavicāraḥ, agnihotrādivyatiriktasaṃnyāsadharmāṇāmapi jñāne samuccayāṅgīkaraṇāt|
analyzed: dharma avabodhaḥ nitya tayā anuṣṭhitaḥ api na brahma vicāra hotuḥ ananuṣṭheyaḥ ca dharma vicāraḥ agnihotra ādi vyatirikta saṃnyāsa dharmāṇām api jñāne samuccaya aṅgīkaraṇāt

original: kiṃca adhyayanavidhiḥ karmavicāraṃ prayuñjāno brahmavicāraṃ kimiti na prayuṅkte iti vaktavyam, "śrotavyaḥ" iti vidhyantaraśravaṇāditi cet, aśrutamīmāṃsāvṛttānto devānāṃpriyaḥ, dharmavicāre klṛptapravartakabhāvenānenaivādhyayanavidhinā brahmavicārasyāpi prayogasambhave śrotavya iti vidherviniyogādhikāraprayogavidhikalpanayā
analyzed: kiṃca adhyayana vidhiḥ karma vicāram prayuñjānaḥ brahma vicāram kim iti na prayuṅkte iti vaktavyam śrotavyaḥ iti vidhi antara śravaṇāt iti ced aśruta mīmāṃsā vṛttāntaḥ devānāṃpriyaḥ dharma vicāre klṛpta pravartaka bhāvena anena eva adhyayana vidhinā brahma vicārasya api prayoga sambhave śrotavyaḥ iti vidheḥ viniyoga adhikāra prayoga vidhi kalpanayā

original: pravartakatvakalpanā'yogāt| brahmajñānasya kāmyamānasādhanatayā tadvicārasyāpi kāmyatvād na nityādhyayanavidhiprayuktateti cet, karmavicāre kāmyamānakarmavākyavicārasyāpyetatprayuktatvaprasaṅgaḥ||
analyzed: pravartaka tva kalpanā yogāt brahma jñānasya kāmyamāna sādhanatayā tad vicārasya api kāmya tvāt na nitya adhyayana vidhi prayukta tā iti ced karma vicāre kāmyamāna karma vākya vicārasya api etad prayukta tva prasaṅgaḥ

original: syādetat -- brahmavicārasya vairāgyaśamadamopasadanādisādhanaviśeṣāṇāmaṅgatvena vidhānādadhyayanavidheḥ karmavicāre śamādyaṅgaśūnyasya brahmavicāre tadaṅgānāmākṣepakatvānupapatteḥ sāṅgavidhyantaraṃ kalpyata iti, so'yamanurūpitavidhivyāpāro vāvadūkaḥ;
analyzed: syāt etat brahma vicārasya vairāgya śama dama upasadana ādi sādhana viśeṣāṇām aṅga tvena vidhānāt adhyayana vidheḥ karma vicāre śama ādi aṅga śūnyasya brahma vicāre tad aṅgānām ākṣepaka tva anupapatteḥ sa aṅga vidhi antaram kalpyate iti saḥ yam anurūpita vidhi vyāpāraḥ vāvadūkaḥ

original: svādhyāyavidhiḥ khalu śirovratabhūbhojanādyaṅgavikalameva vākyāntarādhyayanaṃ vidadhāno muṇḍaka kārīryādyadhyayanaṃ śirovratādyaṅgākṣepapuraḥsarameva vidadhāti| vicāraṃ ca prayuñjānaḥ prativākyaṃ dṛṣṭatayaivāṅgabhūtān nyāyabhedānākṣipyaiva vicāraṃ prayuṅkte|
analyzed: svādhyāya vidhiḥ khalu śiraḥ vrata bhū bhojana ādi aṅga vikalam eva vākya antara adhyayanam vidadhānaḥ muṇḍaka kārīrya ādi adhyayanam śiraḥ vrata ādi aṅga ākṣepa puraḥsaram eva vidadhāti vicāram ca prayuñjānaḥ prativākyam dṛṣṭa tayā eva aṅga bhūtān nyāya bhedān ākṣipya eva vicāram prayuṅkte

original: darśapūrṇamāsavidhiśca nityādhikāro yathāśaktyaṅgānuṣṭhānaṃ prayuṅkte, kāmyādhikārastu sarvāṅgānuṣṭhānamiti| tathā sa eva vidhirupāṃśuyāje karmaṇyājyāvekṣaṇādyaṅgamākṣipati, yāgāntareṣvavaghātādyaṅgamiti| evamadhyayanavidhirbrahmavicāre śamādyaṅgamākṣipet netaratreti na virudhyate| nacādhikāriviśeṣaṇatvāt śamādīnāmanupādeyatvādanākṣepaḥ;
analyzed: darśa pūrṇamāsa vidhiḥ ca nitya adhikāraḥ yathāśakti aṅga anuṣṭhānam prayuṅkte kāmya adhikāraḥ tu sarva aṅga anuṣṭhānam iti tathā saḥ eva vidhiḥ upāṃśuyāje karmaṇi ājya avekṣaṇa ādi aṅgam ākṣipati yāga antareṣu avaghāta ādi aṅgam iti evam adhyayana vidhiḥ brahma vicāre śama ādi aṅgam ākṣipet na itaratra iti na virudhyate na ca adhikāri viśeṣaṇa tvāt śama ādīnām anupādeya tvāt anākṣepaḥ

original: adhyayanavidhyadhikāriṇa eva tatprayuktavicāre'pyadhikāritvāt| tasmāt pradhānavidhirdṛṣṭādṛṣṭāṅgānāmupakāraviśeṣāpekṣayā yatra kvacana yatkiñcidaṅgaṃ prayojayatīti sarvatra samadhigatametat| tasmādekādhyayanavidhiprayuktatvād vicāradvayasya kramāpekṣāyāṃ brahmavicārānantaraṃ dharmavicāro yuktaḥ; vicārādīnāmapi mokṣasādhanatvalābhāt|
analyzed: adhyayana vidhi adhikāriṇaḥ eva tad prayukta vicāre api adhikāri tvāt tasmāt pradhāna vidhiḥ dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa aṅgānām upakāra viśeṣa apekṣayā yatra kvacana yat kiñcid aṅgam prayojayati iti sarvatra samadhigatam etat tasmāt eka adhyayana vidhi prayukta tvāt vicāra dvayasya krama apekṣāyām brahma vicāra anantaram dharma vicāraḥ yuktaḥ vicāra ādīnām api mokṣa sādhanatva lābhāt

original: tasmād na phalaikyādapi dharmajijñāsānantaraṃ brahmajijñāseti| prativākyaṃ ca tātparyabhedāt prameyabhedasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt na phala aikyāt api dharma jijñāsā anantaram brahma jijñāsā iti prativākyam ca tātparya bhedāt prameya bheda siddhiḥ

original: tatra hetvantaramāha -- codanāpravṛttibhedāditi|| etad vivṛṇoti -- idamaparamityādinā|| codaneti śabdabhāvanāṃ kurvañchabdo'bhidhīyate| sā ca codanāṃ'śatrayaviśiṣṭāmarthabhāvanāṃ kurvatī tasminnanavabuddhe puruṣapravṛttyayogādarthabhāvanāmapi pratipādayatīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tatra hetu antaram āha codanā pravṛtti bhedāt iti etat vivṛṇoti idam aparam ityādinā codanā iti śabda bhāvanām kurvan śabdaḥ abhidhīyate sā ca codanā aṃśa traya viśiṣṭām artha bhāvanām kurvatī tasmin anavabuddhe puruṣa pravṛtti ayogāt artha bhāvanām api pratipādayati iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu brahmāvabodhe bhāvye puruṣaṃ prerayantī codanā'vabodhavyāvṛttāṃ bhāvanāṃ pratipādayatīti, netyāha -- nāvabodhe puruṣaḥ preryata iti|| nanu avabodhaḥ puruṣaprayatnasādhya iti, netyāha -- avabodho hi yathāvastviti|| anicchato'prayatamānasyāpi durgandhādijñānadarśanādityarthaḥ||
analyzed: nanu brahma avabodhe bhāvye puruṣam prerayantī codana avabodha vyāvṛttām bhāvanām pratipādayati iti na iti āha na avabodhe puruṣaḥ preryate iti nanu avabodhaḥ puruṣa prayatna sādhyaḥ iti na iti āha avabodhaḥ hi yathāvastu iti an icchatā uprayatamānasya api durgandha ādi jñāna darśanāt iti arthaḥ

original: ucyate nityānityavastuviveka ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| śāstrīyasya vidheḥ śāstrīyamevādhikāranimittaṃ vaktavyamityabhipretyāha -- nityānityavastuviveka ityādi|| "so'nveṣṭavya" iti vidhiprakaraṇe -- "tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ kṣīyata evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ dhīyate" iti nityānityavastuviveko darśitaḥ;
analyzed: ucyate nitya anitya vastu vivekaḥ iti atas prāktanaḥ granthaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ śāstrīyasya vidheḥ śāstrīyam eva adhikāra nimittam vaktavyam iti abhipretya āha nitya anitya vastu vivekaḥ ityādi saḥ unveṣṭavyaḥ iti vidhi prakaraṇe tat yathā iha karma citaḥ lokaḥ kṣīyate evam eva amutra puṇya citaḥ lokaḥ dhīyate iti nitya anitya vastu vivekaḥ darśitaḥ

original: "parīkṣya lokān karmacitān" "ātmanastu kāmāya sarve priyaṃ bhavatī"ti ca jñānaśravaṇavidhiprakaraṇa ihāmutrārthabhogavirāgo darśitaḥ; "śānto dāntaḥ" iti ca darśanavidhiprakaraṇe śamādayo darśitāḥ; "tadvijijñāsasve"ti vicāravidhiprakaraṇe "varuṇaṃ pitaramupasasāre"ti gurūpasadanaṃ darśitam;
analyzed: parīkṣya lokān karma citān ātmanaḥ tu kāmāya sarve priyam bhavati iti ca jñāna śravaṇa vidhi prakaraṇe iha amutra artha bhoga virāgaḥ darśitaḥ śāntaḥ dāntaḥ iti ca darśana vidhi prakaraṇe śama ādayaḥ darśitāḥ tat vijijñāsasva iti vicāra vidhi prakaraṇe varuṇam pitaram upasasāra iti guru upasadanam darśitam

original: sarvatra ca phalaśrutayaḥ kāmanotpādanadvāreṇa mumukṣoradhikārapradarśanārthāḥ; anyathā sādhanānuṣṭhānādeva saṅkīrtanavaiphalyāt| jñānasyāvidheyatvāt tadvidhayo'pi tatsādhanavidhiparāḥ; tatra sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena vidhīnāmekatvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: sarvatra ca phala śrutayaḥ kāmanā utpādana dvāreṇa mumukṣoḥ adhikāra pradarśana arthāḥ anyathā sādhana anuṣṭhānāt eva saṅkīrtana vaiphalyāt jñānasya avidheya tvāt tad vidhayaḥ api tad sādhana vidhi parāḥ tatra sarva śākhā pratyaya nyāyena vidhīnām ekatva upapatteḥ

original: sa caiko vidhiradhikāramīkṣamāṇaḥ prakaraṇasāmarthyāt saṅkīrtanavaiphalyaparihārācca varṇitaṃ dharmakalāpamadhikāranimittatvena svīkaroti; niradhikārasya vidheḥ pravṛttiparyantatvāyogāt| nanu eṣu vākyeṣu vicāro vidhīyata iti kathamavagamyate ucyate -- "vijijñāsitavyaḥ" "vijijñāsasve"ti cāntarṇīto vicāro vidhīyate; iṣyamāṇajñānasyecchāyāśca
analyzed: sa ca ekaḥ vidhiḥ adhikāram īkṣamāṇaḥ prakaraṇa sāmarthyāt saṅkīrtana vaiphalya parihārāt ca varṇitam dharma kalāpam adhikāra nimitta tvena svīkaroti niradhikārasya vidheḥ pravṛtti paryanta tva ayogāt nanu eṣu vākyeṣu vicāraḥ vidhīyate iti katham avagamyate ucyate vijijñāsitavyaḥ vijijñāsasva iti ca antarṇītaḥ vicāraḥ vidhīyate iṣyamāṇa jñānasya icchāyāḥ ca

original: vidheyatvāyogāt| "śrotavyaḥ" iti ca svayameva vicāro vihitaḥ; "tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchedi"ti jñānasya sādhyatāvagamāt| gurūpasadanavidhānācca tatsādhanaśravaṇādividhiḥ kalpyate| "ātmanyevātmānaṃ paśyedi"ti jñānavidhānāyogāt tatsādhane vidhirūpādīyate, iti sarvatra manananididhyāsanābhyāṃ saha śravaṇaṃ nāmāṅgividhīyata iti siddham||
analyzed: vidheya tva ayogāt śrotavyaḥ iti ca svayam eva vicāraḥ vihitaḥ tad vijñāna artham sa gurum eva abhigacchet iti jñānasya sādhya tā avagamāt guru upasadana vidhānāt ca tad sādhana śravaṇa ādi vidhiḥ kalpyate ātmani eva ātmānam paśyet iti jñāna vidhāna ayogāt tad sādhane vidhiḥ ūpādīyate iti sarvatra manana nididhyāsanābhyām saha śravaṇam nāma aṅgi vidhīyate iti siddham

original: nanu phalasādhanavidhau phalakāmanaiva puṣkalādhikāranimittaṃ bhavati, kimitaradharmakalāpeneti satyam śāstrīye'dhikāranimitte saṅkīrtanādeva jīvanagṛhadāhādivadadhikāranimittamiti gamyate|
analyzed: nanu phala sādhana vidhau phala kāmanā eva puṣkala adhikāra nimittam bhavati kim itara dharma kalāpena iti satyam śāstrīya idhikāra nimitte saṅkīrtanāt eva jīvana gṛha dāha ādi vat adhikāra nimittam iti gamyate

original: nanu sādhanakalāpasyānuṣṭheyatayā tatra vidhiṃ parikalpya prayājādivat phalopakāryaṅgatvameva kalpyatām satyam aṅgasyāpipradoṣādikālavadadhikāraviśeṣaṇatvaṃ na virudhyate; śāntyādiguṇo bhūtvā paśyedityādiliṅgāt, dīkṣāyā apyuttarakratvadhikāranimittatādarśanāt| tasmād yuktamuktam -- nityānityavastuviveka iti||
analyzed: nanu sādhana kalāpasya anuṣṭheya tayā tatra vidhim parikalpya prayāja ādi vat phala upakāri aṅgatvam eva kalpyatām satyam aṅgasya api pradoṣa ādi kāla vat adhikāra viśeṣaṇatvam na virudhyate śānti ādi guṇaḥ bhūtvā paśyet ityādi liṅgāt dīkṣāyāḥ api uttarakratu adhikāra nimittatā darśanāt tasmāt yuktam uktam nitya anitya vastu vivekaḥ iti

original: "teṣu hi satsvi"tyuttaraṃ bhāṣyaṃ sādhanakalāpasya brahmānubhavaparyantavicārādisādhanapravṛtteranvayavyatirekasiddhadṛṣṭahetutāṃ pratipādayati| tad vyāvarṇayituṃ mumukṣutvamantareṇa tāvanna pravṛttirityāha -- uktaṃ purastādadhikārārthatva ityādinā|| tasmād mumukṣutvaṃ tāvadiṣyamāṇasādhane pravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ|

original: kiñca "yadi ha vā apyanevaṃvid mahatpuṇyaṃ karma karoti, taddhāsyāntataḥ kṣīyate" ityupakramya "sa ya ātmānameva lokamupāste na hāsya karma kṣīyate" iti vacanādātmopāsanākarmaṇa evāparokṣānubhavadvāreṇākṣayāvidyānivṛttiphalatvāt -- "na karma kṣīyate" ityupāsanākarmapraśaṃsāmātrametadupādīyate|
analyzed: kiñca yadi ha vai api anevaṃvid mahat puṇyam karma karoti tat ha asya antatas kṣīyate iti upakramya sa yaḥ ātmānam eva lokam upāste na ha asya karma kṣīyate iti vacanāt ātma upāsanā karmaṇaḥ eva aparokṣa anubhava dvāreṇa akṣaya avidyā nivṛtti phalatvāt na karma kṣīyate iti upāsanā karma praśaṃsā mātram etat upādīyate

analyzed: tatra ananya pratipādya tvāt sādhana antara nivṛtti rūpāt anyatvāt saṃbandhasya saḥ api pṛthak vaktavyaḥ iti darśayitum vipakṣe dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā sādhu śabda parijñānam ityādinā ayam arthaḥ vyākaraṇa ārambhāt prāk cikitsā vyāpārāt vyāpāra antaraiḥ asādhyam api sādhu śabda jñānam na cikitsā vyāpārasya viṣayaḥ

original: nanu -- na piturāhvāne tātparyahīne saṃsargabuddhiriti -- cet; na; utthānādipravṛttidarśanāt, pravṛtteśca saṃsargajñānapuraḥsaratvābhāve pravṛttyā saṃsarge śabdaśaktitātparyakalpanāyogāt| nanu śabdo na mithyājñānamutpādayati, naiṣa doṣaḥ; satyapi piturāhvāne tathābhūtajñāne ca tātparyaṃ vakturanyatretyetāvaddarśitam|

original: ayamāśayaḥ -- satyapi śarīre viṣayajñānānāmindriyairanvayavyatirekavattvāt karaṇatayā'nvayavyatirekavatvakalpanādāśrayatā'nvayavyatirekakalpanasyābhyarhitatvādindriyāṇyeva vijñānāśrayāṇīti|

original: nanu -- cetanatve'pyahaṃpratyayālambanasyaivātmatvam, tadabhāvānnendriyāṇāmātmatvamiti, tatrāha -- tathācendriyadharmasāmānādhikaraṇyamahaṃpratyayasyeti|| śarīrasyāpyahaṃpratyayālambanatvavijñānānvayavyatirekayorindriyātmanāmāśrayatvenāpyupapatteriti bhāvaḥ||

original: pakṣāntaramāha -- mata eva cetanamiti|| kimatra prāpakaṃ pramāṇamiti tadāha -- dṛśyate hi svapna iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- svapne cakṣurādyabhāve'pi kevale manasi vijñānālambanatvāhaṃpratyayaviṣayatvayoravikalayordarśanāt, rūpādivijñānānāṃ cakṣurādyāśrayatve tadabhāve kevale manasi rūpādismṛtyanupapatteḥ, āśrayāntare cāsiddhe cakṣurādīnāṃ

original: jñānānvayavyatirekayoḥ karaṇaviṣayatayā'pyanupapatteḥ, ahaṃpratyayasya ca deha iva karaṇe kartṛtvopacārāt siddheḥ, pratyabhijñāyāḥ śarīrādāvivaikatvanibandhanatvāt, ekāśrayatvātpratyabhijñāyāmekaprāsādasamāśritānāmapi tatprasaṅgāt| tasmāccakṣurādikaraṇaśarīrādhāraṃ mana evātmeti||

original: pakṣāntaramāha -- vijñānamātraṃ kṣaṇikamityeka iti|| varṇatrayaśabdena varṇatrayābhidheyaṃ vijñānamātramucyate| tena ca vijñānāśrayasyātmano'bhāva ucyata iti| katham śarīrendriyāṇāṃ tāvadvijñeyatvādavijñānasyānātmatvād manasaśca samanantarapratyayavyatirekiṇo'bhāvādāśrayāntarādarśanāditi| kastarhyātmeti tadāha tena vijñānameveti||

original: vijñānānāṃ hetuphalasantānamātrādeva karmaphalasambandha ityarthaḥ| nanu sthāyinyātmanyekasmin sarvametanmukhyamupapannamiti, tatrāha -- anubhavabhagnapakṣāntaramiti||

original: vipratipattyantaramāha -- asti dehādivyatirikta iti|| kathaṃ punarvijñānaśūnyavyatiriktasyātmanaḥ siddhiriti tadāha -- ahamullekhaśūnyasya bhoktṛtvasyeti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- ahamityavabhāsamāno viṣayasaṃvidāśrayatvena bhoktā na kadācidapi mamapratyayālambano bhoktṛtvamanubhavati| sa cābādhitapratyabhijñāgocaro na suṣupte'bhāvamanubhavitumarhati|

original: tatrāha -- yuktirapi lakṣaṇanirṇaye'rthāditi|| apiśabdāt pramāṇamapītyarthaḥ| atra tu sūtritayorbrahmaṇi pramāṇayuktyoradhyāyadvayena nirṇayaḥ kriyate| janmotpattirityārabhya tṛtīyaliṅgetyataḥ prāktanaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| tadguṇasaṃvijñāna iti|| viśeṣyaikadeśameva viśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā samāsa ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra āha yuktiḥ api lakṣaṇa nirṇaya ṛthāt iti apiśabdāt pramāṇam api iti arthaḥ atra tu sūtritayoḥ brahmaṇi pramāṇa yuktyoḥ adhyāya dvayena nirṇayaḥ kriyate janma utpattiḥ iti ārabhya tṛtīya liṅga iti atas prāktanaḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ tad guṇa saṃvijñāne iti viśeṣya eka deśam eva viśeṣaṇam kṛtvā samāsaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu evamapi janmasthitibhaṅgāstrayo'pi viśeṣyāḥ, tatkathamekatvanirdeśa iti ata āha -- tṛtīyaliṅgeti|| janmādīnāmādimadhyāvasānamākṣipati -- nanu ādiriti||
analyzed: nanu evam api janma sthiti bhaṅgāḥ trayaḥ api viśeṣyāḥ tat katham ekatva nirdeśaḥ iti atas āha tṛtīya liṅga iti janma ādīnām ādi madhya avasānam ākṣipati nanu ādiḥ iti

original: pariharati -- janmanaścāditvamiti|| bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- yadanena sūtreṇeti|| nanu sarvaṃ janitvaiva naśyati, na kiñcitkālaṃ tiṣṭhati; svasattāprayuktatvādvināśasyetyata āha -- kṣaṇikatvanirākaraṇāditi|| ato janitvetyādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu idaṃśabdaḥ kiñcideva sannihitaṃ gamayati nākhilaṃ jagadityata āha -- tathāhi sarvatreti||
analyzed: pariharati janmanaḥ ca ādi tvam iti bhāṣyam vyācaṣṭe yat anena sūtreṇa iti nanu sarvam janitvā eva naśyati na kiñcid kālam tiṣṭhati sva sattā prayukta tvāt vināśasya iti atas āha kṣaṇikatva nirākaraṇāt iti atas janitvā ityādiḥ spaṣṭa arthaḥ nanu idaṃśabdaḥ kiñcid eva sannihitam gamayati na akhilam jagat iti atas āha tathā hi sarvatra iti

original: nanu janmādīnāṃ jagataśca kaḥ sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vivakṣita iti tadāha -- sarvaṃ eveti|| nanu jagajjanmasthitibhaṅgaṃ kiṃsambandhitayā lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati na tāvat kākavallakṣyasambandhitayā; jagadāśrayatvāddharmāṇāmiti, kāraṇasambandhitayetyāha -- yata iti kāraṇanirdeśa iti||
analyzed: nanu janma ādīnām jagataḥ ca kaḥ sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vivakṣitaḥ iti tat āha sarvam eva iti nanu jagat janma sthiti bhaṅgam kiṃsambandhitayā lakṣaṇam bhavati na tāvat kāka vat lakṣya sambandhitayā jagat āśraya tvāt dharmāṇām iti kāraṇa sambandhitayā iti āha yatas iti kāraṇa nirdeśaḥ iti

original: nanu jagajjanmādikāraṇatvamapi lakṣaṇāntargatam āhosvillakṣyasvarūpāntargatam iti vaktavyam| nanu gṛhasya kākādhikaraṇatvaṃ nāma dharmaḥ kasminnantarbhavati lakṣya iti cet, kākādhikaraṇatvaṃ ca gṛhaśabdārthaḥ syāt| tataśca kākavigame gṛhaikadeśabhaṅgabuddhiḥ syāt| lakṣaṇāntargatamiti cet, kāraṇatvamapi tathā|
analyzed: nanu jagat janma ādi kāraṇatvam api lakṣaṇa antargatam āhosvit lakṣya svarūpa antargatam iti vaktavyam nanu gṛhasya kāka adhikaraṇa tvam nāma dharmaḥ kasmin antarbhavati lakṣye iti ced kāka adhikaraṇa tvam ca gṛha śabda arthaḥ syāt tatas ca kāka vigame gṛha eka deśa bhaṅga buddhiḥ syāt lakṣaṇa antargatam iti ced kāraṇatvam api tathā

original: nahi nānāvidhakāryākriyāveśātmakatvaṃ tatprasavaśaktyātmakatvaṃ vā jijñāsyaviśuddhabrahmāntargataṃ bhavitumarhati| tasmād jagajjanmādikāraṇatvamevopalakṣaṇamiti|| nanu nimittakāraṇatvamupādānakāraṇatvamubhayaṃ vopalakṣaṇatvenocyate na tāvannimittakāraṇatvameva brahmopalakṣaṇam;
analyzed: nahi nānāvidha kārya akriyā āveśa ātmaka tvam tad prasava śakti ātmaka tvam vā jijñāsya viśuddha brahma antargatam bhavitum arhati tasmāt jagat janma ādi kāraṇatvam eva upalakṣaṇam iti nanu nimitta kāraṇa tvam upādāna kāraṇa tvam ubhayam vā upalakṣaṇa tvena ucyate na tāvat nimitta kāraṇatvam eva brahma upalakṣaṇam

original: jagadabhinnasyopādānakāraṇasya bhedenāvasthānād brahmaśabdasya svārthānvayābhāvaprasaṅgāt| nāpyupādānakāraṇatvamupalakṣaṇam; nimittakāraṇasya sarvajñasya bhedenāvasthānād "yataḥ sarvajñāt sarvaśakteri"ti vyapadeśo na syāt; upādānakāraṇasya loke'cetanatvāt| "satyaṃ jñānamanantami"ti ca svarūpalakṣaṇasyobhayatrāyogāt|
analyzed: jagat abhinnasya upādānakāraṇasya bhedena avasthānāt brahma śabdasya svārtha anvaya abhāva prasaṅgāt na api upādānakāraṇa tvam upalakṣaṇam nimitta kāraṇasya sarvajñasya bhedena avasthānāt yatas sarvajñāt sarva śakteḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ na syāt upādānakāraṇasya loke cetana tvāt satyam jñānam anantam iti ca svarūpa lakṣaṇasya ubhayatra ayogāt

original: nāpyubhayakāraṇatvaṃ brahmopalakṣaṇam; ekasyobhayakāraṇatve pramāṇābhāvāt| pramāṇāntarasiddhaṃ hi lakṣaṇamanadhigatalakṣyasvarūpādhigamāyālam| na tāvadekasya jagannimittopādānatvamanumānenāvagantuṃ śakyam; dṛṣṭānte bhedadarśanāt| mahābhūtapañcakavyatirikteṣu padārtheṣu nānāvidhanimittopādānadarśanānna tadanuvādena brahma vidhātuṃ śakyam|
analyzed: na api ubhaya kāraṇatvam brahma upalakṣaṇam ekasya ubhaya kāraṇatve pramāṇa abhāvāt pramāṇa antara siddham hi lakṣaṇam anadhigata lakṣya svarūpa adhigamāya alam na tāvat ekasya jagat nimitta upādānatvam anumānena avagantum śakyam dṛṣṭānte bheda darśanāt mahābhūta pañcaka vyatirikteṣu padārtheṣu nānāvidha nimitta upādāna darśanāt na tad anuvādena brahma vidhātum śakyam

original: bhūtapañcakanimittopādānatvamekasyāprasiddhamiti, tatrāha -- prakṛtitvanibandhanā pañcamīti|| nimittatvasyāpyupalakṣaṇametat; ubhayatra pañcamīvidhānāt| bhūtapañcakasya tāvadekā prakṛtiranumīyate; sadvastvekasvabhāvānugamāt||
analyzed: bhūta pañcaka nimitta upādāna tvam ekasya aprasiddham iti tatra āha prakṛti tva nibandhanā pañcamī iti nimitta tvasya api upalakṣaṇam etat ubhayatra pañcamī vidhānāt bhūta pañcakasya tāvat ekā prakṛtiḥ anumīyate sat vastu eka svabhāva anugamāt

original: tathāhi -- mahābhūtāni, sadvastuprakṛtikāni, satsvabhāvānuraktatve sati, vividhavikāratvāt; mṛdanusyūtaghaṭādivat| dravyatvādyabhedā api prakṛtisvabhāvā eva sāmānyavadavabhāsante, sadvastu punaḥ sarvānugamātsarvavikāraprakṛtiḥ| bhautikānāṃ ca bhūtopādānatvaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ mūlaprakṛtyadhīnatāmeva sarvasya gamayati|
analyzed: tathā hi mahābhūtāni sat vastu prakṛtikāni sat svabhāva anurakta tve sati vividha vikāra tvāt mṛd anusyūta ghaṭa ādi vat dravya tva ādi abhedāḥ api prakṛti svabhāvāḥ eva sāmānya vat avabhāsante sat vastu punar sarva anugamāt sarva vikāra prakṛtiḥ bhautikānām ca bhūta upādāna tvam dṛśyamānam mūlaprakṛti adhīna tām eva sarvasya gamayati

original: ataḥ sarvakāryopādānamekameva lāghavāt, iti nyāyānugṛhītānumānena siddham| tasyaiva ca nimittakāraṇatvamanumānena kalpyate| tathācedaṃ jagat, abhinnanimittopādānaṃ bhavitumarhati, prekṣāpūrvajanitakāryatvāt; ātmagatasukhaduḥkharāgadveṣādivat| naca ghaṭādiṣvanaikāntikatā; tathāpyabhinnanimittopādānatvakalpanāt|
analyzed: atas sarva kārya upādānam ekam eva lāghavāt iti nyāya anugṛhīta anumānena siddham tasya eva ca nimitta kāraṇa tvam anumānena kalpyate tathā ca idam jagat abhinna nimitta upādānam bhavitum arhati prekṣā pūrva janita kāryatvāt ātma gata sukha duḥkha rāga dveṣa ādi vat na ca ghaṭa ādiṣu anaikāntika tā tathā api abhinna nimitta upādāna tva kalpanāt

original: adṛṣṭādinimittabhedo dṛśyata iti cet, na; upādānādhiṣṭhātrorevaikatvānumānāt| tasmādanumānenaiva
analyzed: adṛṣṭa ādi nimitta bhedaḥ dṛśyate iti ced na upādāna adhiṣṭhātroḥ eva ekatva anumānāt tasmāt anumānena eva

original: prasiddhamekasyobhayakāraṇatvaṃ lakṣaṇatvena nirdiśyate| sṛṣṭivākyaprasiddhaṃ caikasyobhayakāraṇatvaṃ lakṣaṇatvena nirdiśyate||
analyzed: prasiddham ekasya ubhaya kāraṇa tvam lakṣaṇa tvena nirdiśyate sṛṣṭi vākya prasiddham ca ekasya ubhaya kāraṇa tvam lakṣaṇa tvena nirdiśyate

original: tatra kecitpariṇāmavādamavatārayanti| taistatra pramāṇaṃ vaktavyam| sṛṣṭiśrutaya iti cet, na; tatrapariṇāmaśabdāśravaṇāt| satyato'nyathābhāvaḥ pariṇāmo brahmaṇo'pi satyataḥ prapañcāpattiṃ pratipādayatīti cet, na; tāsu satyaśabdāśravaṇāt| svataḥprāmāṇyāt tathābhūtaiva sṛṣṭiriti cet kimidaṃ tathābhūtatvaṃ nāma satyatvamiti cet, na;
analyzed: tatra kecid pariṇāma vādam avatārayanti taiḥ tatra pramāṇam vaktavyam sṛṣṭi śrutayaḥ iti ced na tatra pariṇāma śabda aśravaṇāt satyataḥ anyathābhāvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ brahmaṇaḥ api satyataḥ prapañca āpattim pratipādayati iti ced na tāsu satya śabda aśravaṇāt svatas prāmāṇyāt tathābhūtā eva sṛṣṭiḥ iti ced kim idam tathābhūta tvam nāma satya tvam iti ced na anyathā bhūta tvam iti ced na anyathā bhūta tvam nāma satya tvam iti ced na anyathā

original: "mithyedaṃ rajatami"ti viśiṣṭe'rthe pramāṇagamye svapnasṛṣṭāvapi satyabudhyabhāvāt| svopādhau svaviṣayābhāvavirodhiteti cet, na; māyātmakatve'pi samānam| sṛṣṭeśca svopādhāvabhāvavyāvṛttatvāt sarve ca sopādhikadharmāḥ svāśrayopādhāvabādhyatayā satyā bhavanti, sṛṣṭirapi svarūpeṇa na bādhyate, kintu paramārthasatyatvāṃśena||
analyzed: mithyā idam rajatam iti viśiṣṭa ṛthe pramāṇa gamye svapna sṛṣṭau api satya budhi abhāvāt sva upādhau sva viṣaya abhāva virodhi tā iti ced na māyā ātmaka tve api samānam sṛṣṭeḥ ca sva upādhau abhāva vyāvṛtta tvāt sarve ca sopādhika dharmāḥ sva āśraya upādhau abādhya tayā satyāḥ bhavanti sṛṣṭiḥ api svarūpeṇa na bādhyate kintu paramārtha satya tva aṃśena

original: nanu mithyāsṛṣṭiviṣayatve vākyasyāprāmāṇyaṃ syāt, na tat; pramāṇavyāpārānabhijño devānāṃ priyaḥ| pramāṇaṃ hi prameyābhāvaṃ na sahate, nāprameyābhāvam| naca sṛṣṭiśrutiḥ paramārthasatyatāṃ pramimīte; tadabhidhānābhāvāt| yathā "ghaṭaḥ" ityukte bhāvābhāvayoḥ sādhāraṇo'vabhāsate, anyatārābhidhānābhāvāt, tadvat|
analyzed: nanu mithyā sṛṣṭi viṣaya tve vākyasya aprāmāṇyam syāt na tat pramāṇa vyāpāra anabhijñaḥ devānām priyaḥ pramāṇam hi prameya abhāvam na sahate na aprameya abhāvam na ca sṛṣṭi śrutiḥ paramārtha satya tām pramimīte tad abhidhāna abhāvāt yathā ghaṭaḥ iti ukte bhāva abhāvayoḥ sādhāraṇā uvabhāsate anya tārā abhidhāna abhāvāt tadvat

original: na hi svapnaviṣayā sṛṣṭiśrutistatsatyatāṃ pratipādayati| prayojanaśūnyatayā tātparyahīnatvācca na brahmaṇaḥ prapañcāpattiṃ pratipādayati; anarthahetutvācca duḥkhatatsādhanapariṇāmasya| naca karmakāṇḍasya pratyakṣādervā siddhiḥ prayojanam; jagannityatayāpyupapatteḥ, sṛṣṭiśrutyavagamātprāgeva siddhatvācca|
analyzed: na hi svapna viṣayā sṛṣṭi śrutiḥ tad satya tām pratipādayati prayojana śūnyatayā tātparya hīna tvāt ca na brahmaṇaḥ prapañca āpattim pratipādayati anartha hetu tvāt ca duḥkha tad sādhana pariṇāmasya na ca karmakāṇḍasya pratyakṣa ādeḥ vā siddhiḥ prayojanam jagat nitya tayā api upapatteḥ sṛṣṭi śruti avagamāt prāk eva siddha tvāt ca

original: abhedasyāpi sattvādirūpeṇa siddhātvācca śabdāpekṣeti cet, keyamativyākulatā sarvasaṃkaravādinaḥ| na hi nityaśuddhabuddhamuktaniratiśayānandaprakāśamānasarvajñā'dvitīyapratyagātmabhūtaṃ brahmāvagamāt prāgeva sidhyati| kiṃ tarhi sṛṣṭiśruteḥ prayojanam|
analyzed: abhedasya api sattva ādi rūpeṇa śabda apekṣā iti ced kā iyam ati vyākula tā sarva saṃkara vādinaḥ na hi nitya śuddha buddha mukta niratiśaya ānanda prakāśamāna sarvajña advitīya pratyagātma bhūtam brahma avagamāt prāk eva sidhyati kim tarhi sṛṣṭi śruteḥ prayojanam

original: pratyakṣādisiddhaprapañcasya brahmaṇyevotpattivināśavattayā'nyatrābhāvamupavarṇya, tatrāpi pratiṣidhya, mithyātvāpādanena pramāṇāntarāviruddhatayā'dvitīyabrahmasvarūpasiddhiḥ prayojanam; tenaikavākyatvāt, anyathā śeṣivirodhāt| sṛṣṭyābhāsatvād rajatābhāsavat tajjñānasyāprāmāṇyamiti cet, na;
analyzed: pratyakṣa ādi siddha prapañcasya brahmaṇi eva utpatti vināśavattayā anyatra abhāvam upavarṇya tatra api pratiṣidhya mithyātva āpādanena pramāṇa antara aviruddha tayā advitīya brahma svarūpa siddhiḥ prayojanam tena eka vākya tvāt anyathā śeṣi virodhāt sṛṣṭi ābhāsa tvāt rajata ābhāsa vat tad jñānasya aprāmāṇyam iti cet na

original: satyarajatavanmukhyasṛṣṭyantarābhāvāt, tasyā eva mukhyasṛṣṭitvāt tajjñānavat prāmāṇyāt| "devadatto vyāghro'bhavat" "māyā hyeṣā mayā sṛṣṭe"tyādau mithyākārye'pi tadbhāvasṛṣṭiśabdayoḥ śravaṇāt||
analyzed: satya rajata vat mukhya sṛṣṭi antara abhāvāt tasyāḥ eva mukhya sṛṣṭi tvāt tad jñāna vat prāmāṇyāt devadattaḥ vyāghraḥ bhavat māyā hi eṣā mayā sṛṣṭā ityādau mithyā kārye pi tad bhāva sṛṣṭi śabdayoḥ śravaṇāt

original: kutaḥ punaḥ satyamithyāsādhāraṇyāṃ sṛṣṭau mithyātve pakṣapātaḥ "nāsadāsīnno sadā''sīttama āsīt" "āsīdidaṃ tamobhūtam" "māyāṃ tu prakṛtimi"tyādau sadasadvilakṣaṇānirvacanīyaprakṛtitvaśravaṇāt tadātmakatvācca vikārasya "tamo moho mahāmohastāmisro hyandhasaṃjñitaḥ| avidyā pañcaparvaiṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ"||
analyzed: kutas punar satya mithyā sādhāraṇyām sṛṣṭau mithyātve pakṣapātaḥ na asat āsīt no sat āsīt tamaḥ āsīt āsīt idam tamaḥ bhūtam māyām tu prakṛtim ityādau sat asat vilakṣaṇa anirvacanīya prakṛti tva śravaṇāt tad ātmaka tvāt ca vikārasya tamaḥ mohaḥ mahāmohaḥ tāmisraḥ hi andha saṃjñitaḥ avidyā pañca parvā eṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ

original: iti smṛteḥ, tamo'vidyā māyānāṃ paryāyatvāt| tadevaṃ śrutyavagatāyāṃ mithyāsṛṣṭau satyatvakalpanāyāṃ śrutibādhaprasaṅgāt| tathāca "asti ghaṭaḥ" ityastyarthopādhau pratipannasya ghaṭasya tadupādhāveva nāstīti pratyakṣeṇaiva bādho dṛśyate, deśakālayordeśakālāntarābhāvāttayordvayornirupādhikaniṣedhāt, astyarthasyānuyāyino niṣedhābhāvāt|
analyzed: iti smṛteḥ tamaḥ vidyā māyānām paryāya tvāt tat evam śruti avagatāyām mithyā sṛṣṭau satya tva kalpanāyām śruti bādha prasaṅgāt tathā ca asti ghaṭaḥ iti asti artha upādhau pratipannasya ghaṭasya tad upādhau eva na asti iti pratyakṣeṇa eva bādhaḥ dṛśyate deśa kālayoḥ deśa kāla antara abhāvāt tayoḥ dvayoḥ nirupādhika niṣedhāt asti arthasya anuyāyinaḥ niṣedha abhāvāt

analyzed: kiṃca śruti artha paratvāt sūtrāṇām śrutiḥ eva janma ādi sūtra mūlam iti āha tad artha nirṇaya artha tvāt iti

original: nanu bhūtabhautikamūlakāraṇaṃ na brahmeti pratipattuṃ yuktam; māyāyā api mūlakāraṇatvāt, "māyāṃ tu prakṛtami"ti śruteḥ| prakriyate'nayeti prakṛtiriti karaṇamātraṃ māyeti cet, na; prakṛtiśabdasyopādāne rūḍhatvād vyutpādanāyogāt| "ātmana ākāśaḥ" iti prakṛtyantaraśravaṇād vyutpādyata iti cet na;
analyzed: nanu bhūtabhautika mūlakāraṇam na brahma iti pratipattum yuktam māyāyāḥ api mūla kāraṇa tvāt māyām tu prakṛtam iti śruteḥ prakriyate nayā iti prakṛtiḥ iti karaṇa mātram māyā iti ced na prakṛti śabdasya upādāne rūḍha tvāt vyutpādana ayogāt ātmanaḥ ākāśaḥ iti prakṛti antara śravaṇāt vyutpādyate iti ced na

original: tulyaśrutitvānmāyāprakṛtitvavirodhāt, nimitte'pi pañcamī prayogāt, dṛśyamānajāḍyānusāreṇa ca māyopādānatvaniyamopapatteḥ| "indro māyābhiri"ti tṛtīyaiva śrūyata iti cet, satyam ātmano bahutvāpattau karaṇatā bhavati; prapañcopādānatve kā hāniḥ, nirapekṣaprakṛtidvayānupapattiriti cet, tarhi parasparaviśiṣṭatayā dvisūtrarajjuvatprakṛtitā syāt|
analyzed: tulya śruti tvāt māyā prakṛti tva virodhāt nimitte api pañcamī prayogāt dṛśyamāna jāḍya anusāreṇa ca māyā upādāna tva niyama upapatteḥ indraḥ māyābhiḥ iti tṛtīyā eva śrūyate iti ced satyam ātmanaḥ bahu tva āpattau karaṇa tā bhavati prapañca upādāna tve kā hāniḥ nirapekṣa prakṛti dvaya anupapattiḥ iti ced tarhi paraspara viśiṣṭa tayā dvi sūtra rajju vat prakṛti tā syāt

original: ato jagatkāraṇe brahmaṇi māyāyā api brahmatvaṃ lakṣitaṃ syāt| māyet prajñā'bhidhīyate| sā ca brahmacaitanyamevetyavirodha iti cet, na; anvayavyatirekavirodhāt| paridṛśyamānahastyaśvarathādau pratipannopādhau bādhite ca vṛddhavyavahāre'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ māyāśabdaḥ prayujyamāno dṛśyate| lokasaṃvedanavirodhācca|
analyzed: atas jagat kāraṇe brahmaṇi māyāyāḥ api brahmatvam lakṣitam syāt māyā id prajñā abhidhīyate sā ca brahma caitanyam eva iti avirodhaḥ iti ced na anvaya vyatireka virodhāt paridṛśyamāna hasti aśva ratha ādau pratipanna upādhau bādhite ca vṛddha vyavahāre nvaya vyatirekābhyām māyā śabdaḥ prayujyamānaḥ dṛśyate loka saṃvedana virodhāt ca

original: nahi prajñātiśayavantaṃ māyāvinaṃ vadanti| garhanti ca viduṣi māyāśabdaprayogam| buddhiviṣayatvānmāyāśabdasya na brahmacaitanyaprajñāya| prasaṅgaḥ| svapnādivividhamāyākārapratibhāsanādvā buddheḥ kāryavādinau māyāśabdasyopacārātkaraṇe prayoga ityanavadyam|
analyzed: nahi prajñā atiśayavantam māyāvinam vadanti garhanti ca viduṣi māyā śabda prayogam buddhi viṣaya tvāt māyā śabdasya na brahma caitanya prajñāya prasaṅgaḥ svapna ādi vividha māyā kāra pratibhāsanāt vā buddheḥ kārya vādinau māyā śabdasya upacārāt karaṇe prayogaḥ iti anavadyam

original: api ca "bhūyaścānte viśvamāyānivṛttiḥ" "māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te" "devī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā" "māyayā'pahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ"| iti nivartya tartavyatvaguṇamayatva jñānāvaraṇatvaliṅgācca na brahmacaitanyaṃ māyā| buddhireva māyeti cet, na; prakṛtiśabdavirodhāt| mantrauṣadhādimāyeti cet, na;
analyzed: api ca bhūyas ca ante viśva māyā nivṛttiḥ mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etām taranti te devī hi eṣā guṇa mayī mama māyā duratyayā māyayā apahṛta jñānā āsuram bhāvam āśritāḥ iti nivartya tartavya tva guṇa maya tva jñāna āvaraṇa tva liṅgāt ca na brahma caitanyam māyā buddhiḥ eva māyā iti ced na prakṛti śabda virodhāt mantra auṣadha ādi māyā iti ced na

original: dṛśyamānagandharvanagarādau māyāśabdaprayogāt, mantrauṣadhādau tadaprayogāt| tathā'pi jaḍātmikā māyāśaktiḥ pāramārthikīti cet, na; nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttama āsīdi"ti jagatprāgavasthāyāḥ sadasadvilakṣaṇānirvacanīyatvaśravaṇāt| loke ca hastyaśvarathādiṣu vyabhicāriṣu mithyāvastumātre'nuyāyini māyāśabdaprayogāt|
analyzed: dṛśyamāna gandharvanagara ādau māyā śabda prayogāt mantra auṣadha ādau tad aprayogāt tathā api jaḍa ātmikā māyā śaktiḥ pāramārthikī iti ced na na asat āsīt no sat āsīt tamaḥ āsīt iti jagat prāc avasthāyāḥ sat asat vilakṣaṇa anirvacanīya tva śravaṇāt loke ca hasti aśva ratha ādiṣu vyabhicāriṣu mithyā vastu mātra inuyāyini māyā śabda prayogāt

original: "taratyavidyāṃ vitatāṃ hṛdi yasminniveśite| yogī māyāmameyāya tasmai vidyātmane namaḥ"|| iti māyā'vidyayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyācca| tasmādanirvacanīyamāyāviśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ brahmeti prāptam, tatrāha -- ato yadavaṣṭambho viśvo vivartata iti||
analyzed: tarati avidyām vitatām hṛdi yasmin niveśite yogī māyām ameyāya tasmai vidyā ātmane namaḥ iti māyā avidyayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ca tasmāt anirvacanīya māyā viśiṣṭam kāraṇam brahma iti prāptam tatra āha atas yad avaṣṭambhaḥ viśvaḥ vivartate iti

original: traividhyamatra sambhavati -- rajjvāḥ saṃyuktasūtradvayavanmāyāviśiṣṭaṃ brahma kāraṇamiti vā, "devātmaśaktiṃ svaguṇairnigūḍhami"ti śrutermāyāśaktimatkāraṇamiti vā, jagadupādānamāyāśrayatayā brahma kāraṇamiti veti| tatra viśiṣṭapakṣe tathaiva brahmatvenopalakṣitasya jñānānandādisvarūpalakṣaṇena māyāniṣkarṣāllakṣaṇadvayena viśuddhabrahmasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: traividhyam atra sambhavati rajjvāḥ saṃyukta sūtra dvaya vat māyā viśiṣṭam brahma kāraṇam iti vā devātma śaktim sva guṇaiḥ nigūḍham iti śruteḥ māyā śaktimat kāraṇam iti vā jagat upādāna māyā āśrayatayā brahma kāraṇam iti vā iti tatra viśiṣṭa pakṣe tathā eva brahma tvena upalakṣitasya jñāna ānanda ādi svarūpa lakṣaṇena māyā niṣkarṣāt lakṣaṇa dvayena viśuddha brahma siddhiḥ

original: uttarapakṣayostu māyāyā brahmaparatantratvāttatkāryamapi brahmaparatantraṃ bhavati; yathāṃ'śutantratantvārabdho'pi paṭoṃ'śutantraḥ pratīyate| tataścotpadyamānakāryasya yad āśrayopādhi jñānānandalakṣaṇaṃ ca, tad brahmeti śuddhabrahmalābha iti, tadāha yadavaṣṭambha iti|
analyzed: uttara pakṣayoḥ tu māyāyāḥ brahma paratantra tvāt tad kāryam api brahma paratantram bhavati yathā aṃśu tantra tantu ārabdhaḥ api paṭaḥ oṃśu tantraḥ pratīyate tatas ca utpadyamāna kāryasya yat āśraya upādhi jñāna ānanda lakṣaṇam ca tat brahma iti śuddha brahma lābhaḥ iti tat āha yat avaṣṭambhaḥ iti

original: kecittu -- brahmaiva jagadākāreṇa pariṇamate mṛdiva ghaṭākāreṇeti -- vadanti, tad vyāvartayanti -- viśvo vivartata iti|| ekasya tattvādapracyutasya pūrvaviparītāsatyānekarūpāvabhāsau vivartaḥ| ekasya pūrvarūpaparityāgena satyarūpāntarāpattiḥ pariṇāmaḥ, tatra brahma na vivartate, kiṃtu pariṇamata eveti taistatra pramāṇaṃ vaktavyam| sṛṣṭiśruteḥ
analyzed: kecid tu brahma eva jagat ākāreṇa pariṇamate mṛd iva ghaṭa ākāreṇa iti vadanti tat vyāvartayanti viśvaḥ vivartate iti ekasya tattvāt apracyutasya pūrva viparīta asatya aneka rūpa avabhāsau vivartaḥ ekasya pūrva rūpa parityāgena satya rūpa antara āpattiḥ pariṇāmaḥ tatra brahma na vivartate kiṃtu pariṇamate eva iti taiḥ tatra pramāṇam vaktavyam sṛṣṭi śruteḥ

original: pariṇamata iti cet, sā khalu sṛṣṭiśrutiḥ jñānānandasatyaniravayavāparicchinnabrahmasvarūpasya pūrvasiddhasya parityāgena jaḍaduḥkhamithyāsāvayavaparicchinnakāryāpattiṃ brahmaṇo bravīti āhosvitpūrvasiddharūpāparityāgenaiva tadviparītakāryarūpāpattiṃ brahmaṇo bravīti iti vaktavyam| tatra pūrvaparityāge brahmasvarūpocchedātkāryamātrameva syāt|
analyzed: pariṇamataḥ iti ced sā khalu sṛṣṭi śrutiḥ jñāna ānanda satya niravayava aparicchinna brahma svarūpasya pūrva siddhasya parityāgena jaḍa duḥkha mithyā sa avayava paricchinna kārya āpattim brahmaṇaḥ bravīti āhosvit pūrva siddha rūpa aparityāgena eva tad viparīta kārya rūpa āpattim brahmaṇaḥ bravīti iti vaktavyam tatra pūrva parityāge brahma svarūpa ucchedāt kārya mātram eva syāt

original: punaḥ pralayāvasthāyāṃ jñānānandādirūpeṇa pariṇamata iti cet, anirmokṣaprasaṅgāt| "aja ātmā mahān dhruvaḥ" "na jāyate ce"tyādiśrutivirodhaśca syāt| atha pūrvaviparītabrahmasvarūpāparityāgenaiva kāryarūpāpattiṃ brūyāt sṛṣṭiśrutiḥ, evaṃ tarhi vivartaṃ pratipādayati; śuktikārajatamāyāvyāghrādiṣu vivartasya tallakṣaṇatvāt|
analyzed: punar pralaya avasthāyām jñāna ānanda ādi rūpeṇa pariṇamataḥ iti ced anirmokṣa prasaṅgāt ajaḥ ātmā mahān dhruvaḥ na jāyate ca ityādi śruti virodhaḥ ca syāt atha pūrva viparīta brahma svarūpa a parityāgena eva kārya rūpa āpattim brūyāt sṛṣṭi śrutiḥ evam tarhi vivartam pratipādayati śuktikā rajata māyā vyāghra ādiṣu vivartasya tad lakṣaṇa tvāt

original: atha sṛṣṭiśrutiḥ sṛṣṭimātraviṣayā, na pūrvasvarūpaparityāgāparityāgayorvyāpriyata iti cet, tathā'pi vyavasthitabrahmavākyairekavākyatvāt tatsvarūpāparityāgenaiva kāryarūpāpattiṃ brahmaṇo bruvāṇā vivartameva darśayatītyanavadyam|| yo'pi kaścidāha niravayavamapi pariṇamata iti|
analyzed: atha sṛṣṭi śrutiḥ sṛṣṭi mātra viṣayā na pūrva svarūpa parityāga aparityāgayoḥ vyāpriyate iti ced tathā api vyavasthita brahma vākyaiḥ ekavākya tvāt tad svarūpa aparityāgena eva kārya rūpa āpattim brahmaṇaḥ bruvāṇā vivartam eva darśayati iti anavadyam yaḥ api kaścid āha niravayavam api pariṇamate iti

original: tathāhihemadravye rūcakakāreṇa pariṇamamāne tadavayavā api pariṇameran navā iti vaktavyam| yadi pariṇameran, tarhi tadavayavā api tathā, iti niravayavaparyantaḥ pariṇāmaḥ syāt| atha na pariṇameran, tarhyavayavī na pariṇameta; āśrayavikāramantareṇāśritavikārāyogāt|
analyzed: tathā hi hema dravye rūcakakāreṇa pariṇamamāne tad avayavāḥ api pariṇameran navāḥ iti vaktavyam yadi pariṇameran tarhi tad avayavāḥ api tathā iti niravayava paryantaḥ pariṇāmaḥ syāt atha na pariṇameran tarhi avayavī na pariṇameta āśraya vikāram antareṇa āśrita vikāra ayogāt

original: tasmād yathā saṃyogo'vayavyekadeśasamavetaḥ paramparayā niravayavaparamāṇusaṃyogapuraḥsaraḥ, tathā niravayavapariṇāmapuraḥsaro'vayaviparaṇāma iti||
analyzed: tasmāt yathā saṃyogaḥ uvayavi eka deśa samavetaḥ paramparayā niravayava paramāṇu saṃyoga puraḥsaraḥ tathā niravayava pariṇāma puraḥsaraḥ uvayavi paraṇāmaḥ iti

original: sa vaktavyaḥ -- kaścāyaṃ pariṇāma iti yadi tāvat svāvayavānāṃ pūrvasaṃyogāt saṃyogāntarāpattyā vā'vayavāntarasaṃyogena vā saṃmūrchitāvayavatvaṃ pariṇāmaḥ, na tarhi niravayave pariṇāmaḥ; svāvayavābhāvānniravayavasya| nacāvayavānāṃ saṃyogāntareṇa saṃmūrchitatvamantareṇāvayavinaḥ pariṇāmo'vasthāntaraṃ vā'nyathābhāvo vā nirūpayituṃ śakyate|
analyzed: sa vaktavyaḥ kaḥ ca ayam pariṇāmaḥ iti yadi tāvat sva avayavānām pūrva saṃyogāt saṃyoga antara āpattyā vā avayava antara saṃyogena vā saṃmūrchita avayava tvam pariṇāmaḥ na tarhi niravayave pariṇāmaḥ sva avayava abhāvāt niravayavasya na ca avayavānām saṃyoga antareṇa saṃmūrchita tvam antareṇa avayavinaḥ pariṇāmaḥ avasthā antaram vā anyathābhāvaḥ vā nirūpayitum śakyate

original: naca vastuno vastvantarasaṃyogo vā parispando vā guṇāntarodayo vā pariṇāmaḥ; brahmaṇi teṣāmabhāvāt| ākāśe ca vastvantarasaṃyogini parispandamāne ca bhramare lauhityodaye ca ghaṭe dravye pariṇāmabuddhyabhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca vastunaḥ vastu antara saṃyogaḥ vā parispandaḥ vā guṇa antara udayaḥ vā pariṇāmaḥ brahmaṇi teṣām abhāvāt ākāśe ca vastu antara saṃyogini parispandamāne ca bhramare lauhitya udaye ca ghaṭe dravye pariṇāma buddhi abhāvāt

original: atha tadanuṣaktadravyāntarotpattiḥ pariṇāma iti, tatra kiṃ hemāvayavānāṃ rucakarūpeṇaiva pariṇāmaḥ kiṃ vā dravyāntararūpeṇa na tāvat dravyāntarūpeṇa; tatra rucakadravyātiriktakāryadravyādarśanāt, nāpi rucakākāreṇaiva; tasyāvayavipariṇāmatvāt, avayavānāṃ ca rucakānugamasya rucakānugatāvayavyanugamenaivānyathāsiddhatvāt|
analyzed: atha tad anuṣakta dravya antara utpattiḥ pariṇāmaḥ iti tatra kim hema avayavānām rucaka rūpeṇa eva pariṇāmaḥ kim vā dravya antara rūpeṇa na tāvat dravya anta rūpeṇa tatra rucaka dravya atirikta kārya dravya adarśanāt na api rucaka ākāreṇa eva tasya avayavi pariṇāma tvāt avayavānām ca rucaka anugamasya rucaka anugata avayavi anugamena eva anyathā siddha tvāt

original: naca rucakāvasthāvyatirekeṇa hemāvayavānāmavasthāntarāṇi dṛśyante yena pariṇāmabhedaḥ syāt| naca saṃyogabheda evāvayavapariṇāma ityuktam| nacāvayavi dravyaṃ vinā hemāvayavā rucakākāreṇa pariṇamanta iti yuktam; ārambhavādaprasaṅgāt| athādṛśyamāno'pyavayavapariṇāmo'vayavipariṇāmānupapattyā kalpyate;
analyzed: naca rucaka avasthā vyatirekeṇa hema avayavānām avasthā antarāṇi dṛśyante yena pariṇāma bhedaḥ syāt na ca saṃyoga bhedaḥ eva avayava pariṇāmaḥ iti uktam na ca avayavi dravyam vinā hema avayavāḥ rucaka ākāreṇa pariṇamantaḥ iti yuktam ārambha vāda prasaṅgāt atha adṛśyamānaḥ upi avayava pariṇāmaḥ uvayavi pariṇāma anupapattyā kalpyate

original: āśrayavikāramantareṇāśritavikārānupapatteḥ,naitatsāram; avayavijanmavināśayoravayavānāmapi tattantrāṇāṃ janmavināśaprasaṅgāt, avayavigamane'vayavānāṃ gamanavat| pariṇāmo'pi bhaviṣyatīti cet, na; avayavini ghaṭatvajātisamavāyinyavayavānāṃ ghaṭatvajātisamavāyābhāvāt|
analyzed: āśraya vikāram antareṇa āśrita vikāra anupapatteḥ na etat sāram avayavi janma vināśayoḥ avayavānām api tad tantrāṇām janma vināśa prasaṅgāt avayavi gamana ivayavānām gamana vat pariṇāmaḥ api bhaviṣyati iti ced na avayavini ghaṭa tva jāti samavāyini avayavānām ghaṭa tva jāti samavāya abhāvāt

original: nanu avayavānāmanyathābhāvamantareṇa kathamavayavinonyathābhāvaḥ nahi dravyasyāvasthāntaradravyāntarāpattivad nailyaṃ guṇāntaramāpadyate'vasthāntaraṃ vā| nacāvayavikāryavyatirekeṇāvayavānāṃ kāryaṃ dṛśyata ityuktam| na hi paṭe kāryāntarāvabhāse'pi tantavo'tantvātmanā'vabhāsante| paṭakārye tantvanugamaḥ svānugatānugamādanyathāsiddha ityuktam|
analyzed: nanu avayavānām anyathābhāvam antareṇa katham avayavinaḥ nyathābhāvaḥ nahi dravyasya avasthā antara dravya antara āpatti vat nailyam guṇa antaram āpadyate ivasthā antaram vā na ca avayavi kārya vyatirekeṇa avayavānām kāryam dṛśyate iti uktam na hi paṭe kārya antara avabhāse pi tantavaḥ tantu ātmanā avabhāsante paṭa kārye tantu anugamaḥ sva anugata anugamāt anyathā asiddhaḥ iti uktam

original: kiṃca avayavipariṇāmopādhāvevāyavapariṇāmo dṛṣṭaḥ, iti na nirupādhiniravayavātmapariṇāmasiddhiḥ|| yattu niravayavasaṃyogavatpariṇāma iti, tatrāpi dṛśyamāno'vayavisaṃyogo na paramāṇusamavetaḥ; tadgatarūpādivadapratyakṣatvaprasaṅgāt| nāpyavayavyekadeśasaṃyogena niravayave saṃyogaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyate;

original: tasmāduktāni tātparyaliṅgāni vedāntānāṃ brahmaṇi dṛśyante| tathāhi -- "sadeva saumyedamagra āsīdekamevādvitīyam" "aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasī"tyupakramopasaṃhārayoraikarūpyeṇa pratyāgātmādvitīyarūpaṃ brahmāvagamyate| tathā "aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasī"ti navakṛtvo'bhyasyate|

analyzed: jagat kāraṇa sāmānya anuvādena tatra jñāna ānanda śabdau ānanda viśeṣam gamayataḥ eka satya ananta śabdāḥ bheda mithyātva dvaita abhāva abhidhāna dvāreṇa tatra lakṣaṇayā vartante sarvajñaḥ sarva śaktiḥ ityādi śabdāḥ ca anirvacanīya prapañca upādhi tayā tatra vartante ayam ātmā tattvam asi ityādi śabdāḥ ca mukhya lakṣaṇābhyām brahmaṇi eva vartante iti

original: anekeṣāṃ padānāṃ lakṣaṇādidvāreṇaikarasavṛttitāyāmudāharaṇamāha| tatra dvividhā vākyapravṛttiḥ -- ekā brahmātmanorekatvaviṣayā, aparā satyajñānādilakṣaṇabrahmaviṣayā| tatra prathamaṃ brahmātmaikatve dṛṣṭāntamāha -- so'yamityādivākyasthapadānāmiveti|| tatra "so'yaṃ devadattaḥ" iti padatrayasyaikasmindevadatte paryavasānaṃ dṛśyate||
analyzed: anekeṣām padānām lakṣaṇa ādi dvāreṇa ekarasa vṛttitāyām udāharaṇam āha tatra dvividhā vākya pravṛttiḥ ekā brahma ātmanoḥ ekatva viṣayā aparā satya jñāna ādi lakṣaṇa brahma viṣayā tatra prathamam brahma ātma ekatve dṛṣṭāntam āha saḥ yam ityādi vākya stha padānām iva iti tatra saḥ yam devadattaḥ iti pada trayasya ekasmin devadatte paryavasānam dṛśyate

original: tathāhi -- pratyabhijñāyāmadhigatamekatvaṃ parasmai pratipādayati -- "so'yaṃ devadattaḥ" iti| tatra na taddeśakālayoretaddeśakālayāṃśca parasparaikyaṃ pratyabhijānāti; bhedapratyayāt| ata eva viśiṣṭayorapyaikyaṃ na pratyabhijñāyate, kintu so'yamiti viśiṣṭadvayopalakṣitaḥ pratyabhijñāgocaraḥ|

original: pratyabhijñātaṃ cārthaṃ parasmai "so'yami"ti viśiṣṭābhidhāyibhyāṃ padābhyāṃ svārthaikadeśaparityāgenaikadeśalakṣaṇayā devadattasvarūpaikyameva pratipādayati| nanu "so'yami"ti padārthayoryadaikyam, tadeva vākyenāpi pratipādyate cet, anuvādaprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: pratyabhijñātam ca artham parasmai saḥ yam iti viśiṣṭa abhidhāyibhyām padābhyām svārtha eka deśa parityāgena eka deśa lakṣaṇayā devadatta svarūpa aikyam eva pratipādayati nanu saḥ yam iti padārthayoḥ yat aikyam tat eva vākyena api pratipādyate ced anuvāda prasaṅgaḥ

original: naca devadattasyaikyadvayamasti, yena vākyaprameyamaparamaikyaṃ syāt, pratyabhijñāyāṃ tarhi katham na hyabhijñayoravagatadevadattaikyamasti| ekasya kāladvayasaṃbandhaḥ pratyabhijñāgocara iti cet, kāladvayasaṃbandhipadārthābhijñayoreva siddheḥ pariśeṣāttadaikyaṃ pratyabhijñāviṣayaḥ| tatra cānuvādo darśitaḥ||

analyzed: nanu sūtrakāra prāmāṇyāt eva āmnāyasya kriyā artha tvam siddham iti na iti āha na hi ekam api anyatas iti kaḥ tarhi āmnāya arthaḥ iti tat āha atas yat avagamayati iti nanu prameya viśeṣāt eva prāmāṇyam na avabodhāt na kāryasya api avabodha nibandhana tvāt iti āha tasmāt yathā kāryam iti na tarhi brahmaṇi śabdebhyaḥ pratītiḥ iti na iti āha pratītiḥ ca iti

original: nanu pravartanālakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyam, na bodhalakṣaṇamiti, netyāha -- pratyakṣādiṣvapīti|| nanu bhinnameva pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣādiṣu vastumātrāvabodhaprāmāṇyalakṣaṇam, pravṛttinivṛttī tu vastusvabhāvānurodhinyau na pramāṇaphalam, śabde tu punaḥ pravṛttinivṛttiphalaparyanta eva pramāṇavyāpāraḥ; śrotuḥ puruṣārthamuddiśya śabdaprayogāt|

original: dhyānaṃ nāma vastutattvamanapekṣyāropitaviṣayatayā'pi manaḥsaṃkalpapravāhaḥ, sa vidheya ityāha -- astu tarhi śabdāt pratipannasyeti|
analyzed: dhyānam nāma vastu tattvam an apekṣya āropita viṣaya tayā api manaḥ saṃkalpa pravāhaḥ sa vidheyaḥ iti āha astu tarhi śabdāt pratipannasya iti

original: virodhānutpatteḥ| nanu bhinnābhinnatā vākyārthaḥ kinna syāt na; tathā sati śarīrendriyaviśiṣṭasyaiva tvaṃpadārthasya brahmaṇo bhinnābhinnatvāttathaiva vākyārthasiddherlakṣaṇayā brahmātmajñānenādhyāsabādho na syāt, vartamānāpadeśināṃ phalavacanānāṃ yogyānupalabdhibādhāt, satyapi tattvajñāne na śāstradvandhanivṛttyavagamaḥ|

original: bhinnābhinne ca vākyārthe na tattvajñānād bhedāṃśanivṛttiḥ; tasya svaviṣayānāśakatvātkarmopāsanāparokṣānubhavānnivṛttikalpanā bhinnabhinnaviṣayāgamaviruddhā, āgamasya sarvakālaṃ bhedābhedaviṣayatvāt| yattvabhedāṃśena jñānamokṣādivyavahāro bhedāṃśena karmavidyādivyavahāra iti vyavasthā kalpyate; tanmandacetanopacchandanamātram|

original: tathāhiyadi bhedābhedābhyāmaṃśī jīvo'bhedāṃśaśca brahmaiva syāt, tadā sāvayavo jīvāṃśaśca brahmeti paṇḍitammanyasya hi parīto'rthaḥ saṃpadyeta| bhedāṃśasyābrahmatve'tyantabheda eva syāt| nacāṃśadvayasamudāyo jīvaḥ ; avastutvaprasaṅgāt| na cābhedāṃśa eva jīvaḥ; brahmaṇa eva jīvatvaprasaṅgāt| nacobhāvaṃśau; jīvadvayaprasaṅgāt|

original: na ca bhedāṃśa eva jīvaḥ; atyantabhedaprasaṅgāt| tatra tattvajñānamokṣādivyavahārā'siddhiḥ| bhedābhedāṃśāvabhinnau jīva iti cet, yadyabhinnāveva| jīvaḥ; tarhi brahmaiva jīva iti kuto bandhamokṣavyavahāravyavasthā atha bhedābhedāṃśau parasparaṃ bhinnābhinnāviti matam, naivam; bhedādyanavasthāprasaṅgāt|

original: atra kecidāhuḥ -- utpādyatve'pi mokṣasya nānityatādoṣaḥ; kriyāsādhyasyaivānityatvāt, mokṣasya jñānamātrasādhyatvāt, naca jñānamātrasādhyasyānityatvaṃ dṛṣṭam; nacāvidyānivṛttimātrameva jñānasādhyam; brahmabhāvasyāpi sādhyatvāt| nanu jīvasya brahmabhāvaḥ svābhāviko na sādhanīyaḥ, na; tādātmyasyaiva svābhāvikatvāt|

original: nanu saṃyogavibhāgapracayātirekiṇī keyaṃ kriyā nāma nanu calatīti pratyakṣamevaitaccalanam| satyam; tadapi saṃyogavibhāgālambanameva calanam| nanu sthāṇāvapi śyenasaṃyogavibhāgavati calatīti prasaṅgaḥ, na; svadeśasaṃyogavibhāgālambanatvātpratyayasya, sthāṇośca śyenadeśatvābhāvāt| sarvasya cākāśadeśatvāditi cet, na;

original: bahalāndhakārāvṛte tamasyapratīyamāne'pi khadyote calanabuddhidarśanāt| naca deśamapratītya tatsaṃyogavibhāgāḥ pratīyanta iti| tasmātsaṃyogavibhāgātiriktakriyālambanaścalatīti pratyayaḥ| yastu svadeśasaṃyogavibhāgābhyāṃ kriyāmanumimīte; katham dravyajanitau saṃyogavibhāgau, svāśraye kādācitkātiśayapurassarau;
analyzed: bahala andhakāra āvṛte tamasi a pratīyamāne api khadyote calana buddhi darśanāt na ca deśam a pratītya tad saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ pratīyante iti tasmāt saṃyoga vibhāga atirikta kriyā ālambanaḥ calati iti pratyayaḥ yaḥ tu sva deśa saṃyoga vibhāgābhyām kriyām anumimīte katham dravya janitau saṃyoga vibhāgau sva āśraye kādācitka atiśaya purassarau

original: vyavasthitadravye kādācitkatvāt, saṃyogavibhāgajanyakāryavaditi| tasya makarādiṣu jalapravāhādhāreṣu sthirācalāvayaveṣu svadeśajalasaṃyogavibhāgayoḥ satorapi teṣu kriyājñānābhāvādanaikāntikatā hetoriti|
analyzed: vyavasthita dravye kādācitkatvāt saṃyoga vibhāga janya kārya vat iti tasya makara ādiṣu jala pravāha ādhāreṣu sthira acala avayaveṣu sva deśa jala saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ satoḥ api teṣu kriyā jñāna abhāvāt anaikāntika tā hetoḥ iti

original: kiṃca saṃyogavibhāgaheturatiśayaḥ kriyābhidhānīyaḥ sthirādeva dravyādutpadyate atiśayāntaravato vā pūrvasminnavyavasthitadravyādeva kriyājanmavattata eva saṃyogavibhāgajanma syādityanaikāntikaḥ| atiśayāntarakalpanāyāmanavasthāpātaḥ|
analyzed: kiṃca saṃyoga vibhāga hetuḥ atiśayaḥ kriyā abhidhānīyaḥ sthirāt eva dravyāt utpadyate atiśaya antaravataḥ vā pūrvasmin avyavasthita dravyāt eva kriyā janma vat tatas eva saṃyoga vibhāga janma syāt iti anaikāntikaḥ atiśaya antara kalpanāyām anavasthā āpātaḥ

original: pādāśrayasya karmaṇo hi svāśrayāsambandhibhūtasamavāyipādasaṃyogārambhavat prayatnavadātmapādasaṃyogasyāpi bhūpādasaṃyogārambhasiddherna pādāśrayakarmātiśayāvakāśaḥ| tasmātpratyakṣaḥ kriyāpratyayaḥ||
analyzed: pāda āśrayasya karmaṇaḥ hi sva āśraya asambandhi bhūta samavāyi pāda saṃyoga ārambha vat prayatna vat ātma pāda saṃyogasya api bhū pāda saṃyoga ārambha siddheḥ na pāda āśraya karma atiśaya avakāśaḥ tasmāt pratyakṣaḥ kriyā pratyayaḥ

original: nanu kṣaṇikasya karmaṇaḥ kathamindriyasaṃyogajñānalakṣaṇakṣaṇadvayāvasthānam śabdavidyudādivadityavirodhaḥ|| tasmādasti kriyājñānavilakṣaṇeti| kiṃceti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| kiṃca "vedāntavijñānasuniścitārthāḥ" iti niścitārthaviṣayatattvajñānameva mokṣasādhanamuktam, tacca pramāṇajanyatve saṃbhavatītyāha -- evaṃ samyagjñānatvopapatteriti||
analyzed: nanu kṣaṇikasya karmaṇaḥ katham indriya saṃyoga jñāna lakṣaṇa kṣaṇa dvaya avasthānam śabda vidyut ādi vat iti avirodhaḥ tasmāt asti kriyā jñāna vilakṣaṇā iti kiṃca iti spaṣṭa arthaḥ kiṃca vedānta vijñāna su niścita arthāḥ iti niścita artha viṣaya tattva jñānam eva mokṣa sādhanam uktam tat ca pramāṇa janya tve saṃbhavati iti āha evam samyak jñāna tva upapatteḥ iti

original: dārṣṭāntikamāha -- evaṃ satīti||
analyzed: dārṣṭāntikam āha evam sati iti

original: nanu brahmajñāne vidhayaḥ śrūyante, tatkathaṃ tarkeṇa nirasyanta iti atrāha -- ataḥ śrūyamāṇā apīti|| nanu anuṣṭheyābhāvādvidherabhāve śabdasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāditi, netyāha -- ato'rthavādatayaiveti|| nanu arthavādāntaravatstāvakatve vidhipadamarthaśūnyaṃ syāditi, netyāha -- tadunmukhīkaraṇāditi||
analyzed: nanu brahma jñāne vidhayaḥ śrūyante tat katham tarkeṇa nirasyante iti atra āha atas śrūyamāṇāḥ api iti nanu anuṣṭheya abhāvāt vidheḥ abhāve śabdasya vaiyarthyam syāt iti na iti āha atorthavāda tayā eva iti nanu arthavāda antara vat stāvaka tve vidhi padam artha śūnyam syāt iti na iti āha tad unmukhīkaraṇāt iti

original: "tathāta śravaṇaṃ nāme"tyādinā yaiḥ śravaṇādibhirātmā saṃstūyate| tān vibhajya darśayati| nanu śravaṇādibhiḥ kiṃ śreyaḥ kriyate yenotkarṣavadbhireterviṣayīkaraṇādātmā stutaḥ syāditi, tadāha -- ato vākyārthe sthairyāditi|| nanu vidheyasyaivārthavādasaṃbandhaḥ; stute pravṛttiphalatvāt, na siddhavastunaḥ, ityākṣipati -- kaḥ punariti||
analyzed: tathā ata śravaṇam nāma ityādinā yaiḥ śravaṇa ādibhiḥ ātmā saṃstūyate tān vibhajya darśayati nanu śravaṇa ādibhiḥ kim śreyaḥ kriyate yena utkarṣavadbhiḥ eteḥ viṣayīkaraṇāt ātmā stutaḥ syāt iti tat āha atas vākya arthe sthairyāt iti nanu vidheyasya eva arthavāda saṃbandhaḥ stute pravṛtti phalatvāt na siddha vastunaḥ iti ākṣipati kaḥ punar iti

original: phalapraśaṃsāyā api pravṛttyupayogitvāt phalabhūtātmapraśaṃsāyā api śravaṇādipravṛttyupayogitvamupapadyata ityabhipretyāha -- idamatra prastutamityādi|| granthastu spaṣṭārthaḥ||
analyzed: phala praśaṃsāyāḥ api pravṛtti upayogi tvāt phala bhūta ātma praśaṃsāyāḥ api śravaṇa ādi pravṛtti upayogi tvam upapadyate iti abhipretya āha idam atra prastutam ityādi granthaḥ tu spaṣṭārthaḥ

original: nanu samyagdarśanasya phalarūpatvāt pramāṇādhīnatvāccāvidheyateti yuktā tasyārthavādatā, śravaṇādayastu kriyārūpatvātsamyagdarśanasya dṛṣṭadṛṣṭopakāritayā vidheyā eveti, tadāha -- etacca sarve prathamasūtreṇaiveti|| manananididhyāsanopabṛṃhitasya śravaṇasya samyagdarśanāya vidheyatvamaṅgīkṛtya prathamasūtraṃ pravṛttamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu samyak darśanasya phala rūpa tvāt pramāṇa adhīna tvāt ca avidheya tā iti yuktā tasya arthavāda tā śravaṇa ādayaḥ tu kriyā rūpa tvāt samyak darśanasya dṛṣṭa dṛṣṭa upakāri tayā vidheyāḥ eva iti tat āha etat ca sarve prathama sūtreṇa eva iti manana nididhyāsana upabṛṃhitasya śravaṇasya samyak darśanāya vidheya tvam aṅgīkṛtya prathama sūtram pravṛttam iti arthaḥ

original: vidhīnāmapi satāṃ stāvakatvamuktam, idānīṃ śabdasyārthāntaramāha -- apica naivāyamiti|| nanu mā bhūvan jñānavidhayaḥ, upāsanāvidhistu śrūyata iti, netyāha -- tenātmetyevopāsītetyādi|| sarvatraivakāraviśeṣaṇaśravaṇāt, ahamitisvabhāvaprāptapratyayāvṛttyanuvādena viṣayaviśeṣaḥ pratipādya iti -- ato hānopādānaśūnyetyupasaṃharati||
analyzed: vidhīnām api satām stāvaka tvam uktam idānīm śabdasya artha antaram āha apica na eva ayam iti nanu mā bhūvan jñāna vidhayaḥ upāsanā vidhiḥ tu śrūyate iti na iti āha tena ātmā iti eva upāsīta ityādi sarvatra evakāra viśeṣaṇa śravaṇāt aham iti svabhāva prāpta pratyaya āvṛtti anuvādena viṣaya viśeṣaḥ pratipādyaḥ iti atas hāna upādāna śūnyā iti upasaṃharati

original: bhāṣyaṃ vivṛṇoti -- tasyāyamartha iti|| uktametanmokṣaphalavidheyajñānabrahmarūpanirūpaṇāyāṃ vidhinirapekṣameva brahmaṇi vedāntāḥ pramāṇamiti dvitīyena varṇakena prathamena ca varṇakena pramāṇāntarānapekṣaṃ brahmaṇi prāmāṇyamuktam, idānīṃ tadubhayavarṇakārthamākṣipya samādhatte -- yadapi kecidāhurityādinā||
analyzed: bhāṣyam vivṛṇoti tasya ayam arthaḥ iti uktam etat mokṣa phala vidheya jñāna brahma rūpa nirūpaṇāyām vidhi nirapekṣam eva brahmaṇi vedāntāḥ pramāṇam iti dvitīyena varṇakena prathamena ca varṇakena pramāṇa antara anapekṣam brahmaṇi prāmāṇyam uktam idānīm tad ubhaya varṇaka artham ākṣipya samādhatte yat api kecid āhuḥ ityādinā

original: katham kimahaṃpratyayāvaseya evātmā vedāntaiḥ pratipādyate kiṃ vā tadvyatiriktaḥ yadyādyaḥ, tadā tasya kriyāyāmaṅgatvādvidhivākyairvedāntānāmekavākyatā syāt| atha tadvyatiriktaḥ pratipādyate, tadā kiṃciduddiśya kiṃcitpratipādyamityuddeśatā'bhāvātpratipādanaṃ na syāt| tasyāpi cetanatve karmānaṅgataiva syāt| tasmātkriyāyāmeva vedāntāḥ pramāṇam|
analyzed: katham kim ahaṃpratyaya avaseyaḥ eva ātmā vedāntaiḥ pratipādyate kim vā tad vyatiriktaḥ yadi ādyaḥ tadā tasya kriyāyām aṅga tvāt vidhi vākyaiḥ vedāntānām ekavākyatā syāt atha tad vyatiriktaḥ pratipādyate tadā kiṃcid uddiśya kiṃcid pratipādyam iti uddeśa tā bhāvāt pratipādanam na syāt tasya api cetana tve karma anaṅga tā eva syāt tasmāt kriyāyām eva vedāntāḥ pramāṇam

original: tathāca karmaṇyeva kṛtsnasya vedasya prāmāṇyamāpastambho darśayati -- traividyavṛddhānāṃ tu vedāḥ pramāṇamiti niṣṭhā| tatra yāni śrūyante vrīhiyavapaśvājyapayaḥ kapālapatnīsaṃbandhānyuccairnnīcaiḥ kāryamiti, tairviruddha ācāro'pramāṇamiti manyata iti| tathā "cāgnihotraphalā vedāḥ śīlavṛttaphalaṃ śrutami"ti||
analyzed: tathā ca karmaṇi eva kṛtsnasya vedasya prāmāṇyam āpastambhaḥ darśayati traividya vṛddhānām tu vedāḥ pramāṇam iti niṣṭhā tatra yāni śrūyante vrīhi yava paśu ājya payaḥ kapāla patnī saṃbandhāni uccais nnīcais kāryam iti taiḥ viruddhaḥ ācāraḥ upramāṇam iti manyate iti tathā ca agnihotra phalāḥ vedāḥ śīla vṛtta phalam śrutam iti

original: tatrottaramāha -- tannopaniṣadasyetyādinā|| ahaṃpratyayāvaseyādviśiṣṭātmano'nya eva kriyākārakasaṃsargaśūnyaḥ, na sa karmāṅgatayā vedāntānāṃ vidhiśeṣatāṃ nayatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra uttaram āha tat na upaniṣadasya ityādinā ahaṃpratyaya avaseyāt viśiṣṭa ātmanaḥ nyaḥ eva kriyā kāraka saṃsarga śūnyaḥ na sa karma aṅga tayā vedāntānām vidhi śeṣa tām nayati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu asāvapi cetanaścedahaṃpratyayagamyatayā karmāṅgamiti, netyāha -- na sa kenaciditi|| nanu śāstragamyasyāpi karmāṅgatā kiṃ na syāditi ata āha -- na hi pramāṇāntarāsiddha iti|| adhikāriṇaṃ kartāraṃ ca pramāṇāntarasiddhāvanūdya vidhimātrapratipādanānyathā vākyabhedāditi|
analyzed: nanu asau api cetanaḥ ced ahaṃpratyaya gamya tayā karma aṅgam iti na iti āha na sa kenacid iti nanu śāstra gamyasya api karma aṅgatā kim na syāt iti atas āha na hi pramāṇa antara asiddhaḥ iti adhikāriṇam kartāram ca pramāṇa antara siddhau anūdya vidhi mātra pratipādana anyathā vākya bhedāt iti

original: nanu cetanaḥ pramāṇāntarāgamyatvācchāstreṇāpi na gamyata iti, netyāha -- naca sa na pratīyata iti|| nanu sarvo vedo dharme viniyuktaḥ smṛtikārairityuktam, ata āha -- ata evaupaniṣadatveti|| aupaniṣada iti taddhitapratyayo brahmaṇi vedāntānviniyuṅkte|

original: nanu dṛśyate bhinnābhinnaṃ vastu pratyakṣeṇa, kiṃ tat pratyakṣam na tāvat khaṇḍo gauriti bhinnābhinnaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam; tathā pratibhāsābhāvāt| nanu itaretarātmanaivābhedaḥ pratibhāsate, tarhītaretarānātmanābhedo'pyavabhāseta| nanu rūpabhedena bhedo'vabhāsate tarhi rūpaikyādebhedo vaktavyaḥ|
analyzed: nanu dṛśyate bhinna abhinnam vastu pratyakṣeṇa kim tat pratyakṣam na tāvat khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ iti bhinna abhinna viṣayam pratyakṣam tathā pratibhāsa abhāvāt nanu itaretara ātmanā eva abhedaḥ pratibhāsate tarhi itaretara an ātmanā abhedaḥ upi avabhāseta nanu rūpa bhedena bhedaḥ uvabhāsate tarhi rūpa aikyāt ebhedaḥ vaktavyaḥ

original: athetaretarātmatvādabhedaḥ, rūpabhedād bheda iti, kva dṛṣṭamitaretarātmatvamabheda iti na tāvadeko ghaṭa ityatra dṛśyate| tasmātkhaṇḍo gauriti na bhedābhedāvabhāsaḥ||
analyzed: atha itaretarātma tvāt abhedaḥ rūpa bhedāt bhedaḥ iti kva dṛṣṭam itaretarātma tvam abhedaḥ iti na tāvat ekaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti atra dṛśyate tasmāt khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ iti na bheda abheda avabhāsaḥ

original: syādetat -- khaṇḍo gauriti pratyayābhyāṃ bhedābhedāvabhāsa iti, na; jñānayoḥ saṃbhūya pramāpakatvābhāvāt, pratyabhijñāmantareṇaikasyobhayasambandhāsiddheḥ| tarhi pratyayatrayeṇārthād bhedābhedasiddhiriti, pratyakṣaṃ tāvat parāhatam|
analyzed: syāt etat khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ iti pratyayābhyām bheda abheda avabhāsaḥ iti na jñānayoḥ saṃbhūya pramāpaka tva abhāvāt pratyabhijñām antareṇa ekasya ubhaya sambandha asiddheḥ tarhi pratyaya trayeṇa arthāt bheda abheda siddhiḥ iti pratyakṣam tāvat parāhatam

original: khaṇḍasya gośca tadubhayālambanapiṇḍasya ca trayāṇāṃ pratyakṣe'vabhāsanātsamānādhikaraṇyasya ca tadubhayāśrayapiṇḍālambanatvāt| na cārthāpattirapi; "hṛsvo'kāraḥ" "dīrgho'kāraḥ" "sa evāyamakāraḥ" iti pratyayatrayeṇāpi bhedābhedāsiddherbhrāntimātratvopagamāt| tasmānna bhinnābhinnaṃ vastu| nāpyātmani bhedaḥ pramātuṃ śakyaḥ;
analyzed: khaṇḍasya goḥ ca tad ubhaya ālambana piṇḍasya ca trayāṇām pratyakṣa iva bhāsanāt samāna adhikaraṇyasya ca tad ubhaya āśraya piṇḍa ālambana tvāt na ca arthāpattiḥ api hṛsvaḥ ukāraḥ dīrghaḥ ukāraḥ saḥ eva ayam akāraḥ iti pratyaya trayeṇa api bheda abheda asiddheḥ bhrānti mātra tva upagamāt tasmāt na bhinna abhinnam vastu na api ātmani bhedaḥ pramātum śakyaḥ

original: vivādagocarāpannāḥ, sthāvarajaṅgamaśarīravyaktayaḥ, prativādiśarīravyaktyātmanaivātmavatyaḥ, śarīravyaktitvāt; prativādiśarīravyaktivadityekātmatvānumānāt; yugapajjananamaraṇādiviruddhadharmāśrayatvādagnyudakādivaddharmibhedo'numīyata iti cet, na; śarīrāśrayatayā vyadhikaraṇāsiddhatvāt|
analyzed: vivāda gocara āpannāḥ sthāvara jaṅgama śarīra vyaktayaḥ prativādi śarīra vyakti ātmanā eva ātmavatyaḥ śarīra vyakti tvāt prativādi śarīra vyakti vat iti eka ātma tva anumānāt yugapad janana maraṇa ādi viruddha dharma āśraya tvāt agni udaka ādi vat dharmi bhedaḥ numīyate iti ced na śarīra āśraya tayā vyadhikaraṇa asiddha tvāt

original: pratiśarīraṃ sukhaduḥkhādyanubhavānanusandhānānanusandhānairdraṣṭṛbhedaiḥ kalpyata iti cet, na; śarīrabhede satyekasyāpyātmano janmāntarīyānanusandhānādidarśanāt, satyapyekatve pratibimbabhedeṣu varṇasaṃkarādarśanāt| naca jīvabrahmabhedo'pi pratyakṣasiddhaḥ, viruddhadharmāśrayatvād bhedānumāne bimbapratibimbayoranaikāntikatvāt|
analyzed: pratiśarīram sukha duḥkha ādi anubhava ananusandhāna ananusandhānaiḥ draṣṭṛ bhedaiḥ kalpyate iti ced na śarīra bhede sati ekasya api ātmanaḥ janma antarīya ananusandhāna ādi darśanāt sati api ekatve pratibimba bhedeṣu varṇa saṃkara adarśanāt na ca jīva brahma bhedaḥ api pratyakṣa siddhaḥ viruddha dharma āśraya tvāt bheda anumāne bimba pratibimbayoḥ anaikāntika tvāt

original: niyantṛniyantavyeśitrīśitavyadraṣṭṛdṛśyādīnāṃ bhedaliṅgatvājjīvabrahmabheda iti cet, na; "nānyo'to'sti draṣṭe"tyādiśrutyaiva bhedapratiṣedhe liṅgād bhedānumiterayogāt, atulyapramāṇatvācca bhedābhedakalpanāyogāt| "dvā suparṇā" iti dvitvasaṃkhyā śrūyata iti cet, na;
analyzed: niyantṛ niyantavya īśitṛ īśitavya draṣṭṛ dṛśya ādīnām bheda liṅga tvāt jīva brahma bhedaḥ iti ced na draṣṭā ityādi śrutyā eva bheda pratiṣedhe liṅgāt bheda anumiteḥ ayogāt atulya pramāṇa tvāt ca bheda abheda kalpanā ayogāt dvā suparṇāḥ iti dvitva saṃkhyā śrūyate iti ced na

original: "yaścāyaṃ puruṣe yaścāsāviditye sa ekaḥ" ityekatvaṃsaṃkhyāśravaṇād bhrāntisiddhadvitvānuvādādekatvam; nānātve pramāṇābhāvāt| pratyakṣeṇa bhedagrahaṇe bhedasya dharmipratiyogikatvavyavasthāpekṣatvāt tadvyavasthāyāśca bhedāpekṣatvāditaretarāśrayatvāt| tasmānna bhedābhedau, ityadvaitadarśanena dvaitadarśanabādhaḥ|
analyzed: yaḥ ca ayam puruṣe yaḥ ca asau iditye saḥ ekaḥ iti ekatva saṃkhyā śravaṇāt bhrānti siddha dvitva anuvādāt ekatvam nānātve pramāṇa abhāvāt pratyakṣeṇa bheda grahaṇe bhedasya dharmi pratiyogikatva vyavasthā apekṣa tvāt tad vyavasthāyāḥ ca bheda apekṣa tvāt itaretara āśraya tvāt tasmāt na bheda abhedau iti advaita darśanena dvaita darśana bādhaḥ

original: pratyakṣabhramasya cāptavacanena bādhadarśanātphalavacanānāṃ ca vartamānāpadeśitayā yogyānupalabdhivirodhād dṛṣṭadvāreṇa bandhanivṛttireva mokṣa iti||
analyzed: pratyakṣa bhramasya ca āpta vacanena bādha darśanāt phala vacanānām ca vartamāna apadeśi tayā yogya anupalabdhi virodhāt dṛṣṭa dvāreṇa bandha nivṛttiḥ eva mokṣaḥ iti

original: apicāhuriti ślokatrayasya tātparyamāha -- gauṇamithyātmana ityādinā|| ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- tadetaddraḍhayannāheti|| dvitīyaślokasya tātparyamāha -- kathamidānīmasya prāmāmaṇyamityādinā||
analyzed: api ca āhuḥ iti śloka trayasya tātparyam āha gauṇa mithyā ātmanaḥ ityādinā ślokam vyācaṣṭe tat etat draḍhayan āha iti dvitīya ślokasya tātparyam āha katham idānīm asya prāmāmaṇyam ityādinā

original: tṛtīyaślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- advitīyaniratiśayānandacaitanyaikatānasarvajñasarveśvarasarvaśaktiniravayavasvacchāsaṅgapratyagbhūtabrahmātmanyaparokṣānubhavātprāg dehātmapratyayavat sarvo vyavahāro yathādarśanamupapadyate| tasmiṃścāparokṣe'vabhāsamāne pramātṛtvādibādhāt sarvo vyavahāro nivartata iti ślokārthaḥ||
analyzed: tṛtīya ślokam vyācaṣṭe advitīya niratiśaya ānanda caitanya ekatāna sarvajña sarva īśvara sarva śakti niravayava su acchā saṅga pratyak bhūta brahma ātmani aparokṣa anubhavāt prāk deha ātma pratyaya vat sarvaḥ vyavahāraḥ yathādarśanam upapadyate tasmin ca aparokṣa iva bhāsamāne pramātṛ tva ādi bādhāt sarvaḥ vyavahāraḥ nivartate iti śloka arthaḥ

original: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānanyānubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe samanvayādhikaraṇaṃ nāma navamaṃ varṇakaṃ samāptam||
analyzed: iti śrīmat paramahaṃsa parivrājaka ananya anubhava pūjya pāda śiṣya sva prakāśa anubhava bhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikā vivaraṇe samanvayādhikaraṇam nāma navamam varṇakam samāptam
